en.s: The Missouri gubernatorial election of 1920 was Missouri's thirtieth gubernatorial election. The election was held on November 2, 1920 and resulted in a victory for the Republican nominee, Arthur M. Hyde, over the Democratic candidate, John M. Atkinson, and several other candidates representing minor parties. This was the first Missouri gubernatorial election in which more than one million votes were cast, mostly a result of the increased turnout compared to previous elections, due to the 1919 passage and August 18, 1920 ratification of the Nineteenth Amendment to the U.S. Constitution, giving women the right to vote.

zh.s: 1920年密苏里州州长选举是该州第30次州长选举，于1920年11月2日举行。共和党候选人阿瑟·M·海德获胜，击败民主党候选人约翰·M·阿特金森及数名小党候选人。这是密苏里州首次有超过100万张选票的州长选举。主要原因是选民参与度提高；美国宪法《第十九修正案》于1919年提出并于1920年8月18日批准，赋予女性投票权。

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1920 was the 34th quadrennial presidential election, held on Tuesday, November 2, 1920. The Republicans nominated newspaper publisher and Ohio Senator Warren G. Harding, while the Democrats chose newspaper publisher and Ohio Governor James M. Cox. Incumbent President Woodrow Wilson, a Democrat, in poor health, chose not to run for a third term. Former president Theodore Roosevelt had been the front runner for the Republican nomination, but his health collapsed in 1918. He died in January 1919, leaving no obvious heir to his progressive legacy.

zh.s: 1920年美国总统选举是美国第34次四年一度的总统选举，于1920年11月2日星期二举行。共和党提名报纸出版商、俄亥俄州参议员沃伦·G·哈定；民主党提名报纸出版商、俄亥俄州州长詹姆斯·M·考克斯。健康状况不佳的民主党籍现任总统伍德罗·威尔逊没有寻求第三个任期。前总统西奥多·罗斯福原本是共和党提名的领跑者，但他在1918年健康恶化，并于1919年1月去世，没有留下明显的进步主义政治继承人。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Mexico, 1920
en.s: The 1920 United States presidential election in New Mexico took place on November 2, 1920. All 48 States were part of the United States presidential election. New Mexico voters chose three electors to represent them in the Electoral College, which voted for President and Vice President. New Mexico was won by Ohio Senator Warren G. Harding, in a strong 10 point lead against Ohio Governor James M. Cox. While the Farmer-Labor Party was the leading third-party in New Mexico, the election was spearheaded by both parties attacking Eugene V. Debs of the Socialist Party, and a call for a return to political normalcy in the wake of World War I.

zh.t: 1920年美国新墨西哥州总统选举
zh.s: 1920年美国新墨西哥州总统选举于1920年11月2日举行，当时全部48个州都参加了美国总统选举。新墨西哥州选民选出3名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。俄亥俄州参议员沃伦·G·哈定以10个百分点的优势赢得该州，击败俄亥俄州州长詹姆斯·M·考克斯。农民—劳工党是新墨西哥州领先的第三党。这次选举中，两大党都把抨击社会党候选人尤金·V·德布斯和呼吁一战后恢复政治常态作为竞选重点。

en.t: United States presidential election in Minnesota, 1920
en.s: The 1920 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 2, 1920 in Minnesota as part of the 1920 United States presidential election. The Republican candidate, U.S. Senator Warren G. Harding of Ohio won the state over former Ohio governor James M. Cox by a margin of 376,427 votes, or 51.16%. Nationally, Harding won the election, with 404 electoral votes and a landslide 26.17% lead over Cox in the popular vote. Cox did not win a single state north of the Mason-Dixon line. Nationally, Harding's victory in 1920 still holds the record for the greatest margin of victory in any United States presidential election held since James Monroe's uncontested re-election in 1820.

zh.t: 1920年美国明尼苏达州总统选举
zh.s: 1920年美国明尼苏达州总统选举于1920年11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。共和党候选人、俄亥俄州参议员沃伦·G·哈定以376,427票的优势赢得该州，得票率领先前俄亥俄州州长詹姆斯·M·考克斯51.16个百分点。全国范围内，哈定获得404张选举人票，以普选票领先考克斯26.17个百分点的压倒性优势获胜。考克斯在梅森—迪克森线以北没有赢得任何州。自詹姆斯·门罗1820年无竞争连任以来，哈定在1920年取得的胜差仍是美国总统选举中最大的。

en.s: The 1920 Montana gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 1920. Incumbent Governor of Montana Sam V. Stewart, who was first elected Governor in 1912 and 1916, declined to run for re-election. To replace him, former United States Senator Joseph M. Dixon won the Republican primary, which was closely contested. In the general election, he faced Burton K. Wheeler, the former United States Attorney for the District of Montana and the Democratic nominee. Ultimately, Dixon defeated Wheeler by a wide margin to win his first and only term as governor.

zh.s: 1920年蒙大拿州州长选举于1920年11月2日举行。现任州长萨姆·V·斯图尔特曾于1912年和1916年当选，这次没有寻求连任。前美国参议员约瑟夫·M·迪克森在竞争激烈的共和党初选中胜出，代表共和党参加大选，对手是前蒙大拿州联邦检察官、民主党候选人伯顿·K·惠勒。最终，迪克森以较大优势击败惠勒，赢得其唯一一个州长任期。

en.s: The 1920 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 1920 for the post of the Governor of Arizona. Thomas Campbell won a second term in office, winning a full majority of the popular vote for the first time in three consecutive elections. He beat the sole challenger, Secretary of State Mit Simms. This would be the last office Campbell would win, while Sims would return in the 1930s to win several terms in his old offices of Treasurer and Secretary of State Thomas Campbell was sworn in for his second term on January 3, 1921.

zh.s: 1920年亚利桑那州州长选举于1920年11月2日举行，选出州长。托马斯·坎贝尔成功连任，这是他连续三次参加选举以来首次获得普选票绝对多数。他击败了唯一的对手、州务卿米特·西姆斯。这是坎贝尔最后一次赢得公职；西姆斯在20世纪30年代重返政坛，先后多次当选财政部长和州务卿。托马斯·坎贝尔于1921年1月3日宣誓就任第二个任期。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Jersey, 1920
en.s: The 1920 United States presidential election in New Jersey took place on November 2, 1920. All contemporary 48 states, were part of the 1920 United States presidential election. New Jersey voters chose 14 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New Jersey was won in a landslide by the Republican nominees, Senator Warren G. Harding of Ohio and his running mate Governor Calvin Coolidge of Massachusetts. Harding and Coolidge defeated the Democratic nominees, Governor James M. Cox of Ohio and his running mate Assistant Secretary of the Navy Franklin D. Roosevelt of New York.

en.t: United States Senate special election in Virginia, 1920
en.s: The 1920 United States Senate special election in Virginia was held on November 2, 1920. Appointed Democratic Senator Carter Glass defeated Republican J. R. Pollard and was elected to finish the term of Democrat Thomas S. Martin, who died the previous year. Glass and fellow Senator Claude A. Swanson were the first U.S. Senators to be elected by popular vote (Martin ran unopposed in 1918) following the passage of the 17th Amendment.

Kansas voters chose ten electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Kansas voted for the Republican nominee, Ohio Senator Warren G. Harding, over the Democratic nominee, Ohio Governor James M. Cox.

zh.t: 1920年美国总统选举堪萨斯州结果
zh.s: 1920年美国总统选举堪萨斯州投票于1920年11月2日举行，是1920年美国总统选举的一部分。堪萨斯州选民选出10名总统选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。堪萨斯州选民选择共和党候选人、俄亥俄州参议员沃伦·G·哈定，而非民主党候选人、俄亥俄州州长詹姆斯·M·考克斯。

en.t: 1920 United States presidential election in Iowa
en.s: The 1920 United States presidential election in Iowa took place on November 2, 1920, as part of the 1920 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose 13 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Iowa voted for the Republican nominee, Senator Warren G. Harding of Ohio, over the Democratic nominee, Governor James M.

zh.s: 1920年美国艾奥瓦州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年在美国48个州举行的总统选举的一部分。选民选出13名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。艾奥瓦州支持共和党候选人、俄亥俄州参议员沃伦·G·哈定，胜过民主党候选人、州长詹姆斯·M·考克斯。

en.t: 1920 United States presidential election in Colorado
en.s: The 1920 United States presidential election in Colorado was held on November 2, 1920, as part of the 1920 United States presidential election. State voters chose six electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president.

zh.t: 1920年美国总统选举科罗拉多州结果
zh.s: 1920年美国总统选举科罗拉多州投票于1920年11月2日举行，是1920年美国总统选举的一部分。科罗拉多州选民选出6名总统选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。

en.t: 1920 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 2, 1920, as part of the 1920 United States presidential election. The Republican ticket of the junior U.S. senator from Ohio Warren G. Harding and the governor of Massachusetts Calvin Coolidge defeated the Democratic ticket of the governor of Ohio James M. Cox and the assistant secretary of the Navy Franklin D. Roosevelt.

zh.t: 1920年美国总统选举印第安纳州结果
zh.s: 印第安纳州于1920年11月2日举行总统选举，作为1920年美国总统选举的一部分。共和党候选人搭档沃伦·G·哈定和卡尔文·柯立芝分别是俄亥俄州初级联邦参议员和马萨诸塞州州长；他们击败了民主党候选人搭档俄亥俄州州长詹姆斯·M·考克斯和海军助理部长富兰克林·D·罗斯福。

en.s: The 1920 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1920. Incumbent Republican Lynn Frazier defeated Democratic nominee James Francis Thaddeus O'Connor with 51.01% of the vote.

zh.s: 1920年北达科他州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长林恩·弗雷泽击败民主党候选人詹姆斯·弗朗西斯·萨迪厄斯·奥康纳，获得51.01%的选票。

en.s: The 1920 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1920. Republican nominee Nathan E. Kendall defeated Democratic nominee Clyde L. Herring with 58.66% of the vote.

zh.s: 1920年艾奥瓦州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党候选人内森·E·肯德尔击败民主党候选人克莱德·L·赫林，获得58.66%的选票。

en.s: The 1920 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1920, and featured incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor Pelham A. Barrows, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee Cass G. Barns as well as Independent Robert D. Mousel.

zh.t: 1920年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1920年内布拉斯加州副州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任副州长佩勒姆·A·巴罗斯击败民主党候选人卡斯·G·巴恩斯和独立候选人罗伯特·D·莫塞尔。

en.t: 1920 United States Senate election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1920 United States Senate election in South Dakota took place on November 2, 1920. Incumbent Democratic Senator Edwin S. Johnson declined to seek re-election to a second term. In the Democratic primary, attorney Ulysses Simpson Grant Cherry defeated former State Senator Louis Napoleon Crill and former U.S. Marshal Tom Taubman, while in the Republican primary, Governor Peter Norbeck defeated former State Supreme Court Justice Dick Haney.

zh.t: 1920年美国南达科他州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1920年美国南达科他州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员埃德温·S·约翰逊决定不竞选连任。民主党初选中，律师尤利西斯·辛普森·格兰特·切里击败前州参议员路易斯·拿破仑·克里尔和前联邦法警汤姆·陶布曼；共和党初选中，州长彼得·诺贝克击败前州最高法院法官迪克·哈尼。

en.t: 1920 United States Senate election in Indiana
en.s: The 1920 United States Senate election in Indiana took place on November 2, 1920. Incumbent Republican Senator James E. Watson was re-elected to a full term in office over Thomas Taggart in a rematch of the 1916 special election for the same seat.

zh.t: 1920年美国印第安纳州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1920年美国印第安纳州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员詹姆斯·E·沃森击败托马斯·塔加特，成功当选完整任期；两人此前曾在1916年为同一席位举行的特别选举中交锋。

en.s: The 1920 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1920. Democratic nominee Cameron A. Morrison defeated Republican nominee John J. Parker with 57.2% of the vote. Both were attorneys in private practice at the time.

zh.s: 1920年北卡罗来纳州州长选举于11月2日举行。民主党候选人卡梅伦·A·莫里森击败共和党候选人约翰·J·帕克，获得57.2%的选票。当时两人都是私人执业律师。

en.t: 1920 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1920 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held on November 2, 1920. Incumbent senator Irvine Lenroot, who had been elected to complete the unexpired term of Paul O. Husting, was re-elected to a full term in office.

zh.t: 1920年美国威斯康星州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1920年美国威斯康星州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。现任参议员欧文·伦鲁特此前当选，接替保罗·O·赫斯廷未满的任期；这次他成功当选完整任期。

en.t: 1920 United States Senate election in Arizona
en.s: The 1920 United States Senate election in Arizona took place on November 2, 1920. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Marcus A. Smith ran for reelection to a third term, but was defeated by former Delegate to the U.S. House of Representatives from the Arizona Territory Ralph H. Cameron in the general election. Cameron would become the first Republican elected to the office of U.S.

zh.t: 1920年美国亚利桑那州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1920年美国亚利桑那州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员马库斯·A·史密斯竞选连任第三个任期，但在大选中败给亚利桑那领地前联邦众议院代表拉尔夫·H·卡梅伦。卡梅伦将成为首位从亚利桑那州当选为美国参议员的共和党人。

en.s: The 1920 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1920. Incumbent Republican Henry Justin Allen defeated Democratic nominee Jonathan M. Davis with 58.44% of the vote.

zh.s: 1920年堪萨斯州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长亨利·贾斯汀·艾伦击败民主党候选人乔纳森·M·戴维斯，获得58.44%的选票。

en.s: The 1920 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1920. Republican nominee Alex J. Groesbeck defeated Democratic nominee Woodbridge N. Ferris with 66.43% of the vote.

zh.s: 1920年密歇根州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党候选人亚历克斯·J·格罗斯贝克击败民主党候选人伍德布里奇·N·费里斯，获得66.43%的选票。

en.s: The 1920 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 2, 1920, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general Clifford L. Hilton defeated Independent candidate Thomas V. Sullivan and Democratic nominee Raymond A. McQuat.

zh.t: 1920年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1920年明尼苏达州总检察长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州总检察长。共和党候选人、现任总检察长克利福德·L·希尔顿击败独立候选人托马斯·V·沙利文和民主党候选人雷蒙德·A·麦夸特。

en.t: 1920 United States presidential election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1920 United States presidential election in North Carolina took place on November 2, 1920, as part of the 1920 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all contemporary forty-eight states. Voters chose twelve representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Like all former Confederate states, North Carolina would during its "Redemption" develop a politics based upon Jim Crow laws, disfranchisement of its African-American population and dominance of the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 1920年美国北卡罗来纳州总统选举
zh.s: 1920年美国北卡罗来纳州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年在当时全部48个州举行的总统选举的一部分。选民选出12名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。与其他前邦联州一样，北卡罗来纳州在“重建后时期”逐渐形成了以吉姆·克劳法、剥夺非裔美国人选举权和民主党主导为特点的政治格局。

en.t: 1920 United States presidential election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1920 United States presidential election in North Dakota took place on November 2, 1920, as part of the 1920 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose five representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. North Dakota voted for Republican nominee, Senator Warren G. Harding of Ohio, over the Democratic nominee, Governor James M.

zh.t: 1920年美国北达科他州总统选举
zh.s: 1920年美国北达科他州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年在美国48个州举行的总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。北达科他州支持共和党候选人、俄亥俄州参议员沃伦·G·哈定，胜过民主党候选人、州长詹姆斯·M·考克斯。

en.t: 1920 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1920 United States presidential election in Tennessee took place on November 2, 1920, as part of the 1920 United States presidential election. Tennessee voters chose 12 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. For over a century after the Civil War, Tennessee was divided according to political loyalties established in that war.

zh.s: 1920年美国田纳西州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。田纳西州选民选出12名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。内战结束后的一个多世纪里，田纳西州仍因内战时期形成的政治立场而分裂。

en.t: 1920 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1920 United States presidential election in Louisiana took place on November 2, 1920, as part of the 1920 United States presidential election. Voters chose ten representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ever since the passage of a new constitution in 1898, Louisiana had been a one-party state dominated by the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 1920年美国路易斯安那州总统选举
zh.s: 1920年美国路易斯安那州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出10名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。1898年新宪法通过后，民主党一直一党主导路易斯安那州。

en.s: The 1920 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1920. Republican nominee Emery J. San Souci defeated Democratic nominee Edward M. Sullivan with 64.64% of the vote.

zh.s: 1920年罗得岛州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党候选人埃默里·J·桑苏西击败民主党候选人爱德华·M·沙利文，获得64.64%的选票。

en.s: The 1920 Illinois lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1920. It saw Republican nominee Fred E. Sterling win a landslide victory.

zh.s: 1920年伊利诺伊州副州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党候选人弗雷德·E·斯特林以压倒性优势获胜。

en.t: 1920 United States presidential election in Alabama
en.s: The 1920 United States presidential election in Alabama took place on November 2, 1920, as part of the 1920 general election, in which all 48 states participated. Alabama voters chose twelve electors to represent them in the Electoral College via popular vote pitting Democratic nominee James M. Cox and his running mate, Assistant Secretary of the Navy Franklin Roosevelt, against Republican challenger U.S. Senator Warren G.

zh.t: 1920年美国阿拉巴马州总统选举
zh.s: 1920年美国阿拉巴马州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国48个州参加的普选的一部分。阿拉巴马州选民通过普选选出12名总统选举人。民主党候选人詹姆斯·M·考克斯及其竞选搭档、海军助理部长富兰克林·罗斯福与共和党候选人、美国参议员沃伦·G·哈定角逐。

en.t: 1920 United States House of Representatives election in Arizona
en.s: The 1920 United States House of Representatives elections in Arizona was held on Tuesday November 2, 1920 to elect the state's sole at-large representative. Incumbent democrat, Carl Hayden won re-election to a sixth term with 58 percent of the vote. Both nominees were unopposed in their primary elections which were held on September 7, 1920.

zh.t: 1920年亚利桑那州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1920年亚利桑那州联邦众议院选举于1920年11月2日星期二举行，选出该州唯一的全州单一选区代表。民主党籍现任众议员卡尔·海登以58%的得票率成功连任第六个任期。两名候选人都没有党内初选对手，初选于1920年9月7日举行。

en.s: The 1920 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1920. Incumbent Republican Governor John G. Townsend Jr. declined to seek re-election. At the Republican convention, former State Representative William D. Denney, the frontrunner for the nomination, received the Party's endorsement for Governor without difficulty—though some opposition to his candidacy arose before the convention. The Democratic contest was more lively, with several prospective candidates in the mix.

zh.s: 1920年特拉华州州长选举于1920年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长小约翰·G·汤森拒绝竞选连任。在共和党代表大会上，曾任州众议员的威廉·D·丹尼是提名热门，他顺利获得该党州长候选人提名，不过大会前也有人反对他参选。民主党党内角逐更加激烈，有几位潜在候选人参与竞争。

en.t: 1920 United States Senate election in Kansas
en.s: The 1920 United States Senate election in Kansas was held on November 2, 1920. Incumbent Republican Senator Charles Curtis ran for re-election to his second consecutive term, and his third term overall. He was challenged by former Governor George H. Hodges, the Democratic nominee, and defeated him in a landslide as Republican presidential nominee Warren G. Harding won the state by a similar margin.

zh.t: 1920年堪萨斯州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1920年堪萨斯州联邦参议员选举于1920年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员查尔斯·柯蒂斯竞选连任第二个连续任期，也是他的第三个任期。民主党候选人、前州长乔治·H·霍奇斯向他发起挑战，但柯蒂斯以压倒性优势获胜；共和党总统候选人沃伦·G·哈定也以相近优势赢得该州。

en.s: The 1920 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1920. Republican nominee Hiram Lloyd defeated Democratic nominee Carter M. Buford with 54.49% of the vote.

zh.s: 1920年密苏里州副州长选举于1920年11月2日举行。共和党候选人海勒姆·劳埃德以54.49%的得票率击败民主党候选人卡特·M·布福德。

en.t: 1920 United States presidential election in Utah
en.s: The 1920 United States presidential election in Utah took place on November 2, 1920. All contemporary forty-eight states took part as part of the 1920 United States presidential election, and the state voters selected four electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. This was the first presidential election to feature as a distinct voting unit Daggett County, the newest and least populous of Utah's current twenty-nine counties.

zh.t: 1920年美国总统选举犹他州结果
zh.s: 1920年美国总统选举犹他州投票于1920年11月2日举行。当时的48个州都参加了这次总统选举，犹他州选民选出4名总统选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。这是犹他州首次将达盖特县作为独立投票单位参加总统选举；该县是犹他州现有29个县中最新成立、人口最少的县。

en.t: 1920 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 1920 United States presidential election in Oregon took place on November 2, 1920. All contemporary 48 states were part of the 1920 United States presidential election. Voters chose five electors to the Electoral College, who selected the president and vice president. This is the earliest presidential election in Oregon to include all 36 of the state's present counties.

zh.t: 1920年美国总统选举俄勒冈州结果
zh.s: 1920年美国总统选举俄勒冈州投票于1920年11月2日举行。当时的48个州都参加了这次总统选举。选民选出5名总统选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。这是俄勒冈州最早一次涵盖该州现有全部36个县的总统选举。

en.s: The 1920 Utah gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1920. Republican nominee Charles R. Mabey defeated Democratic nominee Thomas N. Taylor with 58.17% of the vote. This would be the last time a Republican was elected Governor of Utah until 1948.

zh.s: 1920年犹他州州长选举于1920年11月2日举行。共和党候选人查尔斯·R·梅比以58.17%的得票率击败民主党候选人托马斯·N·泰勒。这是1948年之前共和党人最后一次当选犹他州州长。

en.t: 1920 United States presidential election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1920 United States presidential election in Wyoming took place on November 2, 1920, as part of the 1920 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Wyoming was won by Republican Ohio Senator Warren G.

zh.s: 1920年美国怀俄明州总统选举于11月2日举行，是1920年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。怀俄明州支持共和党候选人、俄亥俄州参议员沃伦·G·哈定。

en.s: The 1920 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1920. Incumbent Republican Oliver Henry Shoup defeated Democratic nominee James M. Collins with 59.55% of the vote.

zh.s: 1920年科罗拉多州州长选举于1920年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长奥利弗·亨利·舒普以59.55%的得票率击败民主党候选人詹姆斯·M·柯林斯。

en.t: 1920 United States Senate election in Maryland
en.s: The 1920 United States Senate election in Maryland was held on November 2, 1920. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator John Walter Smith ran for re-election to a third term in office, but was beaten by Republican Ovington Weller.

zh.t: 1920年马里兰州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1920年马里兰州联邦参议员选举于1920年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员约翰·沃尔特·史密斯竞选连任第三个任期，但败给了共和党候选人奥文顿·韦勒。

en.t: 1920 United States Senate election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1920 United States Senate election in North Carolina was held on November 2, 1920. Incumbent Democratic Senator Lee Slater Overman was re-elected to a fourth term in office, defeating Republican A. E. Holton.

zh.t: 1920年北卡罗来纳州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1920年北卡罗来纳州联邦参议员选举于1920年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员李·斯莱特·奥弗曼击败共和党候选人A·E·霍尔顿，连任第四个任期。

en.s: The 1920 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1920. Incumbent Republican Governor Peter Norbeck declined to run for re-election, instead choosing to run for the U.S. Senate. Lieutenant Governor William H. McMaster won the Republican primary and advanced to the general election, where he faced Nonpartisan League candidate Mark P. Bates and former State Senator William W. Howes, the Democratic nominee.

zh.s: 1920年南达科他州州长选举于1920年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长彼得·诺贝克没有竞选连任，而是转而竞选联邦参议员。副州长威廉·H·麦克马斯特赢得共和党初选，进入大选，对阵无党派联盟候选人马克·P·贝茨和民主党候选人、前州参议员威廉·W·豪斯。

en.s: The 1920 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 2, 1920, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Republican nominee and incumbent state auditor George Ernst Hackman defeated Democratic nominee and incumbent State Treasurer of Missouri George H. Middelkamp, Socialist nominee Roy F. Smalley, Farmer-Worker nominee A. R. Smith and Socialist Labor nominee Frederick Spalti.

zh.s: 1920年密苏里州州审计长选举于1920年11月2日举行。共和党候选人、现任州审计长乔治·恩斯特·哈克曼击败了民主党候选人、现任密苏里州财长乔治·H·米德尔坎普、社会党候选人罗伊·F·斯莫利、农工党候选人A·R·史密斯和社会工党候选人弗雷德里克·斯帕尔蒂。

en.t: 1920 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1920 United States presidential election in Rhode Island took place on November 2, 1920, as part of the 1920 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose five representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Rhode Island voted for Republican nominee, Senator Warren G. Harding of Ohio, over the Democratic nominee, Governor James M.

zh.s: 1920年美国罗得岛州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年在美国48个州举行的总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。罗得岛州支持共和党候选人、俄亥俄州参议员沃伦·G·哈定，胜过民主党候选人、州长詹姆斯·M·考克斯。

en.t: 1920 United States Senate election in Colorado
en.s: The 1920 United States Senate election in Colorado took place on November 2, 1920. Incumbent Democratic Senator Charles S. Thomas initially declined to run for re-election, and State Supreme Court Justice Tully Scott won the Democratic nomination to succeed him, facing off against former Leadville Mayor Samuel D. Nicholson, the Republican nominee. However, in October 1920, Thomas announced that he would run for re-election as an independent due to his opposition to the League of Nations.

zh.t: 1920年美国科罗拉多州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1920年美国科罗拉多州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员查尔斯·S·托马斯起初拒绝竞选连任，州最高法院法官塔利·斯科特赢得民主党提名，将与共和党候选人、莱德维尔前市长塞缪尔·D·尼科尔森角逐。1920年10月，托马斯因反对国际联盟而宣布以独立候选人身份参选。

en.t: 1920 United States presidential election in Maryland
en.s: The 1920 United States presidential election in Maryland took place on November 2, 1920, as part of the 1920 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. With its history as a slave state and substantial historic secessionist support, Maryland had been strongly Democratic during the Third Party System despite having Federalist and Whig tendencies under previous systems.

zh.s: 1920年美国马里兰州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年在当时全部48个州举行的总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。马里兰州曾是蓄奴州，历史上有相当多的分离主义支持者；尽管此前也有联邦党和辉格党势力，在第三党体系时期该州一直强烈支持民主党。

en.t: 1920 United States presidential election in Ohio
en.s: The 1920 United States presidential election in Ohio was held on November 2, 1920, as part of the 1920 United States presidential election. State voters chose 24 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Both major-party presidential nominees were from Ohio and each held a statewide elected office there at the time of the presidential election. The Republican candidate, U.S.

zh.s: 1920年美国俄亥俄州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出24名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。两大党总统候选人都来自俄亥俄州，当时也都在该州担任民选公职。共和党候选人是美国参议员沃伦·G·哈定。

en.s: The 1920 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1920, and featured incumbent Governor Samuel R. McKelvie, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee, former Governor John H. Morehead, and progressive-backed independent candidate, York Mayor Arthur G. Wray, to win a second and final two-year term in office.

zh.s: 1920年内布拉斯加州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长塞缪尔·R·麦凯尔维击败民主党候选人、前州长约翰·H·莫雷黑德，以及得到进步派支持的独立候选人、约克市市长阿瑟·G·雷，赢得第二个也是最后一个两年任期。

en.s: The 1920 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 2, 1920, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Republican nominee Lorenzo Dow Thompson defeated Democratic nominee John H. Stone, Socialist nominee James R. Stewart, Farmer-Worker nominee Clayton H. Johnson and Socialist Labor nominee William Veal.

zh.t: 1920年密苏里州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 1920年密苏里州州财政部长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州州财政部长。共和党候选人洛伦佐·道·汤普森击败民主党候选人约翰·H·斯通、社会党候选人詹姆斯·R·斯图尔特、农工党候选人克莱顿·H·约翰逊和社会主义工党候选人威廉·维尔。

en.s: The 1920 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1920 in order to elect the Governor of Texas. Former Democratic state representative Pat Morris Neff won comfortably in a four-way race against Republican nominee J. G. Culbertson, American Party of Texas nominee T. H. McGregor, and Black and Tan Republican nominee Hickerson Capers.

zh.s: 1920年得克萨斯州州长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州州长。前民主党州众议员帕特·莫里斯·内夫在四方角逐中轻松获胜，击败共和党候选人J·G·卡尔伯森、得克萨斯州美国人党候选人T·H·麦格雷戈和“黑棕共和党”候选人希克森·卡珀斯。

en.t: 1920 United States presidential election in Delaware
en.s: The 1920 United States presidential election in Delaware took place on November 2, 1920. All contemporary 48 states were part of the 1920 United States presidential election. State voters chose three electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Delaware was won by the Republican nominee, Senator Warren G. Harding of Ohio, over the Democratic nominee, Governor James M. Cox of Ohio.

zh.s: 1920年美国特拉华州总统选举于11月2日举行。当时的48个州都参加了1920年美国总统选举。特拉华州选民选出3名选举人，组成选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、俄亥俄州联邦参议员沃伦·G·哈定击败民主党候选人、俄亥俄州州长詹姆斯·M·考克斯，赢得特拉华州。

en.t: 1920 United States Senate election in Ohio
en.s: The 1920 United States Senate special election in Ohio was held on November 2, 1920. Incumbent Republican Senator Warren G. Harding did not run for re-election, opting instead to run for President of the United States. Republican Governor Frank B. Willis defeated William Alexander Julian in the race for the open seat.

zh.t: 1920年美国俄亥俄州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1920年美国俄亥俄州联邦参议员特别选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员沃伦·G·哈定没有竞选连任，而是转而竞选美国总统。共和党籍州长弗兰克·B·威利斯击败威廉·亚历山大·朱利安，赢得空缺席位。

en.t: 1920 United States presidential election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1920 United States presidential election in South Dakota took place on November 2, 1920, as part of the 1920 United States presidential election in which all contemporary forty-eight states participated. Voters chose five electors, or representatives to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president.

zh.t: 1920年美国南达科他州总统选举
zh.s: 1920年美国南达科他州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当时全部48个州都参加的总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。

en.t: 1920 United States Senate election in Illinois
en.s: The 1920 United States Senate election in Illinois took place on November 2, 1920. Incumbent Republican senator Lawrence Yates Sherman opted to retire rather than seeking reelection. Fellow Republican William B. McKinley was elected to succeed him in office.

zh.t: 1920年美国伊利诺伊州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1920年美国伊利诺伊州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员劳伦斯·耶茨·谢尔曼决定退休，没有竞选连任。同为共和党人的威廉·B·麦金莱当选接替他。

en.s: The 1920 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 2, 1920, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee Mike Holm defeated Farmer–Labor nominee Lily J. Anderson, Democratic nominee Frank C. Burmaster, Socialist nominee John H. Hirt and National nominee John M. Copeland.

zh.s: 1920年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于11月2日举行，选出该州州务卿。共和党候选人迈克·霍尔姆击败农工党候选人莉莉·J·安德森、民主党候选人弗兰克·C·伯马斯特、社会党候选人约翰·H·赫特和国家党候选人约翰·M·科普兰。

en.t: 1920 United States presidential election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1920 United States presidential election in Oklahoma took place on November 2, 1920, as part of the 1920 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose ten representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. In its early years, Oklahoma was a “Solid South” Democratic state whose founding fathers like "Alfalfa Bill" Murray and Charles N.

zh.t: 1920年美国俄克拉何马州总统选举
zh.s: 1920年美国俄克拉何马州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年在美国48个州举行的总统选举的一部分。选民选出10名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。建州初期，俄克拉何马州曾是民主党占优势的“坚实南方”州。

en.s: The 1920 New Mexico gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1920. Incumbent Republican Governor Octaviano Ambrosio Larrazolo was defeated for renomination. Republican candidate Merritt C. Mechem defeated Democratic nominee Richard H. Hanna with 51.26% of the vote. Otero County and Union County both backed a Republican gubernatorial candidate for the first time, but would not do so again until 1950 and 1938, respectively.

zh.s: 1920年新墨西哥州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长奥克塔维亚诺·安布罗西奥·拉拉索洛在党内提名中落选。共和党候选人梅里特·C·米切姆击败民主党候选人理查德·H·汉纳，获得51.26%的选票。奥特罗县和尤宁县都首次支持共和党州长候选人，但此后分别直到1950年和1938年才再次如此。

en.t: 1920 United States presidential election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1920 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 2, 1920, as part of the 1920 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose seven representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Connecticut voted for Republican nominee, Senator Warren G. Harding of Ohio, over the Democratic nominee, Governor James M.

zh.t: 1920年美国康涅狄格州总统选举
zh.s: 1920年美国康涅狄格州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年在美国48个州举行的总统选举的一部分。选民选出7名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。康涅狄格州支持共和党候选人、俄亥俄州参议员沃伦·G·哈定，胜过民主党候选人、州长詹姆斯·M·考克斯。

en.s: The 1920 Indiana gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1920. Republican nominee Warren T. McCray defeated Democratic nominee Carleton B. McCulloch with 54.63% of the vote.

zh.s: 1920年印第安纳州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党候选人沃伦·T·麦克雷击败民主党候选人卡尔顿·B·麦卡洛克，获得54.63%的选票。

en.s: The 1920 Florida gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1920. Democratic nominee Cary A. Hardee defeated Republican nominee George E. Gay with 77.94% of the vote.

zh.s: 1920年佛罗里达州州长选举于11月2日举行。民主党候选人卡里·A·哈迪击败共和党候选人乔治·E·盖伊，获得77.94%的选票。

en.s: The 1920 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1920. Primary elections were held on September 7, 1920. Republican candidate John J. Blaine won the election with 52.98% of the vote, winning his first of three terms as Governor of Wisconsin. Blaine defeated Democratic Party candidate Robert McCoy, Socialist candidate William Coleman and Prohibition Party candidate Henry H. Tubbs.

zh.s: 1920年威斯康星州州长选举于11月2日举行。初选于1920年9月7日举行。共和党候选人约翰·J·布莱恩以52.98%的选票获胜，开始其三个州长任期中的第一个任期。他击败了民主党候选人罗伯特·麦科伊、社会党候选人威廉·科尔曼和禁酒党候选人亨利·H·塔布斯。

en.t: 1920 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1920 United States presidential election in Arkansas took place on November 2, 1920, as part of the 1920 United States presidential election in which all 48 states participated. State voters chose nine electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting Democratic nominee James M. Cox and his running mate, Assistant Secretary of the Navy Franklin Roosevelt, against Republican challenger U.S.

zh.s: 1920年美国阿肯色州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国48个州参加的总统选举的一部分。阿肯色州选民通过普选选出9名总统选举人。民主党候选人詹姆斯·M·考克斯及其竞选搭档、海军助理部长富兰克林·罗斯福与共和党候选人、美国参议员沃伦·G·哈定角逐。

en.t: 1920 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1920 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 2, 1920, as part of the 1920 United States presidential election. Voters chose thirteen representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president.

zh.s: 1920年美国肯塔基州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出13名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。

en.s: The 1920 Illinois gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1920. Incumbent first-term Republican Governor Frank Orren Lowden declined to stand for re-election. He was an unsuccessful candidate for the Republican nomination for U.S. President at the 1920 Republican National Convention. Republican nominee Len Small defeated Democratic nominee James Hamilton Lewis with 58.78% of the vote.

zh.s: 1920年伊利诺伊州州长选举于1920年11月2日举行。共和党籍首届任期州长弗兰克·奥伦·劳登拒绝竞选连任。他曾在1920年共和党全国代表大会上竞逐总统候选人提名，但未能胜出。共和党候选人伦·斯莫尔以58.78%的得票率击败民主党候选人詹姆斯·汉密尔顿·刘易斯。

en.t: 1920 United States Senate election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1920 United States Senate election in North Dakota took place on November 2, 1920. Incumbent Republican Senator Asle Gronna ran for re-election to a third term. However, he was narrowly defeated in the Republican primary by Edwin F. Ladd, the President of the North Dakota Agricultural College, who had been endorsed by the Nonpartisan League. In the general election, Ladd was opposed by H.

zh.t: 1920年美国北达科他州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1920年美国北达科他州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员阿斯勒·格罗纳竞选连任第三个任期，但在共和党初选中以微弱差距败给北达科他农业学院院长埃德温·F·拉德。拉德得到了无党派联盟的支持。

en.s: The 1920 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1920, in order to elect the Governor of Georgia. Democratic nominee and former United States Senator from Georgia Thomas W. Hardwick ran unopposed and subsequently won the election.

zh.s: 1920年佐治亚州州长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州州长。民主党候选人、佐治亚州前联邦参议员托马斯·W·哈德威克没有对手，随后赢得选举。

en.s: The 1920 Washington gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1920. Incumbent Republican Louis F. Hart defeated Farmer–Labor nominee Robert Bridges with 52.74% of the vote.

zh.s: 1920年华盛顿州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长路易斯·F·哈特击败农工党候选人罗伯特·布里奇斯，获得52.74%的选票。

en.t: 1920 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1920 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 2, 1920, as part of the wider United States presidential election. Voters chose 14 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. With the exception of a handful of historically Unionist North Georgia counties – chiefly Fannin but also to a lesser extent Pickens, Gilmer and Towns – Georgia since the 1880s had been a one-party state dominated by the Democratic Party.

zh.s: 1920年美国佐治亚州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出14名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。除佐治亚州北部少数历史上支持联邦的县外——主要是范宁县，此外还有皮肯斯县、吉尔默县和汤斯县——自19世纪80年代以来，佐治亚州一直由民主党一党主导。

en.t: 1920 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The United States Senate election of 1920 in New York was held on November 2, 1920. Incumbent Republican Senator James Wolcott Wadsworth Jr. was re-elected to a second term over Democratic Lieutenant Governor Harry C. Walker.

zh.t: 1920年美国纽约州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1920年美国纽约州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员小詹姆斯·沃尔科特·沃兹沃思击败民主党副州长哈里·C·沃克，成功连任第二个任期。

en.t: 1920 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1920 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 2, 1920. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Wesley Livsey Jones was re-elected to a third term in office over Farmer-Labor nominee Clemens J. France and former Seattle mayor George F. Cotterill.

zh.t: 1920年华盛顿州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1920年华盛顿州联邦参议员选举于1920年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任联邦参议员韦斯利·利夫赛·琼斯击败农工党提名人克莱门斯·J·弗朗斯和西雅图前市长乔治·F·科特雷尔，成功连任第三个任期。

en.s: The 1920 United States Senate elections were elections for the United States Senate that coincided with the presidential election of Warren G. Harding. The 32 seats of Class 3 were contested in regular elections, and special elections were held to fill vacancies. Democrat Woodrow Wilson's unpopularity allowed Republicans to win races across the country, winning ten seats from the Democrats and providing them with an overwhelming 59-to-37 majority.

zh.s: 1920年美国联邦参议院选举与沃伦·G·哈定总统选举同时举行。联邦参议院第三类32个席位都进行常规改选，并通过特别选举填补空缺。伍德罗·威尔逊总统不受欢迎，帮助共和党赢得全国多个席位，从民主党手中夺得10席，以59席对37席取得压倒性多数。

en.s: The 1920 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on Tuesday November 2, to elect the Governor of Idaho. Incumbent Governor D. W. Davis defeated Democratic Candidate Ted A. Walters with 52.97% of the vote.

zh.s: 1920年爱达荷州州长选举于11月2日（星期二）举行，选出该州州长。共和党籍现任州长D·W·戴维斯击败民主党候选人特德·A·沃尔特斯，获得52.97%的选票。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1920 Iowa Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1920 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 29 of the senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa Senate. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the 1920 elections is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1920年艾奥瓦州参议院选举是当年每两年举行一次的美国选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民在50个州参议院选区中选出29个选区的参议员。州参议员任期四年。艾奥瓦州议会提供了1920年选举中50个州参议院选区的全州地图。

en.s: Elections to Manchester City Council were held on Monday, 2 November 1925. One third of the councillors seats were up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a three-year term of office. The Conservative Party retained overall control of the council.

zh.s: 曼彻斯特市议会选举于1925年11月2日星期一举行。三分之一的议员席位参加选举，胜出者任期三年。保守党保住了对市议会的控制权。

en.s: 1925 Emperor's Cup Final was the fifth final of the Emperor's Cup competition. The final was played at Meiji Jingu Gaien Stadium in Tokyo on November 2, 1925. Rijo Shukyu-Dan won the championship.

zh.s: 1925年天皇杯决赛是天皇杯赛事的第五届决赛。比赛于1925年11月2日在东京明治神宫外苑竞技场举行。理城蹴球团赢得冠军。

en.s: Elections to Liverpool City Council were held on 2 November 1925. One third of the council seats were up for election. The term of office for each councillor being three years. Eight of the thirty-seven seats up for election were uncontested.

zh.s: 利物浦市议会选举于1925年11月2日举行。市议会三分之一的席位改选，议员任期为三年。待改选的37个席位中，有8个没有竞争。

en.s: The 1926 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 1926. Despite being a Democratic year generally, Hunt barely managed to be re-elected against his Republican opponent Elias Clark. Hunt had been governor for around 11 out of the State of Arizona's 14 years, coupled with his age and with issues regarding the Colorado River Compact, he was running out of steam. Despite that Hunt narrowly prevailed and won. Governor W. P. Hunt was sworn in for a 6th term as Governor on January 3, 1927.

zh.s: 1926年亚利桑那州州长选举于1926年11月2日举行。虽然当年整体上对民主党有利，亨特仍是在竞争激烈的选举中以微弱优势击败共和党对手伊莱亚斯·克拉克，成功连任。亨特在亚利桑那州成立14年来约有11年担任州长，加上年事已高，又面临科罗拉多河协定相关争议，已显露疲态。尽管如此，他仍险胜连任。W·P·亨特州长于1927年1月3日宣誓就任第六个任期。

en.s: The Pennsylvania gubernatorial election of 1926 occurred on November 2, 1926. Incumbent Republican governor Gifford Pinchot was not a candidate for re-election. Republican candidate John Fisher defeated Democratic candidate Eugene C. Bonniwell to become Governor of Pennsylvania.

zh.s: 1926年宾夕法尼亚州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长吉福德·平肖没有竞选连任。共和党候选人约翰·费舍尔击败民主党候选人尤金·C·邦尼韦尔，成为宾夕法尼亚州州长。

en.s: The Vermont gubernatorial election of 1926 took place on November 2, 1926. Incumbent Republican Franklin S. Billings, per the "Mountain Rule", did not run for re-election to a second term as Governor of Vermont. Republican candidate John E. Weeks defeated Democratic candidate Herbert C. Comings to succeed him.

zh.s: 1926年佛蒙特州州长选举于11月2日举行。按照“山地规则”，共和党籍现任州长富兰克林·S·比林斯没有竞选连任第二个任期。共和党候选人约翰·E·威克斯击败民主党候选人赫伯特·C·康明斯，接任州长。

en.s: The 1926 Minnesota gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 1926. Republican Party of Minnesota candidate Theodore Christianson defeated Farmer–Labor Party challenger Magnus Johnson.

zh.s: 1926年明尼苏达州州长选举于11月2日举行。明尼苏达州共和党候选人西奥多·克里斯蒂安森击败农工党候选人马格努斯·约翰逊。

en.t: United States Senate election in Vermont, 1926
en.s: The 1926 United States Senate election in Vermont took place on November 2, 1926. Republican Porter H. Dale successfully ran for re-election to a full term in the United States Senate, defeating Democratic candidate James E. Kennedy.

zh.t: 1926年美国佛蒙特州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1926年美国佛蒙特州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。共和党人波特·H·戴尔成功当选，获得完整任期，并击败民主党候选人詹姆斯·E·肯尼迪。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1926
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1926 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 2, 1926. Republicans gained one seat in a special election held on August 31, 1926, after incumbent Democrat John E. Raker died.

zh.t: 1926年美国加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1926年美国加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举是选举该州联邦众议员的投票，于11月2日举行，与联邦众议院普选同时进行。共和党在1926年8月31日举行的一场特别选举中赢得一个席位；民主党籍现任议员约翰·E·雷克去世后，该席位因此空缺。

en.t: United States Senate special election in Massachusetts, 1926
en.s: The United States Senate special election of 1926 in Massachusetts was held on November 2, 1926, with Democratic David I. Walsh defeating Incumbent Republican U.S Senator William Morgan Butler who was appointed after the death of Republican Senator Henry Cabot Lodge, Walsh returned to the U.S Senate for a 2-year term.

zh.t: 1926年美国马萨诸塞州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1926年美国马萨诸塞州联邦参议员特别选举于11月2日举行。民主党人戴维·I·沃尔什击败共和党籍现任参议员威廉·摩根·巴特勒。巴特勒是在共和党参议员亨利·卡伯特·洛奇去世后获任命接任的；沃尔什因此重返联邦参议院，任期两年。

zh.s: 1926年加利福尼亚州州长选举于11月2日举行。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1926, in 33 states, concurrent with the House and Senate elections, on November 2, 1926. Elections took place on October 5 in Arkansas, and September 13 in Maine. In South Carolina, the governor was elected to a four-year term for the first time, instead of a two-year term.

zh.s: 1926年11月2日，美国有33个州举行州长选举，与联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举同时进行。阿肯色州和缅因州的选举分别于10月5日和9月13日举行。南卡罗来纳州州长首次改为任期四年，此前任期为两年。

en.t: 1926 United States Senate special election in Indiana
en.s: The 1926 United States Senate special election in Indiana was held on November 2, 1926, to complete the unexpired term of Senator Samuel M. Ralston, who died on October 14, 1925. Interim Republican Senator Arthur Raymond Robinson, who had been appointed to fill the seat, was re-elected to finish the term over Democrat Evans Woollen.

zh.t: 1926年印第安纳州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1926年印第安纳州联邦参议员特别选举于1926年11月2日举行，以补完参议员塞缪尔·M·拉尔斯顿于1925年10月14日去世后留下的任期。共和党籍临时参议员阿瑟·雷蒙德·罗宾逊曾受任命填补空缺，后在选举中击败民主党候选人埃文斯·伍伦，赢得剩余任期。

en.s: The 1926 Maryland attorney general election was held on November 2, 1926, in order to elect the attorney general of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent attorney general Thomas H. Robinson defeated Republican nominee and former Mayor of Baltimore William Frederick Broening and Socialist nominee John A. Orman.

zh.s: 1926年马里兰州总检察长选举于1926年11月2日举行。民主党候选人、现任总检察长托马斯·H·罗宾逊击败共和党候选人、巴尔的摩前市长威廉·弗雷德里克·布罗宁，以及社会党候选人约翰·A·奥曼。

en.s: The 1926 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1926. Incumbent Republican Governor Carl Gunderson ran for re-election to a second term. The election was largely a rematch of the 1924 election, with Gunderson's chief opponent from two years prior, Democrat William J. Bulow, challenging him once again. Two other candidates—Farmer–Labor nominee Tom Ayres and Pierre Mayor John E. Hipple, an independent—also ran.

zh.s: 1926年南达科他州州长选举于1926年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长卡尔·冈德森竞选连任第二个任期。这次选举很大程度上重演了1924年的对决：民主党候选人威廉·J·布洛击再次挑战冈德森。此外，农工党候选人汤姆·艾尔斯和独立候选人、皮尔市长约翰·E·希普尔也参加了竞选。

en.s: The 1926 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 1926. Incumbent Lieutenant Governor William I. Nolan of the Republican Party of Minnesota defeated Minnesota Farmer–Labor Party challenger Emil E. Holmes and Minnesota Democratic Party candidate Charles D. Johnson.

zh.s: 1926年明尼苏达州副州长选举于1926年11月2日举行。明尼苏达州共和党籍现任副州长威廉·I·诺兰击败了明尼苏达州农工党候选人埃米尔·E·霍姆斯和明尼苏达州民主党候选人查尔斯·D·约翰逊。

en.t: 1926 United States Senate election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1926 United States Senate election in South Dakota took place on November 2, 1926. Incumbent Republican Senator Peter Norbeck ran for re-election to a second term. In the Republican primary, he faced former State Senator George J. Danforth, who had the support of Governor Carl Gunderson in an intra-party split between Norbeck and Gunderson. Norbeck defeated Danforth by a wide margin, and then faced former State Representative Charles J.

zh.t: 1926年美国南达科他州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1926年美国南达科他州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员彼得·诺贝克竞选连任第二个任期。共和党初选中，他面对前州参议员乔治·J·丹福思；丹福思得到州长卡尔·冈德森支持，反映出诺贝克与冈德森之间的党内分歧。诺贝克以较大优势击败丹福思。

en.s: The 1926 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1926. Incumbent Democratic governor Austin Peay defeated Republican nominee Walter White with 64.7% of the vote, improving on his performance from 1924. Peay narrowly won the Democratic primary against Hill McAlister, defeating him by a little over 4%. Shortly after beginning his third term, Peay's health began to decline and he died from a cerebral hemorrhage at 8:05 p.m. on October 2, 1927.

zh.s: 1926年田纳西州州长选举于1926年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州长奥斯汀·皮伊以64.7%的得票率击败共和党候选人沃尔特·怀特，得票率高于1924年。皮伊此前在民主党初选中以略高于4个百分点的优势险胜希尔·麦卡利斯特。开始第三个任期后不久，皮伊健康状况恶化，并于1927年10月2日晚上8点05分死于脑出血。

en.t: 1926 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1926 United States Senate election in California was held on November 2, 1926. Incumbent Republican Senator Samuel Morgan Shortridge was re-elected to a second term.

zh.t: 1926年加利福尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1926年加利福尼亚州联邦参议员选举于1926年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员塞缪尔·摩根·肖特里奇成功连任第二个任期。

en.t: 1926 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1926 United States House of Representatives elections were elections for the United States House of Representatives to elect members to serve in the 70th United States Congress. They were held for the most part on November 2, 1926, while Maine held theirs on September 13. They occurred in the middle of President Calvin Coolidge's second term. Coolidge's Republican Party lost seats to the opposition Democratic Party, but it retained a majority.

zh.s: 1926年美国联邦众议院选举旨在选出第70届美国国会的议员。大多数州于1926年11月2日举行选举，缅因州则于9月13日投票。此次选举在卡尔文·柯立芝总统第二个任期中举行。柯立芝所属的共和党失去部分席位，但仍保住多数。

en.s: The 1926 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1926. Incumbent Republican John Hammill defeated Democratic nominee Alex R. Miller with 71.51% of the vote.

zh.s: 1926年艾奥瓦州州长选举于1926年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长约翰·哈米尔以71.51%的得票率击败民主党候选人亚历克斯·R·米勒。

en.s: The 1926 Oklahoma gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1926, and was a race for Governor of Oklahoma. Democrat Henry S. Johnston defeated Republican Omer K. Benedict. Also on the ballot were John Franing of the Farmer–Labor Party, E. H. H. Gates of the Socialist Party, and Independent Ed Boyle.

zh.s: 1926年俄克拉何马州州长选举于1926年11月2日举行。民主党候选人亨利·S·约翰斯顿击败共和党候选人奥默·K·本尼迪克特。选票上还有农工党候选人约翰·弗雷宁、社会党候选人E·H·H·盖茨和独立候选人埃德·博伊尔。

en.t: 1926 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico
en.s: The 1926 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico was held on November 2, 1926, to elect the states sole at large representative. Democrat John Morrow won re-election to a third term by 3.11 percentage points. This election coincided with the states Governor election which republicans won.

zh.t: 1926年新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1926年新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举于1926年11月2日举行，选出该州全州单一选区的代表。民主党候选人约翰·莫罗以3.11个百分点的优势成功连任第三个任期。此次选举与州长选举同时举行，后者由共和党赢得。

en.s: The 1926 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1926. Democratic nominee Billy Adams defeated Republican nominee Oliver Henry Shoup with 59.84% of the vote.

zh.s: 1926年科罗拉多州州长选举于11月2日举行。民主党候选人比利·亚当斯击败共和党候选人奥利弗·亨利·舒普，获得59.84%的选票。

en.t: 1926 United States Senate election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1926 United States Senate election in Oklahoma took place on November 2, 1926. Incumbent Republican Senator John W. Harreld ran for re-election to a second term. After facing many challengers in a crowded Republican primary, he advanced to the general election. In the Democratic primary, Congressman Elmer Thomas beat out a similarly crowded field, which included former Governor Jack C.

zh.t: 1926年美国俄克拉何马州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1926年美国俄克拉何马州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员约翰·W·哈雷尔竞选连任第二个任期。他在竞争激烈的共和党初选中胜出，进入大选。民主党初选同样竞争激烈，联邦众议员埃尔默·托马斯从中胜出。

en.s: The 1926 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1926, and featured incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor George A. Williams, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee Frank A. Dutton as well as Progressive nominee Lloyd H. Huffman.

zh.t: 1926年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1926年内布拉斯加州副州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任副州长乔治·A·威廉姆斯击败民主党候选人弗兰克·A·达顿和进步党候选人劳埃德·H·赫夫曼。

en.s: The 1926 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 2, 1926, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent comptroller William S. Gordy Jr. defeated Republican nominee Charles F. Goodell and Socialist nominee James L. Smiley.

zh.s: 1926年马里兰州州审计长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州州审计长。民主党候选人、现任审计长威廉·S·戈迪二世击败共和党候选人查尔斯·F·古德尔和社会党候选人詹姆斯·L·斯迈利。

en.t: 1926 United States Senate elections in Iowa
en.s: The 1926 United States Senate election in Iowa was held on November 2, 1926, alongside a concurrent special election to the same seat. Incumbent Senator Albert B. Cummins ran for re-election to a fourth term in office but was defeated in the Republican primary by former Senator Smith W. Brookhart, who had been removed from office by a vote of the Senate in 1924.

zh.t: 1926年美国艾奥瓦州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1926年美国艾奥瓦州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行，同一席位当天还举行特别选举。现任参议员阿尔伯特·B·卡明斯竞选第四个任期，但在共和党初选中败给前参议员史密斯·W·布鲁克哈特。布鲁克哈特曾在1924年被参议院投票罢免。

en.s: The 1926 Oregon gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 1926, to elect the governor of the U.S. state of Oregon. The election matched incumbent Democrat Walter M. Pierce against Republican Isaac L. Patterson and Independent candidate H. H. Stallard, who ran on an anti-Prohibition platform. Patterson won by a wide margin.

zh.s: 1926年俄勒冈州州长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州州长。民主党籍现任州长沃尔特·M·皮尔斯对阵共和党人艾萨克·L·帕特森，以及奉行反禁酒政纲的独立候选人H·H·斯塔拉德。帕特森以较大优势获胜。

en.t: 1926 United States Senate election in Maryland
en.s: The 1926 United States Senate election in Maryland was held on November 2, 1926. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Ovington Weller ran for re-election to a second term in office, but was beaten badly by Democratic U.S. Representative Millard Tydings of Havre de Grace.

zh.t: 1926年美国马里兰州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1926年美国马里兰州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员奥文顿·韦勒竞选连任第二个任期，但惨败于民主党联邦众议员、来自黑弗尔格雷斯的米勒德·泰丁斯。

en.s: The 1926 New Mexico gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1926. Incumbent Democratic Governor Arthur T. Hannett was defeated by Republican nominee Richard C. Dillon who won 51.60% of the vote. This was the first ever gubernatorial election in which Luna County voted for a Republican candidate.

zh.s: 1926年新墨西哥州州长选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州长亚瑟·T·汉尼特败给共和党候选人理查德·C·狄龙；狄龙获得51.60%的选票。这是卢纳县首次在州长选举中支持共和党候选人。

en.t: 1926 United States Senate election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1926 United States Senate election in Connecticut was held on November 2, 1926. Incumbent Senator Hiram Bingham III, who won a 1924 special election to complete the unexpired term of Frank B. Brandegee, was re-elected to a full term in office over Democrat Rollin U. Tyler.

zh.t: 1926年美国康涅狄格州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1926年美国康涅狄格州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。现任参议员海勒姆·宾厄姆三世在1924年特别选举中当选，完成弗兰克·B·布兰迪吉未满的任期；这次他击败民主党人罗林·U·泰勒，当选完整任期。

en.t: 1926 United States Senate election in Ohio
en.s: The 1926 United States Senate special election in Ohio was held on November 2, 1926. Incumbent Republican Senator Frank B. Willis was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating former U.S. Senator Atlee Pomerene.

zh.t: 1926年美国俄亥俄州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1926年美国俄亥俄州联邦参议员特别选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员弗兰克·B·威利斯击败前联邦参议员阿特利·波默伦，当选连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1926 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1926. Incumbent Republican John H. Trumbull defeated Democratic nominee Charles G. Morris with 63.58% of the vote.

zh.s: 1926年康涅狄格州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长约翰·H·特朗布尔击败民主党候选人查尔斯·G·莫里斯，获得63.58%的选票。

en.t: 1926 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1926 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held on November 2, 1926. Incumbent Senator Irvine Lenroot ran for a second term in office but lost the Republican primary to Governor John J. Blaine. Blaine won the general election over Democratic nominee Thomas Kearney and Socialist Leo Krzycki; his primary opposition, however, came from independent Republican candidate Charles D. Rosa.

zh.t: 1926年美国威斯康星州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1926年美国威斯康星州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。现任参议员欧文·伦鲁特竞选第二个任期，但在共和党初选中败给州长约翰·J·布莱恩。布莱恩随后在大选中击败民主党候选人托马斯·卡尼和社会党人利奥·克尔兹基；他在初选中的对手是独立共和党人查尔斯·D·罗萨。

en.t: 1926 United States Senate election in Indiana
en.s: The 1926 United States Senate election in Indiana took place on November 2, 1926. Incumbent Republican Senator James E. Watson was re-elected to a second full term in office over Democratic attorney Albert Stump.

zh.t: 1926年美国印第安纳州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1926年美国印第安纳州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员詹姆斯·E·沃森击败民主党律师阿尔伯特·斯顿普，连任第二个完整任期。

en.s: The 1926 Connecticut Attorney General election was held on November 2, 1926, in order to elect the Attorney General of Connecticut. Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Connecticut House of Representatives Benjamin W. Alling defeated Democratic nominee and former member of the Connecticut State Senate Frederick M. McCarthy.

zh.t: 1926年康涅狄格州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1926年康涅狄格州总检察长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州总检察长。共和党候选人、康涅狄格州众议院现任议员本杰明·W·艾林击败民主党候选人、前康涅狄格州参议员弗雷德里克·M·麦卡锡。

en.s: The 1926 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 2, 1926, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general Clifford L. Hilton defeated Farmer–Labor nominee Frank McAllister and Democratic nominee George Cahill.

zh.t: 1926年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1926年明尼苏达州总检察长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州总检察长。共和党候选人、现任总检察长克利福德·L·希尔顿击败农工党候选人弗兰克·麦卡利斯特和民主党候选人乔治·卡希尔。

en.s: The 1926 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1926. Incumbent Democrat Albert Ritchie defeated Republican nominee Addison E. Mullikin with 57.93% of the vote.

zh.s: 1926年马里兰州州长选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州长阿尔伯特·里奇击败共和党候选人艾迪生·E·穆利金，获得57.93%的选票。

en.s: The 1926 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1926. Republican Deputy Los Angeles County District Attorney Buron Fitts defeated Democratic State Assemblyman Charles O. Dunbar with 75.85% of the vote.

zh.t: 1926年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1926年加利福尼亚州副州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党候选人、洛杉矶县副地方检察官布伦·菲茨击败民主党候选人、州众议员查尔斯·O·邓巴，获得75.85%的选票。

en.t: 1926 United States Senate election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1926 United States Senate election in North Carolina was held on November 2, 1926. Incumbent Democratic Senator Lee Slater Overman was re-elected to a fifth term in office, defeating Republican Johnson Jay Hayes.

zh.t: 1926年北卡罗来纳州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1926年北卡罗来纳州联邦参议员选举于1926年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员李·斯莱特·奥弗曼击败共和党候选人约翰逊·杰伊·海斯，连任第五个任期。

en.s: The 1926 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1926. Incumbent Republican Benjamin S. Paulen defeated Democratic nominee Jonathan M. Davis with 63.31% of the vote.

zh.s: 1926年堪萨斯州州长选举于1926年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长本杰明·S·保伦以63.31%的得票率击败民主党候选人乔纳森·M·戴维斯。

en.s: The 1926 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1926. Incumbent Republican Aram J. Pothier defeated Democratic nominee Joseph H. Gainer with 53.90% of the vote.

zh.s: 1926年罗得岛州州长选举于1926年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长阿拉姆·J·波蒂耶以53.90%的得票率击败民主党候选人约瑟夫·H·盖纳。

en.s: The 1926 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1926. Incumbent Republican Governor Alvan T. Fuller was elected over Democrat William A. Gaston. This was Gaston's third and final unsuccessful bid for governor.

zh.s: 1926年马萨诸塞州州长选举于1926年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长阿尔文·T·富勒击败民主党候选人威廉·A·加斯顿，当选州长。这是加斯顿第三次也是最后一次竞选州长，但仍未成功。

en.s: The 1926 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1926. Republican nominee Huntley N. Spaulding defeated Democratic nominee Eaton D. Sargent with 59.70% of the vote.

zh.s: 1926年新罕布什尔州州长选举于1926年11月2日举行。共和党候选人亨特利·N·斯波尔丁以59.70%的得票率击败民主党候选人伊顿·D·萨金特。

en.s: The 1926 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1926, in order to elect the Governor of Texas. Incumbent Democratic Attorney general of Texas Dan Moody defeated Republican nominee H. H. Haines.

zh.s: 1926年得克萨斯州州长选举于1926年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州长丹·穆迪曾任得克萨斯州总检察长，他击败共和党候选人H·H·海恩斯。

en.s: The 1926 Nevada gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1926. Republican nominee Fred B. Balzar defeated Democratic incumbent James G. Scrugham with 53.00% of the vote.

en.s: The 1926 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1926, and featured incumbent Governor Adam McMullen, a Republican, narrowly defeating Democratic nominee, former Governor Charles W. Bryan, to win a second and final two-year term in office.

zh.s: 1926年内布拉斯加州州长选举于1926年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长亚当·麦克马伦险胜民主党候选人、前州长查尔斯·W·布赖恩，赢得第二个也是最后一个两年任期。

en.s: The 1926 Alabama gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 1926, in order to elect the governor of Alabama. Democratic incumbent William W. Brandon was term-limited, and could not seek a second consecutive term.

zh.s: 1926年阿拉巴马州州长选举于1926年11月2日举行，选举该州州长。民主党籍现任州长威廉·W·布兰登受任期限制，不能竞选连续第二个任期。

en.s: The 1926 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1926. Primary elections were held on September 7, 1926. Incumbent Republican Governor John J. Blaine retired to run for the U.S. Senate. Republican nominee Fred R. Zimmerman defeated Independent Charles B. Perry, Democratic nominee Virgil H. Cady and Socialist nominee Herman O. Kent.

zh.s: 1926年威斯康星州州长选举于1926年11月2日举行。初选于1926年9月7日举行。共和党籍现任州长约翰·J·布莱恩退休并转而竞选联邦参议员。共和党候选人弗雷德·R·齐默尔曼击败独立候选人查尔斯·B·佩里、民主党候选人维吉尔·H·凯迪和社会党候选人赫尔曼·O·肯特。

en.s: The 1926 Wyoming gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 1926. Incumbent Democratic Governor Nellie Tayloe Ross, first elected in the 1924 special election, ran for re-election to a second term. She was narrowly defeated by the Republican nominee, former State Engineer Frank Emerson.

zh.s: 1926年怀俄明州州长选举于1926年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州长内莉·泰洛·罗斯首次在1924年特别选举中当选，此次竞选连任第二个任期，但以微弱差距败给共和党候选人、前州工程师弗兰克·埃默森。

en.s: The 1926 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1926. Republican nominee H. C. Baldridge defeated Progressive nominee W. Scott Hall with 51.05% of the vote.

zh.s: 1926年爱达荷州州长选举于1926年11月2日举行。共和党候选人H·C·鲍德里奇以51.05%的得票率击败进步党候选人W·斯科特·霍尔。

en.s: The 1926 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 2, 1926, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Mike Holm defeated Farmer–Labor nominee Charles Olson.

zh.s: 1926年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于1926年11月2日举行。共和党候选人、现任州务卿迈克·霍尔姆击败农工党候选人查尔斯·奥尔森。

en.s: The 1926 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 2, 1926, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent state auditor Ray P. Chase defeated Farmer–Labor nominee Severin O. Tjosvold.

zh.t: 1926年明尼苏达州州审计长选举
zh.s: 1926年明尼苏达州州审计长选举于1926年11月2日举行。共和党候选人、现任州审计长雷·P·蔡斯击败农工党候选人塞韦林·O·乔斯沃尔德。

en.s: The 1926 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1926. Republican nominee Fred W. Green defeated Democratic nominee William Comstock with 63.35% of the vote.

zh.s: 1926年密歇根州州长选举于1926年11月2日举行。共和党候选人弗雷德·W·格林以63.35%的得票率击败民主党候选人威廉·康斯托克。

en.t: 1926 United States Senate election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1926 United States Senate election in North Dakota took place on November 2, 1926. Following his re-election in the special election earlier in the year, Senator Gerald Nye ran for re-election to a full term. Despite spurning the Republican Party's endorsement in the special election, Nye ran in the Republican primary in the regular election. On the same day that he defeated former Governor Louis B.

zh.t: 1926年美国北达科他州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1926年美国北达科他州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。参议员杰拉尔德·奈伊在当年早些时候的特别选举中连任后，又竞选完整任期。尽管他在特别选举中没有接受共和党背书，仍参加了常规选举的共和党初选。

en.t: 1926 United States Senate election in Colorado
en.s: The 1926 United States Senate election in Colorado took place on November 2, 1926. Incumbent Republican Senator Rice W. Means ran for re-election, but he was defeated in the Republican primary by Charles W. Waterman, a prominent attorney and party leader. In the general election, Waterman faced former Governor William Ellery Sweet, the Democratic nominee.

zh.t: 1926年科罗拉多州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1926年科罗拉多州联邦参议员选举于1926年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员赖斯·W·米恩斯竞选连任，但在共和党初选中败给知名律师、党内领袖查尔斯·W·沃特曼。大选中，沃特曼对阵民主党候选人、前州长威廉·埃勒里·斯威特。

en.s: The 1926 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1926. Incumbent Democrat A. Victor Donahey defeated Republican nominee Myers Y. Cooper with 50.33% of the vote.

zh.s: 1926年俄亥俄州州长选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州长A·维克托·多纳希击败共和党候选人迈尔斯·Y·库珀，获得50.33%的选票。

en.s: The 1926 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1926. Incumbent Republican Arthur G. Sorlie defeated Democratic nominee David M. Holmes in a landslide victory with 81.74% of the vote. Sorlie won with the biggest vote percentage (and Holmes, in contrast, the fewest for a major party nominee) in North Dakota history.

zh.s: 1926年北达科他州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长阿瑟·G·索利以压倒性优势击败民主党候选人大卫·M·霍姆斯，得票率为81.74%。索利的得票率创北达科他州历史最高纪录；霍姆斯的得票率则是该州主要政党候选人中的最低纪录。

en.t: 1926 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1926 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 2, 1926. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Wesley Livsey Jones was re-elected to a fourth term in office over Seattle attorney A. Scott Bullitt. Frank E. Hammond, one of the losing candidates on the Republican side, ran as a "wet" candidate, opposing the prohibition of alcohol, which was already in effect in Washington state, but not yet nationally.

zh.t: 1926年华盛顿州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1926年华盛顿州联邦参议员选举于1926年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任联邦参议员韦斯利·利夫赛·琼斯击败西雅图律师A·斯科特·布利特，成功连任第四个任期。共和党初选中的落败候选人之一弗兰克·E·哈蒙德以支持合法饮酒的“湿派”候选人身份参选；当时华盛顿州已实行禁酒令，但全国尚未实行。

en.s: The 1926 New York state election was held on November 2, 1926, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, the state comptroller, the attorney general, a U.S. senator, the chief judge and an associate judge of the New York Court of Appeals, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly and the New York State Senate.

zh.s: 1926年纽约州选举于1926年11月2日举行，选出州长、副州长、州审计长、总检察长、一名联邦参议员、纽约州上诉法院首席法官和一名副法官，并改选纽约州众议院和州参议院全部议员。

en.t: 1926 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The United States Senate election of 1926 in New York was held on November 2, 1926. Incumbent Republican Senator James Wolcott Wadsworth Jr. ran for re-election to a third term, but was defeated by Democrat Robert F. Wagner.

zh.s: 1926年纽约州联邦参议员选举于1926年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员詹姆斯·沃尔科特·沃兹沃思二世竞选连任第三个任期，但败给了民主党人罗伯特·F·瓦格纳。

en.s: The 1926 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1926 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 21 of the state senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the 1926 elections is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1926年艾奥瓦州参议院选举是当年每两年举行一次的美国选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民在50个州参议院选区中选出21个选区的参议员。州参议员任期四年。艾奥瓦州议会提供了1926年选举中50个州参议院选区的全州地图。

en.t: Haile Selassie I is crowned emperor of Ethiopia
en.s: On November 2, 1930, Tafari Makonnen was crowned Haile Selassie I, emperor of Ethiopia, at a ceremony in Addis Ababa. He had succeeded Empress Zewditu after her death earlier that year. The coronation marked his public enthronement; his accession to the throne had already taken place in April.
en.n: The coronation took place November 2, 1930, several months after his April accession to the throne.

zh.t: 海尔·塞拉西一世加冕为埃塞俄比亚皇帝
zh.s: 1930年11月2日，塔法里·马康南在亚的斯亚贝巴举行加冕仪式，成为埃塞俄比亚皇帝海尔·塞拉西一世。女皇佐迪图去世后，他已在同年4月继承皇位；11月2日举行的是正式加冕典礼，不是他第一次继位的日期。
zh.n: 加冕仪式举行于1930年11月2日；他在同年4月已经继承皇位。

en.s: Elections to Manchester City Council were held on Monday, 2 November 1931. One third of the councillors seats were up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a three-year term of office. The council remained under no overall control.

en.s: The 1933 British Columbia general election was the eighteenth general election in the Province of British Columbia, Canada. It was held to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of British Columbia. The election was called on September 13, 1933, and held on November 2, 1933. The new legislature met for the first time on February 20, 1934. The Liberal Party won a majority government.

en.t: 1936 United States Senate election in Alabama
en.s: The 1936 United States Senate election in Alabama was held on November 2, 1936. Senator John H. Bankhead II was re-elected to a second term in office over Republican H. E. Berkstresser.

zh.t: 1936年美国阿拉巴马州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1936年美国阿拉巴马州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。参议员约翰·H·班克黑德二世成功连任第二个任期，击败共和党人H·E·伯克斯特瑟。

en.s: Elections to Sale Council were held on Monday, 2 November 1936. One third of the councillors were up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a three-year term of office. Independents retained overall control of the council.

zh.t: 1936年塞尔市政自治市议会选举
zh.s: 塞尔市议会选举于1936年11月2日（星期一）举行。三分之一的市议员席位进行改选，胜选者任期三年。独立派继续控制市议会多数。

en.t: The BBC Television Service, the world's first regular, "high-definition" (then defined as at least 200 lines) service begins. Renamed BBC1 in 1964, the channel still runs to this day
en.s: BBC Television is the television service of the BBC. The corporation has operated a public broadcast television service in the United Kingdom, under the terms of a royal charter, since 1 January 1927. It produced television programmes from its own studios from 1932, although the start of its regular service of television broadcasts is dated to 2 November 1936.

zh.t: BBC电视服务开播，这是世界上首个定期播出的“高清”电视服务（当时高清的定义是至少200线）；该频道于1964年更名为BBC1，至今仍在播出
zh.s: BBC电视是英国广播公司（BBC）的电视服务。根据皇家特许状，BBC自1927年1月1日起在英国运营公共电视广播服务；1932年起，BBC开始在自有演播室制作电视节目。其定期电视广播服务于1936年11月2日开播。

en.t: The CBC was established on November 2, 1936
en.s: The Canadian Broadcasting Corporation (French: Société Radio-Canada), branded as CBC/Radio-Canada, is the Canadian public broadcaster for both radio and television. It is a Crown corporation that serves as the national public broadcaster, with its English-language and French-language service units known as CBC and Radio-Canada, respectively. Although some local stations in Canada predate its founding, the CBC is the oldest continually-existing broadcasting network in Canada.

zh.s: 加拿大广播公司（CBC/Radio-Canada）是加拿大面向广播和电视的公共广播机构，也称加拿大广播电台。它是一家国有企业，承担国家公共广播服务，英语和法语频道分别称为CBC和Radio-Canada。加拿大一些地方电台成立得更早，但CBC是该国持续运营至今最久的广播电视网络。

en.s: The Mayoral election of 1937 in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania was held on Tuesday, November 2, 1937. Incumbent Democrat Conn Scully, the former City Council President who had assumed the executive rank in October 1936, after the resignation of William McNair, was elected to a first full term. The McNair administration had been shrouded in controversy, including hostile relations between the mayor and both city council and the county bureaucracy, as well as a slow response to the devastating St. Patrick's Day Flood. Scully had been a vocal McNair adversary and was closely connected to David L.

en.s: The 1937 Virginia gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1937. James Hubert Price, incumbent lieutenant governor and former member of the Virginia House of Delegates, was nominated by the Democratic Party to run against the Republican nominee, former state senator John Powell Royall.

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 2, 1937, in two states. Virginia holds its gubernatorial elections in odd numbered years, every 4 years, following the United States presidential election year. New Jersey at this time held gubernatorial elections every 3 years, which it would abandon in 1949. This marks the Democratic Party's largest gubernatorial extent in history and the largest for any party.

zh.s: 1937年11月2日，美国有两个州举行州长选举。弗吉尼亚州每四年在总统选举年之后的奇数年举行州长选举。当时新泽西州每三年举行一次州长选举，这一安排于1949年取消。这次选举让民主党取得该党历史上最多的州长职位，也是任何政党当时取得的最大规模。

en.s: The 1937 New York City mayoral election took place on November 2, 1937, in New York City. Incumbent Mayor Fiorello La Guardia, the Republican candidate, was reelected with 60.09% of the vote, defeating the Democratic candidate Jeremiah T. Mahoney, a lawyer and former New York Supreme Court justice, as well as other, third-party candidates.

zh.s: 1937年纽约市市长选举于11月2日举行。共和党候选人、现任市长菲奥雷洛·拉瓜迪亚以60.09%的选票成功连任，击败民主党候选人、律师及前纽约州最高法院法官杰里迈亚·T·马奥尼，以及其他第三党候选人。

en.s: The 1937 Virginia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1937, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Virginia. Democratic nominee and incumbent President pro tempore of the Senate of Virginia Saxon W. Holt defeated Republican nominee Samuel A. Reynolds and Prohibition nominee R. L. Alter.

zh.s: 1937年弗吉尼亚州副州长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州副州长。民主党候选人、弗吉尼亚州参议院临时议长萨克森·W·霍尔特击败共和党候选人塞缪尔·A·雷诺兹和禁酒党候选人R·L·奥尔特。

en.s: The Boston mayoral election of 1937 occurred on Tuesday, November 2, 1937. Boston School Committee member Maurice J. Tobin defeated five other candidates, including former mayors James Michael Curley and Malcolm Nichols. In 1918, the Massachusetts state legislature had passed legislation making the Mayor of Boston ineligible to serve consecutive terms. Thus, incumbent Frederick Mansfield was unable to run for re-election.

zh.s: 1937年波士顿市长选举于11月2日（星期二）举行。波士顿学校委员会成员莫里斯·J·托宾击败另外5名候选人，其中包括前市长詹姆斯·迈克尔·柯利和马尔科姆·尼科尔斯。马萨诸塞州议会于1918年通过法律，禁止波士顿市长连续任职，因此现任市长弗雷德里克·曼斯菲尔德不能竞选连任。

en.s: Elections were held on November 2, 1937, to fill the New York City Council, which had just been formed to replace the New York City Board of Aldermen. The new Council comprised 26 members elected via proportional representation by borough, in contrast to the 65-member Board of Aldermen formerly elected by single-member district district.

zh.s: 1937年11月2日举行选举，选出刚成立的纽约市议会成员。新市议会取代纽约市参事会，由26名成员组成，按行政区采用比例代表制选出。此前的市参事会有65名成员，按单一选区选出。

en.s: The Cleveland mayoral election of 1937 was held on November 2, 1937. The election resulted in the reelection of incumbent Republican candidate Harold Hitz Burton.

zh.s: 1937年克利夫兰市长选举于1937年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任市长哈罗德·希茨·伯顿成功连任。

en.s: The Battle of Elaia–Kalamas (Greek: Μάχη Ελαίας-Καλαμά, romanized: Machi Elaias-Kalama) took place in Epirus on 2–8 November 1940. The battle was fought between the Greeks and the Italians during the initial stage of the Greco-Italian War in World War II. The Royal Italian Army, deployed on the Greek-Albanian border, launched an offensive against Greece on 28 October 1940.

zh.s: 埃莱亚—卡拉马斯战役于1940年11月2日至8日在伊庇鲁斯发生。第二次世界大战希意战争初期，希腊军队与意大利军队在此交战。意大利皇家陆军部署在希腊—阿尔巴尼亚边境，并于1940年10月28日向希腊发动进攻。

en.s: The 1941 Copa Adrián C. Escober Final was the final that decided the winner of the 2nd. edition of Copa Adrián C. Escobar, an Argentine domestic cup organised by the Argentine Football Association. The match was contested by River Plate and Huracán, both being finalists for the first time. The final was held in River Plate Stadium on November 2, 1941.

zh.t: 1941年阿德里安·埃斯科瓦尔杯决赛
zh.s: 1941年阿德里安·C·埃斯科瓦尔杯决赛决定了第二届阿根廷国内杯赛的冠军。该赛事由阿根廷足球协会主办，决赛由河床队对阵飓风队；两队此前都未进过决赛。比赛于1941年11月2日在河床体育场举行。

en.s: The 1941 Tschammerpokal final decided the winner of the 1941 Tschammerpokal, the 7th season of Germany's knockout football cup competition. It was played on 2 November 1941 at the Olympiastadion in Berlin. Dresdner SC won the match 2–1 against Schalke 04, to claim their 2nd cup title.

zh.s: 1941年德国足协杯决赛决出了该年度德国足协杯冠军，这是德国淘汰制足球杯赛的第七届赛事。决赛于1941年11月2日在柏林奥林匹克体育场举行。德累斯顿体育俱乐部以2比1击败沙尔克04，赢得队史第二座杯赛冠军。

en.s: The Battle of Trešnjica was fought 2 November 1941 between partisan and Chetnik detachments and was the first major battle between Chetniks and partisans. This battle marks the beginning of an open conflict between formations under the command of Josip Broz Tito and Colonel Dragoljub Mihailović and implies the end of the two-month partial cooperation between the Partisan and Ravnagorje Chetnik movements in the area of western and central Serbia .

zh.s: 特雷什尼察战役于1941年11月2日爆发，交战双方是游击队和切特尼克武装。这是切特尼克与游击队之间的第一场大规模战斗，标志着约瑟普·布罗兹·铁托和德拉戈柳布·米哈伊洛维奇上校所率部队公开冲突的开始，也意味着游击队与拉夫纳戈拉切特尼克运动在塞尔维亚西部和中部地区长达两个月的有限合作结束。

en.s: The Partisan–Chetnik War or 1941-1945 Yugoslav internal War was an armed conflict between the communist Yugoslav Partisans and the monarchist Chetniks which lasted from 1941 (after the end of the Chetnik Partisan Alliance during the Serbian Uprising in the Second World War) until 1945 (the end of the Second World War in Yugoslavia).

zh.t: 南斯拉夫游击队—切特尼克战争（1941—1945年）
zh.s: 南斯拉夫游击队—切特尼克战争，也称1941—1945年南斯拉夫内战，是共产党领导的南斯拉夫游击队与君主主义切特尼克武装之间的武装冲突。冲突始于1941年，即第二次世界大战期间塞尔维亚起义中的游击队与切特尼克联盟结束之后；至1945年南斯拉夫的第二次世界大战结束时告终。

en.t: 1942 United States Senate election in Michigan
en.s: The 1942 United States Senate election in Michigan was held on November 2, 1942. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Prentiss M. Brown ran for re-election to second term in office, but was defeated by Republican Homer S. Ferguson.

zh.t: 1942年美国密歇根州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1942年美国密歇根州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员普伦蒂斯·M·布朗竞选连任第二个任期，但败给共和党人霍默·S·弗格森。

en.s: In 1942, German U-boats attacked Bell Island twice which led to four cargo ships being sunk, and more than 60 sailors killed. This made it one of the few places in the Dominion of Newfoundland that came under attack during the Second World War. These engagements are considered a part of a larger battle, the Battle of the Atlantic.

zh.s: 1942年，德国潜艇两次袭击贝尔岛，击沉4艘货船，造成60多名水手死亡。贝尔岛因此成为纽芬兰自治领二战期间少数遭到攻击的地点之一。这两次袭击被视为大西洋战役的一部分。

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1943 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 2, 1943. Republican Walter Evans Edge defeated Democratic nominee Vincent J. Murphy with 55.20% of the vote.

zh.s: 1943年新泽西州州长选举于1943年11月2日举行。共和党候选人沃尔特·埃文斯·埃奇以55.20%的得票率击败民主党候选人文森特·J·墨菲。

en.s: The 1943 Kentucky gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1943. Republican nominee Simeon Willis defeated Democratic nominee J. Lyter Donaldson with 50.49% of the vote, becoming the first Republican elected Governor of Kentucky since 1927.

zh.s: 1943年肯塔基州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党候选人西缅·威利斯击败民主党候选人J·莱特·唐纳森，获得50.49%的选票，成为自1927年以来首位当选肯塔基州州长的共和党人。

en.s: The 1943 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 1943, to elect the Governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Democrat Paul B. Johnson Sr. was term-limited, and could not run for reelection to a second term (he died less than two months after the election was held). As was common at the time, the Democratic candidate ran unopposed in the general election so therefore the Democratic primary was the real contest, and winning the primary was considered tantamount to election.

zh.s: 1943年密西西比州州长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州州长。民主党籍现任州长保罗·B·约翰逊一世因任期限制不能竞选连任第二个任期；他在选举举行不到两个月后去世。当时民主党候选人通常在大选中没有对手，因此民主党初选才是真正的角逐，赢得初选就等于当选。

en.s: The 1943 San Francisco mayoral election was held on November 2, 1943. Roger Lapham was elected with 41% of the vote.

zh.s: 1943年旧金山市长选举于1943年11月2日举行。罗杰·拉帕姆当选，得票率为41%。

en.s: The Columbus, Ohio, mayoral election of 1943 saw the election of Jim Rhodes.

zh.t: 1943年俄亥俄州哥伦布市市长选举
zh.s: 1943年俄亥俄州哥伦布市市长选举由吉姆·罗兹当选。

en.s: Mayoral elections were held in 1943 in Cleveland, Ohio. The election saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Frank Lausche.

zh.t: 1943年俄亥俄州克利夫兰市长选举
zh.s: 俄亥俄州克利夫兰市于1943年举行市长选举。现任市长弗兰克·劳舍成功连任。

en.s: The Battle of Empress Augusta Bay, on 1–2 November 1943 – also known as the Battle of Gazelle Bay, Operation Cherry Blossom, and in Japanese sources as the Sea Battle off Bougainville Island (ブーゲンビル島沖海戦) – was a naval battle fought at night in Empress Augusta Bay near Bougainville Island. The naval battle was a result of Allied landings at Cape Torokina in the first action in the Bougainville campaign of World War II.

zh.s: 1943年11月1日至2日，盟军与日军在布干维尔岛附近的皇后奥古斯塔湾夜间交战。这场海战也称瞪羚湾海战，由盟军在托罗基纳角登陆引发，是二战布干维尔战役的首场行动。

en.t: Howard Hughes flies the H-4 Hercules flying boat
en.s: On November 2, 1947, Howard Hughes piloted the H-4 Hercules, nicknamed the Spruce Goose, on its first and only flight over Long Beach Harbor in California. The huge wooden flying boat briefly lifted off during what had begun as a taxi test. Designed as a wartime cargo and troop carrier, it was completed after World War II and never entered regular service. The aircraft is preserved in McMinnville, Oregon.
en.n: The H-4 Hercules flew once, at Long Beach Harbor on November 2, 1947.

zh.t: 霍华德·休斯驾驶H-4“云杉鹅”完成唯一一次飞行
zh.s: 1947年11月2日，霍华德·休斯驾驶H-4“赫拉克勒斯”飞行艇，在美国加利福尼亚州长滩港上空完成了它的第一次、也是唯一一次飞行。这架绰号“云杉鹅”的大型木制飞机原本只是在水面滑行测试，却短暂升空。它设计于二战期间，计划用来运输人员和物资，但直到战后才完工，也从未投入常规运营。如今飞机保存在俄勒冈州麦克明维尔。
zh.n: H-4“云杉鹅”唯一的一次飞行发生在1947年11月2日，地点是长滩港。

en.t: United States Senate election in Montana, 1948
en.s: The 1948 United States Senate election in Montana took place on November 2, 1948. Incumbent United States Senator James E. Murray, who was first elected to the Senate in a special election in 1934 and was re-elected in 1936 and 1942, ran for re-election. After winning the Democratic primary, he faced Tom J. Davis, an attorney and the Republican nominee, in the general election. Following a narrow re-election in 1936, Murray significantly expanded his margin of victory and comfortably won re-election over Davis, winning his fourth term and his third full term in the Senate.

zh.t: 1948年美国蒙大拿州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1948年美国蒙大拿州联邦参议员选举于1948年11月2日举行。现任参议员詹姆斯·E·默里于1934年在特别选举中首次当选，之后于1936年和1942年连任，这次再次竞选。赢得民主党初选后，他在大选中迎战律师、共和党候选人汤姆·J·戴维斯。默里在1936年仅以微弱优势连任；这次他的胜差大幅扩大，轻松击败戴维斯，赢得第四个参议员任期，其中第三个是完整任期。

en.t: United States presidential election in Vermont, 1948
en.s: The 1948 United States Presidential Election in Vermont took place on November 2, 1948 as part of the 1948 United States Presidential Election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose 3 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Vermont voted for the Republican nominee, former Governor Thomas E. Dewey of New York, over the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Harry S. Truman of Missouri. Dewey's running mate was Governor Earl Warren of California, while Truman ran with Senator Alben W. Barkley of Kentucky.

zh.s: 1948年美国佛蒙特州总统选举于1948年11月2日举行，是当时全部48个州参加的美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出3名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。佛蒙特州支持共和党候选人、纽约州前州长托马斯·E·杜威，击败民主党候选人、密苏里州在任总统哈里·S·杜鲁门。杜威的竞选搭档是加利福尼亚州州长厄尔·沃伦；杜鲁门的搭档是肯塔基州参议员阿尔本·W·巴克利。

en.t: United States presidential election in Texas, 1948
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in Texas was held on November 2, 1948. Texas voters chose 23 electors to represent the state in the Electoral College, which chose the President and Vice President. Texas overwhelmingly voted for the Democratic nominee Harry S. Truman, who received 66% of the vote. Texas was Truman's strongest state, and one of four in the country which gave Truman over 60% of the popular vote. Truman carried 246 out of the state's 254 counties.

zh.t: 1948年美国得克萨斯州总统选举
zh.s: 1948年美国得克萨斯州总统选举于1948年11月2日举行。得州选民选出23名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。得州以压倒性优势支持民主党候选人哈里·S·杜鲁门，得票率为66%。得州是杜鲁门表现最好的州，也是全国四个让他获得超过60%普选票的州之一。杜鲁门赢得该州254个县中的246个。
