en.t: United States presidential election in Minnesota, 1948
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 2, 1948 in Minnesota as part of the 1948 United States presidential election. The Democratic candidate, incumbent President Harry S. Truman, who had assumed the presidency following the death of Franklin D. Roosevelt in 1945, won the state over New York governor Thomas E. Dewey by a margin of 209,349 votes, or 17.27%. Nationally, the election was the greatest election upset in American history; nearly every prediction forecast that Truman would be defeated by Dewey, but in the end, Truman won the election with 303 electoral votes and a comfortable 4.5% lead over Dewey in the popular vote.

zh.t: 1948年美国明尼苏达州总统选举
zh.s: 1948年美国明尼苏达州总统选举于1948年11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。民主党候选人、现任总统哈里·S·杜鲁门（他于1945年富兰克林·D·罗斯福去世后继任总统）以209,349票、即17.27个百分点的优势击败纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威，赢得明尼苏达州。全国范围内，这场选举被视为美国历史上最出人意料的选举；几乎所有预测都认为杜鲁门会输给杜威，但最终杜鲁门获得303张选举人票，并以普选票领先4.5个百分点获胜。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Mexico, 1948
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in New Mexico took place on November 2, 1948. All 48 States were part of the United States presidential election. New Mexico voters chose four electors to represent them in the Electoral College, which voted for President and Vice President. New Mexico was won by incumbent President Harry S. Truman, who took the Oval Office after the death of President Franklin D. Roosevelt. Running against Truman was Governor of New York Thomas E. Dewey, who was strongly predicted to win the contest.

zh.t: 1948年美国新墨西哥州总统选举
zh.s: 1948年美国新墨西哥州总统选举于1948年11月2日举行，当时全部48个州都参加了美国总统选举。新墨西哥州选民选出4名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。现任总统哈里·S·杜鲁门赢得新墨西哥州；他是在富兰克林·D·罗斯福总统去世后继任总统的。杜鲁门的对手是纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威，当时许多预测都认为杜威会获胜。

en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in New Hampshire took place on November 2, 1948 as part of the 1948 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. zh.t: 1948年美国新罕布什尔州总统选举
zh.s: 1948年美国新罕布什尔州总统选举于1948年11月2日举行，是当时全部48个州参加的美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。新罕布什尔州由共和党候选人、纽约州前州长托马斯·E·杜威及其竞选搭档、加利福尼亚州州长厄尔·沃伦获胜。两人击败了民主党候选人、现任总统哈里·S·杜鲁门及其竞选搭档、参议员阿尔本·W·巴克利。

Barkley of Kentucky, while Dewey's running mate was Governor Earl Warren of California.

zh.t: 1948年美国马萨诸塞州总统选举
zh.s: 1948年美国马萨诸塞州总统选举于1948年11月2日举行，是当时全部48个州参加的美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出16名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。马萨诸塞州支持民主党候选人、现任总统哈里·S·杜鲁门，击败共和党候选人、纽约州前州长托马斯·E·杜威。杜鲁门的竞选搭档是肯塔基州参议员阿尔本·W·巴克利；杜威的搭档是加利福尼亚州州长厄尔·沃伦。

en.t: United States presidential election in New York, 1948
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 2, 1948. All contemporary 48 states were part of the 1948 United States presidential election. New York voters chose 47 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New York was won by local Republican Governor Thomas E. Dewey, who was running against incumbent Democratic President Harry S. Truman. Dewey ran with California Governor Earl Warren for Vice President, and Truman ran with Kentucky Senator Alben W. Barkley. Dewey took 45.99% of the vote to Truman's 45.01%, a margin of 0.99%.

zh.s: 1948年美国纽约州总统选举于1948年11月2日举行。当时全部48个州都参加了美国总统选举。纽约州选民选出47名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。纽约州由当地共和党籍州长托马斯·E·杜威获胜，对手是民主党籍现任总统哈里·S·杜鲁门。杜威的竞选搭档是加利福尼亚州州长厄尔·沃伦，杜鲁门的搭档是肯塔基州参议员阿尔本·W·巴克利。杜威得票率为45.99%，杜鲁门为45.01%，两人相差0.99个百分点。

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1948 was the 41st quadrennial presidential election, held on Tuesday, November 2, 1948. Incumbent President Harry S. Truman, the Democratic nominee, who had succeeded to the presidency after the death of President Franklin D. Roosevelt in 1945, successfully ran for election for a full term against Thomas E. Dewey, the Republican nominee, who also was the Republican presidential nominee in 1944 The election is considered to be the greatest election upset in American history. Virtually every prediction (with or without public opinion polls) indicated that Truman would be defeated by Dewey.

zh.s: 1948年美国总统选举是美国第41次四年一度的总统选举，于1948年11月2日星期二举行。民主党籍现任总统哈里·S·杜鲁门在1945年富兰克林·D·罗斯福总统去世后继任，这次成功争取完整任期，对手是共和党候选人托马斯·E·杜威。杜威在1944年也曾获共和党提名参选总统。这场选举被视为美国历史上最出人意料的选举。几乎所有预测，无论是否依据民调，都认为杜鲁门会输给杜威。

en.t: United States presidential election in Pennsylvania, 1948
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania took place on November 2, 1948 throughout the continuous 48 states. Voters chose 35 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Pennsylvania voted for the Republican nominee, New York Governor Thomas E. Dewey, over the Democratic nominee, President Harry Truman. Dewey won Pennsylvania by a margin of 4.01%. As of 2012, this is the last time that a Democrat won the national election without carrying Pennsylvania. It was also the last time until 1968 that a presidential candidate won the election without carrying the state.

zh.t: 1948年美国宾夕法尼亚州总统选举
zh.s: 1948年美国宾夕法尼亚州总统选举于11月2日举行，当时美国本土相连的48个州都参加了总统选举。选民选出35名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。宾夕法尼亚州支持共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威，击败民主党候选人、总统哈里·杜鲁门。杜威在宾州领先4.01个百分点。截至2012年，这是民主党总统候选人赢得全国选举却未赢得宾州的最后一次，也是总统候选人未赢得宾州仍当选总统的最后一次（直到1968年）。

en.t: United States presidential election in Virginia, 1948
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in Virginia took place on November 2, 1948 throughout the 48 contiguous states. Voters chose 11 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Virginia voted for the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Harry S. Truman, over the Republican nominee, New York Governor Thomas E. Dewey and South Carolina Governor Strom Thurmond, who received the nomination of the States' Rights Democratic Party. Truman ultimately won the national election with 49.55% of the vote.

zh.t: 1948年美国弗吉尼亚州总统选举
zh.s: 1948年美国弗吉尼亚州总统选举于11月2日举行，当时美国本土相连的48个州都参加了总统选举。选民选出11名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。弗吉尼亚州支持民主党候选人、现任总统哈里·S·杜鲁门，击败共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威，以及获得州权民主党提名的南卡罗来纳州州长斯特罗姆·瑟蒙德。杜鲁门最终以49.55%的全国得票率赢得总统选举。

en.s: The Missouri gubernatorial election of 1948 was Missouri's thirty-seventh gubernatorial election. The election was held on November 2, 1948 and resulted in a victory for the Democratic nominee, State Auditor Forrest Smith, over the Republican candidate Murray Thompson, and candidates representing the Progressive, Socialist and Socialist Labor parties.

zh.s: 1948年密苏里州州长选举是该州第37次州长选举，于1948年11月2日举行。民主党候选人、州审计长福里斯特·史密斯击败共和党候选人默里·汤普森，以及进步党、社会党和社会工党候选人，当选州长。

en.t: United States presidential election in Wisconsin, 1948
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in Wisconsin was held on November 2, 1948. Wisconsin voters chose twelve electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Democratic Party candidate Harry S. Truman won the state with 51% of the popular vote, winning Wisconsin's twelve electoral votes.

zh.t: 1948年美国总统选举威斯康星州结果
zh.s: 1948年美国总统选举威斯康星州投票于11月2日举行。威斯康星州选民选出12名总统选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。民主党候选人哈里·S·杜鲁门以51%的普选票赢得该州，也获得威斯康星州的12张选举人票。

en.t: United States Senate election in Virginia, 1948
en.s: The 1948 United States Senate election in Virginia was held on November 2, 1948. Incumbent Democratic Senator Absalom Willis Robertson defeated Republican Robert H. Woods and was re-elected to his first full term in office.

zh.s: 1948年弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员阿布萨隆·威利斯·罗伯逊击败共和党候选人罗伯特·H·伍兹，当选完整任期。

en.s: General elections were held in Puerto Rico on 2 November 1948. Luis Muñoz Marín of the Popular Democratic Party won the gubernatorial elections with 61.2% of the vote.

en.t: United States Senate election in Massachusetts, 1948
en.s: The United States Senate election of 1948 in Massachusetts was held on November 2, 1948, with Republican incumbent Leverett Saltonstall defeating his challengers.

zh.s: 1948年马萨诸塞州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员莱弗里特·索尔顿斯托尔击败挑战者，成功连任。

en.s: The 1948 West Virginia gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 1948, to elect the governor of West Virginia.

en.s: The Vermont gubernatorial election of 1948 took place on November 2, 1948. Incumbent Republican Ernest W. Gibson, Jr. ran successfully for re-election to a second term as Governor of Vermont, defeating Democratic candidate Charles F. Ryan.

zh.s: 1948年佛蒙特州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长小欧内斯特·W·吉布森成功连任，击败民主党候选人查尔斯·F·瑞安。

en.s: The 1948 Minnesota gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 1948. Republican Party of Minnesota candidate Luther Youngdahl defeated Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party challenger Charles Halsted.

zh.s: 1948年明尼苏达州州长选举于11月2日举行。明尼苏达州共和党候选人卢瑟·扬达尔击败明尼苏达州民主党—农民—劳工党候选人查尔斯·哈尔斯特德。

en.s: The 1948 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1948. Democrat Paul A. Dever defeated Republican incumbent Robert F. Bradford, Socialist Labor candidate Horace Hillis, and Prohibition candidate Mark R. Shaw. In the race for Lieutenant Governor, Democrat Charles F. Sullivan defeated Republican incumbent Arthur W. Coolidge, Socialist Labor candidate Lawrence Gilfedder, and Prohibition candidate Guy S. Williams.

zh.s: 1948年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月2日举行。民主党候选人保罗·A·德弗击败共和党籍现任州长罗伯特·F·布拉德福德、社会工党候选人霍勒斯·希利斯和禁酒党候选人马克·R·肖。在副州长选举中，民主党候选人查尔斯·F·沙利文击败共和党籍现任副州长阿瑟·W·库利奇、社会工党候选人劳伦斯·吉尔费德和禁酒党候选人盖伊·S·威廉姆斯。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina, 1948
en.s: The 1948 South Carolina United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 2, 1948 to select six Representatives for two-year terms from the state of South Carolina. Four incumbents were re-elected, but John J. Riley of the 2nd congressional district was defeated in the Democratic primary by Hugo S. Sims, Jr.

zh.t: 1948年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1948年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举于11月2日举行，选出六名众议员，任期两年。四名现任议员成功连任；第二选区的约翰·J·赖利则在民主党初选中败给小休戈·S·西姆斯。

en.t: United States presidential election in Montana, 1948
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in Montana took place on November 2, 1948, throughout the continuous 48 states. Voters chose 4 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Montana voted for the Democratic nominee, President Harry Truman, over the Republican nominee, New York Governor Thomas E. Dewey. Truman won Montana by a large margin of 9.94%.

zh.s: 1948年美国蒙大拿州总统选举于11月2日在当时连续相连的48个州举行。选民选出4名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。蒙大拿州支持民主党候选人、总统哈里·杜鲁门，击败共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威。杜鲁门以9.94个百分点的较大优势赢得该州。

en.s: The 1948 Montana gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 1948. Incumbent Governor of Montana Sam C. Ford, who was first elected Governor in 1940 and was re-elected in 1944, ran for re-election. He won the Republican primary and advanced to the general election, where he faced John W. Bonner, the former Attorney General of Montana and the Democratic nominee.

zh.s: 1948年蒙大拿州州长选举于11月2日举行。现任州长萨姆·C·福特于1940年首次当选，并于1944年连任，这次竞选连任。他赢得共和党初选，进入大选，对手是前蒙大拿州总检察长、民主党候选人约翰·W·邦纳。

en.t: United States Senate election in South Carolina, 1948
en.s: The 1948 South Carolina United States Senate election was held on November 2, 1948 to select the U.S. Senator from the state of South Carolina. Incumbent Democratic Senator Burnet R. Maybank won the Democratic primary and defeated Republican challenger J. Bates Gerald in the general election to win another six-year term.

zh.t: 1948年美国南卡罗来纳州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1948年美国南卡罗来纳州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行，选出该州联邦参议员。民主党籍现任参议员伯内特·R·梅班克赢得民主党初选，并在大选中击败共和党挑战者J·贝茨·杰拉德，连任六年。

en.t: 1948 United States presidential election in Illinois
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in Illinois took place on November 2, 1948, as part of the 1948 United States presidential election. State voters chose 28 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Illinois was won by incumbent President Harry S. Truman (D–Missouri), running with Senator Alben W.

zh.t: 1948年美国伊利诺伊州总统选举
zh.s: 1948年美国伊利诺伊州总统选举于11月2日举行，是1948年美国总统选举的一部分。伊利诺伊州选民选出28名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。现任总统、来自密苏里州的民主党人哈里·S·杜鲁门赢得伊利诺伊州；他的竞选搭档是参议员阿尔本·W·巴克利。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1948, in 33 states, concurrent with the House, Senate elections and presidential election, on November 2, 1948. Elections took place on September 13 in Maine. This was the last time Connecticut elected its governors to 2-year terms, switching to 4-year terms from the 1950 election.

zh.s: 1948年11月2日，美国有33个州举行州长选举，与联邦众议院、联邦参议院和总统选举同时进行。缅因州的选举于9月13日举行。这是康涅狄格州最后一次选举任期为两年的州长；从1950年选举起，州长任期改为四年。

en.s: The 1948 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 2, 1948, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general Joseph A. A. Burnquist defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee Francis M. Smith.

zh.t: 1948年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1948年明尼苏达州总检察长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州总检察长。共和党候选人、现任总检察长约瑟夫·A·A·伯恩奎斯特击败民主—农民—劳工党候选人弗朗西斯·M·史密斯。

en.t: 1948 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in Arkansas took place on November 2, 1948, as part of the 1948 United States presidential election. State voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. This would be the last presidential election where Arkansas had nine electoral votes: the Great Migration would see the state lose three congressional districts in the next decade-and-a-half.

zh.s: 1948年美国阿肯色州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。阿肯色州选民选出9名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。这是阿肯色州最后一次拥有9张选举人票的总统选举；大迁徙导致该州在随后约15年内失去3个国会选区。

en.s: The 1948 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 2, 1948, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Democratic nominee and former member of the Missouri House of Representatives Mount Etna Morris defeated Republican nominee Vern F. Carpenter, Progressive nominee James W. Cowen, Socialist nominee Lucy Henschel and Socialist Labor nominee Theodore Baeff.

zh.s: 1948年密苏里州财长选举于1948年11月2日举行。民主党候选人、前密苏里州众议员芒特·伊特纳·莫里斯击败共和党候选人弗恩·F·卡彭特、进步党候选人詹姆斯·W·考恩、社会党候选人露西·亨舍尔和社会工党候选人西奥多·贝夫。

en.s: The 1948 Florida gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1948. Democratic nominee Fuller Warren defeated Republican nominee Bert L. Acker with 83.35% of the vote.

zh.s: 1948年佛罗里达州州长选举于1948年11月2日举行。民主党候选人富勒·沃伦以83.35%的得票率击败共和党候选人伯特·L·阿克。

en.s: The 1948 North Carolina lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1948. Democratic nominee Hoyt Patrick Taylor defeated Republican nominee R. Kyle Hayes with 72.18% of the vote.

zh.t: 1948年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举
zh.s: 1948年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举于1948年11月2日举行。民主党候选人霍伊特·帕特里克·泰勒以72.18%的得票率击败共和党候选人R·凯尔·海斯。

en.t: 1948 United States presidential election in California
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in California took place on November 2, 1948, as part of the 1948 United States presidential election. State voters chose 25 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. California narrowly voted for the Democratic incumbent, Harry S. Truman, over the Republican challenger, New York Governor Thomas E.

zh.t: 1948年美国加利福尼亚州总统选举
zh.s: 1948年美国加利福尼亚州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。加利福尼亚州选民选出25名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。加利福尼亚州以微弱优势支持民主党籍现任总统哈里·S·杜鲁门，胜过共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威。

en.s: The 1948 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1948. Former Democratic governor Gordon Browning once again sought the party's nomination for governor. In the hardly fought primary, Browning comfortably defeated Governor Jim Nance McCord. In the general election, Browning easily defeated Republican nominee Roy Acuff, a famous country musician, with 66.9% of the vote. Before this election, Gordon Browning was last elected governor of Tennessee in 1936.

zh.s: 1948年田纳西州州长选举于1948年11月2日举行。前民主党籍州长戈登·布朗宁再次竞选州长提名。在竞争不激烈的初选中，布朗宁轻松击败州长吉姆·南斯·麦科德。大选中，布朗宁以66.9%的得票率轻松击败共和党候选人、乡村音乐家罗伊·阿卡夫。此次选举前，布朗宁上一次当选田纳西州州长是在1936年。

en.s: The 1948 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 1948, in order to elect the Governor of New Mexico. Incumbent Democrat Thomas J. Mabry won reelection to a second term, defeating Manuel Lujan Sr., mayor of Santa Fe.

zh.s: 1948年新墨西哥州州长选举于1948年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州长托马斯·J·马布里击败圣菲市长老曼努埃尔·卢汉，连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1948 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1948. Incumbent Democrat William Lee Knous defeated Republican nominee David A. Hamil with 66.33% of the vote.

zh.s: 1948年科罗拉多州州长选举于1948年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州长威廉·李·诺斯以66.33%的得票率击败共和党候选人大卫·A·哈米尔。

en.s: The 1948 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1948. Democratic nominee W. Kerr Scott defeated Republican nominee George M. Pritchard with 73.16% of the vote. This was the first gubernatorial election in North Carolina where a woman appeared on the ballot.

zh.s: 1948年北卡罗来纳州州长选举于1948年11月2日举行。民主党候选人W·克尔·斯科特以73.16%的得票率击败共和党候选人乔治·M·普里查德。这是北卡罗来纳州首次有女性名字出现在州长选票上。

en.t: 1948 United States presidential election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in Oklahoma took place on November 2, 1948. All forty-eight states were part of the 1948 United States presidential election. Voters chose ten electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Incumbent Democratic President Harry S. Truman won Oklahoma by a landslide 25.5 percentage points.

zh.t: 1948年美国总统选举俄克拉何马州结果
zh.s: 1948年美国总统选举俄克拉何马州投票于1948年11月2日举行。美国全部48个州都参加了这次总统选举。选民选出10名总统选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。民主党籍现任总统哈里·S·杜鲁门以25.5个百分点的明显优势赢得俄克拉何马州。

en.t: 1948 United States presidential election in Utah
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in Utah was held on November 2, 1948, as part of the 1948 United States presidential election. State voters chose four electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Utah was won by Democratic Party candidate Harry S. Truman, who carried the state with 53.98 percent of the popular vote and winning its four electoral votes.

zh.t: 1948年美国总统选举犹他州结果
zh.s: 1948年美国总统选举犹他州投票于1948年11月2日举行，是1948年美国总统选举的一部分。犹他州选民选出4名总统选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。民主党候选人哈里·S·杜鲁门以53.98%的普选票赢得犹他州及其4张选举人票。

en.t: 1948 United States presidential election in Iowa
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in Iowa took place on November 2, 1948, as part of the 1948 United States presidential election. Iowa voters chose ten representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Iowa was won by incumbent Democratic President Harry S. Truman of neighbouring Missouri, running with Senator Alben W. Barkley, with 50.31% of the popular vote, against Governor Thomas E.

zh.s: 1948年美国艾奥瓦州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民选出10名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。艾奥瓦州支持民主党籍现任总统哈里·S·杜鲁门及其竞选搭档、参议员阿尔本·W·巴克利，杜鲁门获得50.31%的普选票；他的对手是州长托马斯·E·杜威。

en.s: The 1948 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1948. Incumbent Republican Governor Oscar Rennebohm defeated Democratic nominee Carl W. Thompson with 54.09% of the vote.

zh.s: 1948年威斯康星州州长选举于1948年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长奥斯卡·伦尼博姆以54.09%的得票率击败民主党候选人卡尔·W·汤普森。

en.t: 1948 United States Senate election in Illinois
en.s: The 1948 United States Senate election in Illinois took place on November 2, 1948. Incumbent Republican Charles W. Brooks lost reelection in a landslide to Democrat Paul Douglas. The primaries and general election coincided with those of other federal elections (United States President and House), as well as those for state elections. Primaries were held April 13, 1948.

zh.t: 1948年伊利诺伊州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1948年伊利诺伊州联邦参议员选举于1948年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员查尔斯·W·布鲁克斯以压倒性差距败给民主党候选人保罗·道格拉斯。党内初选和大选与其他联邦选举（包括总统和联邦众议院选举）以及州级选举同时举行。初选于1948年4月13日举行。

en.t: 1948 United States Senate election in Texas
en.s: The 1948 United States Senate election in Texas was held on November 2, 1948. Democratic U.S. representative and future president of the United States Lyndon B. Johnson was elected in an open race to succeed retiring Democratic incumbent W. Lee O'Daniel. Johnson won the Democratic primary over Texas governor Coke R. Stevenson in one of the narrowest and most controversial elections in United States history.

zh.t: 1948年得克萨斯州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1948年得克萨斯州联邦参议员选举于1948年11月2日举行。民主党籍联邦众议员、后来成为美国总统的林登·B·约翰逊在开放席位角逐中当选，接替退休的民主党籍现任参议员W·李·奥丹尼尔。约翰逊在民主党初选中击败得克萨斯州州长科克·R·史蒂文森；这场选举是美国历史上差距最小、争议最大的选举之一。

en.t: 1948 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in Louisiana took place on November 2, 1948, as part of the 1948 United States presidential election. State voters chose ten representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Louisiana was won by Governor Strom Thurmond (DX–South Carolina), running with Governor Fielding L. Wright, with 49.07% of the popular vote, against incumbent President Harry S.

zh.t: 1948年美国路易斯安那州总统选举
zh.s: 1948年美国路易斯安那州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。路易斯安那州选民选出10名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。州权民主党候选人、南卡罗来纳州州长斯特罗姆·瑟蒙德与竞选搭档、州长菲尔丁·L·赖特赢得路易斯安那州，获得49.07%的普选票；他们的对手是民主党籍现任总统哈里·S·杜鲁门。

en.t: 1948 United States presidential election in Idaho
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in Idaho took place on November 2, 1948, as part of the 1948 United States presidential election. State voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Franklin D. Roosevelt had carried Idaho in all four of his presidential runs, carrying the state by more than 20 points in 1932 and 1936, but by a narrower 9 points in 1940 and only 3.5 points in 1944.

zh.t: 1948年美国总统选举爱达荷州结果
zh.s: 1948年美国总统选举爱达荷州投票于1948年11月2日举行，是1948年美国总统选举的一部分。爱达荷州选民选出4名总统选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。富兰克林·D·罗斯福此前四次竞选总统都赢得爱达荷州：1932年和1936年领先超过20个百分点，1940年领先9个百分点，1944年只领先3.5个百分点。

en.t: 1948 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 2, 1948, as part of the 1948 United States presidential election. Kentucky voters chose 11 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Kentucky was won by incumbent President Harry S. Truman (D–Missouri), running with Senator Alben W. Barkley, with 56.74 percent of the popular vote, against Governor Thomas E.

zh.s: 1948年美国肯塔基州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。肯塔基州选民选出11名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。民主党籍现任总统哈里·S·杜鲁门及其竞选搭档、参议员阿尔本·W·巴克利赢得肯塔基州，获得56.74%的普选票；他的对手是州长托马斯·E·杜威。

en.s: The 1948 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1948. Incumbent Democratic Governor Beauford H. Jester defeated Republican nominee Alvin H. Lane with 84.72% of the vote.

zh.s: 1948年得克萨斯州州长选举于1948年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州长比福德·H·杰斯特以84.72%的得票率击败共和党候选人阿尔文·H·莱恩。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 2, 1948. Primaries were held April 13, 1948.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于1948年11月2日（星期二）举行选举。初选于1948年4月13日举行。

en.s: The 1948 Utah gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1948. Incumbent Democratic governor Herbert B. Maw ran for a third consecutive term but lost to Republican nominee J. Bracken Lee in a rematch of the previous election.

zh.s: 1948年犹他州州长选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州长赫伯特·B·莫于竞选连续第三个任期，但在与共和党候选人J·布拉肯·李的再次交锋中败选。

en.t: 1948 United States Senate election in Michigan
en.s: The 1948 United States Senate election in Michigan was held on November 2, 1948. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Homer S. Ferguson was re-elected to a second term in office over U.S. Representative Frank E. Hook.

zh.t: 1948年美国密歇根州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1948年美国密歇根州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员霍默·S·弗格森击败联邦众议员弗兰克·E·胡克，连任第二个任期。

en.t: 1948 United States Senate election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1948 United States Senate election in Tennessee took place on November 2, 1948, concurrently with the U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic Senator Tom Stewart was defeated in the Democratic primary by Estes Kefauver.

zh.t: 1948年美国田纳西州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1948年美国田纳西州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行，与美国总统选举、其他州的联邦参议员选举、联邦众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时进行。民主党籍现任参议员汤姆·斯图尔特在民主党初选中败给埃斯蒂斯·基福弗。

en.s: The 1948 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1948. Incumbent Democratic Governor Benjamin Travis Laney did not seek a third term. Democratic nominee Sid McMath defeated Republican nominee Charles R. Black with 89.37% of the vote.

zh.s: 1948年阿肯色州州长选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州长本杰明·特拉维斯·莱尼没有竞选第三个任期。民主党候选人锡德·麦克马斯以89.37%的选票击败共和党候选人查尔斯·R·布莱克。

en.t: 1948 United States presidential election in Alabama
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in Alabama was held on November 2, 1948. Alabama voters sent eleven electors to the Electoral College who voted for president and vice-president. In Alabama, voters voted for electors individually instead of (as in most other states) as a slate. Since the 1890s, Alabama had been effectively a one-party state ruled by the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 1948年美国阿拉巴马州总统选举
zh.s: 1948年美国阿拉巴马州总统选举于11月2日举行。阿拉巴马州选民选出11名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。阿拉巴马州选民分别投票选举人，而不是像多数州那样投票给一整组候选人。自19世纪90年代以来，民主党实际上一直一党主导该州。

en.t: 1948 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in Tennessee took place on November 2, 1948, as part of the 1948 United States presidential election. Tennessee voters chose 12 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Incumbent president Harry S. Truman won the state with 49.14% of the vote over the Republican nominee, governor of New York Thomas E.

zh.s: 1948年美国田纳西州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。田纳西州选民选出12名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。民主党籍现任总统哈里·S·杜鲁门以49.14%的得票率击败共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威，赢得该州。

en.t: 1948 United States presidential election in Maryland
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in Maryland took place on November 2, 1948, as part of the 1948 United States presidential election. State voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maryland was won by Governor Thomas E. Dewey (R–New York), running with Governor Earl Warren, with 49.40% of the popular vote, against incumbent President Harry S.

zh.s: 1948年美国马里兰州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。马里兰州选民选出8名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威与竞选搭档、加利福尼亚州州长厄尔·沃伦赢得马里兰州，获得49.40%的普选票；他们的对手是民主党籍现任总统哈里·S·杜鲁门。

en.s: The 1948 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 1948. Incumbent Lieutenant Governor C. Elmer Anderson of the Republican Party of Minnesota defeated Minnesota Democratic-Farmer-Labor Party challenger John T. McDonough.

zh.s: 1948年明尼苏达州副州长选举于11月2日举行。明尼苏达州共和党籍现任副州长C·埃尔默·安德森击败明尼苏达州民主—农民—劳工党挑战者约翰·T·麦克多诺。

en.t: 1948 United States presidential election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 2, 1948, as part of the 1948 United States presidential election. State voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Connecticut was won by Republican candidate New York governor Thomas E. Dewey over Democratic candidate, incumbent President Harry S. Truman. Dewey won the state by a narrow margin of 1.64%.

zh.t: 1948年美国康涅狄格州总统选举
zh.s: 1948年美国康涅狄格州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。康涅狄格州选民选出8名选举人，组成选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威击败民主党候选人、时任总统哈里·S·杜鲁门，赢得康涅狄格州。杜威以1.64个百分点的微弱优势获胜。

en.s: The 1948 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 2, 1948, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent attorney general Jonathan E. Taylor defeated Republican nominee Herbert Douglas and Progressive nominee Douglas MacLeod.

zh.s: 1948年密苏里州总检察长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州总检察长。民主党候选人、现任总检察长乔纳森·E·泰勒击败共和党候选人赫伯特·道格拉斯和进步党候选人道格拉斯·麦克劳德。

en.s: The 1948 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 2, 1948, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Mike Holm defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee Koscie H. Marsh.

zh.s: 1948年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于11月2日举行，选出该州州务卿。共和党候选人、现任州务卿迈克·霍尔姆击败民主—农民—劳工党候选人科斯基·H·马什。

en.s: The 1948 Illinois gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 1948. Incumbent Governor Dwight H. Green, a Republican seeking a third term, lost reelection to Democratic nominee Adlai Stevenson II. The primaries and general election both coincided with those for federal offices (United States President, House, and United States Senate) and those for other state offices. The election was part of the 1948 Illinois elections.

zh.s: 1948年伊利诺伊州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长德怀特·H·格林竞选第三个任期，但败给民主党候选人阿德莱·史蒂文森二世。初选和大选都与联邦公职选举（总统、联邦众议院和联邦参议院）及其他州级公职选举同时举行。这次选举是1948年伊利诺伊州选举的一部分。

en.t: 1948 United States presidential election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 2, 1948, as part of the 1948 United States presidential election. West Virginia voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. West Virginia was won by incumbent President Harry S. Truman (D–Missouri), running with Kentucky Senator Alben W.

zh.t: 1948年美国西弗吉尼亚州总统选举
zh.s: 1948年美国西弗吉尼亚州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。西弗吉尼亚州选民选出8名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。民主党籍现任总统哈里·S·杜鲁门及其竞选搭档、肯塔基州参议员阿尔本·W·巴克利赢得西弗吉尼亚州。

en.t: 1948 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 2, 1948, as part of the 1948 United States presidential election. The Republican ticket of the governor of New York Thomas E. Dewey and the governor of California Earl Warren defeated the Democratic ticket of the incumbent president of the United States Harry S. Truman and the senior U.S. senator from Kentucky Alben W. Barkley.

zh.t: 1948年美国印第安纳州总统选举
zh.s: 1948年美国印第安纳州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。共和党候选人组合——纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威和加利福尼亚州州长厄尔·沃伦——击败民主党候选人组合——时任美国总统哈里·S·杜鲁门和肯塔基州资深联邦参议员阿尔本·W·巴克利。

en.s: The 1948 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 2, 1948, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Democratic nominee Walter H. Toberman defeated Republican nominee Roy Scantlin and Socialist nominee Alice B. Verburg.

zh.s: 1948年密苏里州州务卿选举于11月2日举行，选出该州州务卿。民主党候选人沃尔特·H·托伯曼击败共和党候选人罗伊·斯坎特林和社会党候选人爱丽丝·B·弗布格。

en.t: 1948 United States Senate election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1948 United States Senate election in Oklahoma took place on November 2, 1948. Incumbent Republican Senator Edward H. Moore declined to run for re-election. A crowded Democratic primary, including the former Governor, multiple members of Congress, and several statewide elected officials, developed; former Governor Robert S. Kerr won a slim plurality in the initial primary and then defeated former Congressman Gomer Smith by a wide margin in the runoff.

zh.t: 1948年美国俄克拉何马州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1948年美国俄克拉何马州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员爱德华·H·摩尔决定不竞选连任。民主党初选竞争激烈，参选者包括前州长、多名国会议员和几位州级民选官员。前州长罗伯特·S·克尔在首轮初选中以微弱优势领先，随后在第二轮初选中大幅击败前联邦众议员戈默·史密斯。

en.s: The 1948 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1948. Incumbent Republican Governor Walter W. Bacon was term-limited, having served two consecutive terms. Democratic nominee Elbert N. Carvel defeated Republican nominee Hyland P. George with 53.69% of the vote.

zh.s: 1948年特拉华州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长沃尔特·W·培根已连续任职两届，受任期限制不能参选。民主党候选人埃尔伯特·N·卡维尔击败共和党候选人海兰德·P·乔治，获得53.69%的选票。

en.t: 1948 United States presidential election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in South Dakota took place on November 2, 1948, as part of the 1948 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. South Dakota was won by Governor Thomas E. Dewey (R–New York), running with Governor Earl Warren, with 51.84% of the popular vote, against incumbent President Harry S.

zh.t: 1948年美国南达科他州总统选举
zh.s: 1948年美国南达科他州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威与竞选搭档、加利福尼亚州州长厄尔·沃伦赢得南达科他州，获得51.84%的普选票；他们的对手是民主党籍现任总统哈里·S·杜鲁门。

en.t: 1948 United States Senate election in New Jersey
en.s: The United States Senate election of 1948 in New Jersey was held on November 2, 1948. Incumbent Republican Senator Albert Hawkes ran for re-election to a second term but withdrew from the Republican primary after facing overwhelming establishment opposition to his re-election. Republican State Treasurer Robert C. Hendrickson won the primary over Harry Harper and defeated Princeton attorney Archibald S. Alexander in a close general election.

zh.t: 1948年新泽西州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1948年新泽西州联邦参议员选举于1948年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员阿尔伯特·霍克斯竞选连任第二个任期，但因党内建制派强烈反对他连任，在共和党初选前退出。共和党州财长罗伯特·C·亨德里克森在初选中击败哈里·哈珀，并在势均力敌的大选中击败普林斯顿律师阿奇博尔德·S·亚历山大。

en.t: 1948 United States presidential election in Nevada
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in Nevada took place on November 2, 1948, as part of the 1948 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nevada was won by incumbent President Harry S. Truman (D–Missouri), running with Senator Alben W. Barkley, with 50.37% of the popular vote, against Governor Thomas E.

zh.s: 1948年美国内华达州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。内华达州选民选出3名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。民主党籍现任总统哈里·S·杜鲁门及其竞选搭档、参议员阿尔本·W·巴克利赢得内华达州，获得50.37%的普选票；他们的对手是州长托马斯·E·杜威。

en.t: 1948 United States Senate election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1948 United States Senate election in Kentucky took place on November 2, 1948. Incumbent Republican Senator John Sherman Cooper, who won a 1946 special election to fill the vacant seat of Commissioner of Baseball Happy Chandler, ran for a full term in office but was defeated by Democratic U.S. Representative Virgil Chapman.

zh.t: 1948年肯塔基州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1948年肯塔基州联邦参议员选举于1948年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员约翰·谢尔曼·库珀曾在1946年特别选举中胜出，填补棒球专员哈皮·钱德勒离任后留下的空缺。他此次竞选完整任期，但被民主党联邦众议员维吉尔·查普曼击败。

en.t: 1948 United States presidential election in Washington (state)

zh.s: 1948年美国科罗拉多州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。科罗拉多州选民选出6名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。民主党籍现任总统哈里·S·杜鲁门及其竞选搭档、参议员阿尔本·W·巴克利赢得科罗拉多州，获得51.88%的普选票；他的对手是州长托马斯·E·杜威。

en.t: 1948 United States Senate election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1948 United States Senate election in Nebraska took place on November 2, 1948. Incumbent Republican Senator Kenneth S. Wherry, who served as the Senate Majority Whip, ran for re-election to a second term. Wherry was challenged by former Congressman Terry Carpenter, the Democratic nominee. Despite significant Democratic gains nationwide, Wherry won re-election by a wide margin, defeating Carpenter with 57% of the vote.

zh.t: 1948年内布拉斯加州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1948年内布拉斯加州联邦参议员选举于1948年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员肯尼斯·S·惠里兼任参议院党鞭，竞选连任第二个任期。他的对手是民主党候选人、前联邦众议员特里·卡彭特。尽管民主党在全国范围内取得显著进展，惠里仍以较大优势连任，以57%的得票率击败卡彭特。

en.t: 1948 United States Senate election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1948 United States Senate election in Minnesota took place on November 2, 1948. It was the first election held for Minnesota's Class 2 seat in the United States Senate since the Minnesota Democratic Party and the Farmer-Labor Party of Minnesota merged in 1944 to form the Minnesota Democratic-Farmer-Labor Party. Democratic Mayor of Minneapolis and future Vice President Hubert H. Humphrey defeated incumbent Republican Joseph H.

zh.t: 1948年明尼苏达州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1948年明尼苏达州联邦参议员选举于1948年11月2日举行。这是1944年明尼苏达州民主党与农工党合并、组成明尼苏达州民主党—农民—劳工党后，首次选举联邦参议院第二类席位。明尼阿波利斯市长、未来的副总统休伯特·H·汉弗莱击败共和党籍现任参议员约瑟夫·H·巴尔。

en.s: The 1948 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1948, and featured incumbent Governor Val Peterson, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee, former state Senator Frank Sorrell, to win a second two-year term in office.

zh.s: 1948年内布拉斯加州州长选举于1948年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长瓦尔·彼得森击败民主党候选人、前州参议员弗兰克·索雷尔，当选第二个两年任期。

en.t: 1948 United States presidential election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in Mississippi took place on November 2, 1948, in Mississippi as part of the wider United States presidential election of 1948. The Democratic Party candidate, South Carolina governor Strom Thurmond, overwhelmingly won Mississippi against fellow Democrat, incumbent President Harry S. Truman by a margin of 148,154 votes, or 77.08%.

zh.t: 1948年美国总统选举密西西比州结果
zh.s: 1948年美国总统选举密西西比州投票于1948年11月2日举行，是1948年美国总统大选的一部分。民主党候选人、南卡罗来纳州州长斯特罗姆·瑟蒙德以压倒性优势击败民主党籍现任总统哈里·S·杜鲁门，在密西西比州多得148,154票，领先77.08个百分点。

en.t: 1948 United States presidential election in Arizona
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in Arizona took place on November 2, 1948, as part of the 1948 United States presidential election. State voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Arizona was won by incumbent President Harry S. Truman (D–Missouri), running with Senator Alben W.

zh.t: 1948年美国亚利桑那州总统选举
zh.s: 1948年美国亚利桑那州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。亚利桑那州选民选出4名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。民主党籍现任总统哈里·S·杜鲁门及其竞选搭档、参议员阿尔本·W·巴克利赢得亚利桑那州。

en.t: 1948 United States presidential election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in North Carolina took place on November 2, 1948, as part of the 1948 United States presidential election. North Carolina voters chose 14 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. As a former Confederate state, North Carolina had a history of Jim Crow laws, disfranchisement of its African-American population and dominance of the Democratic Party in state politics.

zh.t: 1948年美国北卡罗来纳州总统选举
zh.s: 1948年美国北卡罗来纳州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。北卡罗来纳州选民选出14名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。作为前邦联州，北卡罗来纳州曾实行吉姆·克劳法，剥夺非裔美国人的选举权，州政治也长期由民主党主导。

en.t: 1948 United States presidential election in Maine
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in Maine took place on November 2, 1948, as part of the 1948 United States presidential election. State voters chose five electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Maine was won by Republican candidate New York governor Thomas E. Dewey over Democratic candidate, incumbent President Harry S. Truman. Dewey won Maine by a margin of 14.47%.

zh.t: 1948年美国总统选举缅因州结果
zh.s: 1948年美国总统选举缅因州投票于1948年11月2日举行，是1948年美国总统选举的一部分。缅因州选民选出5名总统选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威击败民主党候选人、现任总统哈里·S·杜鲁门，赢得缅因州；杜威以14.47个百分点的优势获胜。

en.s: The 1948 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1948. Democratic nominee G. Mennen Williams defeated incumbent Republican Kim Sigler with 53.41% of the vote.

zh.s: 1948年密歇根州州长选举于1948年11月2日举行。民主党候选人G·梅嫩·威廉姆斯以53.41%的得票率击败共和党籍现任州长金·西格勒。

en.t: 1948 United States presidential election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in Nebraska took place on November 2, 1948, as part of the 1948 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nebraska was won by Governor Thomas E. Dewey (R–New York), running with Governor Earl Warren, with 54.15% of the popular vote, against incumbent President Harry S.

zh.t: 1948年美国内布拉斯加州总统选举
zh.s: 1948年美国内布拉斯加州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、纽约州州长托马斯·E·杜威与竞选搭档、加利福尼亚州州长厄尔·沃伦赢得内布拉斯加州，获得54.15%的普选票；他们的对手是民主党籍现任总统哈里·S·杜鲁门。

en.t: 1948 United States presidential election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in Wyoming took place on November 2, 1948, as part of the 1948 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Wyoming was won by incumbent Democratic President Harry S. Truman, running with Senate Majority Leader Alben W.

zh.s: 1948年美国怀俄明州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。怀俄明州选民选出3名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。民主党籍现任总统哈里·S·杜鲁门及其竞选搭档、参议院多数党领袖阿尔本·W·巴克利赢得怀俄明州。

en.s: The 1948 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 2, 1948, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Democratic nominee W. H. Holmes defeated Republican nominee F. Reed Grainger, Progressive nominee George Kimmel, Socialist nominee Elizabeth Erbe and Socialist Labor nominee George B. Cross.

zh.s: 1948年密苏里州州审计长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州州审计长。民主党候选人W·H·霍姆斯击败共和党候选人F·里德·格兰杰、进步党候选人乔治·金梅尔、社会党候选人伊丽莎白·厄布和社会主义工党候选人乔治·B·克罗斯。

en.s: The 1948 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1948. Democratic nominee Chester Bowles narrowly defeated incumbent Republican James C. Shannon with 49.31% of the vote.

zh.s: 1948年康涅狄格州州长选举于11月2日举行。民主党候选人切斯特·鲍尔斯以微弱优势击败共和党籍现任州长詹姆斯·C·香农，获得49.31%的选票。

en.t: 1948 United States Senate elections in North Carolina
en.s: Two Senate elections took place on November 2, 1948 in North Carolina as part of the 1948 Senate elections. The incumbent Democratic Senator Josiah Bailey died 4 years into his third term on December 15, 1946; as a result, a special election for the final month of this term was held concurrently with the regular election. en.s: An election for a seat in the United States House of Representatives took place in California's 12th congressional district on November 2, 1948, the date set by law for the elections for the 81st United States Congress. In the 12th district election, the candidates were one-term incumbent Republican Richard Nixon, and Progressive challenger Una W. Rice. Nixon was reelected with 87% of the vote.

zh.t: 1948年加利福尼亚州第12国会选区选举
zh.s: 1948年11月2日，加利福尼亚州第12国会选区举行联邦众议员选举，选举日期由法律规定，用于选出第81届国会议员。候选人包括连任一届的共和党籍现任议员理查德·尼克松和进步党挑战者乌娜·W·赖斯。尼克松以87%的选票连任。

en.s: The 1948 Washington gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1948. Republican nominee Arthur B. Langlie defeated incumbent Democrat Monrad Wallgren with 50.50% of the vote in a rematch of the 1944 contest.

zh.s: 1948年华盛顿州州长选举于1948年11月2日举行。共和党提名人阿瑟·B·兰利以50.50%的得票率击败民主党籍现任州长蒙拉德·沃尔格伦。这是两人继1944年选举后的再次对决。

en.s: The 1948 Georgia lieutenant gubernatorial special election was held on November 2, 1948, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Georgia upon the succession of Lieutenant Governor Melvin E. Thompson to the Georgia governorship on March 18, 1947. Democratic nominee Marvin Griffin ran unopposed and subsequently won the election.

zh.t: 1948年佐治亚州副州长特别选举
zh.s: 1948年佐治亚州副州长特别选举于1948年11月2日举行，以选出该州副州长。副州长梅尔文·E·汤普森于1947年3月18日接任州长后，该职位出现空缺。民主党提名人马文·格里芬没有对手，最终当选。

en.t: 1948 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1948 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 2, 1948, as part of the wider United States presidential election. Voters chose 12 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. With the exception of a handful of historically Unionist North Georgia counties – chiefly Fannin but also to a lesser extent Pickens, Gilmer and Towns – Georgia since the 1880s had been a one-party state dominated by the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 1948年美国总统选举佐治亚州结果
zh.s: 1948年美国总统选举佐治亚州投票于1948年11月2日举行，是美国总统大选的一部分。选民选出12名总统选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。自19世纪80年代以来，佐治亚州一直由民主党主导，形成一党独大的局面；例外是北佐治亚少数历来支持联邦主义的县，主要是范宁县，此外还有皮肯斯县、吉尔默县和汤斯县。

en.s: The 1948 United States Senate elections were held concurrently with the election of Democratic President Harry S. Truman for a full term. The 32 seats of Class 2 were contested in regular elections, and one special election was held to fill a vacancy. Truman campaigned against an "obstructionist" Congress that had blocked many of his initiatives, and additionally, the U.S. economy had recovered from the post-World War II Recession of 1945 by election day.

zh.s: 1948年美国联邦参议院选举与民主党籍总统哈里·S·杜鲁门竞选完整任期的选举同时举行。常规选举改选32个第二类席位，另举行一场特别选举填补空缺。杜鲁门在竞选中批评阻挠其多项政策的“阻挠主义”国会。此外，到选举日，美国经济已从1945年二战后的经济衰退中复苏。

en.s: The Liaoshen campaign (Chinese: 辽沈会战; pinyin: Liáoshěn huìzhàn), an abbreviation of Liaoning–Shenyang campaign after the province of Liaoning and its Yuan directly administered capital city Shenyang, was the first of the three major military campaigns (along with Huaihai campaign and Pingjin campaign) launched by the Chinese Communist Party's People's Liberation Army (PLA) against the Kuomintang Nationalist government during the late stage of the Chinese Civil War.

en.t: United States Senate election in South Carolina, 1954
en.s: The 1954 South Carolina United States Senate election was held on November 2, 1954 to select the next U.S. Senator from the state of South Carolina. Senator Burnet R. Maybank did not face a primary challenge in the summer and was therefore renominated as the Democratic Party's nominee for the election in the fall. However, his death on September 1 left the Democratic Party without a nominee and the executive committee decided to nominate state Senator Edgar A. Brown as their candidate for the election. Many South Carolinians were outraged by the party's decision to forgo a primary election and former Governor Strom Thurmond entered the race as a write-in candidate.

zh.t: 1954年美国南卡罗来纳州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1954年美国南卡罗来纳州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行，选出该州下一任联邦参议员。参议员伯内特·R·梅班克在夏季没有遇到民主党初选对手，因此获得提名参加秋季大选。但他于9月1日去世，民主党因此没有了候选人；民主党执行委员会决定提名州参议员埃德加·A·布朗参选。许多南卡罗来纳州居民对党内跳过初选的决定感到愤怒，前州长斯特罗姆·瑟蒙德于是以写入选票的候选人身份参选。

en.t: United States Senate election in Montana, 1954
en.s: The 1954 United States Senate election in Montana took place on November 2, 1954. Incumbent United States Senator James E. Murray, who was first elected to the Senate in a special election in 1934 and was re-elected in 1936, 1942, and 1948, ran for re-election. After winning the Democratic primary against trivial opponents, he advanced to the general election, where he was opposed by Wesley A. D'Ewart, the Republican nominee and the United States Congressman from Montana's 2nd congressional district. A contentious and close election ensued, but ultimately, Murray was able to narrowly win re-election over D'Ewart to a final term in the Senate.

zh.t: 1954年美国蒙大拿州联邦参议员选举

en.t: United States Senate election in Massachusetts, 1954
en.s: The United States Senate election of 1954 in Massachusetts was held on November 2, 1954, with Republican Incumbent Leverett Saltonstall defeating his challengers.

zh.t: 1954年美国马萨诸塞州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1954年美国马萨诸塞州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员莱弗里特·索尔顿斯托尔击败对手。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 2, 1954, in 34 states, concurrent with the House and Senate elections. Elections also took place on September 13 in Maine. The special election in Florida was due to the death of incumbent governor Daniel T. McCarty on September 28, 1953. In Tennessee, the governor was elected to a 4-year term for the first time, instead of a 2-year term.

zh.s: 1954年11月2日，美国有34个州举行州长选举，与联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举同时进行。缅因州的选举于9月13日举行。佛罗里达州的特别选举是因现任州长丹尼尔·T·麦卡蒂于1953年9月28日去世而举行。田纳西州州长首次改为任期四年，此前任期为两年。

en.s: The 1954 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1954. Republican nominee Lane Dwinell defeated Democratic nominee John Shaw with 55.12% of the vote.

zh.s: 1954年新罕布什尔州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党候选人莱恩·德温内尔击败民主党候选人约翰·肖，获得55.12%的选票。

en.s: The 1954 Oregon gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 1954. Republican incumbent Paul L. Patterson defeated Democratic nominee Joseph K. Carson to win the election. Earl T. Newbry unsuccessfully sought the Republican nomination.

zh.s: 1954年俄勒冈州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长保罗·L·帕特森击败民主党候选人约瑟夫·K·卡森，赢得选举。厄尔·T·纽布里未能赢得共和党提名。

en.s: The 1954 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1954. Incumbent Republican Harold J. Powers defeated Democratic nominee Edward R. Roybal with 55.34% of the vote in a landslide.

zh.t: 1954年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1954年加利福尼亚州副州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任副州长哈罗德·J·鲍尔斯以压倒性优势击败民主党候选人爱德华·R·罗伊巴尔，获得55.34%的选票。

en.s: The 1954 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1954, to elect the next governor of Tennessee. Incumbent Democratic governor Frank G. Clement defeated Independent candidate John Randolph Neal Jr. with 87.2% of the vote. In 1953, the Tennessee State Constitution was amended, extending the gubernatorial term from two years to four years. The new amendments prevented governors from serving consecutive terms, but a temporary exception was made for Clement.

zh.s: 1954年田纳西州州长选举于11月2日举行，选出下任州长。民主党籍现任州长弗兰克·G·克莱门特以87.2%的选票击败独立候选人约翰·伦道夫·尼尔二世。田纳西州宪法于1953年修订，州长任期从两年延长到四年。新修正案禁止州长连续任职，但克莱门特获得临时例外。

en.s: The 1954 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 2, 1954, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent state auditor Stafford King defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee Clint Haroldson.

zh.t: 1954年明尼苏达州州审计长选举
zh.s: 1954年明尼苏达州州审计长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州州审计长。共和党候选人、现任州审计长斯塔福德·金击败民主—农民—劳工党候选人克林特·哈罗德森。

en.t: 1954 United States Senate election in Illinois
en.s: The United States Senate election in Illinois of 1954 took place on November 2, 1954. Incumbent Democratic United States Senator Paul Douglas was reelected to a second term.

zh.t: 1954年美国伊利诺伊州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1954年美国伊利诺伊州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员保罗·道格拉斯成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1954 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1954, and featured incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor Charles J. Warner, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee Stanley D. Long, a former member of the University of Nebraska Board of Regents, to win his fourth term as lieutenant governor. About a month shy of a year after this election, Charles J.

zh.t: 1954年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1954年内布拉斯加州副州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任副州长查尔斯·J·沃纳击败民主党候选人、内布拉斯加大学校董会前成员斯坦利·D·朗，赢得第四个任期。

en.t: 1954 United States Senate election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1954 United States Senate election in Oklahoma took place on November 2, 1954. Incumbent Democratic Senator Robert S. Kerr ran for re-election to a second term. He faced strong competition in the Democratic primary from former Governor Roy J. Turner, and though he won a sizable victory over Turner in the primary, he fell shy of an outright majority.

zh.t: 1954年美国俄克拉何马州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1954年美国俄克拉何马州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员罗伯特·S·克尔竞选连任第二个任期。他在民主党初选中遭遇前州长罗伊·J·特纳的有力挑战。虽然克尔在初选中以较大优势获胜，但得票未过半。

en.t: 1954 United States Senate election in Kansas
en.s: The 1954 United States Senate election in Kansas took place on November 2, 1954. Incumbent Republican Senator Andrew F. Schoeppel ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged by George McGill, the Democratic nominee and a former U.S. Senator, whom he had defeated in 1948. Despite a favorable national environment for Democrats, Schoeppel increased his margin of victory over McGill, defeating him with 56% of the vote.

zh.t: 1954年美国堪萨斯州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1954年美国堪萨斯州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员安德鲁·F·舍佩尔竞选连任第二个任期。民主党提名人、前联邦参议员乔治·麦吉向他发起挑战；舍佩尔曾在1948年击败麦吉。尽管全国形势有利于民主党，舍佩尔仍扩大了对麦吉的胜出优势，以56%的选票获胜。

en.s: The 1954 Minnesota secretary of state election was held on November 2, 1954, in order to elect the secretary of state of Minnesota. Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee Joseph L. Donovan defeated Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Virginia Paul Holm.

zh.s: 1954年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于11月2日举行，选出该州州务卿。民主—农民—劳工党候选人约瑟夫·L·多诺万击败共和党候选人、现任州务卿弗吉尼娅·保罗·霍尔姆。

en.s: The 1954 Maryland attorney general election was held on November 2, 1954, in order to elect the attorney general of Maryland. Democratic nominee and former Speaker of the Maryland House of Delegates C. Ferdinand Sybert defeated Republican nominee and incumbent acting attorney general Edward D. E. Rollins.

zh.s: 1954年马里兰州总检察长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州总检察长。民主党候选人、前马里兰州众议院议长C·费迪南德·西伯特击败共和党候选人、现任代理总检察长爱德华·D·E·罗林斯。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 2, 1954. Primaries were held April 13, 1954.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于1954年11月2日（星期二）举行选举。初选于1954年4月13日举行。

en.s: A Massachusetts general election was held on November 2, 1954, in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts. The election included: statewide elections for United States Senator, Governor, Lieutenant Governor, Attorney General, Secretary of the Commonwealth, Treasurer, and Auditor; district elections for U.S. Representatives, State Representatives, State Senators, and Governor's Councillors; and ballot questions at the state and local levels. Democratic and Republican candidates were selected in party primaries held on September 14, 1954.

zh.s: 马萨诸塞州于1954年11月2日举行大选。选举包括联邦参议员、州长、副州长、总检察长、州务卿、州财政部长和州审计长等全州公职；联邦众议员、州众议员、州参议员和州州长委员会成员等选区公职；以及州和地方层面的公投问题。两党候选人由1954年9月14日举行的党内初选选出。

en.s: The 1954 Alabama Senate election took place on Tuesday, November 2, 1954, to elect 35 representatives to serve four-year terms in the Alabama Senate. The election used the same districts first drawn by the Alabama Constitution of 1901. None of the 35 Democratic nominees faced significant opposition in the general election. As the Democratic Party was dominant in the state, state legislative seats were generally decided at the Democratic primary election.

zh.s: 1954年阿拉巴马州参议院选举于1954年11月2日星期二举行，选出35名议员，任期四年。此次选举沿用1901年阿拉巴马州宪法首次划定的选区。35名民主党候选人在大选中都没有遇到明显对手。由于民主党当时在该州占主导地位，州议会席位通常在民主党初选中就已决定。

en.s: The 1954 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1954. Incumbent Democrat Dennis J. Roberts defeated Republican nominee Dean J. Lewis with 57.69% of the vote.

zh.s: 1954年罗得岛州州长选举于1954年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州长丹尼斯·J·罗伯茨以57.69%的得票率击败共和党候选人迪恩·J·刘易斯。

en.s: The 1954 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1954. Democratic nominee Edwin C. Johnson defeated Republican nominee Donald G. Brotzman with 53.56% of the vote.

zh.s: 1954年科罗拉多州州长选举于1954年11月2日举行。民主党候选人埃德温·C·约翰逊以53.56%的得票率击败共和党候选人唐纳德·G·布罗茨曼。

en.t: 1954 United States Senate election in Iowa
en.s: The 1954 United States Senate election in Iowa took place on November 2, 1954. Incumbent Democratic Senator Guy Gillette ran for re-election but was defeated in an upset by Republican U.S. Representative Thomas E. Martin. This was the fifth consecutive election in which the incumbent lost and this seat changed parties.

zh.t: 1954年艾奥瓦州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1954年艾奥瓦州联邦参议员选举于1954年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员盖伊·吉列特竞选连任，但意外败给共和党联邦众议员托马斯·E·马丁。这是连续第五次现任参议员落选且席位易手。

en.s: The 1954 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 2, 1954, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent acting state auditor Haskell Holman defeated Republican nominee Harold L. Butterfield.

zh.s: 1954年密苏里州州审计长选举于1954年11月2日举行。民主党候选人、代理州审计长哈斯克尔·霍尔曼击败共和党候选人哈罗德·L·巴特菲尔德。

en.s: The 1954 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1954. Republican nominee Fred Hall defeated Democratic nominee George Docking with 52.98% of the vote.

zh.s: 1954年堪萨斯州州长选举于1954年11月2日举行。共和党候选人弗雷德·霍尔以52.98%的得票率击败民主党候选人乔治·多金。

en.t: 1954 United States Senate election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1954 United States Senate election in Tennessee took place on November 2, 1954, concurrently with United States Senate elections in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic Senator Estes Kefauver won re-election, defeating Republican candidate Thomas P. Wall Jr.

zh.t: 1954年田纳西州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1954年田纳西州联邦参议员选举于1954年11月2日举行，与其他州的联邦参议员选举、联邦众议院选举及多项州和地方选举同时进行。民主党籍现任参议员埃斯蒂斯·基福弗成功连任，击败共和党候选人小托马斯·P·沃尔。

en.t: 1954 United States Senate elections in Wyoming
en.s: The 1954 United States Senate elections in Wyoming took place on November 2, 1954. Incumbent Democratic senator Lester C. Hunt, who decided not to be a candidate for re-election, committed suicide by firearm on June 19, 1954, and Republican Governor Clifford J. Rogers appointed former state highway commissioner Edward D. Crippa to replace him.

zh.t: 1954年美国怀俄明州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1954年美国怀俄明州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员莱斯特·C·亨特决定不竞选连任，并于1954年6月19日用枪自杀身亡。共和党籍州长克利福德·J·罗杰斯任命前州公路专员爱德华·D·克里帕接替他。

en.t: 1954 United States Senate elections in Nebraska
en.s: The 1954 United States Senate elections in Nebraska took place on November 2, 1954, for the Class II United States Senate seat. Incumbent Republican Senator Kenneth S. Wherry was elected to a second term in 1948, and died in office on November 29, 1951. Governor Val Peterson appointed Fred A. Seaton to hold the seat until the 1952 election.

zh.t: 1954年美国内布拉斯加州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1954年美国内布拉斯加州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行，选出第二组联邦参议员席位。共和党籍现任参议员肯尼思·S·惠里于1948年当选，开始第二个任期，后于1951年11月29日在任内去世。州长瓦尔·彼得森任命弗雷德·A·西顿接任，任职至1952年选举。

en.s: The 1954 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1954, and featured Mayor of Lincoln Victor Anderson, the Republican nominee, defeating Democratic nominee, attorney William Ritchie.

zh.s: 1954年内布拉斯加州州长选举于1954年11月2日举行。共和党提名人、林肯市市长维克托·安德森击败民主党提名人、律师威廉·里奇。

en.t: 1954 United States Senate election in Delaware
en.s: The 1954 United States Senate election in Delaware took place on November 2, 1954. Incumbent Democratic Senator J. Allen Frear Jr. won re-election to a second term.

zh.t: 1954年特拉华州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1954年特拉华州联邦参议员选举于1954年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员J·艾伦·弗里尔二世成功连任，开始第二个任期。

en.t: 1954 United States Senate election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1954 United States Senate election in South Dakota took place on November 2, 1954. Incumbent Republican Senator Karl E. Mundt ran for re-election to his second term. He was opposed by former State Representative Kenneth Holum, the Democratic nominee. Mundt defeated Holum in a landslide to win re-election.

zh.t: 1954年南达科他州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1954年南达科他州联邦参议员选举于1954年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员卡尔·E·蒙特竞选连任第二个任期，对手是民主党提名人、前州众议员肯尼斯·霍勒姆。蒙特以压倒性优势击败霍勒姆，成功连任。

en.t: 1954 United States Senate special election in California
en.s: The 1954 United States Senate special election in California was held on November 2, 1954 to elect a United States Senator to complete the unexpired term of Richard Nixon, who had resigned on becoming vice president of the United States in 1952 presidential election. Republican interim appointee Thomas Kuchel, won the election over Democratic U.S. representative Sam Yorty. Primary elections were held on June 8, 1954.

zh.t: 1954年加利福尼亚州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1954年加利福尼亚州联邦参议员特别选举于1954年11月2日举行，选出一名联邦参议员，完成理查德·尼克松未满的任期。尼克松在1952年总统选举中当选副总统后辞去了参议员职务。共和党临时任命的参议员托马斯·库切尔在选举中击败民主党籍联邦众议员萨姆·约蒂。初选于1954年6月8日举行。

en.t: 1954 United States Senate election in New Jersey
en.s: The 1954 United States Senate election in New Jersey was held on November 2, 1954. Republican U.S. Representative Clifford P. Case defeated Democratic U.S. Representative Charles R. Howell with 48.66% of the vote. This election was decided by the fewest votes (3,507) and narrowest percentage margin (0.19%) in New Jersey history.

zh.t: 1954年新泽西州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1954年新泽西州联邦参议员选举于1954年11月2日举行。共和党籍联邦众议员克利福德·P·凯斯击败民主党籍联邦众议员查尔斯·R·豪厄尔，得票率为48.66%。这是新泽西州历史上得票差最小的一次选举，仅差3,507票，得票率差距为0.19个百分点。

en.t: 1954 United States Senate election in Alabama
en.s: The 1954 United States Senate election in Alabama was held on November 2, 1954. Incumbent Senator John Sparkman was re-elected to a second full term in office over Republican Junius Foy Guin Jr.

zh.t: 1954年阿拉巴马州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1954年阿拉巴马州联邦参议员选举于1954年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员约翰·斯帕克曼击败共和党候选人小朱尼厄斯·福伊·金，当选第二个完整任期。

en.t: 1954 United States Senate election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1954 United States Senate election in Kentucky took place on November 2, 1954. Incumbent Republican Senator John Sherman Cooper, who won a 1952 special election to fill the vacant seat of Virgil Chapman, ran for a full term in office but was defeated by Democratic former Senator and Vice President of the United States Alben W. Barkley.

zh.t: 1954年美国肯塔基州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1954年美国肯塔基州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员约翰·谢尔曼·库珀于1952年特别选举中当选，接替维吉尔·查普曼空缺的席位；这次他竞选完整任期，但败给民主党前参议员、美国前副总统阿尔本·W·巴克利。

en.s: The 1954 Iowa gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 1954. Republican candidate Leo Hoegh, who won the Republican primary against William H. Nicholas, defeated Democratic candidate Clyde E. Herring, receiving 51.37% of the vote. Following the election, on November 21, outgoing Governor William Beardsley died in a car accident. Lieutenant Governor Leo Elthon served as governor until Hoegh's term began.

zh.s: 1954年艾奥瓦州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党候选人利奥·霍格在党内初选中击败威廉·H·尼古拉斯，随后击败民主党候选人克莱德·E·赫林，获得51.37%的选票。选举后，离任州长威廉·比尔兹利于11月21日在车祸中去世。副州长利奥·埃尔松代行州长职务，直到霍格的任期开始。

en.s: The 1954 Florida gubernatorial special election was held on November 2, 1954, to elect a successor to Daniel T. McCarty, who died in office on September 28, 1953. State Senator LeRoy Collins won the Democratic nomination in a three-way race against acting Governor Charley E. Johns and J. Brailey Odham. He defeated Johns in a run-off election with 54.8% of the vote.

zh.t: 1954年佛罗里达州州长特别选举
zh.s: 1954年佛罗里达州州长特别选举于11月2日举行，选出丹尼尔·T·麦卡蒂的继任者。麦卡蒂于1953年9月28日在任内去世。州参议员勒罗伊·柯林斯在三人角逐中赢得民主党提名，对手是代理州长查利·E·约翰斯和J·布雷利·奥德姆。随后，柯林斯在第二轮选举中以54.8%的选票击败约翰斯。

en.s: The 1954 Nevada gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1954. Incumbent Republican Charles H. Russell defeated Democratic nominee and former Governor Vail M. Pittman on a re-match with 53.10% of the vote.

zh.s: 1954年内华达州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长查尔斯·H·罗素在与民主党候选人、前州长韦尔·M·皮特曼再次交锋时胜出，获得53.10%的选票。

en.s: The 1954 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 2, 1954, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee Miles Lord defeated Republican nominee Bernhard LeVander.

zh.t: 1954年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1954年明尼苏达州总检察长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州总检察长。民主—农民—劳工党候选人迈尔斯·洛德击败共和党候选人伯恩哈德·莱万德。

en.t: 1954 United States Senate election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1954 United States Senate election in Minnesota took place on November 2, 1954. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Hubert H. Humphrey defeated Republican Minnesota State Treasurer Val Bjornson, to become the first Democrat to win a second term in the state.

zh.t: 1954年美国明尼苏达州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1954年美国明尼苏达州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员休伯特·H·汉弗莱击败明尼苏达州财政部长、共和党人瓦尔·比约恩森，成为该州首位成功连任的民主党参议员。

en.s: The 1954 Wyoming gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 1954. Incumbent Republican Governor Clifford Joy Rogers ran for a full term as Governor of Wyoming after Frank A. Barrett was elected to the U.S. Senate, but lost the nomination to former State Representative Milward Simpson. Simpson narrowly defeated Democratic former Secretary of State William Jack in the general election.

zh.s: 1954年怀俄明州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长克利福德·乔伊·罗杰斯在弗兰克·A·巴雷特当选联邦参议员后，竞选州长完整任期，但在共和党提名中败给前州众议员米尔沃德·辛普森。辛普森随后在大选中以微弱优势击败民主党前州务卿威廉·杰克。

en.s: The 1954 Connecticut Attorney General election took place on November 2, 1954, to elect the Attorney General of Connecticut. Incumbent Republican Attorney General William L. Beers did not seek re-election. Republican nominee John J. Bracken defeated Democratic state senator Samuel J. Tedesco. As of 2026, this was the last time a Republican was elected Attorney General of Connecticut.

zh.t: 1954年康涅狄格州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1954年康涅狄格州总检察长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州总检察长。共和党籍现任总检察长威廉·L·比尔斯没有竞选连任。共和党候选人约翰·J·布拉肯击败民主党州参议员塞缪尔·J·特德斯科。截至2026年，这是共和党人最近一次当选康涅狄格州总检察长。

en.s: The 1954 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 2, 1954, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent comptroller J. Millard Tawes won re-election as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 1954年马里兰州州审计长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州州审计长。民主党候选人、现任审计长J·米勒德·陶斯在没有对手的情况下成功连任。

en.t: 1954 United States Senate election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1954 United States Senate election in North Carolina was held on November 2, 1954. Interim Democratic Senator Alton A. Lennon, who had been appointed to fill the vacant seat left by the death of Willis Smith, ran for re-election. Lennon lost the Democratic primary to former Governor W. Kerr Scott, who easily won the general election over Republican Paul C. West.

zh.t: 1954年美国北卡罗来纳州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1954年美国北卡罗来纳州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。临时任职的民主党参议员阿尔顿·A·列侬是在威利斯·史密斯去世后获任命填补空缺，这次竞选连任。他在民主党初选中败给前州长W·克尔·斯科特。斯科特随后在大选中轻松击败共和党人保罗·C·韦斯特。

en.t: 1954 United States Senate election in Colorado
en.s: The 1954 United States Senate election in Colorado took place on November 2, 1954. Incumbent Democratic Senator Edwin C. Johnson did not run for re-election, instead he gave up his seat to run for Governor again. Republican Lieutenant Governor Gordon Allott defeated Democratic U.S. Representative John A. Carroll in the race for the open seat.

zh.t: 1954年美国科罗拉多州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1954年美国科罗拉多州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员埃德温·C·约翰逊没有竞选连任，而是放弃席位，再次竞选州长。共和党副州长戈登·阿洛特击败民主党联邦众议员约翰·A·卡罗尔，赢得空缺席位。

en.s: The 1954 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1954. Incumbent Republican Theodore McKeldin defeated Democratic nominee Curley Byrd with 54.46% of the vote. This was the first time that a Republican was re-elected to a second consecutive term as governor of Maryland, and this would not occur again until 2018 when Larry Hogan won re-election.

zh.s: 1954年马里兰州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长西奥多·麦凯尔丁击败民主党候选人柯利·伯德，获得54.46%的选票。这是共和党人首次连任马里兰州州长；直到2018年拉里·霍根连任时，才再次出现这种情况。

en.t: 1954 United States Senate election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1954 United States Senate election in New Hampshire took place on November 2, 1954. Incumbent Republican Senator Styles Bridges won re-election to a fourth term in office, defeating Democrat Gerald Morin. Primary elections were held on September 14, 1954.

zh.t: 1954年美国新罕布什尔州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1954年美国新罕布什尔州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员斯泰尔斯·布里奇斯击败民主党人杰拉尔德·莫林，成功连任第四个任期。初选于1954年9月14日举行。

en.t: 1954 United States Senate special election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1954 United States Senate special election in New Hampshire took place on November 2, 1954, to elect a U.S. Senator to complete the unexpired term of Senator Charles W. Tobey, who died on July 24, 1953. Former President of the New Hampshire Bar Association Robert W. Upton was appointed on August 14, 1953, by Governor Hugh Gregg to fill the vacancy until a special election could be held.

zh.t: 1954年美国新罕布什尔州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1954年美国新罕布什尔州联邦参议员特别选举于11月2日举行，选出继任者，完成参议员查尔斯·W·托比未满的任期。托比于1953年7月24日去世。1953年8月14日，州长休·格雷格任命新罕布什尔州律师协会前会长罗伯特·W·厄普顿填补空缺，直至举行特别选举。

en.s: The 1954 Oklahoma gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1954, and was a race for Governor of Oklahoma. Democrat Raymond Gary defeated Republican Reuben K. Sparks.

zh.s: 1954年俄克拉何马州州长选举于11月2日举行。民主党人雷蒙德·加里击败共和党人鲁本·K·斯帕克斯。

en.t: 1954 United States Senate election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1954 United States Senate election in Rhode Island took place on November 2, 1954. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Theodore F. Green was re-elected to a fourth term in office.

zh.t: 1954年美国罗得岛州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1954年美国罗得岛州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员西奥多·F·格林成功连任第四个任期。

en.s: The 1954 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1954. Incumbent Republican Governor Walter J. Kohler Jr. defeated Democratic nominee William Proxmire in a rematch of the 1952 election with 51.45% of the vote.

zh.s: 1954年威斯康星州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长沃尔特·J·科勒二世在与民主党候选人威廉·普罗克斯迈尔再次交锋时胜出，获得51.45%的选票。

en.s: The 1954 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 1954. Minnesota Democratic-Farmer-Labor Party candidate Karl Rolvaag defeated Republican Party of Minnesota challenger P. Kenneth Peterson.

zh.s: 1954年明尼苏达州副州长选举于11月2日举行。明尼苏达州民主—农民—劳工党候选人卡尔·罗尔瓦格击败明尼苏达州共和党候选人P·肯尼斯·彼得森。

en.s: The 1954 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1954. Incumbent Democratic Governor Francis Cherry was narrowly defeated in the Democratic primary. Cherry was only one of four Arkansas governors in the twentieth century denied initial second terms in office; the others were Tom Terral in 1926, Bill Clinton in 1980, and Frank White in 1982. Only one previous governor, Henry Rector in 1862, was defeated after one term.

zh.s: 1954年阿肯色州州长选举于1954年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州长弗朗西斯·切里在民主党初选中以微弱差距落败。切里是20世纪阿肯色州仅有的四位未能连任第二个任期的州长之一；另外三位是1926年的汤姆·特拉尔、1980年的比尔·克林顿和1982年的弗兰克·怀特。此前，只有1862年的亨利·雷克托曾在一个任期后落选。

en.s: The 1954 Connecticut lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1954, to elect the lieutenant governor of Connecticut. Incumbent Republican lieutenant governor Edward N. Allen chose not to seek re-election to a second term. Republican Charles W. Jewett defeated Democratic nominee John N. Dempsey with 50.3% to 49.7% of the vote.

zh.s: 1954年康涅狄格州副州长选举于1954年11月2日举行，选出康涅狄格州副州长。共和党籍现任副州长爱德华·N·艾伦决定不竞选连任。共和党候选人查尔斯·W·朱厄特击败民主党提名人约翰·N·邓普西，得票率为50.3%对49.7%。

en.t: 1954 United States Senate election in Texas
en.s: The 1954 United States Senate election in Texas was held on November 2, 1954. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Lyndon Baines Johnson was re-elected to a second term in office, easily dispatching his challengers.

zh.t: 1954年得克萨斯州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1954年得克萨斯州联邦参议员选举于1954年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员林登·贝恩斯·约翰逊成功连任第二个任期，轻松击败对手。

en.t: 1954 United States Senate election in Michigan
en.s: The 1954 United States Senate election in Michigan was held on November 2, 1954. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Homer S. Ferguson ran for re-election to a third term, but was defeated by the Democratic Detroit Board of Education member Patrick V. McNamara.

zh.t: 1954年密歇根州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1954年密歇根州联邦参议员选举于1954年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任联邦参议员霍默·S·弗格森竞选连任第三个任期，但败给了民主党籍底特律教育委员会成员帕特里克·V·麦克纳马拉。

en.s: The 1954 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 1954. Incumbent Governor John Howard Pyle, the first Republican elected to the office in two decades, ran for reelection for a third term. Former U.S. Senator Ernest McFarland defeated Governor John Howard Pyle by a narrow margin. McFarland had lost his bid for reelection to the United States Senate to Barry Goldwater in 1952, with McFarland subsequently deciding to run for the office of governor.

zh.s: 1954年亚利桑那州州长选举于1954年11月2日举行。现任州长约翰·霍华德·派尔是二十年来首位当选该职位的共和党人，他竞选连任第三个任期。前联邦参议员欧内斯特·麦克法兰以微弱优势击败派尔。麦克法兰在1952年竞选连任联邦参议员时败给巴里·戈德华特，随后决定竞选州长。

en.s: The 1954 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 1954, in order to elect the Governor of New Mexico. Incumbent Republican Edwin L. Mechem was term-limited, and could not run for reelection to a third consecutive term. Democrat John F. Simms defeated Republican Alvin Stockton, winning the largest share of the vote for any candidate since Clyde Tingley in 1936.

zh.s: 1954年新墨西哥州州长选举于1954年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长埃德温·L·米肯已达到任期限制，不能竞选连续第三个任期。民主党人约翰·F·西姆斯击败共和党人阿尔文·斯托克顿，当选得票率是克莱德·廷格利1936年以来所有候选人中最高的。

en.s: The 1954 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1954. Incumbent Republican Governor Sigurd Anderson was term-limited. Republican nominee Joe Foss defeated Democratic nominee Ed C. Martin with 56.67% of the vote.

zh.s: 1954年南达科他州州长选举于1954年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长西居德·安德森因任期限制不能参选。共和党提名人乔·福斯以56.67%的得票率击败民主党提名人埃德·C·马丁。

en.t: 1954 United States Senate election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1954 United States Senate election in West Virginia took place on November 2, 1954. Incumbent Democratic Senator Matthew M. Neely was re-elected to a fifth term in office.

zh.t: 1954年西弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1954年西弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员选举于1954年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员马修·M·尼利成功连任，开始第五个任期。

en.s: The 1954 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1954. Incumbent Democrat Frank Lausche defeated Republican nominee Jim Rhodes with 54.10% of the vote. To date this is the last gubernatorial election where Van Wert County voted Democratic.

zh.s: 1954年俄亥俄州州长选举于1954年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州长弗兰克·劳舍以54.10%的得票率击败共和党提名人吉姆·罗兹。迄今，这是范沃特县最后一次在州长选举中投票支持民主党。

en.s: The 1954 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1954. Incumbent Republican Norman Brunsdale defeated Democratic nominee Cornelius Bymers with 64.21% of the vote.

zh.s: 1954年北达科他州州长选举于1954年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长诺曼·布朗斯代尔以64.21%的得票率击败民主党提名人科尼利厄斯·拜默斯。

en.s: The 1954 Georgia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1954, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Georgia. Democratic nominee Ernest Vandiver ran unopposed and subsequently won the election.

zh.s: 1954年佐治亚州副州长选举于1954年11月2日举行。民主党提名人欧内斯特·范迪弗没有对手，最终当选。

en.s: The 1954 New York state election was held on November 2, 1954, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, the state comptroller, the attorney general, the chief judge and three associate judges of the New York Court of Appeals, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly and the New York State Senate.

zh.s: 1954年纽约州选举于1954年11月2日举行，选出州长、副州长、州审计长、总检察长、纽约州上诉法院首席法官和3名副法官，并改选纽约州众议院和州参议院全部议员。

en.s: The 1954 New York gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1954, to elect the Governor and Lieutenant Governor of New York. Incumbent Republican governor Thomas E. Dewey did not run for re-election to a fourth term in office. In the race to succeed Dewey, W. Averell Harriman defeated U.S. Senator Irving Ives by 11,125 votes, the closest margin in a New York gubernatorial election since 1850.

zh.s: 1954年纽约州州长选举于1954年11月2日举行，选出州长和副州长。共和党籍现任州长托马斯·E·杜威没有竞选第四个任期。接替他的竞选中，W·埃弗雷尔·哈里曼以11,125票的优势击败联邦参议员欧文·艾夫斯；这是自1850年以来纽约州州长选举中差距最小的一次。

en.s: The 1954 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1954 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 21 of the state senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the 1954 elections is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1954年艾奥瓦州参议院选举是1954年美国定期选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民在州参议院50个选区中的21个选区选出参议员。州参议员任期四年。艾奥瓦州议会提供了1954年选举所涉及的50个州参议院选区地图。

en.s: The 1954 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on Tuesday November 2.to elect next Governor of Connecticut. Democratic candidate Abraham Ribicoff narrowly defeated Republican Candidate incumbent Governor of Connecticut and John Davis Lodge with 49.50% of the vote. This is the last time that an incumbent governor of Connecticut lost reelection.

zh.s: 1954年康涅狄格州州长选举于11月2日星期二举行，选出新任州长。民主党候选人亚伯拉罕·里比科夫以49.50%的得票率险胜共和党籍现任州长约翰·戴维斯·洛奇。这是康涅狄格州现任州长最后一次竞选连任失败。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1954 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 2. Republican nominee Robert E. Smylie defeated Democratic nominee Clark Hamilton with 54.24% of the vote. The incumbent governor was not allowed to run for a second four-year term until 1958.

zh.s: 1954年爱达荷州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党提名人罗伯特·E·斯迈利以54.24%的得票率击败民主党提名人克拉克·汉密尔顿。现任州长直到1958年才获准竞选第二个四年任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1954 Pennsylvania gubernatorial election was held on November 2. In what is considered a crucial realigning election for the state, Democratic State Senator George M. Leader defeated Republican incumbent Lieutenant Governor Lloyd Wood, becoming the first Democrat to be elected governor since 1934.

zh.s: 1954年宾夕法尼亚州州长选举于11月2日举行。这场选举被视为该州政治重组的重要转折点。民主党籍州参议员乔治·M·利德击败共和党籍现任副州长劳埃德·伍德，当选州长；这是自1934年以来首位当选州长的民主党人。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1957 Auckland City mayoral by-election was held to fill the vacant position of Mayor of Auckland. The polling was conducted using the standard first-past-the-post electoral method.

zh.s: 1957年奥克兰市长补选旨在填补市长职位空缺。投票采用普通多数制。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.t: Penguin Books is acquitted in the Lady Chatterley obscenity trial
en.s: On November 2, 1960, a jury at London's Central Criminal Court found Penguin Books not guilty of obscenity over its publication of D. H. Lawrence's novel Lady Chatterley's Lover. The verdict ended a trial that had begun on October 20. Penguin had published an unabridged edition of the novel to test Britain's 1959 Obscene Publications Act, which allowed a defence based on the book's literary merit. The decision cleared the way for its wider sale in Britain.
en.n: The acquittal came November 2, at the end of a trial that ran from October 20 to November 2, 1960.

zh.t: 企鹅图书在《查泰莱夫人的情人》案中获判无罪
zh.s: 1960年11月2日，伦敦中央刑事法院的陪审团裁定，企鹅图书出版劳伦斯小说《查泰莱夫人的情人》不构成淫秽出版罪。审判从10月20日开始，持续到这一天。企鹅图书出版了小说的未删节版，借此检验英国1959年《淫秽出版物法》允许以作品的文学价值提出抗辩的规定。判决后，这本书得以在英国更广泛地销售。
zh.n: 审判从1960年10月20日持续到11月2日，无罪判决于最后一天作出。

en.s: The 1961 Labour Party leadership election was held when, for the second year in succession, the incumbent leader was challenged for re-election. Normally the annual re-election of the leader had been a formality. The challenge followed factional in-fighting over issues like nuclear disarmament. The leader favoured the retention of nuclear weapons by the UK, whereas the left wing of the party supported the Campaign for Nuclear Disarmament.

zh.s: 1961年工党党魁选举在现任党魁连续第二年受到挑战时举行。通常，党魁每年改选只是例行程序。此次挑战源于党内围绕核裁军等议题的派系斗争。现任党魁支持英国保留核武器，而党内左翼支持核裁军运动。

en.t: Arrest and assassination of Ngo Dinh Diem
en.s: On 2 November 1963, Ngô Đình Diệm, the president of South Vietnam, was arrested and assassinated in a CIA-backed coup d'état led by General Dương Văn Minh. After years of autocratic and nepotistic family rule in the country, discontent with the Diệm regime had been simmering below the surface and culminated with mass Buddhist protests against religious discrimination after the Huế Phật Đản shootings of protesters who defied a ban on the flying of the Buddhist flag.

zh.s: 1963年11月2日，南越总统吴廷琰在由杨文明将军领导、美国中央情报局支持的政变中被捕并遭暗杀。多年来，吴廷琰家族在越南实行专制和裙带统治，民众不满逐渐积累。顺化佛诞枪击事件中，抗议宗教歧视、违反佛教旗帜禁令的民众遭枪击，随后大规模佛教抗议爆发，最终使不满集中显现。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: On November 1, 1963, President Ngô Đình Diệm and the Personalist Labor Revolutionary Party of the Republic of Vietnam (South Vietnam) were deposed by a group of CIA-backed Army of the Republic of Vietnam officers who disagreed with Diệm's handling of the Buddhist crisis and the North Vietnamese-Viet Cong (VC) threat to South Vietnam. During South Vietnam's later years, some referred to the coup as Cách mạng 1-11-1963 (The 1st November 1963 Revolution).
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1963年11月1日，吴廷琰总统和越南共和国（南越）的个人主义劳动革命党政府被一批得到美国中央情报局支持的越南共和国军军官推翻。这些军官不满吴廷琰处理佛教徒危机的方式，也担忧北越和越共对南越构成的威胁。南越后来有人把这场政变称为“1963年11月1日革命”（Cách mạng 1-11-1963）。
zh.n: 本条目采用来源信息框标注的结束日期。

en.t: King Saud of Saudi Arabia is deposed by a family coup, and replaced by his half-brother Faisal
en.s: Saud bin Abdulaziz Al Saud (Arabic: سعود بن عبد العزيز آل سعود; 15 January 1902 – 23 February 1969) was King of Saudi Arabia from 9 November 1953 until his abdication on 2 November 1964. During his reign, he served as Prime Minister of Saudi Arabia from 1953 to 1954 and from 1960 to 1962. Prior to his accession, Saud was Crown Prince of Saudi Arabia from 11 May 1933 to 9 November 1953.

zh.t: 沙特国王沙特在家族政变中被废黜，由同父异母弟弟费萨尔继位
zh.s: 沙特·本·阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹·阿勒沙特（阿拉伯语：سعود بن عبد العزيز آل سعود；1902年1月15日—1969年2月23日）于1953年11月9日至1964年11月2日担任沙特阿拉伯国王，并于1964年11月2日退位。在位期间，他还于1953年至1954年、1960年至1962年担任沙特阿拉伯首相。即位前，他于1933年5月11日至1953年11月9日担任沙特阿拉伯王储。

en.s: The New York City mayoral election of 1965 occurred on Tuesday, November 2, 1965, with Republican Congressman John Lindsay winning a close plurality victory over the Democratic candidate, New York City Comptroller Abraham Beame. Lindsay received 44.99% of the vote to Beame's 40.98%, a victory margin of 4.01%. Finishing in a distant third was the candidate of the recently formed Conservative Party, conservative author and commentator William F. Buckley, Jr., who received 13.36% of the vote. Lindsay, a liberal Republican, also was the nominee of the Liberal Party. Beame also received the Civil Service ballot line.

zh.s: 1965年纽约市市长选举于11月2日星期二举行。共和党籍联邦众议员约翰·林赛以微弱优势胜过民主党候选人、纽约市审计长亚伯拉罕·比姆，当选市长。林赛得票率为44.99%，比姆为40.98%，相差4.01个百分点。新成立的保守党候选人、保守派作家和评论员小威廉·F·巴克利以13.36%的得票率位居第三，远低于前两名。自由党也提名了自由派共和党人林赛；比姆还获得了公务员选票线的提名。

en.s: The Mayoral election of 1965 in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania was held on Tuesday, November 2, 1965. The incumbent mayor, Joe Barr of the Democratic Party was victorious for his second term. A total of 184,604 votes were cast. The 1965 race marks the last time that a Republican candidate was marginally competitive, as Barr defeated attorney Vince Rovitto by only about a 25% margin of victory.

zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡市长选举于1965年11月2日（星期二）举行。民主党籍现任市长乔·巴尔获胜，开始第二个任期。选举共有184,604张有效票。这是共和党候选人最后一次有一定竞争力的市长选举；巴尔以约25个百分点的优势击败律师文斯·罗维托。
