Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the Virginia House of Delegates Fred G. Pollard defeated Republican nominee Vincent F. Callahan and Conservative nominee Reid T. Putney.

zh.s: 1965年弗吉尼亚州副州长选举于1965年11月2日举行。民主党提名人、现任弗吉尼亚州众议员弗雷德·G·波拉德击败共和党提名人文森特·F·卡拉汉和保守党提名人里德·T·普特尼。

en.t: 1965 New York City Council presidential election
en.s: An election was held on November 2, 1965, to elect the President of the New York City Council. Democratic incumbent Paul Screvane ran for mayor, leaving the office open for the next term. Queens district attorney Frank D. O'Connor won the Democratic primary and general election to succeed him.

en.s: In the 1965 Virginia gubernatorial election, incumbent Governor of the U.S. state, Albertis Harrison, a Democrat, was unable to seek re-election due to term limits. For the first time in many decades there was an uncontested Democratic primary, in which incumbent Lieutenant Governor Mills Godwin was unopposed. Linwood Holton, an attorney from Roanoke, was nominated by the Republican Party, whilst the newly formed Virginia Conservative Party nominated William J.

zh.s: 1965年弗吉尼亚州州长选举中，民主党籍现任州长阿尔伯蒂斯·哈里森因任期限制不能竞选连任。几十年来，民主党首次出现无人竞争的初选，现任副州长米尔斯·戈德温自动获得提名。罗阿诺克律师林伍德·霍尔顿获共和党提名；新成立的弗吉尼亚保守党也提名了候选人。

en.s: The 1965 New Jersey Senate elections were held on November 2. The elections were the first held after the Supreme Court's Reynolds v. Sims decision, which held that New Jersey's single-seat county apportionment was unconstitutional. The ruling forced New Jersey to grant multiple seats to its largest counties (and eventually, switch to single-member districts that did not follow county lines).

zh.s: 1965年新泽西州参议院选举于11月2日举行。这是美国最高法院在“雷诺兹诉西姆斯案”作出裁决后首次举行的选举。该裁决认定新泽西州按县划分单席位选区的制度违宪，迫使新泽西州为人口最多的县增加多个席位，并最终改用不受县界限制的单席位选区。

en.s: The Cuban Adjustment Act (CAA) (Spanish: Ley de Ajuste Cubano), Public Law 89-732, is a United States federal law enacted on November 2, 1966. Passed by the 89th United States Congress and signed by President Lyndon Johnson, the legislation applies to citizens of Cuba admitted into the U.S. after January 1, 1959—the date of the Cuban Communist Revolution—and who have been present in the U.S. for at least two years (later amended to one year).
en.n: This entry records the signing, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 《古巴调整法》（CAA；西班牙语：Ley de Ajuste Cubano），公法第89-732号，是美国于1966年11月2日颁布的一项联邦法律。该法由第89届美国国会通过，并由林登·约翰逊总统签署，适用于1959年1月1日（古巴共产主义革命之日）之后获准进入美国、且已在美国居住至少两年的古巴公民；后来规定的居住期限缩短为一年。

en.s: The Hamilton by-election, which took place in Hamilton, Lanarkshire, Scotland, on 2 November 1967, was "the most sensational by-election result in Scotland since 1945" and a "watershed" moment in Scottish political history. The victory of the Scottish National Party's candidate Winnie Ewing over Labour catapulted the lawyer, her party and the cause of Scottish independence to national prominence for the first time. Prior to 1967, the Hamilton parliamentary constituency was widely perceived to be an impregnable Labour party stronghold. As in many places in Labour's urban, working-class heartlands in the west of Scotland, it was said the Labour vote "is not counted here, it is weighed".

zh.s: 汉密尔顿补选于1967年11月2日在苏格兰拉纳克郡汉密尔顿举行，被称为“1945年以来苏格兰最轰动的补选结果”，也是苏格兰政治史上的“转折点”。苏格兰民族党候选人温妮·尤因击败工党候选人，她和所在政党以及苏格兰独立主张因此首次受到全国关注。1967年以前，汉密尔顿选区普遍被视为工党牢不可破的票仓。在苏格兰西部许多工人阶级聚居的工党传统地区，人们常说工党的票“不是在这里计数，而是用秤称”。

en.t: 1970 United States Senate election in Delaware
en.s: The 1970 United States Senate election in Delaware took place on November 2, 1970. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator John J. Williams retired. Republican Party U.S. Representative Bill Roth was elected to succeed him.

zh.t: 1970年特拉华州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1970年特拉华州联邦参议员选举于1970年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任联邦参议员约翰·J·威廉斯退休，共和党联邦众议员比尔·罗斯当选接替他。

en.t: Kentucky and Mississippi hold gubernatorial elections
en.s: On November 2, 1971, voters in Kentucky and Mississippi chose new governors. Democrat Wendell Ford won Kentucky's open seat, which had been held by a Republican, while Democrat William Waller won Mississippi's open seat. Both elections were part of the broader 1971–72 U.S. gubernatorial cycle. Louisiana's election took place separately on February 1, 1972; it was not a November 2 vote.
en.n: Only Kentucky and Mississippi voted for governor on November 2, 1971; Louisiana held its general election in 1972.

zh.t: 美国肯塔基州和密西西比州举行州长选举
zh.s: 1971年11月2日，美国肯塔基州和密西西比州举行州长选举。民主党人温德尔·福特赢得肯塔基州选举，该职位此前由共和党人担任；民主党人威廉·沃勒赢得密西西比州选举。两场投票属于1971年至1972年的美国州长选举周期。路易斯安那州则在1972年2月1日举行州长普选。
zh.n: 肯塔基州和密西西比州的州长选举举行于1971年11月2日，路易斯安那州普选举行于次年2月1日。

en.s: The Boston mayoral election of 1971 occurred on Tuesday, November 2, 1971 between Mayor Kevin White and United States Representative Louise Day Hicks. This was the second election in a row between White and Hicks. White once again defeated Hicks and was elected to a second term. The nonpartisan municipal preliminary election was held on September 14, 1971.

zh.s: 1971年波士顿市长选举于11月2日（星期二）举行，由市长凯文·怀特对阵美国联邦众议员路易丝·戴·希克斯。这是怀特和希克斯连续第二次在市长选举中交锋。怀特再次击败希克斯，当选连任。无党派市政初选于1971年9月14日举行。

en.s: The Columbus mayoral election of 1971 was the 74th mayoral election in Columbus, Ohio. It was held on Tuesday, November 2, 1971. Incumbent Democratic mayor Jack Sensenbrenner was defeated by Republican party nominee Tom Moody.

zh.t: 1971年俄亥俄州哥伦布市市长选举
zh.s: 1971年俄亥俄州哥伦布市市长选举是该市第74届市长选举，于11月2日（星期二）举行。民主党籍现任市长杰克·森森布伦纳败给共和党提名人汤姆·穆迪。

en.s: The 1971 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on 2 November 1971 for the post of Governor of Mississippi. The incumbent governor, Democrat John Bell Williams, was ineligible due to term limits, a rule that was changed to two back-to-back terms in the 1980s. Democrat Bill Waller was elected into office and served as Governor of Mississippi from 1972 to 1976.

zh.s: 1971年密西西比州州长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州州长。民主党籍现任州长约翰·贝尔·威廉姆斯因任期限制而不能参选；这一规定在20世纪80年代改为最多连续担任两届。民主党人比尔·沃勒当选，1972年至1976年担任密西西比州州长。

en.s: The 1971 Virginia Senate elections were held on November 2, 1971, alongside the Virginia House of Delegates election. All 40 seats in the Senate of Virginia were up for election.

zh.s: 1971年弗吉尼亚州参议院选举于1971年11月2日举行，与弗吉尼亚州众议院选举同时进行。州参议院的40个席位全部改选。

en.s: The Indianapolis mayoral election of 1971 took place on November 2, 1971. This was the first election after the creation of the Unigov. Incumbent Republican Richard Lugar was reelected to a second term. Lugar's challenger had been Democrat John Neff, a former state senator. Neff had campaigned in opposition to the Unigov, promising to seek its abolishment if elected.

zh.t: 1971年印第安纳波利斯市长选举
zh.s: 1971年印第安纳波利斯市长选举于1971年11月2日举行。这是印第安纳波利斯实行“统一政府”制度后的首次选举。共和党籍现任市长理查德·卢加尔成功连任，开始第二个任期。民主党候选人约翰·内夫曾任州参议员，是卢加尔的对手。内夫反对统一政府制度，并承诺如果当选就推动废除该制度。

en.s: The 1971 Philadelphia mayoral election took place on November 2, 1971, to fill the 182nd mayoral term in Philadelphia, with Democratic nominee Frank Rizzo defeating Republican Thacher Longstreth. While Longstreth received many split ticket votes from Democrats, Rizzo found support among unions and the white working-class electorate. Rizzo was the first Italian-American mayor of Philadelphia, and would be reelected in 1975 before a failed attempt to change the city charter to allow him to run for a third term.

zh.s: 1971年费城市长选举于1971年11月2日举行，选出第182届市长。民主党提名人弗兰克·里佐击败共和党提名人撒切尔·朗斯特雷斯。朗斯特雷斯获得不少民主党选民的分票支持；里佐则得到工会和白人工人阶层选民的支持。里佐是费城首位意大利裔市长，1975年成功连任，之后曾试图修改市宪章以允许自己竞选第三个任期，但未能成功。

en.s: The 1971 New Jersey State Senate election were held on November 2, 1971, during William T. Cahill's term as governor of New Jersey. The Democratic Party gained seven seats, breaking the Republican supermajority in the Senate and narrowing the majority significantly. Primary elections were held on June 8.

zh.s: 1971年新泽西州参议院选举于1971年11月2日举行，当时威廉·T·卡希尔担任州长。民主党增加了7个席位，打破共和党在参议院的绝对多数，大幅缩小共和党优势。初选于6月8日举行。

en.s: The 1971 Virginia lieutenant gubernatorial special election was held on November 2, 1971, to elect the next Lieutenant Governor of Virginia following the death of incumbent J. Sargeant Reynolds on June 13. The election was concurrent with the 1971 Virginia Senate election and 1971 Virginia House of Delegates election. Independent candidate Henry Howell won against both Democratic nominee George J. Kostel and Republican nominee George P.

zh.t: 1971年弗吉尼亚州副州长特别选举
zh.s: 1971年弗吉尼亚州副州长特别选举于11月2日举行，因现任副州长J·萨金特·雷诺兹于6月13日去世而提前选出继任者。该选举与1971年弗吉尼亚州参议院和众议院选举同期举行。独立候选人亨利·豪厄尔击败了民主党和共和党候选人。

en.s: The 1971 Kentucky gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1971. Incumbent Republican Louie Nunn, was ineligible for a second term due to term limits, a rule that was later repealed in 1992. In the Democratic primary, Lieutenant Governor Wendell Ford ran against former Governor Bert Combs and 6 other opponents. Ford would win in an easy victory that wasn't expected.

zh.s: 1971年肯塔基州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长路易·纳恩因任期限制不能连任；这项规定于1992年废除。民主党初选中，副州长温德尔·福特对阵前州长伯特·库姆斯和另外6名候选人。福特轻松获胜，尽管此前并未被看好。

en.s: The 1971 San Diego mayoral election was held on November 2, 1971, to elect the mayor for San Diego. Incumbent Frank Curran stood for reelection for a third term. California State Assembly member Pete Wilson and former San Diego City Attorney Ed Butler received the most votes in the primary and advanced to the runoff. Wilson was then elected mayor with a majority of the votes.

zh.s: 1971年圣迭戈市长选举于1971年11月2日举行。现任市长弗兰克·柯伦竞选第三个任期。加利福尼亚州众议员皮特·威尔逊和圣迭戈前市检察官埃德·巴特勒在初选中得票领先，进入第二轮选举。威尔逊随后以多数票当选市长。

en.s: The San Francisco mayoral election of 1971 was held on November 2, 1971, with incumbent Joseph Alioto being re-elected with 38.6 percent of the vote, from among 11 candidates, there being no provision for a runoff.

zh.s: 1971年旧金山市长选举于1971年11月2日举行。现任市长约瑟夫·阿里奥托以38.6%的得票率成功连任。共有11名候选人参选，且没有第二轮选举安排。

en.s: The Cleveland mayoral election of 1971 saw the election of Ralph Perk. This was the last officially partisan mayoral election in Cleveland. Subsequent elections have used a nonpartisan system.

zh.s: 1971年克利夫兰市长选举由拉尔夫·珀克当选。这是克利夫兰最后一次正式按党派举行的市长选举，此后的选举都不设党派。

en.s: Aeroflot Flight 19 was a scheduled passenger flight from Bykovo Airport, Moscow, Soviet Union, to Bryansk Airport, Bryansk, Soviet Union. On 2 November 1973, the Yakovlev Yak-40 flying this route was hijacked by four people ten minutes before landing. The aircraft was then diverted to Moscow's Vnukovo Airport, where the hijackers demanded a buyout and provision of a flight to Sweden.

zh.t: 俄罗斯航空19号班机劫机事件
zh.s: 俄罗斯航空19号班机原定从苏联莫斯科的贝科沃机场飞往苏联布良斯克的布良斯克机场。1973年11月2日，飞机在预计降落前10分钟遭4人劫持。这架雅克-40飞机随后被迫改飞莫斯科伏努科沃机场，劫机者要求支付赎金并安排航班送他们前往瑞典。

en.s: The Sydenham by-election 1974 was a by-election held in the Sydenham electorate during the term of the 37th New Zealand Parliament on 2 November 1974. The by-election was caused by the death of incumbent MP Norman Kirk of the Labour Party, who at the time was Prime Minister, on 31 August 1974. The by-election was won by John Kirk, Norman Kirk's son.

zh.s: 1974年锡德纳姆选区补选于1974年11月2日举行，属于新西兰第37届议会任期内的补选。工党议员诺曼·柯克于1974年8月31日去世；他当时是新西兰总理，因此触发补选。诺曼·柯克的儿子约翰·柯克赢得补选。

en.t: United States presidential election in Alaska, 1976
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in Alaska took place on November 2, 1976, as part of the 1976 United States presidential election. Voters chose three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Alaska was won by incumbent President Gerald Ford (R-Michigan) with 57.9% of the popular vote against Jimmy Carter (D-Georgia) with 35.7%. Carter ultimately won the national vote however, defeating Ford and becoming the next President. Alaska has only voted Democratic once, and that was in the 1964 election for Lyndon B. Johnson.

zh.t: 1976年美国阿拉斯加州总统选举
zh.s: 1976年美国阿拉斯加州总统选举于1976年11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出3名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。共和党籍现任总统杰拉尔德·福特（来自密歇根州）以57.9%的普选票赢得阿拉斯加州，民主党候选人吉米·卡特（来自佐治亚州）得票率为35.7%。不过，卡特最终赢得全国选举，成为下一任总统。阿拉斯加州只在1964年投票支持过一次民主党总统候选人林登·B·约翰逊。

en.t: United States presidential election in New York, 1976
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 2, 1976. All 50 states and The District of Columbia, were part of the 1976 United States presidential election. New York voters chose forty one electors to the Electoral College, which voted for President and Vice President. New York was won by Democratic Georgia Governor Jimmy Carter, in a narrow victory against incumbent Republican President Gerald Ford, who failed to gain the presidency through formal election that year. Carter was running with Minnesota Senator Walter Mondale, and President Ford had selected Kansas Congressman Bob Dole.

en.t: United States presidential election in New Mexico, 1976
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in New Mexico took place on November 2, 1976. All 50 states and The District of Columbia, were part of the 1976 United States presidential election. New Mexico voters chose four electors to represent them in the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. New Mexico was won by President Gerald Ford by a 2-point lead. A very partisan election in New Mexico, only 1% of the State voted for third party candidates. While Ford took the State of New Mexico, and much of the American Southwest and Midwest, Georgia Governor Jimmy Carter won the electoral college with 297 votes, and was elected President.

zh.s: 1976年美国新墨西哥州总统选举于11月2日举行，当时全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了总统选举。新墨西哥州选民选出4名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。现任总统杰拉尔德·福特以2个百分点的优势赢得该州。这是一场党派色彩浓厚的选举，新墨西哥州投给第三党候选人的选票仅占1%。福特赢得新墨西哥州以及美国西南部和中西部的许多地区，但佐治亚州州长吉米·卡特以297张选举人票赢得选举，成为总统。

en.t: United States presidential election in Mississippi, 1976
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in Mississippi was held on November 2, 1976. The Democratic Party candidate Jimmy Carter won the state of Mississippi, as well as the other 9 southern states which one comprised the Confederacy in the general election due to his ties to the south as being the former Governor of Georgia. He won the state with 49% of the vote, and all 7 of the state's electors were pledged to Carter. In the 1972 election, Mississippi had the strongest showing of Richard Nixon in the country, with Nixon carrying 78% of the vote.

zh.t: 1976年美国密西西比州总统选举
zh.s: 1976年美国密西西比州总统选举于11月2日举行。民主党候选人吉米·卡特赢得密西西比州以及南方其他9个曾组成邦联的州，原因是他曾任佐治亚州州长，与南方联系密切。他在密西西比州获得49%的选票，该州全部7张选举人票都承诺投给卡特。

en.t: United States Senate election in North Dakota, 1976
en.s: The 1976 U.S. Senate election for the state of North Dakota was held November 2, 1976. The incumbent, North Dakota Democratic NPL Party (Dem-NPL) Senator Quentin Burdick, sought and received re-election to his fourth term to the United States Senate, defeating Republican candidate Robert Stroup. Only Burdick filed as a Dem-NPLer, and the endorsed Republican candidate was Robert Stroup, as state senator from Hazen, North Dakota. Burdick and Stroup won the primary elections for their respective parties. One independent candidate, Clarence Haggard, also filed before the deadline under the American Party.

zh.t: 1976年美国北达科他州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1976年美国北达科他州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。现任参议员、北达科他州民主党—无党派联盟党（Dem-NPL）成员昆廷·伯迪克寻求连任，并成功赢得第四个参议员任期，击败共和党候选人罗伯特·斯特劳普。伯迪克是唯一登记参加Dem-NPL初选的人；共和党支持的候选人是来自黑森市的州参议员斯特劳普。两人分别赢得各自政党的初选。美国党候选人克拉伦斯·哈加德也在截止日前登记参选。

en.t: United States presidential election in Connecticut, 1976
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 2, 1976. All 50 states and The District of Columbia, were part of the 1976 United States presidential election. Connecticut voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Connecticut was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President Gerald Ford of Michigan and his running mate Senator Bob Dole of Kansas. Ford and Dole defeated the Democratic nominees, Governor Jimmy Carter of Georgia and his running mate Senator Walter Mondale of Minnesota. Ford narrowly carried Connecticut with 52.06% of the vote to Carter's 46.90%, a victory margin of 5.16%.

en.t: United States presidential election in Virginia, 1976
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in Virginia took place on November 2, 1976. All 50 states and the District of Columbia were part of the 1976 United States presidential election. Virginia voters chose 12 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President of the United States. Virginia was narrowly won by incumbent United States President Gerald Ford of Michigan with 49.29% of the vote, who was running against Governor Jimmy Carter of Georgia. The national election was ultimately won by Carter with 50.08% of the vote.

en.t: United States presidential election in North Carolina, 1976
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in North Carolina took place on November 2, 1976 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 1976 United States presidential election. Voters chose 13 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. North Carolina voted decisively for the Democratic nominee, Georgia Governor Jimmy Carter, over the Republican nominee, incumbent President Gerald R. Ford of Michigan. Carter carried the state with 55.27% to Ford's 44.22%, a victory margin of 11.05%. Carter's victory would be the last time a Democratic presidential candidate would win North Carolina's electoral votes until 2008, when Barack Obama would carry it with a narrow plurality.

en.t: United States presidential election in Vermont, 1976

en.t: United States presidential election in Massachusetts, 1976
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in Massachusetts took place on November 2, 1976, as part of the 1976 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all 50 states and D.C. Voters chose 14 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. en.t: United States House of Representatives election in the District of Columbia, 1976
en.s: The 1976 congressional election for the Delegate from the District of Columbia was held on November 2, 1976. The winner of the race was Walter E. Fauntroy (D), who won his third re-election. The election was notable for having a record-low turnout, as less than 16,000 voters cast their ballot in this election. This was the lowest recorded turnout for an election to this office. en.s: Indirect parliamentary elections were held in Cuba on 2 November 1976, the first since the Cuban Revolution. Between December 1975 and November 1976 voters had elected members of the 169 Municipal Assemblies, who in turn elected the 489 members of the National Assembly. Candidates had to be members of the Communist Party or mass organisations. Of the members elected to the National Assembly, 30% worked in industry or public services (including education), 29% were local government officials and 12% were civil servants. Municipal Assembly members also elected members of the 14 Provincial Assemblies.

en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in Michigan was held on November 2, 1976. Incumbent President Gerald Ford won his home state of Michigan with 51.83% of the vote, carrying Michigan's 21 electoral votes. However, he lost the general election to Democratic candidate Jimmy Carter.

zh.t: 1976年美国总统选举密歇根州结果
zh.s: 1976年美国总统选举密歇根州投票于1976年11月2日举行。现任总统杰拉尔德·福特以51.83%的得票率赢得家乡密歇根州及其21张选举人票，但他在全国大选中败给民主党候选人吉米·卡特。

en.t: United States Senate election in Florida, 1976
en.s: The 1976 United States Senate election in Florida was held on November 2, 1976. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Lawton Chiles won re-election to a second term.

zh.t: 1976年佛罗里达州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1976年佛罗里达州联邦参议员选举于1976年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员劳顿·奇利斯成功连任第二个任期。

en.t: United States presidential election in Alabama, 1976
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in Alabama took place on November 2, 1976 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 1976 United States presidential election. Voters chose nine representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Alabama voted for the Democratic nominee, former Governor Jimmy Carter, over the Republican nominee, President Gerald Ford.

zh.t: 1976年美国总统选举阿拉巴马州结果
zh.s: 1976年美国总统选举阿拉巴马州投票于1976年11月2日举行。美国全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了这次总统选举。选民选出9名总统选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。阿拉巴马州选民选择民主党候选人、前州长吉米·卡特，而非共和党候选人、总统杰拉尔德·福特。

en.t: United States Senate election in Utah, 1976
en.s: The 1976 United States Senate election in Utah took place on November 2, 1976. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Frank Moss ran for re-election to a fourth term but was defeated by Republican challenger Orrin Hatch.

zh.s: 1976年犹他州联邦参议员选举于1976年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员弗兰克·莫斯竞选连任第四个任期，但被共和党挑战者奥林·哈奇击败。

en.t: United States Senate election in Montana, 1976
en.s: The 1976 United States Senate election in Montana took place on November 2, 1976. Rather than seek a fifth term, incumbent United States Senator Mike Mansfield, a Democrat, opted to retire, creating an open seat. United States Congressman John Melcher, who had represented Montana's 2nd congressional district from 1969 to 1977, won the Democratic nomination and defeated Stanley C.

zh.t: 1976年美国蒙大拿州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1976年美国蒙大拿州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员迈克·曼斯菲尔德没有寻求第五个任期，选择退休，留下空缺席位。曾于1969年至1977年代表蒙大拿州第二国会选区的联邦众议员约翰·梅尔彻赢得民主党提名，并在普选中击败共和党候选人斯坦利·C·伯格。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina, 1976
en.s: The 1976 South Carolina United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 2, 1976 to select six Representatives for two-year terms from the state of South Carolina. All six incumbents were re-elected and the composition of the state delegation remained five Democrats and one Republican.

zh.t: 1976年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1976年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举于11月2日举行，选出六名众议员，任期两年。六名现任议员全部连任，南卡罗来纳州代表团仍由五名民主党人和一名共和党人组成。

en.t: United States Senate election in Arizona, 1976
en.s: The 1976 United States Senate election in Arizona took place on November 2, 1976. Incumbent Republican senator Paul Fannin decided to retire instead of seeking a third term. Democrat Dennis DeConcini won the open seat.

zh.t: 1976年亚利桑那州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1976年亚利桑那州联邦参议员选举于1976年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员保罗·范宁决定退休，没有竞选第三个任期。民主党候选人丹尼斯·德康西尼赢得空缺席位。

en.s: The Missouri gubernatorial election of 1976 was Missouri's forty-fourth gubernatorial election. The election was held on November 2, 1976 and resulted in a narrow victory for the Democratic nominee, Joseph P. Teasdale, over the Republican candidate, incumbent Governor Kit Bond, and two other candidates.

zh.s: 1976年密苏里州州长选举是该州第44次州长选举，于1976年11月2日举行。民主党候选人约瑟夫·P·蒂斯代尔以微弱优势击败共和党候选人、现任州长基特·邦德和另外两名候选人。

en.t: United States Senate election in Nevada, 1976
en.s: The 1976 United States Senate election in Nevada was held on November 2, 1976. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Howard Cannon won re-election to a fourth term.

zh.t: 1976年内华达州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1976年内华达州联邦参议员选举于1976年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员霍华德·坎农成功连任第四个任期。

en.t: 1976 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in Louisiana took place on November 2, 1976, as part of the 1976 United States presidential election. State voters chose ten representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Louisiana was won by Jimmy Carter (D–Georgia), with 51.73% of the popular vote. Carter defeated incumbent President Gerald Ford (R–Michigan), who finished with 45.95% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1976年美国路易斯安那州总统选举
zh.s: 1976年美国路易斯安那州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。路易斯安那州选民选出10名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。民主党人、来自佐治亚州的吉米·卡特以51.73%的普选票赢得该州。卡特击败共和党籍现任总统、来自密歇根州的杰拉尔德·福特；福特的得票率为45.95%。

en.s: The 1976 Montana House of Representatives election took place on November 2, 1976, with the primary election held on June 1, 1976. Montana voters elected all 100 members of the Montana House of Representatives to serve two-year terms. The election coincided with United States national elections and Montana state elections, including U.S. President, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, Montana Governor and Montana Senate.

zh.s: 1976年蒙大拿州众议院选举于11月2日举行，初选于1976年6月1日举行。蒙大拿州选民选出州众议院全部100名议员，任期两年。此次选举与美国全国选举和蒙大拿州选举同时举行，包括美国总统、联邦参议员、联邦众议员、蒙大拿州州长和州参议员选举。

en.s: The 1976 North Carolina lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1976. Democratic nominee James C. Green defeated Republican nominee William S. Hiatt with 66.04% of the vote.

zh.t: 1976年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举
zh.s: 1976年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举于11月2日举行。民主党候选人詹姆斯·C·格林击败共和党候选人威廉·S·海厄特，获得66.04%的选票。

en.t: 1976 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas
en.s: The 1976 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas occurred on November 2, 1976, to elect the members of the state of Texas's delegation to the United States House of Representatives. Texas had twenty-four seats in the House apportioned according to the 1970 United States census. Texas underwent mid-decade redistricting as a result of the U.S. Supreme Court case White v. Weiser.

zh.t: 1976年美国得克萨斯州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1976年美国得克萨斯州联邦众议院选举于11月2日举行，选出该州的联邦众议员。根据1970年美国人口普查，得克萨斯州在联邦众议院有24个席位。由于美国最高法院审理的“怀特诉魏瑟案”，得州在十年人口普查周期之间重新划分了选区。

en.t: 1976 United States presidential election in California
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in California took place on November 2, 1976, as part of the 1976 United States presidential election. State voters chose 45 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. California narrowly voted for the Republican incumbent, Gerald Ford, over the Democratic challenger, Jimmy Carter.

zh.t: 1976年美国加利福尼亚州总统选举
zh.s: 1976年美国加利福尼亚州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出45名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。加利福尼亚州以微弱优势支持共和党籍现任总统杰拉尔德·福特，击败民主党挑战者吉米·卡特。

en.s: The 1976 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1976. Incumbent Republican Bill Phelps defeated Democratic nominee Richard J. Rabbitt with 50.0% of the vote.

zh.s: 1976年密苏里州副州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任副州长比尔·菲尔普斯击败民主党候选人理查德·J·拉比特，获得50.0%的选票。

en.t: 1976 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in Oregon took place on November 2, 1976, as part of the 1976 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Oregon was narrowly won by incumbent President Gerald Ford (R–Michigan) with 47.78% of the popular vote, against Jimmy Carter (D–Georgia), with 47.62% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1976年美国俄勒冈州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。共和党籍现任总统杰拉尔德·福特以47.78%的普选票微弱优势赢得俄勒冈州；吉米·卡特的得票率为47.62%。

en.s: The 1976 Utah gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1976. Democratic candidate Scott M. Matheson defeated Republican nominee Vernon B. Romney, who had defeated Dixie L. Leavitt for his party's nomination, with 52.02% of the vote.

zh.s: 1976年犹他州州长选举于11月2日举行。民主党候选人斯科特·M·马西森击败共和党候选人弗农·B·罗姆尼，获得52.02%的选票。罗姆尼此前在共和党提名竞争中击败迪克西·L·利维特。

en.s: The 1976 Arizona Senate election was held on November 2, 1976. Voters elected members of the Arizona Senate in all 30 of the state's legislative districts to serve a two-year term. Primary elections were held on September 7, 1976. Prior to the elections, the Democrats held a majority of 18 seats over the Republicans' 12 seats.

zh.s: 1976年亚利桑那州参议院选举于11月2日举行。选民选出该州全部30个州参议院选区的议员，任期两年。初选于1976年9月7日举行。选举前，民主党有18席，占多数；共和党有12席。

en.s: The 1976 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 2, 1976, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent state treasurer Jim Spainhower defeated Republican nominee Albert L. Kemp Jr.

zh.t: 1976年密苏里州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 1976年密苏里州州财政部长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州州财政部长。民主党候选人、现任州财政部长吉姆·斯班豪尔击败共和党候选人阿尔伯特·L·肯普二世。

en.t: 1976 United States presidential election in Maine
en.s: The 1976 presidential election in Maine took place on November 2, 1976, as part of the 1976 United States presidential election, which took place across all 50 states plus the District of Columbia. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the electoral college, to vote for president and vice president. Maine narrowly voted for incumbent Republican president Gerald Ford over his Democratic opponent, Georgia Governor Jimmy Carter.

zh.s: 1976年美国缅因州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年涵盖全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区的总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。缅因州以微弱优势支持共和党籍现任总统杰拉尔德·福特，击败民主党对手、佐治亚州州长吉米·卡特。

en.s: The 1976 Montana Senate election took place on November 2, 1976, with the primary election held on June 1, 1976. Montana voters elected 25 of the 50 members of the Montana Senate. The election coincided with United States national elections and Montana state elections, including U.S. President, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, Montana Governor and Montana House. Following the previous election in 1974, Democrats held a 30-to-20-seat majority over Republicans.

zh.s: 1976年蒙大拿州参议院选举于11月2日举行，初选于1976年6月1日举行。蒙大拿州选民从州参议院50名议员中选出25人。此次选举与美国全国选举和蒙大拿州选举同时举行，包括美国总统、联邦参议员、联邦众议员、蒙大拿州州长和州众议院选举。1974年上一次选举后，民主党以30席对20席领先共和党。

en.t: 1976 United States presidential election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in North Dakota took place on November 2, 1976, as part of the 1976 United States presidential election. Voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. North Dakota was won by the Republican candidate and incumbent President, Gerald Ford, with 51.66% of the popular vote, against the Democratic candidate, Jimmy Carter, with 45.80% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1976年美国北达科他州总统选举
zh.s: 1976年美国北达科他州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出3名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。共和党候选人、现任总统杰拉尔德·福特以51.66%的普选票赢得北达科他州；民主党候选人吉米·卡特的得票率为45.80%。

en.t: 1976 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in Arkansas took place on November 2, 1976, as part of the wider 1976 United States presidential election. State voters chose six electors to represent them in the Electoral College. Arkansas overwhelmingly voted for the Democratic Party, former governor of Georgia Jimmy Carter and his running mate Minnesota U.S. Senator Walter Mondale with 64.94% of the vote.

zh.s: 1976年美国阿肯色州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。阿肯色州选民选出6名选举人，组成选举人团投票。民主党候选人、佐治亚州前州长吉米·卡特和竞选搭档、明尼苏达州联邦参议员沃尔特·蒙代尔，以64.94%的选票在阿肯色州大胜。

en.t: 1976 San Juan, Puerto Rico, mayoral election
en.s: San Juan, Puerto Rico, held an election for mayor on November 2, 1976. It was held as part of the 1976 Puerto Rican general election. It saw the election of Hernán Padilla, a member of the New Progressive Party. Incumbent mayor Carlos Romero Barceló, a member of the New Progressive Party, did not seek re-election, and instead ran for governor.

zh.t: 1976年波多黎各圣胡安市市长选举
zh.s: 波多黎各圣胡安市于1976年11月2日举行市长选举，是1976年波多黎各大选的一部分。新进步党成员埃尔南·帕迪利亚当选。新进步党籍现任市长卡洛斯·罗梅罗·巴塞洛没有竞选连任，而是转而竞选总督。

en.s: The 1976 Indiana gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1976. Incumbent Republican Governor Otis Bowen defeated Democratic nominee Larry A. Conrad with 56.85% of the vote.

zh.s: 1976年印第安纳州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长奥蒂斯·鲍恩击败民主党候选人拉里·A·康拉德，获得56.85%的选票。

en.s: The 1976 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 2, 1976, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Republican nominee and former state auditor of Missouri John Ashcroft defeated Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the Missouri House of Representatives James G. Baker.

zh.s: 1976年密苏里州总检察长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州总检察长。共和党候选人、密苏里州前州审计长约翰·阿什克罗夫特击败民主党候选人、现任密苏里州众议员詹姆斯·G·贝克。

en.s: The 1976 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1976. Pitting incumbent Democratic Governor Sherman W. Tribbitt Against U.S. Representative Pete du Pont. Largely due to the state's unresolved financial problems, du Pont defeated Governor Tribbitt by a landslide margin of 57% to 42%. This is the last time that an incumbent governor of Delaware lost re-election.

zh.s: 1976年特拉华州州长选举于1976年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州长谢尔曼·W·特里比特与联邦众议员皮特·杜邦展开角逐。由于该州的财政问题仍未解决等原因，杜邦以57%对42%的悬殊得票率击败特里比特。这是特拉华州现任州长最后一次竞选连任失败。

en.t: 1976 United States presidential election in Florida
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in Florida took place on November 2, 1976. All fifty states and the District of Columbia were part of the 1976 United States presidential election. Florida voters chose seventeen electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Florida was won by Georgia Governor Jimmy Carter by a margin of 5.29%, giving him the state's 17 electoral votes.

zh.t: 1976年美国总统选举佛罗里达州结果
zh.s: 1976年美国总统选举佛罗里达州投票于1976年11月2日举行。当年美国总统选举涵盖全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区。佛罗里达州选民选出17名总统选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。佐治亚州州长吉米·卡特赢得佛罗里达州，领先5.29个百分点，为他赢得该州17张选举人票。

en.s: The 1976 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1976. Democratic nominee J. Joseph Garrahy defeated Republican nominee James L. Taft Jr. with 54.82% of the vote.

zh.s: 1976年罗得岛州州长选举于1976年11月2日举行。民主党提名人J·约瑟夫·加拉希以54.82%的得票率击败共和党提名人小詹姆斯·L·塔夫脱。

en.t: 1976 United States Senate election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1976 United States Senate election in West Virginia was held on November 2, 1976. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Robert Byrd won re-election to a fourth term. The Republican Party did not field a candidate for this election, leading to a 100% election victory for Byrd. Byrd's 566,359 votes is the most received by a Democrat in any statewide election in the state's history.

zh.t: 1976年西弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1976年西弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员选举于1976年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员罗伯特·伯德成功连任，开始第四个任期。共和党没有派出候选人，伯德因此以100%的得票率胜出。他获得566,359票，是该州历史上民主党候选人在全州选举中获得的最高票数。

en.t: 1976 United States presidential election in Missouri
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in Missouri took place on November 2, 1976, as part of the 1976 United States presidential election. Voters chose 12 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Missouri was won by Jimmy Carter (D–Georgia), with 51.10% of the popular vote. Carter defeated incumbent President Gerald Ford (R–Michigan), who finished with 47.47% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1976年美国总统选举密苏里州结果
zh.s: 1976年美国总统选举密苏里州投票于1976年11月2日举行，是1976年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出12名总统选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。吉米·卡特（民主党，佐治亚州）赢得密苏里州，得票率为51.10%；现任总统杰拉尔德·福特（共和党，密歇根州）获得47.47%的选票。

en.s: The 1976 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1976. Democratic nominee Jim Hunt defeated Republican nominee David T. Flaherty with 64.99% of the vote. This election marked the last time an incumbent North Carolina governor was ineligible to run for reelection to a second term before the adoption of an amendment allowing such runs.

zh.s: 1976年北卡罗来纳州州长选举于1976年11月2日举行。民主党提名人吉姆·亨特以64.99%的得票率击败共和党提名人大卫·T·弗莱厄蒂。这是修改州宪法允许州长竞选连任后，最后一次有现任州长因任期限制而不能竞选第二个任期。

en.t: 1976 United States House of Representatives election in Nevada
en.s: The 1976 United States House of Representatives election in Nevada was held on Tuesday November 2, 1976, to elect the state's at-large representative. Primary elections were held on September 2, 1976. Incumbent Democrat James David Santini won re-election by a landslide margin of 64.98% over Republican nominee Walden Charles Earhart and Independent American, Janine M. Hansen.

zh.t: 1976年内华达州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1976年内华达州联邦众议院选举于1976年11月2日星期二举行，选出该州的单一选区联邦众议员。初选于1976年9月2日举行。民主党籍现任众议员詹姆斯·戴维·桑蒂尼以64.98%的得票率大幅领先共和党提名人沃尔登·查尔斯·厄尔哈特和美国独立党候选人珍妮·M·汉森，成功连任。

en.t: 1976 United States presidential election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in Nebraska took place on November 2, 1976, as part of the 1976 United States presidential election. Voters chose five representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nebraska was won by incumbent President Gerald Ford (R–Michigan), with 59.19% of the popular vote, against Jimmy Carter (D–Georgia), with 38.46% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1976年美国总统选举内布拉斯加州结果
zh.s: 1976年美国总统选举内布拉斯加州投票于1976年11月2日举行，是1976年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名总统选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。现任总统杰拉尔德·福特（共和党，密歇根州）赢得内布拉斯加州，得票率为59.19%；吉米·卡特（民主党，佐治亚州）获得38.46%的选票。

en.t: 1976 United States presidential election in Iowa
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in Iowa took place on November 2, 1976, as part of the 1976 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Iowa was won by incumbent President Gerald Ford (R–Michigan). with 49.47 percent of the popular vote, against Jimmy Carter (D–Georgia), with 48.46 percent, making Iowa about 3% more Republican than the nation-at-large.

zh.t: 1976年美国总统选举艾奥瓦州结果
zh.s: 1976年美国总统选举艾奥瓦州投票于1976年11月2日举行，是1976年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名总统选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。现任总统杰拉尔德·福特（共和党，密歇根州）赢得艾奥瓦州，得票率为49.47%；吉米·卡特（民主党，佐治亚州）获得48.46%的选票。艾奥瓦州的共和党倾向比全国平均水平高约3%。

en.s: The 1976 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1976. Incumbent Democratic governor Arthur A. Link Ran for a second term against Republican Richard Elkin.

zh.s: 1976年北达科他州州长选举于1976年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州长亚瑟·A·林克竞选连任第二个任期，对手是共和党候选人理查德·埃尔金。

en.s: The 1976 Delaware lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1976, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Delaware. Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the Delaware House of Representatives James D. McGinnis defeated Republican nominee Andrew Foltz, American nominee Margaret Mercer and Prohibition nominee Robert Appling.

zh.s: 1976年特拉华州副州长选举于1976年11月2日举行，选出特拉华州副州长。民主党提名人、特拉华州众议院现任议员詹姆斯·D·麦金尼斯击败共和党提名人安德鲁·福尔茨、美国党提名人玛格丽特·默瑟和禁酒党提名人罗伯特·阿普林。

en.t: 1976 United States presidential election in Delaware
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in Delaware took place on November 2, 1976, as part of the 1976 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Delaware was won by Jimmy Carter (D–Georgia), with 51.98% of the popular vote. Carter defeated incumbent President Gerald Ford (R–Michigan), who finished with 46.57% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1976年美国总统选举特拉华州结果
zh.s: 1976年美国总统选举特拉华州投票于1976年11月2日举行，是1976年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名总统选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。吉米·卡特（民主党，佐治亚州）赢得特拉华州，得票率为51.98%；现任总统杰拉尔德·福特（共和党，密歇根州）获得46.57%的选票。

en.s: The 1976 Illinois gubernatorial election was held in Illinois on November 2, 1976. Incumbent first-term Democratic governor Dan Walker lost renomination to Illinois Secretary of State Michael Howlett, who was an ally of Chicago mayor Richard J. Daley. Howlett then lost the general election to Republican nominee James R. Thompson. This election was the first of seven consecutive Republican gubernatorial victories in Illinois, a streak not broken until the election of Democrat Rod Blagojevich in 2002.

zh.s: 1976年伊利诺伊州州长选举于1976年11月2日举行。民主党籍首任州长丹·沃克在党内提名中败给了伊利诺伊州州务卿迈克尔·豪利特，后者是芝加哥市长理查德·J·戴利的盟友。豪利特随后在大选中败给共和党提名人詹姆斯·R·汤普森。这是伊利诺伊州连续7次共和党人当选州长的开端；直到2002年民主党人罗德·布拉戈耶维奇当选，连胜纪录才告终。

en.t: 1976 United States presidential election in Idaho
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in Idaho took place on November 2, 1976, as part of the 1976 United States presidential election. State voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Idaho was won by incumbent President Gerald Ford (R–Michigan), with 59.9 percent of the popular vote, against Jimmy Carter (D–Georgia), with 37.1 percent of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1976年美国总统选举爱达荷州结果
zh.s: 1976年美国总统选举爱达荷州投票于1976年11月2日举行，是1976年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出4名总统选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。现任总统杰拉尔德·福特（共和党，密歇根州）赢得爱达荷州，得票率为59.9%；吉米·卡特（民主党，佐治亚州）获得37.1%的选票。

en.t: 1976 United States House of Representatives elections in New Mexico
en.s: The 1976 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico was held on Tuesday November 2, 1976 to elect the state's two representatives to serve in the 95th United States Congress. Both districts retained their partisan control with The Democrats retaining the 2nd district and Republicans holding on to the 1st District. This made the state's delegation stay evenly split as it had been since 1970.

zh.t: 1976年新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1976年新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举于1976年11月2日星期二举行，选出代表该州的两名联邦众议员，进入第95届国会。两个选区都维持了原有的党派归属：民主党保住第二选区，共和党守住第一选区。因此，自1970年以来，新墨西哥州的联邦众议员代表团继续由两党各占一半。

en.t: 1976 United States presidential election in Colorado
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in Colorado took place on November 2, 1976, as part of the 1976 United States presidential election. Voters chose seven representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Colorado was won by incumbent President Gerald Ford (R–Michigan) with 54.05% of the popular vote, against Jimmy Carter (D–Georgia), with 42.58% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1976年美国总统选举科罗拉多州结果
zh.s: 1976年美国总统选举科罗拉多州投票于1976年11月2日举行，是1976年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出7名总统选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。现任总统杰拉尔德·福特（共和党，密歇根州）赢得科罗拉多州，得票率为54.05%；吉米·卡特（民主党，佐治亚州）获得42.58%的选票。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 2, 1976. Primaries were held on March 16, 1976. In order to, per Constitution of Illinois, allow for all statewide executive offices to be up for election in the 1978 midterms, all statewide executive offices up for election in 1976 were only elected to two-year terms.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州选举于1976年11月2日星期二举行，初选于1976年3月16日举行。根据《伊利诺伊州宪法》，为使全州行政职位在1978年中期选举时都进行改选，1976年改选的这些职位任期都只有两年。

en.t: 1976 United States presidential election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in Wyoming took place on November 2, 1976, as part of the 1976 United States presidential election. Voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Wyoming was won by incumbent President Gerald Ford (R–Michigan), with 59.30% of the popular vote, against Jimmy Carter (D–Georgia), with 39.81% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1976年美国总统选举怀俄明州结果
zh.s: 1976年美国总统选举怀俄明州投票于1976年11月2日举行，是1976年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出3名总统选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。现任总统杰拉尔德·福特（共和党，密歇根州）赢得怀俄明州，得票率为59.30%；吉米·卡特（民主党，佐治亚州）获得39.81%的选票。

en.t: 1976 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 2, 1976, as part of the 1976 United States presidential election. Voters chose 9 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Kentucky was won by Jimmy Carter (D–Georgia), with 52.75 percent of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1976年美国肯塔基州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出9名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。来自佐治亚州的民主党候选人吉米·卡特以52.75%的普选票赢得肯塔基州。

en.t: 1976 United States presidential election in Hawaii
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in Hawaii took place on November 2, 1976. All fifty states and the District of Columbia were part of the 1976 United States presidential election. Hawaii voters chose four electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Hawaii was won by Georgia Governor Jimmy Carter by 2.53 points, making Hawaii 0.43% more Democratic than the nation-at-large.

zh.s: 1976年美国夏威夷州总统选举于11月2日举行，全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了当年总统选举。夏威夷州选民选出4名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。佐治亚州州长吉米·卡特以2.53个百分点的优势赢得夏威夷州，该州的民主党支持度比全国平均水平高0.43个百分点。

en.s: The 1976 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 2, 1976, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent secretary of state James Kirkpatrick defeated Republican nominee Mildred P. Huffman and Nonpartisan candidate Evelyn F. Carmack.

zh.s: 1976年密苏里州州务卿选举于11月2日举行，选出该州州务卿。民主党候选人、现任州务卿詹姆斯·柯克帕特里克击败共和党候选人米尔德丽德·P·赫夫曼和无党派候选人伊夫琳·F·卡马克。

en.t: 1976 United States presidential election in the District of Columbia
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in the District of Columbia took place on November 2, 1976, as part of the 1976 United States presidential election in order to select the District of Columbia's three electoral votes for President of the United States. Democrat Jimmy Carter won the District by an overwhelming margin.

zh.t: 1976年美国哥伦比亚特区总统选举
zh.s: 1976年美国哥伦比亚特区总统选举于11月2日举行，选出哥伦比亚特区的3张总统选举人票。民主党人吉米·卡特以压倒性优势赢得该区。

en.t: 1976 United States presidential election in Arizona
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in Arizona was part of the 1976 United States presidential election, which took place on November 2, 1976, throughout all fifty states and D.C. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Arizona voted strongly for the Republican nominee, incumbent President Gerald Ford, over the Democratic nominee, Georgia Governor Jimmy Carter.

zh.t: 1976年美国亚利桑那州总统选举
zh.s: 1976年美国亚利桑那州总统选举是当年美国总统选举的一部分，于11月2日在全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区举行。选民选出6名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。亚利桑那州大力支持共和党候选人、现任总统杰拉尔德·福特，击败民主党候选人、佐治亚州州长吉米·卡特。

en.s: The 1976 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1976. Incumbent Republican Governor Meldrim Thomson Jr. defeated Democratic nominee Harry V. Spanos with 57.66% of the vote.

zh.s: 1976年新罕布什尔州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长梅尔德里姆·汤姆森二世击败民主党候选人哈里·V·斯帕诺斯，获得57.66%的选票。

en.t: 1976 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1976 United States House of Representatives elections were elections for the United States House of Representatives on November 2, 1976, to elect members to serve in the 95th United States Congress. They coincided with Jimmy Carter's election as president. Carter's narrow victory over Gerald Ford had limited coattails, and his Democratic Party gained a net of only one seat from the Republican Party in the House.

zh.s: 1976年美国联邦众议院选举于11月2日举行，选出第95届国会议员，与吉米·卡特当选总统同时发生。卡特以微弱优势击败杰拉尔德·福特，对众议院民主党候选人的带动有限，民主党在众议院只比共和党净增1席。

en.t: 1976 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in Rhode Island took place on November 2, 1976, as part of the 1976 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Rhode Island was won by Jimmy Carter (D–Georgia), with 55.36% of the popular vote. Carter defeated incumbent President Gerald Ford (R–Michigan), who finished with 44.08% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1976年美国罗得岛州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。来自佐治亚州的民主党候选人吉米·卡特以55.36%的普选票赢得罗得岛州。卡特击败共和党籍现任总统、来自密歇根州的杰拉尔德·福特；福特的得票率为44.08%。

en.s: The 1976 Arizona House of Representatives elections were held on November 2, 1976. Voters elected all 60 members of the Arizona House of Representatives in multi-member districts to serve a two-year term. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and State Senate. Primary elections were held on September 7, 1976.

zh.s: 1976年亚利桑那州众议院选举于11月2日举行。选民从多席位选区中选出亚利桑那州众议院全部60名议员，任期两年。此次选举与其他公职选举同时举行，包括联邦参议员、联邦众议员和州参议员选举。初选于1976年9月7日举行。

en.s: The Pennsylvania State Treasurer election was held on November 2, 1976. Democrat Robert E. Casey defeated Republican Patricia A. Crawford by a margin of 5.86%. Casey defeated Catherine Baker Knoll in the Democratic primary by a margin of 11.51%. Casey's victory was due in large part to his similar name to then State Auditor General Robert P. Casey. Robert E.

zh.t: 1976年宾夕法尼亚州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州州财政部长选举于1976年11月2日举行。民主党人罗伯特·E·凯西以5.86个百分点的优势击败共和党人帕特里夏·A·克劳福德。凯西在民主党初选中以11.51个百分点的优势击败凯瑟琳·贝克·诺尔。凯西的胜选很大程度上归因于他与当时的州审计长罗伯特·P·凯西同名。

en.t: 1976 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1976 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held on November 2, 1976. Incumbent Democrat William Proxmire defeated Republican nominee Stanley York in a landslide, taking 72.20% of the vote.

zh.t: 1976年美国威斯康星州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1976年美国威斯康星州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员威廉·普罗克斯迈尔以压倒性优势击败共和党候选人斯坦利·约克，获得72.20%的选票。

en.t: 1976 United States Senate election in New Jersey
en.s: The 1976 United States Senate election in New Jersey was held on November 2, 1976. Incumbent Democrat Harrison A. Williams defeated Republican nominee David A. Norcross with 60.66% of the vote. Primary elections were held on June 8, 1976 and were uneventful. Williams easily staved off an anti-abortion campaign from attorney Stephen J. Foley. Norcross cleared a four-man field to win the Republican nomination in a landslide.

zh.t: 1976年美国新泽西州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1976年美国新泽西州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员哈里森·A·威廉姆斯击败共和党候选人戴维·A·诺克罗斯，获得60.66%的选票。初选于1976年6月8日举行，过程平静。律师斯蒂芬·J·福利发起反堕胎运动，威廉姆斯轻松顶住压力。诺克罗斯则在四人角逐中以压倒性优势赢得共和党提名。

en.t: 1976 United States presidential election in Kansas
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in Kansas took place on November 2, 1976, as part of the 1976 United States presidential election. Kansas voters chose seven representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Kansas was won by incumbent President Gerald Ford (R–Michigan). with 52.49 percent of the popular vote, against Jimmy Carter (D–Georgia), with 44.94 percent of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1976年美国堪萨斯州总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。堪萨斯州选民选出7名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。共和党籍现任总统、来自密歇根州的杰拉尔德·福特以52.49%的普选票赢得该州；来自佐治亚州的民主党候选人吉米·卡特获得44.94%的选票。

en.s: The 1976 Washington gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1976. This election was especially significant in that Washington elected its first female governor, Dixy Lee Ray. Wesley C. Uhlman and John Patric unsuccessfully ran in the blanket primary.

zh.s: 1976年华盛顿州州长选举于1976年11月2日举行。迪克西·李·雷当选，成为华盛顿州首位女州长。韦斯利·C·乌尔曼和约翰·帕特里克参加了无党派综合初选，但未能胜出。

en.t: 1976 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1976 United States presidential election in Georgia was held on November 2, 1976. The Democratic candidate, former Governor of Georgia Jimmy Carter, overwhelmingly won his home state with 66.74% of the vote ahead of the Republican Party nominee, incumbent President Gerald Ford, giving him the state's 12 electoral votes. Carter carried all of Georgia's 159 counties (the last time any presidential candidate has won every single county in the state) and 10 congressional districts by wide margins.

zh.t: 1976年美国总统选举佐治亚州结果
zh.s: 1976年美国总统选举佐治亚州投票于1976年11月2日举行。民主党候选人、佐治亚州前州长吉米·卡特以66.74%的得票率大胜共和党提名人、现任总统杰拉尔德·福特，为自己赢得该州12张选举人票。卡特赢得佐治亚州全部159个县和10个国会选区，且优势明显；这是总统候选人最后一次赢得该州的每一个县。

en.t: 1976 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1976 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 2, 1976. Incumbent Democrat Henry M. Jackson, who had been a candidate for President earlier that year, won a fifth term in office with a landslide victory over Republican George Brown even as incumbent President Gerald Ford won the state for President on the same ballot.

zh.t: 1976年美国华盛顿州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1976年美国华盛顿州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员亨利·M·杰克逊在当年早些时候曾竞选总统，这次以压倒性优势击败共和党人乔治·布朗，赢得第五个任期。尽管同一张选票上的共和党籍现任总统杰拉尔德·福特赢得华盛顿州，杰克逊仍成功连任。

en.t: 1976 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1976 United States Senate election in New York was held on November 2, 1976. Republican incumbent James L. Buckley ran for re-election to a second term in office but was defeated by Democratic nominee Pat Moynihan, former White House aide and ambassador to the United Nations and India. As of 2026, this is the last time an incumbent lost re-election to this seat.

zh.t: 1976年美国纽约州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1976年美国纽约州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员詹姆斯·L·巴克利竞选连任第二个任期，但败给民主党候选人帕特·莫伊尼汉；莫伊尼汉曾任白宫助理和美国驻联合国及印度大使。截至2026年，这是该席位现任参议员最后一次连任失败。

en.s: The 1976 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on Tuesday November 2, Incumbent Democratic governor David Pryor defeated Republican candidate Leon Griffith with 83.24% of the vote. Pryor carried all of the state's 75 counties in his reelection effort, the last governor to do so until fellow Democrat Mike Beebe did in his 2010 reelection bid.

en.s: The 1976 United States Senate elections was an election for the United States Senate. Held on November 2, the 33 seats of Class 1 were contested in regular elections. They coincided with Democrat Jimmy Carter's presidential election and the United States Bicentennial celebration. Although almost half of the seats decided in this election changed parties, Carter's narrow victory did not provide coattails for the Democratic Party.

en.s: The 1976 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1976 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 28 of the state senate's districts—the 25 even-numbered state senate districts and special elections in districts 11, 15, and 41. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate, with half of the seats up for election each cycle.

en.s: The Alabama gubernatorial election of 1982 included the last campaign and final electoral victory of George Wallace. The election occurred on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Governor Fob James declined to run for a second term, allowing for an open election in 1982. In the Democratic primary, Wallace received challenges from Lieutenant Governor George McMillan, Speaker of the State House Joe McCorquodale, Jr., former Governor Jim Folsom, and Reuben McKinley. Because Wallace did not receive a majority of the votes, he advanced to a run-off with McMillan and then narrowly won the Democratic nomination. Montgomery Mayor Emory Folmar went unchallenged for the Republican nomination.

zh.s: 1982年阿拉巴马州州长选举包括乔治·华莱士最后一次竞选及其最后一次胜选。选举于1982年11月2日举行。现任州长福布·詹姆斯不寻求连任，州长职位因此开放。在民主党初选中，华莱士面对副州长乔治·麦克米伦、州众议院议长小乔·麦克科奎代尔、前州长吉姆·福尔瑟姆和鲁本·麦金利的挑战。由于华莱士没有获得过半选票，他与麦克米伦进入第二轮初选，最终以微弱优势赢得民主党提名。蒙哥马利市长埃默里·福尔马尔无人竞争，获得共和党提名。

en.t: United States Senate election in Montana, 1982
en.s: The 1982 United States Senate election in Montana took place on November 2, 1982. Incumbent United States Senator John Melcher, who was first elected to the Senate in 1976, opted to run for re-election. He won the Democratic primary after he faced a tough intraparty challenger, and advanced to the general election, where he faced Larry R. Williams, an author and the Republican nominee, and Larry Dodge, the Libertarian nominee. Though his margin was reduced significantly from his initial election, Melcher still comfortably won re-election to his second and final term in the Senate.

Only Burdick filed as a Dem-NPLer, and the endorsed Republican candidate was cattle rancher Gene Knorr. Burdick and Knorr won the primary elections for their respective parties. Burdick's campaign was known for employing more television advertisement spending when compared with his campaigns in the past, as well as making several negative portrayals. Knorr had the support of Vice President George H.

zh.s: 北达科他州于1982年11月2日举行联邦参议员选举。时任民主党—无党派联盟（Dem-NPL）参议员昆廷·伯迪克竞选连任第五届，并击败共和党候选人吉恩·诺尔。只有伯迪克以Dem-NPL候选人身份登记；共和党支持的候选人是牧场主吉恩·诺尔。两人分别赢得各自政党的初选。伯迪克此次竞选比以往投入更多电视广告，也采用了多种负面宣传。诺尔获得副总统乔治·H。

en.s: The 1982 Alaska gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 1982 for the post of governor of Alaska. To replace outgoing Republican governor Jay Hammond, Democratic nominee Bill Sheffield defeated three opponents: Republican nominee Tom Fink, Libertarian nominee Dick Randolph and Alaskan Independence Party nominee Joe Vogler. Hammond had endorsed his lieutenant governor, Terry Miller, who lost the Republican nomination to Fink in the primary election. Randolph, as a member of a political party not recognized by the state, gained access to the ballot via a nominating petition. He garnered nearly fifteen percent of the vote, to date the highest percentage received by any Libertarian Party gubernatorial candidate.

zh.s: 1982年阿拉斯加州州长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州州长。为接替即将卸任的共和党籍州长杰伊·哈蒙德，民主党候选人比尔·谢菲尔德击败了三名对手：共和党候选人汤姆·芬克、自由党候选人迪克·伦道夫和阿拉斯加独立党候选人乔·沃格勒。哈蒙德支持自己的副州长特里·米勒，但米勒在共和党初选中输给了芬克。伦道夫所在的政党未获该州正式承认，因此通过提名请愿获得参选资格。他的得票率接近15%，至今仍是自由党州长候选人的最高得票率。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina, 1982
en.s: The 1982 South Carolina United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 2, 1982, to select six Representatives for two-year terms from the state of South Carolina. The primary elections for the Democrats were held on June 8 and the runoff elections were held two weeks later on June 22. Three incumbents were re-elected, but John Light Napier of the 6th congressional district was defeated in his bid for re-election and the open seat in the 5th congressional district was retained by the Democrats. The composition of the state delegation after the elections was three Republicans and three Democrats.

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections, 1982
en.s: The U.S. House election, 1982 was an election for the United States House of Representatives held on November 2, 1982, in the middle of President Ronald Reagan's first term, whose popularity was sinking due to economic conditions under the 1982 recession. The President's Republican Party lost seats in the House, which could be viewed as a response to the President's approval at the time. Unlike most midterm election cycles, the number of seats lost—27 seats to the Democratic Party—was a comparatively large swap. It included most of the seats that had been gained the previous election, cementing the Democratic majority.

zh.s: 1982年美国联邦众议院选举于1982年11月2日举行，时值罗纳德·里根总统第一个任期中期。当时经济衰退，里根的支持率下滑，共和党因此失去众议院席位。失去的席位可视为选民对总统支持度的反映。与大多数中期选举相比，共和党将27席输给民主党，席位变化幅度较大。这些席位大多是共和党在上一次选举中赢得的，民主党由此巩固了多数席位。

en.t: Robert Stafford wins reelection to the U.S. Senate from Vermont
en.s: On November 2, 1982, Vermont voters reelected Republican Robert Stafford to the United States Senate. Stafford defeated Democrat James A. Guest, a former Vermont secretary of state. The Vermont Secretary of State's official results record 84,450 votes for Stafford and 79,340 for Guest.
en.n: The retained article and Vermont's official election records date the Stafford–Guest contest to November 2, 1982, not 1988.

zh.s: 1982年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月2日举行。迈克尔·杜卡基斯当选州长，开启第二个非连续任期。他在大选中击败共和党人约翰·W·西尔斯；此前，他已在民主党初选中击败时任州长爱德华·J·金。

en.s: The 1982 Maine gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Democratic Governor Joseph Brennan defeated Republican challenger Charles R. Cragin. Brennan defeated Cragin, winning his re-election by the largest number of votes in the state's history, and the highest percent margin in more than thirty years. The 281,066 votes received by Brennan represents the single highest vote total for Governor in Maine history.

zh.s: 1982年缅因州州长选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州长约瑟夫·布伦南击败共和党挑战者查尔斯·R·克拉金，成功连任。布伦南的得票数创该州州长选举史上最高纪录，得票率优势也是30多年来最大。他获得281,066票，是缅因州州长选举史上单一候选人的最高得票数。

en.s: The Nevada gubernatorial election of 1982 occurred on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Republican governor Robert List ran unsuccessfully for re-election to a second term as Governor of Nevada, losing to Democratic candidate Richard Bryan.

zh.s: 1982年内华达州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长罗伯特·利斯竞选连任第二个任期，但败给民主党候选人理查德·布赖恩。

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in Alaska, 1982
en.s: The Alaska Congressional election of 1982 was held on Tuesday, November 2, 1982. The term of the state's sole Representative to the United States House of Representatives expired on January 3, 1983. The winning candidate would serve a two-year term from January 3, 1983, to January 3, 1985.

zh.t: 1982年美国阿拉斯加州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1982年美国阿拉斯加州国会选举于11月2日（星期二）举行。该州唯一一名联邦众议员的任期于1983年1月3日届满。胜选者将任职两年，任期从1983年1月3日至1985年1月3日。

en.s: The United States Senate election of November 2, 1982 was an election for the United States Senate following Republican gains in 1980. A total of four seats changed hands between parties, and the lone independent, Senator Harry Byrd, retired. Democrats made a net gain of one seat in the election.

zh.s: 1982年11月2日举行美国联邦参议院选举，此前共和党在1980年选举中取得席位。两党之间共有4个席位易手，唯一的独立派参议员哈里·伯德退休。民主党在本次选举中净增1席。

en.s: The 1982 Minnesota Senate election was held in the U.S. state of Minnesota on November 2, 1982, to elect members to the Senate of the 73rd and 74th Minnesota Legislatures. A primary election was held on September 14, 1982. The Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party (DFL) won a majority of seats, remaining the majority party, followed by the Independent-Republicans of Minnesota. The new Legislature convened on January 4, 1983.

zh.s: 1982年明尼苏达州参议院选举于11月2日举行，选出明尼苏达州第73届和第74届议会参议院议员。初选于1982年9月14日举行。明尼苏达州民主—农民—劳工党（DFL）赢得多数席位，继续成为多数党；明尼苏达州独立共和党排名其后。新一届议会于1983年1月4日开会。

en.s: The 1982 California gubernatorial election occurred on November 2, 1982. The Republican nominee, Attorney General George Deukmejian, narrowly defeated the Democratic nominee, Los Angeles Mayor Tom Bradley. Incumbent Governor Jerry Brown did not seek reelection to a third term (although he was elected again in 2010).

zh.s: 1982年加利福尼亚州州长选举于1982年11月2日举行。共和党候选人、州检察长乔治·德克梅吉安以微弱优势击败民主党候选人、洛杉矶市长汤姆·布拉德利。现任州长杰里·布朗没有竞选第三个任期，不过他后来于2010年再次当选州长。

en.s: The Vermont gubernatorial election of 1982 took place on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Republican Richard A. Snelling ran successfully for a fourth term as Governor of Vermont, defeating Democratic candidate Madeleine M. Kunin.

zh.s: 1982年佛蒙特州州长选举于1982年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长理查德·A·斯内林成功竞选第四个任期，击败民主党候选人玛德琳·M·库宁。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1982
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1982 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 2, 1982. California gained two seats, both of which were won by Democrats, as a result of the 1980 Census, and Democrats picked up three Republican-held districts.

zh.t: 1982年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1982年加利福尼亚州举行联邦众议院选举，选出该州的联邦众议员。这是1982年11月2日联邦众议院大选的一部分。由于1980年人口普查结果，加州增加两个席位，这两个席位都由民主党赢得；民主党还从共和党手中赢得三个选区。

en.t: United States Senate election in Virginia, 1982
en.s: The 1982 United States Senate election in Virginia was held on November 2, 1982. U.S. Representative from Virginia's 1st district, Paul Trible replaced Independent Senator Harry F. Byrd, Jr., who was stepping down after three terms.

zh.t: 1982年弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1982年弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。来自弗吉尼亚州第一选区的联邦众议员保罗·特里布尔接替了任满三届后卸任的独立派参议员小哈里·F·伯德。

en.t: United States Senate election in New Jersey, 1982
en.s: The 1982 United States Senate election in New Jersey was held on November 2, 1982. Democrat Frank Lautenberg won for the seat held by retiring incumbent Republican Senator Nicholas Brady. Lautenberg won the seat with a margin of 3.19% over U.S. Representative Millicent Fenwick.

zh.t: 1982年新泽西州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1982年新泽西州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。民主党候选人弗兰克·劳滕伯格赢得即将退休的共和党籍现任参议员尼古拉斯·布雷迪所持席位。劳滕伯格以3.19个百分点的优势击败联邦众议员米利森特·芬威克。

en.s: The 1982 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1982 to elect the Governor of Texas. Incumbent Republican Governor Bill Clements was running for reelection, but was defeated in the general election by Democrat Mark White, winning 46% of the vote to White's 53%. White was sworn in for his first and only term on January 18, 1983.

zh.s: 1982年得克萨斯州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长比尔·克莱门茨竞选连任，但在大选中败给民主党候选人马克·怀特。克莱门茨获得46%的选票，怀特获得53%。怀特于1983年1月18日宣誓就职，开始其唯一一个任期。

en.t: United States Senate election in Maryland, 1982
en.s: The 1982 Senate election in Maryland took place on November 2, 1982 simultaneously with other elections for seats in the U.S. Senate and House of Representatives in addition to gubernatorial openings. Incumbent Democratic Senator Paul Sarbanes won reelection to a second term in office. He defeated the Republican nominee, former Representative from Maryland's 5th district and Prince George's County Executive Lawrence Hogan.

zh.t: 1982年马里兰州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 马里兰州联邦参议员选举于1982年11月2日举行，与其他联邦参议员和众议员选举及州长选举同时进行。民主党籍现任参议员保罗·萨班斯连任第二个任期，击败共和党候选人劳伦斯·霍根。霍根曾任马里兰州第五选区联邦众议员和乔治王子县行政长官。

en.s: Gubernatorial elections were held in Ohio on November 2, 1982. Dick Celeste of the Democratic Party was elected with 61% of the vote.

zh.s: 俄亥俄州于1982年11月2日举行州长选举。民主党候选人迪克·塞莱斯特以61%的得票率当选。

en.t: United States Senate election in Massachusetts, 1982
en.s: The 1982 United States Senate election in Massachusetts was held on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Ted Kennedy won re-election to his fourth full term.

zh.t: 1982年马萨诸塞州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1982年马萨诸塞州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员泰德·肯尼迪成功连任第四个完整任期。

en.s: The Pennsylvania gubernatorial election of 1982 was held on November 2, 1982 between incumbent Republican Dick Thornburgh and Democratic U.S. Congressman Allen E. Ertel.

zh.s: 1982年宾夕法尼亚州州长选举于11月2日举行，候选人为共和党籍现任州长迪克·桑伯格和民主党籍联邦众议员艾伦·E·埃特尔。

en.t: 1982 United States Senate election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1982 United States Senate election in West Virginia took place on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Robert Byrd won re-election to a fifth term.

zh.t: 1982年西弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1982年西弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员选举于1982年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员罗伯特·伯德成功连任第五个任期。
