en.t: 1982 United States Virgin Islands general election
en.s: General elections were held in the United States Virgin Islands on 2 November 1982, to elect a new governor and lieutenant governor, 15 members of the Legislature of the Virgin Islands and the Delegate to United States House of Representatives.

zh.s: 美属维尔京群岛于1982年11月2日举行大选，选出新任总督和副总督、维尔京群岛议会15名议员，以及美国联邦众议院代表。

en.t: 1982 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas
en.s: The 1982 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas occurred on November 2, 1982, to elect the members of the state of Texas's delegation to the United States House of Representatives. Texas had twenty-seven seats in the House, up three from the 1970s, apportioned according to the 1980 United States census. Due to the Texas' divided government, considerable challenge was foreseen in the state's decennial redistricting process.

zh.t: 1982年美国得克萨斯州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1982年美国得克萨斯州联邦众议院选举于11月2日举行，选出该州的联邦众议员。根据1980年美国人口普查，得克萨斯州在众议院有27个席位，比1970年代增加3席。由于得州由两党共同执政，州内十年一次的选区重新划分过程预计将面临重大挑战。

en.s: The 1982 Michigan Secretary of State election was held on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Democrat Richard H. Austin defeated Republican nominee Elizabeth A. Andrus with 67.90% of the vote.

zh.s: 1982年密歇根州州务卿选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州务卿理查德·H·奥斯汀击败共和党候选人伊丽莎白·A·安德鲁斯，获得67.90%的选票。

en.t: 1982 United States House of Representatives election in Vermont
en.s: The 1982 United States House of Representatives election in Vermont was held on Tuesday, November 2, 1982, to elect the U.S. representative from the state's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with the elections of other federal and state offices, including a U.S. Senate election. Incumbent representative Jim Jeffords won re-election to a 5th term with 69.23% of the vote.

zh.t: 1982年美国佛蒙特州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1982年美国佛蒙特州联邦众议院选举于11月2日（星期二）举行，选出该州不分区国会选区的联邦众议员。此次选举与其他联邦和州级公职选举同时举行，其中包括联邦参议员选举。现任众议员吉姆·杰福兹以69.23%的选票连任第五个任期。

en.t: 1982 United States Senate election in Florida
en.s: The 1982 United States Senate election in Florida was held on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Lawton Chiles won re-election to a third term.

zh.t: 1982年佛罗里达州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1982年佛罗里达州联邦参议员选举于1982年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员劳顿·奇利斯成功连任，开始第三个任期。

en.s: The 1982 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1982, to elect the governor of Arkansas. Former Democratic governor Bill Clinton regained the position after having narrowly been defeated by Republican candidate Frank D. White at the previous election. Clinton held the position from January 1983 until he resigned after being elected president in 1992.

zh.s: 1982年阿肯色州州长选举于1982年11月2日举行，选出阿肯色州州长。前民主党籍州长比尔·克林顿重新当选；在上一次选举中，他以微弱差距败给共和党候选人弗兰克·D·怀特。克林顿从1983年1月任职，直到1992年当选总统后辞去州长一职。

en.s: The 1982 Florida gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Democratic Governor Bob Graham was re-elected in a landslide, defeating Republican Congressman Skip Bafalis with 64.70% of the vote. Bafalis was the last Florida Republican gubernatorial nominee never to have won at least one gubernatorial election in his career. Graham carried 63 of Florida’s counties, with Bafalis only carrying Charlotte, Collier, Lee, and Sarasota counties.

zh.s: 1982年佛罗里达州州长选举于1982年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州长鲍勃·格雷厄姆以压倒性优势连任，以64.70%的得票率击败共和党联邦众议员斯基普·巴法利斯。巴法利斯是最后一位在其政治生涯中从未赢得过州长选举的共和党州长候选人。格雷厄姆赢得佛罗里达州63个县；巴法利斯仅在夏洛特县、科利尔县、李县和萨拉索塔县获胜。

en.s: The 1982 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Democrat Harry Hughes defeated Republican nominee Robert A. Pascal with 61.97% of the vote.

zh.s: 1982年马里兰州州长选举于1982年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州长哈里·休斯以61.97%的得票率击败共和党提名人罗伯特·A·帕斯卡。

en.t: 1982 United States Senate election in Arizona
en.s: The 1982 United States Senate election in Arizona took place on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Dennis DeConcini won re-election to a second term.

zh.t: 1982年亚利桑那州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1982年亚利桑那州联邦参议员选举于1982年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员丹尼斯·德康西尼成功连任，开始第二个任期。

en.s: The 1982 California Secretary of State election was held on November 2, 1982. Democratic incumbent March Fong Eu defeated Republican nominee Gordon W. Duffy with 60.54% of the vote.

zh.t: 1982年加利福尼亚州州务卿选举
zh.s: 1982年加利福尼亚州州务卿选举于1982年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州务卿马奇·方·欧以60.54%的得票率击败共和党提名人戈登·W·达菲。

en.t: 1982 United States Senate election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1982 United States Senate election in Minnesota was held on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator David Durenberger was reelected to a second term (his first full term) over DFL nominee Mark Dayton.

zh.t: 1982年明尼苏达州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1982年明尼苏达州联邦参议员选举于1982年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任联邦参议员戴维·杜伦伯格成功连任第二个任期，这也是他的第一个完整任期；他击败了民主党—农民—劳工党提名人马克·戴顿。

en.s: The 1982 Maryland Senate elections were held on November 2, 1982, as part of the 1982 United States elections, including the 1982 Maryland gubernatorial election. All 47 of Maryland's state senators were up for reelection. Leading up to the 1982 elections, Republicans were hopeful to gain seats in the legislature, citing Lawrence Hogan and Robert A. Pascal leading the party's ticket in the U.S.

zh.s: 1982年马里兰州参议院选举于11月2日举行，属于当年美国选举的一部分，并与马里兰州州长选举同期进行。该州47个州参议员席位全部改选。选举前，共和党希望扩大在州议会的席位，理由之一是劳伦斯·霍根和罗伯特·A·帕斯卡尔领衔该党候选人名单。

en.s: The 1982 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1982. Republican nominee Terry Branstad defeated Democratic nominee Roxanne Conlin with 52.81% of the vote.

zh.s: 1982年艾奥瓦州州长选举于1982年11月2日举行。共和党提名人特里·布兰斯塔德以52.81%的得票率击败民主党提名人罗克珊·康林。

en.t: 1982 United States Senate election in Texas
en.s: The 1982 United States Senate election in Texas took place on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Lloyd Bentsen won re-election to a third term in office, defeating Republican U.S. Representative James M. Collins. Bentsen's victory in the election was credited with producing a coattail effect that allowed Democrats to win in the concurrent gubernatorial election.

zh.t: 1982年得克萨斯州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1982年得克萨斯州联邦参议员选举于1982年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员劳埃德·本特森击败共和党联邦众议员詹姆斯·M·柯林斯，成功连任第三个任期。本特森的胜选带来连带效应，帮助民主党人在同期举行的州长选举中获胜。

en.s: The 1982 Michigan Attorney General election was held on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Democrat Frank J. Kelley defeated Republican nominee and future Oakland County executive L. Brooks Patterson with 57.52% of the vote.

zh.s: 1982年密歇根州总检察长选举于1982年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任总检察长弗兰克·J·凯利以57.52%的得票率击败共和党提名人L·布鲁克斯·帕特森；帕特森后来成为奥克兰县行政长官。

en.s: The 1982 Alabama Senate election took place on Tuesday, November 2, 1982, to elect 35 representatives to serve four-year terms in the Alabama Senate. Primary elections were held on September 7 with runoff elections on September 28. The state's three Black senators, Michael Figures, Earl Hilliard, and J. Richmond Pearson, all won re-election. The Republicans won three seats at the general election, its best showing of the entire century up to that point.

zh.s: 1982年阿拉巴马州参议院选举于1982年11月2日星期二举行，选出35名议员，任期四年。初选于9月7日举行，第二轮初选于9月28日举行。该州3名黑人参议员迈克尔·菲格斯、厄尔·希利亚德和J·里士满·皮尔森均成功连任。共和党在大选中赢得3个席位，这是该党在此前整个20世纪中取得的最好成绩。

en.t: 1982 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1982 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Democrat William Proxmire defeated Republican nominee, future Lieutenant Governor and Governor Scott McCallum in a landslide, taking 63.65% of the vote to McCallum's 34.14%. Primary elections were held on September 14, 1982.

zh.t: 1982年威斯康星州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1982年威斯康星州联邦参议员选举于1982年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员威廉·普罗克斯迈尔以压倒性优势击败共和党提名人斯科特·麦卡勒姆，获得63.65%的选票；麦卡勒姆后来担任副州长和州长。初选于1982年9月14日举行。

en.s: The 1982 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1982, to elect the governor of Tennessee. Incumbent Republican governor Lamar Alexander was now qualified to run for re-election because of Tennessee's 1978 constitutional amendment allowing governors to serve a second consecutive four-year term. Alexander ran for re-election and defeated Democratic nominee Randy Tyree, the mayor of Knoxville, with 59.6% of the vote.

zh.s: 1982年田纳西州州长选举于1982年11月2日举行。根据田纳西州1978年通过的宪法修正案，州长可以连续担任两个四年任期，共和党籍现任州长拉马尔·亚历山大因此可以竞选连任。他最终以59.6%的得票率击败民主党提名人、诺克斯维尔市长兰迪·泰里，成功连任。

en.s: The Maryland county executive elections of 1982 took place on November 2, 1982. Anne Arundel County, Baltimore County, Harford County, Howard County, Montgomery County, and Prince George's County elected county executives.

zh.t: 1982年马里兰州县行政长官选举
zh.s: 1982年马里兰州县行政长官选举于1982年11月2日举行。安妮阿伦德尔县、巴尔的摩县、哈福德县、霍华德县、蒙哥马利县和乔治王子县均选出了县行政长官。

en.s: The 1982 Connecticut Attorney General election took place on November 2, 1982, to elect the Attorney General of Connecticut. Two-term incumbent Democratic Attorney General Carl R. Ajello did not seek re-election. Democratic nominee Joe Lieberman defeated Republican nominee William H. Champlin III.

zh.t: 1982年康涅狄格州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1982年康涅狄格州总检察长选举于1982年11月2日举行，选出该州总检察长。任职两届的民主党籍现任总检察长卡尔·R·阿杰洛没有竞选连任。民主党提名人乔·利伯曼击败共和党提名人威廉·H·钱普林三世。

en.s: The 1982 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Democrat J. Joseph Garrahy defeated Republican nominee Vincent Marzullo with 73.30% of the vote.

zh.s: 1982年罗得岛州州长选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州长J·约瑟夫·加拉希击败共和党候选人文森特·马祖洛，获得73.30%的选票。

en.s: The 1982 Guam legislative election was held in Guam on November 2, 1982. The Democratic Party won fourteen of the twenty-one seats in the Legislature.

zh.s: 关岛立法机构选举于1982年11月2日在关岛举行。民主党赢得立法机构21个席位中的14席。

en.s: The 1982 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Democrat John W. Carlin defeated Republican nominee Sam Hardage with 53.2% of the vote. As of 2026, this was the most recent election in which a male Democrat was elected governor of Kansas.

zh.s: 1982年堪萨斯州州长选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州长约翰·W·卡林击败共和党候选人萨姆·哈达奇，获得53.2%的选票。截至2026年，这是男性民主党人最近一次当选堪萨斯州州长。

en.s: The 1982 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1982, and featured businessman Bob Kerrey, a Democrat, narrowly defeating incumbent Republican governor Charles Thone.

zh.s: 1982年内布拉斯加州州长选举于11月2日举行。民主党商人鲍勃·克里以微弱优势击败共和党籍现任州长查尔斯·索恩。

en.s: The 1982 Texas lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1982, to elect the Lieutenant Governor of Texas. The Incumbent, William P. Hobby Jr. ran for re-election to his fourth term, he was elected against Republican and former Secretary of State of Texas, George Strake Jr. During the campaign Strake ran a weekly series of newspaper ads called "Strake Talk" in which he would discuss current issues with the readers and hoped to generate public interest in the issues he discussed.

zh.s: 1982年得克萨斯州副州长选举于11月2日举行。现任副州长威廉·P·霍比二世竞选第四个任期，对手是共和党人、前得克萨斯州务卿乔治·斯特雷克二世。竞选期间，斯特雷克每周刊登一系列名为“斯特雷克谈”的报纸广告，与读者讨论时事，希望引起公众对相关议题的关注。

en.t: 1982 United States Senate election in Missouri
en.s: The 1982 United States Senate election in Missouri was held on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Senator John Danforth was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating State Sen. Harriett Woods.

zh.t: 1982年美国密苏里州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1982年美国密苏里州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。现任参议员约翰·丹福斯击败州参议员哈丽雅特·伍兹，连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1982 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 2, 1982, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Republican nominee and incumbent state auditor James Antonio defeated Democratic nominee James R. Butler.

zh.s: 1982年密苏里州州审计长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州州审计长。共和党候选人、现任州审计长詹姆斯·安东尼奥击败民主党候选人詹姆斯·R·巴特勒。

en.s: The 1982 Illinois gubernatorial election was held in Illinois on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Republican governor James R. Thompson won a third term in office, defeating the Democratic nominee, former United States Senator Adlai Stevenson III, by a slim margin of 5,074 votes.

zh.s: 1982年伊利诺伊州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长詹姆斯·R·汤普森击败民主党候选人、前联邦参议员阿德莱·史蒂文森三世，以5,074票的微弱优势赢得第三个任期。

en.s: The 1982 Arizona Senate election was held on November 2, 1982. Voters elected members of the Arizona Senate in all 30 of the state's legislative districts to serve a two-year term. Primary elections were held on September 7, 1982. Prior to the elections, the Republicans held a majority of 16 seats over the Democrats' 14 seats.

zh.s: 1982年亚利桑那州参议院选举于11月2日举行。选民选出该州全部30个州参议院选区的议员，任期两年。初选于1982年9月7日举行。选举前，共和党有16席，占多数；民主党有14席。

en.s: The 1982 Maryland attorney general election was held on November 2, 1982, in order to elect the attorney general of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent attorney general Stephen H. Sachs defeated Republican nominee Robert N. Dugan.

zh.s: 1982年马里兰州总检察长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州总检察长。民主党候选人、现任总检察长斯蒂芬·H·萨克斯击败共和党候选人罗伯特·N·杜根。

en.t: 1982 United States Senate election in Michigan
en.s: The 1982 United States Senate election in Michigan took place on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Don Riegle was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating Republican U.S. Representative Philip Ruppe.

zh.t: 1982年美国密歇根州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1982年美国密歇根州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员唐·里格尔击败共和党联邦众议员菲利普·鲁佩，连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1982 Maryland House of Delegates elections were held on November 2, 1982, as part of the 1982 United States elections, including the 1982 Maryland gubernatorial election. All 141 of Maryland's state delegates were up for reelection. Leading up to the 1982 elections, Republicans were hopeful to gain seats in the legislature, citing Lawrence Hogan and Robert A. Pascal leading the party's ticket in the U.S.

zh.s: 1982年马里兰州众议院选举于11月2日举行，属于当年美国选举的一部分，并与马里兰州州长选举同期进行。该州141个州众议员席位全部改选。选举前，共和党希望扩大在州议会的席位，理由之一是劳伦斯·霍根和罗伯特·A·帕斯卡尔领衔该党候选人名单。

en.s: The 1982 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 2, 1982, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee and incumbent member of the Minnesota Senate Hubert Humphrey III defeated Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Minnesota House of Representatives Elliot C. Rothenberg and Conservative People's nominee Samuel A. Faulk.

zh.t: 1982年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1982年明尼苏达州总检察长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州总检察长。民主—农民—劳工党候选人、明尼苏达州参议员小休伯特·汉弗莱击败共和党候选人、明尼苏达州众议员埃利奥特·C·罗森伯格，以及保守人民党候选人塞缪尔·A·福克。

en.s: On November 2, 1982, the District of Columbia held an election for its mayor. It resulted in the reelection of incumbent Democratic mayor Marion Barry to a second term, defeating Republican candidate E. Brooke Lee.

zh.t: 1982年华盛顿哥伦比亚特区市长选举
zh.s: 哥伦比亚特区于1982年11月2日举行市长选举。民主党籍现任市长马里昂·巴里击败共和党候选人E·布鲁克·李，连任第二个任期。

en.t: 1982 United States Senate election in Utah
en.s: The 1982 United States Senate election in Utah took place on November 2, 1982, concurrently with other elections to the United States Senate and United States House of Representatives, as well as various State and Local elections. Republican Orrin Hatch won re-election against Democratic challenger Ted Wilson. This is the last time a Democrat won more than 40% in a Utah Senate election.

zh.t: 1982年美国犹他州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1982年美国犹他州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行，与其他州的联邦参议员和联邦众议员选举以及各州和地方选举同时进行。共和党人奥林·哈奇击败民主党挑战者泰德·威尔逊，成功连任。截至目前，这是民主党人在犹他州联邦参议员选举中最后一次获得超过40%的选票。

en.s: The 1982 Arizona House of Representatives elections were held on November 2, 1982. Voters elected all 60 members of the Arizona House of Representatives in multi-member districts to serve a two-year term. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including Governor, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and State Senate. Primary elections were held on September 7, 1982.

zh.s: 1982年亚利桑那州众议院选举于11月2日举行。选民从多席位选区中选出亚利桑那州众议院全部60名议员，任期两年。此次选举与其他公职选举同时举行，包括州长、联邦参议员、联邦众议员和州参议员选举。初选于1982年9月7日举行。

en.t: 1982 United States Senate election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1982 United States Senate election in Mississippi was held on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Senator John C. Stennis won re-election to his seventh term against future Republican governor Haley Barbour. As of 2026, this was the last time Democrats won a U.S. Senate election in Mississippi.

zh.t: 1982年美国密西西比州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1982年美国密西西比州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。现任参议员约翰·C·斯坦尼斯成功连任第七个任期，击败未来的共和党州长海利·巴伯。截至2026年，这是民主党人在密西西比州联邦参议员选举中最后一次获胜。

en.s: The 1982 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Lieutenant Governor Mike Curb decided to run for Governor of California instead of running for a second term. Democratic nominee Leo T. McCarthy defeated Republican nominee Carol Boyd Hallett with 52.21% of the vote.

zh.t: 1982年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1982年加利福尼亚州副州长选举于11月2日举行。现任副州长迈克·柯布决定竞选加利福尼亚州州长，没有寻求第二个副州长任期。民主党候选人利奥·T·麦卡锡击败共和党候选人卡罗尔·博伊德·哈莱特，获得52.21%的选票。

en.s: The 1982 Oklahoma gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1982, and was a race for Governor of Oklahoma. Democrat George Nigh won re-election by a substantial majority over the Republican, former State Auditor and Inspector Tom Daxon. This is the most recent gubernatorial election in which a candidate carried every county in the state. With Nigh's victory, he became the first Oklahoma governor to serve two consecutive terms.

zh.s: 1982年俄克拉何马州州长选举于1982年11月2日举行。民主党人乔治·奈以明显优势击败共和党候选人、前州审计与检查长汤姆·达克森，成功连任。这是最近一次有候选人赢得该州全部县的州长选举。奈胜选后成为俄克拉何马州首位连续担任两个任期的州长。

en.t: 1982 United States Senate election in Ohio
en.s: The 1982 United States Senate election in Ohio took place on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Howard Metzenbaum was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating Republican State Senator Paul Pfeifer. Along with the gubernatorial election that same year, this election is the last time Butler County voted Democratic in a statewide election.

zh.t: 1982年俄亥俄州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1982年俄亥俄州联邦参议员选举于1982年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员霍华德·梅岑鲍姆击败共和党籍州参议员保罗·普费弗，成功连任第二个任期。与同年州长选举一样，这是巴特勒县最后一次在全州选举中投票支持民主党。

en.t: 1982 United States Senate election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1982 United States Senate election in Wyoming took place on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Republican Senator Malcolm Wallop ran for his second term. He was challenged in the general election by former State Senator Rodger McDaniel, the Democratic nominee. Despite the strong national environment for Democratic candidates that year, Democratic Governor Edgar Herschler's landslide re-election, and the closeness of Wallop's campaign with former Democratic Senator Gale W.

zh.t: 1982年美国怀俄明州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1982年美国怀俄明州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员马尔科姆·沃勒普竞选连任第二个任期。大选中，他的对手是民主党候选人、前州参议员罗杰·麦克丹尼尔。

en.t: 1982 United States Senate election in Delaware
en.s: The 1982 United States Senate election in Delaware was held on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator William V. Roth won reelection to a third term.

zh.t: 1982年特拉华州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1982年特拉华州联邦参议员选举于1982年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任联邦参议员威廉·V·罗斯成功连任第三个任期。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 2, 1982. Primaries were held on March 16.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州选举于1982年11月2日星期二举行。初选于3月16日举行。

en.t: 1982 United States Senate election in New Mexico
en.s: The 1982 United States Senate election in New Mexico took place on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Harrison Schmitt was running for re-election to a second term, but lost to Democratic state attorney general Jeff Bingaman. As of 2026, this is the last time an incumbent senator lost re-election in New Mexico.

zh.t: 1982年新墨西哥州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1982年新墨西哥州联邦参议员选举于1982年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任联邦参议员哈里森·施密特竞选连任第二个任期，但败给了民主党籍州总检察长杰夫·宾格曼。截至2026年，这是新墨西哥州最后一次现任联邦参议员竞选连任失败。

en.s: The 1982 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 2, 1982, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Independent Republican nominee and incumbent state auditor Arne Carlson defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee Paul Wellstone.

zh.t: 1982年明尼苏达州州审计长选举
zh.s: 1982年明尼苏达州州审计长选举于1982年11月2日举行，选出该州审计长。独立共和党提名人、现任州审计长阿恩·卡尔森击败民主党—农民—劳工党提名人保罗·韦尔斯通。

en.s: The 1982 Wyoming gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Democratic Governor Edgar Herschler ran for re-election to a third term. He faced former State House Speaker Warren A. Morton in the general election after several prominent Republicans, including then-Congressman Dick Cheney, declined to challenge him. However, Herschler remained personally popular and the national political environment favored Democrats, and he had little difficulty defeating Morton to win a third term.

zh.s: 1982年怀俄明州州长选举于1982年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州长埃德加·赫施勒竞选连任第三个任期。大选中，他的对手是前州众议院议长沃伦·A·莫顿；包括时任联邦众议员迪克·切尼在内的几位知名共和党人都没有参选。赫施勒个人很受欢迎，加上全国政治形势有利于民主党人，他轻松击败莫顿，成功连任第三个任期。

en.s: The 1982 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 2, 1982, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Joan Growe defeated Independent-Republican nominee Mark Hanson and Libertarian nominee Linda Taylor.

zh.s: 1982年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于1982年11月2日举行，选出该州州务卿。民主党—农民—劳工党提名人、现任州务卿琼·格罗击败独立共和党提名人马克·汉森和自由党提名人琳达·泰勒。

en.s: The 1982 California Attorney General election was held on November 2, 1982. Democratic nominee John Van de Kamp defeated Republican nominee George Nicholson with 52.83% of the vote.

zh.t: 1982年加利福尼亚州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1982年加利福尼亚州总检察长选举于1982年11月2日举行。民主党提名人约翰·范德坎普以52.83%的得票率击败共和党提名人乔治·尼科尔森。

en.t: 1982 United States Senate election in Maine
en.s: The 1982 United States Senate election in Maine took place on November 2, 1982. Edmund Muskie, elected in the 1976 Senate election, resigned his seat in 1980 to become Secretary of State. Incumbent Senator George J. Mitchell, who was appointed to the seat on May 17, 1980, by Governor Joseph E. Brennan, won election to a full six-year term, defeating Congressman David F.

zh.t: 1982年美国缅因州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1982年美国缅因州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。埃德蒙·马斯基在1976年当选参议员，1980年辞职出任国务卿。州长约瑟夫·E·布伦南于1980年5月17日任命乔治·J·米切尔接任；米切尔作为现任参议员赢得完整的六年任期。

en.t: 1982 United States Senate election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1982 United States Senate election in Tennessee was held on November 2, 1982, concurrently with other elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Jim Sasser won re-election. Sasser defeated Republican Robin Beard. Sasser received 92% of the black vote.

zh.t: 1982年田纳西州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1982年田纳西州联邦参议员选举于1982年11月2日举行，与其他州的联邦参议员和联邦众议员选举及多项州和地方选举同时进行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员吉姆·萨瑟成功连任。他击败共和党候选人罗宾·比尔德，并获得92%的黑人选民支持。

en.s: The 1982 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Democrat Richard Lamm defeated Republican nominee John Fuhr with 65.69% of the vote.

zh.s: 1982年科罗拉多州州长选举于1982年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州长理查德·拉姆以65.69%的得票率击败共和党提名人约翰·富尔，成功连任。

en.s: The 1982 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 1982 to elect the governor of New Mexico. Due to term limits, incumbent Democrat Bruce King was ineligible to seek a second consecutive (and third overall) term as governor. Democrat Toney Anaya defeated Republican state senator John B. Irick by about five points. Anaya was the first Democrat to carry Harding County in a gubernatorial election since Thomas J.

zh.s: 1982年新墨西哥州州长选举于11月2日举行，以选出该州州长。受任期限制，民主党籍现任州长布鲁斯·金不能竞选连续第二个任期；这将是他第三个总任期。民主党人托尼·阿纳亚以约5个百分点的优势击败共和党州参议员约翰·B·艾里克。

en.s: The 1982 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 2, 1982, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent comptroller Louis L. Goldstein defeated Republican nominee Richard L. Andrews.

zh.s: 1982年马里兰州州审计长选举于1982年11月2日举行，选出该州州审计长。民主党提名人、现任州审计长路易斯·L·戈尔茨坦击败共和党提名人理查德·L·安德鲁斯。

en.s: A Massachusetts general election was held on November 2, 1982 in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts. The election included: statewide elections for United States Senator, Governor, Lieutenant Governor, Attorney General, Secretary of the Commonwealth, Treasurer, and Auditor; district elections for U.S. Representatives, State Representatives, State Senators, and Governor's Councillors; and ballot questions at the state and local levels. Democratic and Republican candidates were selected in party primaries held September 14, 1982.

zh.s: 马萨诸塞州大选于1982年11月2日举行，涵盖联邦参议员、州长、副州长、总检察长、州务卿、州财政部长和州审计长等全州职位选举，以及联邦众议员、州众议员、州参议员和州长议会成员等地区选举，并包括州和地方层面的公投议题。民主党和共和党的候选人分别在1982年9月14日举行的党内初选中选出。

en.t: 1982 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1982 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Democrat Henry M. Jackson defeated Republican nominee Douglas Jewett with 68.96% of the vote.

zh.t: 1982年美国华盛顿州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1982年美国华盛顿州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员亨利·M·杰克逊击败共和党候选人道格拉斯·朱厄特，获得68.96%的选票。

en.t: 1982 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1982 United States Senate election in New York was held on November 2, 1982. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Daniel Patrick Moynihan won re-election to a second term. Moynihan's victory made him the first Senator holding this seat to win a second term since Irving M. Ives won his second and final term in 1952.

zh.t: 1982年美国纽约州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1982年美国纽约州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员丹尼尔·帕特里克·莫伊尼汉成功连任第二个任期。自欧文·M·艾夫斯于1952年成功连任该席位后，莫伊尼汉是首位连任的参议员。

en.s: The 1982 New York gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1982, to elect the Governor and Lieutenant Governor of New York. Incumbent Democratic Governor Hugh Carey chose not to run for a third term, which resulted in an open race. Democratic nominee Mario Cuomo, the Lieutenant Governor of New York, narrowly defeated Republican Lewis Lehrman, a banker who ran as a conservative.

zh.s: 1982年纽约州州长选举于11月2日举行，选出州长和副州长。民主党籍现任州长休·凯里决定不竞选第三个任期，因此州长席位空缺。民主党候选人、纽约州副州长马里奥·科莫以微弱优势击败共和党候选人刘易斯·莱尔曼；莱尔曼是银行家，奉行保守主义政纲。

en.s: The 1982 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1982. Joe Frank Harris was elected as the 78th Governor of Georgia.

zh.s: 1982年佐治亚州州长选举于11月2日举行。乔·弗兰克·哈里斯当选佐治亚州第78任州长。

en.s: The 1982 Georgia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1982, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Georgia. Democratic nominee and incumbent lieutenant governor Zell Miller defeated Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Georgia State Senate Franklin Sutton.

zh.s: 1982年佐治亚州副州长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州副州长。民主党候选人、现任副州长泽尔·米勒击败共和党候选人、佐治亚州参议员富兰克林·萨顿。

en.s: The 1982 New York State Attorney General election took place on November 2, 1982, in order to elect the Attorney General of New York. Democratic nominee and incumbent Attorney General Robert Abrams won re-election against Republican nominee Frances A. Sciafani, Right to Life nominee Kevin P. McGovern and Libertarian nominee Dolores Grande.

zh.s: 1982年纽约州总检察长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州总检察长。民主党候选人、现任总检察长罗伯特·艾布拉姆斯成功连任，击败共和党候选人弗朗西斯·A·斯基亚法尼、生命权党候选人凯文·P·麦戈文和自由意志党候选人多洛雷斯·格兰德。

en.s: The 1982 Alberta general election was held on November 2, 1982, to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of Alberta.

zh.s: 1982年艾伯塔省大选于11月2日举行，选出艾伯塔省议会议员。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 2, 1982, in 36 states and two territories. The Democratic party had a net gain of seven seats. This election coincided with the Senate and the House elections. As of 2026, this remains the last election cycle in which a Republican won the governorship of Oregon.

zh.s: 1982年11月2日，美国有36个州和两个属地举行州长选举。民主党净增7个州长职位。这次选举与联邦参议院和联邦众议院选举同时举行。截至2026年，这是共和党人最近一次赢得俄勒冈州州长选举。

en.s: The 1982 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1982 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 29 of the state senate's 50 districts—all 25 of the odd-numbered seats were up for regularly scheduled elections to four-year terms and, due to the oddities of redistricting following the 1980 Census, four of the even-numbered seats were up as well.

zh.s: 1982年艾奥瓦州参议院选举是当年每两年举行一次的美国选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民在50个州参议院选区中的29个选区选出参议员。由于1980年人口普查后重新划分选区时的特殊情况，25个奇数编号席位都按原定计划改选四年任期，此外还改选了4个偶数编号席位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1982 Connecticut State Senate elections took place as a part of the biennial 1982 United States elections. All 36 seats were up for re-election. Senators serve two year terms and are up for re-election every election cycle. While both parties gained and lost seats, neither had a net-change, leading to the Democrats maintaining their 23-13 majority over the Republicans.

zh.s: 1982年康涅狄格州参议院选举是当年每两年举行一次的美国选举的一部分。全部36个席位都进行改选。州参议员任期两年，每轮选举都要改选。两党各有席位增减，但席位净变化为零，民主党继续以23席对13席领先共和党。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1982 Texas Senate elections took place as part of the biennial United States elections. Texas voters elected state senators in all 31 State Senate districts. The winners of this election served in the 68th Texas Legislature, serving staggered terms, with half of them up for election in 1984 and the other half up in 1986.

zh.s: 1982年得克萨斯州参议院选举是当年美国选举的一部分。得克萨斯州选民在全部31个州参议院选区选出参议员。胜选者将在得克萨斯州第68届议会任职，任期分批安排，其中一半席位于1984年改选，另一半于1986年改选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1982 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 2. Incumbent Democrat John V. Evans narrowly defeated Republican nominee Phil Batt with 50.64% of the vote, the fourth of six consecutive wins for the Democratic party. Evans served nearly ten years as governor, then ran for the U.S. Senate in 1986. Batt ran again for governor twelve years later in 1994 and won.

zh.s: 1982年爱达荷州州长选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州长约翰·V·埃文斯以50.64%的选票微弱优势击败共和党候选人菲尔·巴特。这是民主党连续6次州长选举获胜中的第4次。埃文斯担任州长近10年，随后于1986年竞选联邦参议员。巴特则于12年后的1994年再次竞选州长并胜选。

en.t: Channel 4, the British free-to-air public broadcast television channel funded by its commercial activities, starts broadcasting
en.s: Channel 4 is a British free-to-air public broadcast television channel owned and operated by Channel Four Television Corporation. It is publicly owned but, unlike the BBC, it receives no public funding and is funded entirely by its commercial activities, including advertising. It began its transmission in 1982 and was established to provide a fourth television service in the United Kingdom.

zh.t: 英国第四频道（Channel 4）开始播出
zh.s: Channel 4是英国免费播出的公共电视频道，由第四频道电视公司运营。它虽为公营频道，却不像英国广播公司（BBC）那样接受公共资金，完全依靠广告等商业活动收入。该频道于1982年开播，旨在提供英国的第四套电视服务。

en.s: The United States and a coalition of Caribbean countries invaded the island nation of Grenada at dawn on 25 October 1983. It was codenamed Operation Urgent Fury by the U.S. military, and resulted in military occupation within a few days. It was triggered by strife within the People's Revolutionary Government, which led to the house arrest and execution of the previous leader and second Prime Minister of Grenada, Maurice Bishop, and to the establishment of the Revolutionary Military Council, with Hudson Austin as chairman.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1983年10月25日凌晨，美国和多个加勒比国家组成的联盟入侵格林纳达。美军将行动代号定为“紧急狂暴行动”，数日内实现军事占领。人民革命政府内部的冲突引发了入侵；此前，格林纳达前领导人、第二任总理莫里斯·毕晓普遭软禁并被处决，随后成立了由哈德森·奥斯汀任主席的革命军事委员会。
zh.n: 本条目采用来源信息框标注的结束日期。

en.t: Capital punishment: Velma Barfield becomes the first woman executed in the United States since 1962
en.s: Margie Velma Barfield (née Bullard; October 29, 1932 – November 2, 1984) was an American serial killer who was convicted of one murder but was linked to seven murders in total. She became the first woman in the United States to be executed after the resumption of capital punishment in 1976, and the first since 1962. She was also the first woman to be executed by lethal injection.

zh.t: 死刑：维尔玛·巴菲尔德成为1962年以来美国首位被处决的女性
zh.s: 玛吉·维尔玛·巴菲尔德（娘家姓布拉德；1932年10月29日—1984年11月2日）是一名美国连环杀手。她因一起谋杀案被定罪，但还被认为与另外六起谋杀案有关。美国于1976年恢复死刑后，她成为首位被处决的女性，也是1962年以来首位被处决的女性。她还是首位被注射死刑处决的女性。

en.s: W.A.K.O. World Championships 1985 Budapest were the joint fifth world kickboxing championships hosted by the W.A.K.O. organization arranged by the Hungarian Sport Karate Union. The organization was under some strain at the time and had split into two separate factions due to politically differences, meaning there were two separate world championships being held on the same date - with an event in London also taking place. These political differences would, however, be resolved and the organization would come back together the following year. It was the first ever W.A.K.O. championships to be held in Eastern Europe.

zh.s: 1985年W.A.K.O.布达佩斯世界锦标赛是W.A.K.O.组织举办的第五届世界自由搏击锦标赛之一，由匈牙利体育空手道联盟承办。当时组织内部关系紧张，因政治分歧分裂为两派，因此同一日期还在伦敦举办了另一场世界锦标赛。双方的分歧于次年解决，组织也重新合并。这是W.A.K.O.首次在东欧举办锦标赛。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: W.A.K.O. World Championships 1985 London were the joint fifth world kickboxing championships hosted by the W.A.K.O. organization arranged by British karate master Joe Johal – who had been made W.A.K.O. president earlier that year. The organization was facing some turmoil at the time with it splitting into two separate factions due to political differences which meant there were two separate world championships being held – with an event in Budapest that very same weekend. These political differences would, however, be resolved the following year and the organization would come back together.

zh.s: 1985年W.A.K.O.伦敦世界锦标赛是W.A.K.O.组织举办的第五届世界自由搏击锦标赛之一，由英国空手道大师乔·乔哈尔组织；他于当年早些时候出任W.A.K.O.主席。当时该组织因政治分歧陷入动荡并分裂为两派，因此同一周末也在布达佩斯举办了另一场世界锦标赛。双方分歧于次年解决，组织重新合并。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in North Korea on 2 November 1986. 655 Deputies were elected to the parliament. The agenda of the first session of the elected eighth Supreme People's Assembly was "For the complete victory of socialism".

zh.s: 朝鲜于1986年11月2日举行最高人民会议选举，选出655名议员。新一届第八届最高人民会议首次会议的议程主题是“为社会主义的完全胜利而奋斗”。

en.s: General elections were held in Palau on 2 November 1988 to elect a President, Vice-President, Senate and House of Delegates. All candidates ran as independents. Ngiratkel Etpison was elected President, whilst Kuniwo Nakamura won the election for Vice-President. Voter turnout was 82.6%.

zh.s: 帕劳于1988年11月2日举行大选，选举总统、副总统、参议员和众议员。所有候选人均以独立人士身份参选。恩吉拉特克尔·埃特皮森当选总统，库尼沃·中村当选副总统，投票率为82.6%。

en.s: On 2 November 1988, LOT Polish Airlines Flight 703, an Antonov An-24 operating a scheduled domestic passenger flight from Warsaw Okęcie Airport to Rzeszów Airport in Poland, crashed short of the runway after an attempted emergency landing following a dual engine failure. Of the 25 passengers and 4 crew members, 1 passenger was killed, while 12 people were injured.

zh.s: 1988年11月2日，LOT波兰航空703号班机失事。这架安东诺夫An-24客机原定执行从华沙奥肯切机场飞往热舒夫机场的波兰国内定期客运航班，双发失效后尝试紧急降落，最终在跑道前坠毁。机上有25名乘客和4名机组人员，其中1名乘客遇难，12人受伤。

en.t: 1988 San Juan, Puerto Rico, mayoral election
en.s: San Juan, Puerto Rico, held an election for mayor on November 2, 1988. It was held as part of the 1988 Puerto Rican general election. It saw the election Héctor Luis Acevedo, a member of the Popular Democratic Party. Acevedo defeated his main opponent, New Progressive Party nominee José Granados (the minority leader of the Puerto Rico House of Representatives) by margin of merely 29 votes (winning 100,525 votes to Granados' 100,496 votes).

zh.t: 1988年波多黎各圣胡安市长选举
zh.s: 波多黎各圣胡安市长选举于1988年11月2日举行，是1988年波多黎各大选的一部分。人民民主党候选人埃克托·路易斯·阿塞维多当选。他以仅29票的优势击败主要对手、新进步党提名人何塞·格拉纳多斯。格拉纳多斯是波多黎各众议院少数党领袖；阿塞维多获得100,525票，格拉纳多斯获得100,496票。

en.t: The Morris worm, the first Internet-distributed computer worm to gain significant mainstream media attention, is launched from MIT
en.s: The Morris worm or Internet worm of November 2, 1988, was a malicious self-replicating computer program that affected VAX computers and SUN-3 workstations running the 4.2 and 4.3 Berkeley UNIX code. It is one of the oldest computer worms distributed via the Internet, and the first to gain significant mainstream media attention. The incident resulted in the first felony conviction in the US under the 1986 Computer Fraud and Abuse Act.

zh.t: 莫里斯蠕虫从麻省理工学院发出，成为首个引起主流媒体广泛关注的互联网传播计算机蠕虫
zh.s: 莫里斯蠕虫，也称1988年11月2日互联网蠕虫，是一种会自我复制的恶意程序，影响了运行4.2和4.3版伯克利UNIX代码的VAX计算机和SUN-3工作站。它是最早通过互联网传播的计算机蠕虫之一，也是首个引起主流媒体广泛关注的蠕虫。这起事件促成了美国依据1986年《计算机欺诈与滥用法》作出的首个重罪定罪。

en.t: British Satellite Broadcasting and Sky Television plc merge to form BSkyB as a result of massive losses
en.s: British Satellite Broadcasting plc (BSB) was a short-lived television company, based in London, that provided direct broadcast satellite television services to the United Kingdom. It started broadcasting on 25 March 1990. The company was merged with competing company Sky Television plc on 2 November 1990 to form British Sky Broadcasting.

zh.t: 英国卫星广播公司与天空电视合并，组建英国天空广播公司（BSkyB）
zh.s: 英国卫星广播公司（BSB）是一家短暂运营的电视公司，总部位于伦敦，为英国提供直播卫星电视服务。该公司于1990年3月25日开始广播。1990年11月2日，BSB与竞争对手天空电视合并，组建英国天空广播公司（British Sky Broadcasting）。

en.s: The Houston mayoral election of 1993 took place on November 2, 1993. The race was officially non-partisan. Incumbent mayor Bob Lanier was re-elected to a second term.

zh.s: 1993年休斯敦市长选举于1993年11月2日举行。此次选举名义上不分党派。现任市长鲍勃·兰尼尔成功连任第二个任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1993 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 2, 1993. Incumbent Democratic governor James Florio was narrowly defeated by Republican Christine Todd Whitman following backlash from voters regarding tax increases that had occurred during Florio's tenure.

zh.s: 1993年新泽西州州长选举于1993年11月2日举行。由于选民反对其任内的加税政策，民主党籍现任州长詹姆斯·弗洛里奥以微弱差距败给共和党候选人克里斯蒂娜·托德·惠特曼。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The United States gubernatorial elections of 1993 were held on November 2, 1993. Two states, New Jersey and Virginia, voted to select a governor, as well as other statewide offices and members of state legislatures. Both seats were originally held by Democrats, but switched parties following the elections.

zh.s: 美国于1993年11月2日举行州长选举，新泽西州和弗吉尼亚州两个州选出州长及其他州级官员和州议员。两个州的州长席位原本都由民主党持有，选举后均转由其他党派赢得。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Mayoral election of 1993 in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania was held on Tuesday, November 2, 1993. The incumbent mayor, Sophie Masloff of the Democratic Party chose not to run for re-election.

zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡市长选举于1993年11月2日星期二举行。民主党籍现任市长索菲·马斯洛夫决定不竞选连任。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The New York City mayoral election of 1993 occurred on Tuesday, November 2, 1993, with Republican nominee U.S. Attorney for the Southern District of New York Rudolph Giuliani narrowly defeating incumbent Democratic mayor David Dinkins. They also faced several third-party candidates. The election was a re-match between the same two candidates from 1989, when Dinkins had narrowly defeated Giuliani to win the mayoralty.

zh.s: 1993年纽约市市长选举于11月2日（星期二）举行。共和党候选人、纽约南区联邦检察官鲁迪·朱利安尼以微弱优势击败民主党籍现任市长戴维·丁金斯。另有几名第三党候选人参选。这是两人再次交锋；1989年丁金斯曾以微弱优势击败朱利安尼，当选市长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Boston mayoral election of 1993 occurred on Tuesday, November 2, 1993 between Acting Mayor Thomas Menino and State Representative James Brett. Menino was elected to his first term. The nonpartisan municipal preliminary election was held on September 21, 1993.

zh.s: 1993年波士顿市长选举于11月2日（星期二）举行，由代理市长托马斯·梅尼诺对阵州众议员詹姆斯·布雷特。梅尼诺当选，开始第一个任期。无党派市政初选于1993年9月21日举行。

en.t: Republic of the Congo Civil War (1993–1994)
en.s: The First Republic of the Congo Civil War, also known as the First Brazzaville-Congolese Civil War, was a conflict in the Republic of the Congo which lasted from 2 November 1993 to 30 January 1994 and was between rival militias led by former politician Bernard Kolelas, former Prime Minister Pascal Lissouba, and former President Denis Sassou-Nguesso.

zh.t: 刚果共和国第一次内战（1993—1994年）
zh.s: 刚果共和国第一次内战又称布拉柴维尔—刚果第一次内战，是一场发生在刚果共和国的冲突，从1993年11月2日持续到1994年1月30日。交战双方是由前政治人物贝尔纳·科莱拉、前总理帕斯卡尔·利苏巴和前总统德尼·萨苏-恩格索领导的敌对民兵。

en.s: The 1993 Virginia gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1993. Barred from seeking a second term due to term limits restricting consecutive terms for Virginia governor, incumbent Democratic governor L. Douglas Wilder was replaced by Republican nominee and former U.S. representative George Allen. Allen, who had defeated Clinton Miller for the Republican nomination, defeated former attorney general of Virginia Mary Sue Terry, the Democratic nominee, by 58.27% to 40.89%, which ended 12 consecutive years of Democratic control of the governor's mansion.

zh.s: 1993年弗吉尼亚州州长选举于11月2日举行。根据任期限制，弗吉尼亚州州长不能连续担任第二个任期，因此民主党籍现任州长L·道格拉斯·怀尔德无法连任，由共和党候选人、前联邦众议员乔治·艾伦接任。艾伦先在共和党提名竞争中击败克林顿·米勒，随后又在大选中击败民主党候选人、前弗吉尼亚州总检察长玛丽·苏·特里，得票率为58.27%对40.89%，结束了民主党对州长职位长达12年的控制。

en.s: The 1993 Toledo, Ohio mayoral election took place on November 2, 1993. Following the adoption of a city charter amendment in 1992, which converted the city to a strong-mayor government, this was the first mayoral election for a four-year term. Incumbent Mayor John McHugh declined to seek re-election, and a crowded race developed to succeed him.

zh.t: 1993年俄亥俄州托莱多市市长选举
zh.s: 1993年俄亥俄州托莱多市市长选举于11月2日举行。该市于1992年通过市宪章修正案，改为强势市长制；这是修正案通过后首次举行四年一届的市长选举。现任市长约翰·麦克休决定不竞选连任，形成多人角逐的接任之战。

en.t: 1993 New York City Public Advocate election
en.s: An election was held on November 2, 1993 to elect the New York City Public Advocate, an office created for this election following reforms to the city charter which held some of the devolved powers of the defunct office of New York City Council President following the disestablishment of the New York City Board of Estimate in the Supreme Court case Board of Estimate of City of New York v.

zh.s: 1993年11月2日举行选举，选出纽约市公共倡导官。该职位是在市宪章改革后设立的，承接了已撤销的纽约市议会主席职位部分下放的权力；纽约市估值委员会此前在最高法院案件中被解散。

en.s: The 1993 Virginia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 1993. Democratic incumbent Don Beyer defeated Republican nominee Michael Farris with 54.49% of the vote.

zh.s: 1993年弗吉尼亚州副州长选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任副州长唐·拜尔击败共和党候选人迈克尔·法里斯，获得54.49%的选票。

en.s: The 1993 Virginia Attorney General election was held on November 2, 1993, to elect the next attorney general of Virginia. The Republican nominee, Jim Gilmore, defeated the Democratic nominee, William Dolan, by around 12 percent.

zh.t: 1993年弗吉尼亚州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1993年弗吉尼亚州总检察长选举于11月2日举行，选出下任总检察长。共和党候选人吉姆·吉尔摩以约12个百分点的优势击败民主党候选人威廉·多兰。

en.s: The 1993 Atlanta mayoral election occurred on November 2, 1993, with a runoff election held on November 23, 1993. Incumbent mayor Maynard Jackson declined to seek reelection to what would have been a fourth overall (and second consecutive) term, citing family and personal reasons. Since no candidate received a majority in the general election, a runoff election was held between the top-two finishers.

zh.s: 1993年亚特兰大市长选举于11月2日举行，第二轮选举于11月23日举行。现任市长梅纳德·杰克逊因家庭和个人原因，决定不竞选第四个总任期（也是第二个连续任期）。由于没有候选人在大选中获得过半选票，得票最高的两名候选人进入第二轮选举。

en.s: The 1993 Durham mayoral election was held on November 2, 1993, to elect the mayor of Durham, North Carolina. It saw the election of Sylvia Kerckhoff, who unseated incumbent mayor Harry E. Rodenhizer Jr. Kerckhoff became the city's first female mayor.

zh.t: 1993年北卡罗来纳州达勒姆市长选举
zh.s: 1993年北卡罗来纳州达勒姆市长选举于11月2日举行，选出该市市长。西尔维娅·柯克霍夫击败现任市长小哈里·E·罗登海泽，当选达勒姆首位女市长。

en.s: The 1993 Cleveland mayoral election took place on November 2, 1993, to elect the Mayor of Cleveland, Ohio. It saw the reelection of Michael R. White to a second consecutive term. The election was officially nonpartisan. White faced only token opposition.

zh.t: 1993年俄亥俄州克利夫兰市长选举
zh.s: 1993年俄亥俄州克利夫兰市长选举于11月2日举行。迈克尔·R·怀特成功连任第二个连续任期。此次选举正式以无党派方式举行，怀特只遇到象征性的反对。

en.s: The 1993 New York City Comptroller election was held on November 2, 1993. Democratic nominee Alan Hevesi defeated Republican nominee Herman Badillo with 56.00% of the vote. Primary elections were held on September 14, 1993.

zh.s: 1993年纽约市审计长选举于11月2日举行。民主党候选人艾伦·赫维西击败共和党候选人赫尔曼·巴迪略，获得56.00%的选票。初选于1993年9月14日举行。

en.s: The Virginia House of Delegates election of 1993 was held on Tuesday, November 2.

zh.s: 1993年弗吉尼亚州众议院选举于11月2日（星期二）举行。

en.s: The 1993 Allentown mayoral election was a municipal election to determine a new mayor of Allentown, Pennsylvania. Incumbent 16-year Democratic mayor Joseph S. Daddona refused to run for re-election, retiring from politics allowing for a new slate of Democratic candidates to try and succeed him, but Republican William L. Heydt won the election to become, to date, the most recent Republican mayor of Allentown.

zh.t: 1993年宾夕法尼亚州阿伦敦市市长选举
zh.s: 1993年宾夕法尼亚州阿伦敦市市长选举选出该市新任市长。民主党籍现任市长约瑟夫·达多纳已任职16年，决定退休，不再竞选连任，由此为民主党候选人接任留下空缺。共和党人威廉·L·海特获胜，成为截至当时最近一位当选阿伦敦市长的共和党人。

en.s: The 1993 New Jersey Senate election was held on November 2. The election took place alongside Christine Todd Whitman's election as Governor over incumbent Jim Florio. Republicans defended the large majority they gained in the 1991 landslide elections, though Democrats did win back districts 7 and 19 that they lost in that election, and picked up the 25th district in an upset over incumbent John H.

zh.s: 1993年新泽西州参议院选举于11月2日举行，与克里斯蒂娜·托德·惠特曼击败现任州长吉姆·弗洛里奥当选州长的选举同期进行。共和党守住了1991年大胜后取得的多数席位，但民主党夺回了在那次选举中失去的第7和第19选区席位，并爆冷赢下第25选区，击败该区现任参议员。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1997 Scottish Challenge Cup final was an association football match between Falkirk and Queen of the South on 2 November 1997 at Fir Park in Motherwell. It was the eighth final of the Scottish Challenge Cup since it was first organised in 1990 to celebrate the centenary of the Scottish Football League.

zh.s: 1997年苏格兰挑战杯决赛于1997年11月2日在马瑟韦尔的冷杉公园球场举行，由福尔柯克对阵南方女王队。这是苏格兰挑战杯第八届决赛；该赛事于1990年创办，以纪念苏格兰足球联赛成立100周年。

en.s: The Houston mayoral election of 1999 took place on November 2, 1999. Incumbent Mayor Lee Brown was re-elected to a second term. The election was officially non-partisan.

zh.s: 1999年休斯敦市长选举于11月2日举行。现任市长李·布朗成功连任，开启第二个任期。此次选举正式以无党派方式举行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Columbus mayoral election of 1999 was the 81st mayoral election in Columbus, Ohio. It was held on Tuesday, November 2, 1999. Republican party incumbent mayor Greg Lashutka retired from office after two consecutive terms in office. Democratic party nominee Michael B. Coleman defeated Republican party nominee Dorothy Teater. Coleman became the first African American elected as mayor of Ohio's capital city.

zh.t: 1999年俄亥俄州哥伦布市市长选举
zh.s: 1999年俄亥俄州哥伦布市市长选举是该市第81届市长选举，于11月2日（星期二）举行。共和党籍现任市长格雷格·拉舒特卡在连续任职两届后卸任。民主党候选人迈克尔·B·科尔曼击败共和党候选人多萝西·蒂特。科尔曼成为首位当选俄亥俄州首府市长的非裔美国人。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1999 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 1999 to elect the Governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Governor Kirk Fordice, a member of the Republican Party who had been first elected in 1991, was ineligible to run for reelection due to term limits. In the general election, Democrat Lieutenant Governor Ronnie Musgrove won a plurality of the vote over Republican Congressman Mike Parker.

zh.s: 1999年11月2日，密西西比州举行州长选举。共和党籍现任州长柯克·福代斯于1991年首次当选，因任期限制不能再次参选。普选中，民主党籍副州长罗尼·马斯格罗夫的得票数领先于共和党籍国会议员迈克·帕克。

loc: 美国阿拉巴马州伯明翰

en.s: The 1999 Birmingham, Alabama mayoral election was held on November 2, 1999, following a primary election on October 12, 1999, to elect the mayor of Birmingham, Alabama. Mayor Richard Arrington Jr. announced that he would not seek another term, and resigned from office on July 19, 1999, elevating City Council President William A. Bell as interim Mayor.

zh.t: 1999年阿拉巴马州伯明翰市市长选举
zh.s: 1999年阿拉巴马州伯明翰市市长选举于11月2日举行，初选于1999年10月12日举行。市长理查德·阿灵顿二世宣布不再竞选连任，并于1999年7月19日辞职；市议会主席威廉·A·贝尔因此接任代理市长。

en.s: The 1999 Tucson mayoral election occurred on November 2, 1999, to elect the mayor of Tucson, and occurred coinciding with the elections to the Tucson City Council wards 1, 2 and 4. It saw the election of Bob Walkup. Incumbent mayor George Miller did not seek reelection to a third term.

zh.s: 1999年图森市市长选举于11月2日举行，选出该市市长，同时举行的还有图森市议会第1、第2和第4选区选举。鲍勃·沃克普当选。现任市长乔治·米勒没有竞选第三个任期。

en.s: The Indianapolis mayoral election of 1999 took place on November 2, 1999. Voters elected the Mayor of Indianapolis, members of the Indianapolis City-County Council, as well as several other local officials. Democrat Bart Peterson was the first Democrat to be elected as Mayor of Indianapolis since 1963.

zh.t: 1999年印第安纳波利斯市市长选举
zh.s: 1999年印第安纳波利斯市市长选举于11月2日举行。选民选出市长、市—县议会成员和其他地方官员。民主党人巴特·彼得森成为自1963年以来首位当选印第安纳波利斯市长的民主党人。

en.s: The 1999 Kentucky gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 1999, for the post of Governor of Kentucky. Democratic incumbent Governor Paul E. Patton defeated Republican nominee Peppy Martin to win a second term. Martin later switched parties and lost the 2023 Democratic primary for Governor of Kentucky to incumbent Andy Beshear. 1999 was the first time that the election was held since the Kentucky General Assembly changed its term limits law in 1992, allowing Patton to run again and leaving Virginia as the only state that prohibits its Governor from serving immediate successive terms.

zh.s: 1999年肯塔基州州长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州州长。民主党籍现任州长保罗·E·巴顿击败共和党候选人佩皮·马丁，赢得第二个任期。马丁后来改入民主党，并在2023年民主党州长初选中败给时任州长安迪·贝希尔。1999年是肯塔基州议会于1992年修改州长任期限制法后首次举行州长选举；新法让巴顿得以再次参选，也使弗吉尼亚州成为唯一禁止州长连续担任多个任期的州。

en.s: The 1999 Snohomish County Executive election took place on November 2, 1999, to elect the county executive of Snohomish County, Washington. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Bob Drewel ran for re-election to a third term. He faced three challengers: Republican Lew Moore, the chief of staff to Congressman Jack Metcalf, and Democrats Dale Smith, a county secession advocate, and Mardi Jorgensen, a businesswoman.

zh.t: 1999年斯诺霍米什县县行政长官选举
zh.s: 1999年斯诺霍米什县县行政长官选举于11月2日举行，选出华盛顿州斯诺霍米什县县行政长官。民主党籍现任县行政长官鲍勃·德鲁尔竞选第三个任期，对手有3人：共和党人卢·摩尔（国会议员杰克·梅特卡夫的幕僚长），以及民主党人戴尔·史密斯（主张县分离的人士）和商人玛蒂·约根森。

en.s: The 1999 Allegheny County Executive election was held on November 2, 1999. The election was the first one following the 1998 passage of Allegheny County's charter, which replaced the existing County Commission with an elected County Executive and a fifteen-member County Council. Both parties had contested primaries for the position. In the Democratic primary, County Coroner Cyril Wecht defeated County Commissioner Michael Dawida by a wide margin, winning the nomination with 57 percent of the vote.

zh.t: 1999年阿勒格尼县县行政长官选举
zh.s: 1999年阿勒格尼县县行政长官选举于11月2日举行。这是该县于1998年通过新宪章后首次举行选举；新宪章以民选县行政长官和15人县议会取代原有的县委员会。两党都举行了职位提名初选。民主党初选中，县验尸官西里尔·魏克特以57%的得票率大幅击败县委员迈克尔·达维达，赢得提名。

en.s: On November 2, 1999, the city of Baltimore, Maryland, elected a new mayor, the 47th in the city's history. Primary elections were held to determine the nominees for the Democratic Party and Republican Party on September 14. Incumbent mayor Kurt Schmoke, a Democrat, opted not to run for reelection. Martin O'Malley, a member of the Baltimore City Council, won the election to succeed Schmoke.

zh.s: 马里兰州巴尔的摩市于1999年11月2日选出第47任市长。民主党和共和党提名候选人的初选于9月14日举行。民主党籍现任市长科特·施莫克决定不竞选连任。巴尔的摩市议会议员马丁·奥马利当选接替施莫克。

en.s: The 1999 San Francisco mayoral election was held on November 2, 1999, with a runoff election held on December 14, 1999. Incumbent mayor Willie Brown won reelection against supervisor and future Assemblyman Tom Ammiano and nine other candidates for a second term as Mayor of San Francisco. There is a documentary about the election titled See How They Run.

zh.s: 1999年旧金山市长选举于1999年11月2日举行，第二轮选举于同年12月14日举行。现任市长威利·布朗击败市议员、后来成为州众议员的汤姆·阿米亚诺和其他9名候选人，成功连任。关于这场选举还拍摄了一部名为《看他们如何竞选》的纪录片。

en.s: The 1999 Durham mayoral election was held on November 2, 1999, to elect the mayor of Durham, North Carolina. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Nick Tennyson.

zh.t: 1999年北卡罗来纳州达勒姆市长选举
zh.s: 北卡罗来纳州达勒姆市长选举于1999年11月2日举行，选出该市市长。现任市长尼克·坦尼森成功连任。

en.s: Nonpartisan elections are currently held every four years to elect the mayor of Aurora, Colorado.

zh.t: 科罗拉多州奥罗拉市长选举
zh.s: 奥罗拉市目前每四年举行一次无党派选举，选出市长。

en.s: The 1999 Philadelphia mayoral election saw the narrow election of Democrat John F. Street.

zh.s: 1999年费城市长选举中，民主党人约翰·F·斯特里特以微弱优势当选。

en.s: The Virginia Senate election of 1999 was held on Tuesday, November 2. Republicans won a 1997 special election to claim a 21-19 majority in the chamber after Democrat Charles L. Waddell resigned his seat. Republicans maintained this majority in 1999, which gave Republicans their first ever elected majority in history.

zh.s: 1999年弗吉尼亚州参议院选举于11月2日（星期二）举行。查尔斯·L·沃德尔辞职后，共和党在1997年特别选举中获胜，以21席对19席占据参议院多数。1999年共和党保住多数，首次在弗吉尼亚州参议院选举中赢得多数席位。

en.s: The Virginia House of Delegates election of 1999 was held on Tuesday, November 2. Independent Lacey Putney sided with the Republicans in the previous legislature, leaving the chamber tied. However, Republicans flipped three seats in this election, and won their first ever majority in the House of Delegates.

zh.s: 1999年弗吉尼亚州众议院选举于11月2日（星期二）举行。独立派议员莱西·帕特尼在上届议会中与共和党合作，导致议会席位打平。本次选举中，共和党赢得3个原属对手的席位，首次在州众议院获得多数。

en.s: The 1999 Des Moines mayoral election was held on October 5, 1999, to elect the mayor of Des Moines, Iowa. It saw Preston Daniels win reelection.

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in three states in October and November 1999. Kentucky and Mississippi held their general elections on November 2. Louisiana held the first round of its jungle primary on October 23 and did not need to hold a runoff. The Democratic Party had a net gain of one seat, picking up an open seat in Mississippi.

zh.s: 1999年10月至11月，美国有三个州举行州长选举。肯塔基州和密西西比州于11月2日举行大选。路易斯安那州于10月23日举行首轮无党派初选，无需举行第二轮。民主党净增一个席位，在密西西比州赢得一个原本空缺的席位。

en.s: The 2000 El Castillo del Terror (Spanish for "The Tower of Terror") was a major lucha libre event produced and scripted by the Mexican International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG) professional wrestling promotion on November 2, 2000. The 2000 El Castillo del Terror was the first ever IWRG El Castillo del Terror event held, starting an annual tradition for the promotion. The main event was the eponymous Castillo del Terror (Spanish for "Tower of Terror") steel cage match where the last person eliminated would be forcibly unmasked or have his hair shaved off as a result.

zh.s: 2000年“恐怖城堡”（El Castillo del Terror，西班牙语意为“恐怖之塔”）是墨西哥国际摔角革命集团（IWRG）策划并制作的一场大型自由式摔角赛事，于2000年11月2日举行。这是IWRG首次举办“恐怖城堡”赛事，并由此形成年度传统。主赛是同名钢笼赛，按比赛规则，最后被淘汰的人将被强制摘下面具或剃掉头发。

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in the District of Columbia, 2000
en.s: The 2000 congressional election for the Delegate from the District of Columbia was held on November 2, 2000. The winner of the race was incumbent Eleanor Holmes Norton (D). The non-voting delegate to the United States House of Representatives from the District of Columbia is elected for two-year terms.

zh.t: 2000年美国哥伦比亚特区联邦众议院代表选举
zh.s: 2000年哥伦比亚特区联邦众议院代表选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任代表埃莉诺·霍姆斯·诺顿胜选。哥伦比亚特区选出的联邦众议院代表没有投票权，任期两年。

en.s: Expedition 1 was the first long-duration expedition to the International Space Station (ISS). The three-person crew stayed aboard the station for 136 days, from 2 November 2000 to 19 March 2001. It was the beginning of an uninterrupted human presence on the station which continues as of 2026.

zh.s: 远征1号是国际空间站（ISS）的首个长期驻留任务。3名机组人员在空间站驻留136天，从2000年11月2日持续到2001年3月19日。这开启了人类在空间站持续驻留的时期，截至2026年仍在继续。

en.s: UFC 34: High Voltage was a mixed martial arts event held by the Ultimate Fighting Championship at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas, Nevada on November 2, 2001.

en.s: The 2002 South Dakota gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 2002 to elect a Governor of South Dakota. Republican nominee Mike Rounds was elected, defeating Democratic nominee Jim Abbott.

zh.s: 2002年南达科他州州长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州州长。共和党候选人迈克·朗兹当选，击败民主党候选人吉姆·阿博特。

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in the District of Columbia, 2002
en.s: The 2002 congressional election for the Delegate from the District of Columbia was held on November 2, 2002. The winner of the race was incumbent Eleanor Holmes Norton (D), who is now serving in the 108th Congress from January 4, 2003, until her term of office expires on January 3, 2005. The non-voting delegate to the United States House of Representatives from the District of Columbia is elected for two-year terms.

zh.t: 2002年美国哥伦比亚特区联邦众议院代表选举
zh.s: 2002年哥伦比亚特区联邦众议院代表选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任代表埃莉诺·霍姆斯·诺顿胜选，并在第108届国会任职，任期从2003年1月4日至2005年1月3日。哥伦比亚特区选出的联邦众议院代表没有投票权，任期两年。

en.s: Plzeň municipal election in 2002 was held as part of Czech municipal elections, 2002. It was held on 1 and 2 November 2002. The Civic Democratic Party won the election with 38% of the votes. The incumbent Mayor Jiří Šneberger was reelected.

zh.s: 比尔森市政选举是2002年捷克市政选举的一部分，于2002年11月1日和2日举行。公民民主党以38%的得票率获胜。现任市长伊日·什内贝格尔成功连任。

en.s: Senate elections were held in the Czech Republic on 25 and 26 October 2002, with a second round on 1 and 2 November. Voter turnout was just 24.1% in the first round and 31.7% in the second. The results saw the Civic Democratic Party emerge as the most successful party, winning nine seats. Independent candidates were also successful, winning eight seats.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 捷克于2002年10月25日和26日举行参议院选举，第二轮投票于11月1日和2日举行。首轮投票率仅为24.1%，第二轮为31.7%。公民民主党表现最佳，赢得九个席位；独立候选人也取得不错成绩，赢得八席。

en.s: The 2003 El Castillo del Terror (Spanish for "The Tower of Terror") was a major lucha libre event produced and scripted by the Mexican International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG) professional wrestling promotion on November 2, 2003. The 2003 El Castillo del Terror was the third ever IWRG El Castillo del Terror event held. The main event was the eponymous Castillo del Terror (Spanish for "Tower of Terror") Steel cage match where the last person eliminated would be forced to take off his wrestling mask or have his hair shaved off as a result of the loss.

zh.s: 2003年“恐怖城堡”（El Castillo del Terror，西班牙语意为“恐怖之塔”）是墨西哥国际摔角革命集团（IWRG）策划并制作的一场大型自由式摔角赛事，于2003年11月2日举行。这是IWRG举办的第三届“恐怖城堡”赛事。主赛是同名钢笼赛，按比赛规则，最后被淘汰的人将被迫摘下面具或剃掉头发。

en.t: United States presidential election in Missouri, 2004
en.s: The 2004 United States presidential election in Missouri took place on November 2, 2004 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2004 United States presidential election. Voters chose 11 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Missouri was won by incumbent President George W. Bush by a 7.2% margin of victory. Prior to the election, 10 of 12 news organizations considered this a state Bush would win, or otherwise considered as a red state. He also won a wide majority of the counties and congressional districts in the state.

zh.s: 2004年美国密苏里州总统选举于2004年11月2日举行，当时全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了总统选举。密苏里州选民选出11名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。现任总统乔治·W·布什以7.2个百分点的优势赢得密苏里州。选举前，12家新闻机构中有10家预测布什会赢得该州，或将其视为共和党稳胜州。他还赢得该州绝大多数县和国会选区。

en.t: United States presidential election in Colorado, 2004
en.s: The 2004 United States presidential election in Colorado took place on November 2, 2004 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2004 United States presidential election. Voters chose 9 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Colorado was won by incumbent President George W. Bush by a 4.67% margin of victory. Prior to the election, 10 of 12 news organizations considered this a state Bush would win, or otherwise considered as a red state. Although, both campaigns targeted it.

zh.t: 2004年美国科罗拉多州总统选举
zh.s: 2004年美国科罗拉多州总统选举于2004年11月2日举行，当时全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了总统选举。科罗拉多州选民选出9名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。现任总统乔治·W·布什以4.67个百分点的优势赢得科罗拉多州。选举前，12家新闻机构中有10家预测布什会赢得该州，或将其视为共和党稳胜州。不过，两位候选人的竞选团队都把该州列为重点争取对象。

en.s: The Jersey City 2004 mayoral special election took place on November 2, 2004. Democrat Jerramiah Healy won the election with 28% of the vote over his nearest rivals (Assemblyman Lou Manzo, 24%, and Acting Mayor L. Harvey Smith, 22%). The previous Mayor Glenn Cunningham, the first African-American Mayor died of a heart attack five months prior and L. Harvey Smith became acting mayor. There was also an election in 2005, which Healy also won. The election was marked by attempts to claim the legacy of deceased Mayor Cunningham, innuendo, and a picture of the eventual winner drunk and naked on his front porch.

zh.s: 2004年泽西市市长特别选举于11月2日举行。民主党人杰拉迈亚·希利以28%的得票率当选，领先于最近的对手：州众议员卢·曼佐（24%）和代理市长L·哈维·史密斯（22%）。前市长格伦·坎宁安是该市首位非裔市长，他在五个月前死于心脏病，之后由史密斯代理市长。希利在2005年还参加了一次选举，并再次获胜。这场选举中，各方争相继承坎宁安的政治遗产，也出现了影射攻击；最终胜出的希利曾被拍到醉酒且赤身裸体地站在家门廊上。

en.t: United States presidential election in Connecticut, 2004
en.s: The 2004 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 2, 2004 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2004 United States presidential election. Voters chose 7 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Connecticut was won by Democratic nominee John Kerry by a margin of 10.4%. Prior to the election, all 12 news organizations considered this a state Kerry would win, or otherwise considered as a safe blue state. In presidential elections, Connecticut is usually expected to fall into the Democrats' electoral vote column, as no Republican has won the state since 1988.

zh.t: 2004年美国康涅狄格州总统选举
zh.s: 2004年美国康涅狄格州总统选举于2004年11月2日举行，当时全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了总统选举。康涅狄格州选民选出7名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。民主党候选人约翰·克里以10.4个百分点的优势赢得该州。选举前，12家新闻机构都预测克里会在该州获胜，或将其视为民主党稳胜州。总统选举中，康涅狄格州通常被认为会把选举人票投给民主党；自1988年以来，没有共和党候选人赢得过该州。

en.t: United States presidential election in Minnesota, 2004
en.s: The 2004 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 2, 2004 throughout all 50 states and the District of Columbia, which was part of the 2004 U.S. presidential election. Voters chose 10 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Minnesota was won by Democrat nominee John Kerry by a 3.5% margin of victory. Prior to the election, most news organizations considered it as a major swing state in 2004 based on pre-election polling. The state is historically a blue state, as the last Republican to carry the state in a presidential election was Richard Nixon in 1972.

zh.t: 2004年美国明尼苏达州总统选举
zh.s: 2004年美国明尼苏达州总统选举于2004年11月2日举行，当时全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了美国总统选举。明尼苏达州选民选出10名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。民主党候选人约翰·克里以3.5个百分点的优势赢得该州。根据选前民调，多数新闻机构将明尼苏达州视为2004年选举中的主要摇摆州。该州历来倾向民主党；最近一次赢得明尼苏达州的共和党总统候选人是1972年的理查德·尼克松。

en.t: United States presidential election in Hawaii, 2004
en.s: The 2004 United States presidential election in Hawaii took place on November 2, 2004 throughout all 50 states and the District of Columbia, which was part of the 2004 presidential election. Voters chose 4 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Hawaii was won by Democratic nominee John Kerry by an 8.7% margin of victory. Prior to the election, all 12 news organizations considered this a state Kerry would win, or otherwise considered as a safe blue state. A Republican presidential nominee has carried the state only twice since its statehood (In 1972 and 1984).

zh.s: 2004年美国夏威夷州总统选举于2004年11月2日举行，当时全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了总统选举。夏威夷州选民选出4名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。民主党候选人约翰·克里以8.7个百分点的优势赢得该州。选举前，12家新闻机构都预测克里会赢得夏威夷州，或将其视为民主党稳胜州。夏威夷建州以来，共和党总统候选人只在1972年和1984年两次赢得该州。

en.t: United States presidential election in Michigan, 2004
en.s: The 2004 United States presidential election in Michigan took place on November 2, 2004 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2004 United States presidential election. Voters chose 17 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Michigan was won by Democrat nominee John Kerry by a 3.4% margin of victory. Although no Republican carried this state in a presidential election since 1988, early polling showed the race was a toss-up, thus was considered as a possible target for the Republicans.

zh.s: 2004年美国密歇根州总统选举于2004年11月2日举行，当时全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了总统选举。密歇根州选民选出17名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。民主党候选人约翰·克里以3.4个百分点的优势赢得该州。自1988年以来，没有共和党候选人赢得过密歇根州总统选举，但早期民调显示双方势均力敌，因此共和党也将该州列为争取目标。

en.t: United States Senate election in Idaho, 2004
en.s: The 2004 United States Senate election in Idaho took place on November 2, 2004 alongside other elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Mike Crapo ran for re-election and won a second term in office in a landslide after no one filed for the Democratic Party nomination. Scott McClure conducted a write-in campaign but only received 4,136 votes, or about 1% of those cast.

zh.t: 2004年美国爱达荷州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2004年美国爱达荷州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行，同时还举行了其他州的联邦参议员选举、联邦众议院选举以及各州和地方选举。共和党籍现任参议员迈克·克拉波寻求连任，并以压倒性优势赢得第二个任期；没有人登记参加民主党提名。斯科特·麦克卢尔以写入选票的方式参选，但只获得4136票，约占总票数的1%。

en.s: Pennsylvania's Attorney General election was held November 2, 2004. Necessary primary elections were held on April 27, 2004. Tom Corbett was elected Attorney General, a position that he had held from 1995-97 after being appointed by Governor Tom Ridge to fill a vacancy. Corbett, who had been a U.S. Attorney, narrowly defeated Montgomery County District Attorney Bruce Castor in the Republican primary, then won by an even tighter margin in the general election. Corbett's Democratic opponent was Jim Eisenhower, the 2002 nominee who had once served as an Assistant U.S. Attorney and had been a close confidant of Governor Ed Rendell.

zh.t: 2004年宾夕法尼亚州总检察长选举
zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州总检察长选举于2004年11月2日举行，相关初选于4月27日举行。汤姆·科贝特当选总检察长。他曾于1995至1997年任职，当时是汤姆·里奇州长任命他填补空缺。曾任联邦检察官的科贝特在共和党初选中险胜蒙哥马利县地方检察官布鲁斯·卡斯特，并在大选中以更小差距获胜。民主党对手是吉姆·艾森豪威尔；他曾在2002年获提名，任职过助理联邦检察官，也是州长埃德·伦德尔的亲密顾问。

en.t: United States presidential election in Mississippi, 2004
en.s: The 2004 United States presidential election in Mississippi took place on November 2, 2004 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2004 United States presidential election. Voters chose 6 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Mississippi was won by incumbent President George W. Bush by a 19.7% margin of victory. Prior to the election, all 12 news organizations considered this a state Bush would win, or otherwise considered as a safe red state. Southern Democrat Jimmy Carter was the last Democrat to carry this state, in the 1976 election.

zh.t: 2004年美国密西西比州总统选举
zh.s: 2004年美国密西西比州总统选举于11月2日举行，当时全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了总统选举。选民选出6名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。现任总统乔治·W·布什以19.7个百分点的优势赢得密西西比州。选举前，12家新闻机构都认为布什会赢得该州，或将其视为共和党稳胜州。来自南方的民主党人吉米·卡特是最近一位赢得该州的民主党候选人，时间是1976年。

en.t: United States presidential election in Kentucky, 2004
en.s: The 2004 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 2, 2004 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2004 United States presidential election. Voters chose 8 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Kentucky was won by incumbent President George W. Bush by a 20.0% margin of victory. Prior to the election, all 12 news organizations considered this a state Bush would win, or otherwise considered as a safe red state. Bush widened his margin of victory since his victory here in 2000 against Al Gore, who used to be senator from neighboring Tennessee by 5%.

zh.s: 2004年美国肯塔基州总统选举于11月2日举行，当时全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了总统选举。选民选出8名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。现任总统乔治·W·布什以20.0个百分点的优势赢得肯塔基州。选举前，12家新闻机构都认为布什会赢得该州，或将其视为共和党稳胜州。布什在该州的胜差比2000年对阵阿尔·戈尔时扩大了5个百分点；戈尔曾任邻州田纳西州参议员。

en.t: North Carolina Council of State election, 2004
en.s: Elections to choose members of the North Carolina Council of State (who head executive branch departments) were held on Tuesday, November 2, 2004. In all but two races (Superintendent of Public Instruction and Labor Commissioner), incumbent Democrats sought re-election. The U.S. Presidential election, U.S. House election, U.S. Senate election, North Carolina gubernatorial election, North Carolina General Assembly election, and North Carolina judicial elections were all held on the same day. Note that the Governor and Lt. Governor are also members of the Council of State, but their elections are covered in the article on the 2004 gubernatorial election.

zh.t: 2004年北卡罗来纳州州政委员会选举
zh.s: 2004年11月2日星期二举行北卡罗来纳州州政委员会选举，选出领导州政府行政部门的官员。除了公共教育总监和劳工专员两场选举外，现任民主党人都寻求连任。同一天还举行了美国总统、联邦众议院、联邦参议院选举，以及北卡罗来纳州州长、州议会和司法选举。州长和副州长也是州政委员会成员，但他们的选举情况记载在2004年州长选举条目中。

en.t: United States Senate election in Illinois, 2004
en.s: The 2004 United States Senate election in Illinois was held on November 2, 2004. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Peter Fitzgerald decided to retire after one term. The Democratic and Republican primary elections were held in March, which included a total of 15 candidates who combined to spend a record total of over $60 million seeking the open seat. State Senator Barack Obama won the Democratic primary and Jack Ryan won the Republican primary. Three months later, Ryan announced his withdrawal from the race four days after the Chicago Tribune persuaded a California court to release child custody records.

zh.t: 2004年美国伊利诺伊州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2004年美国伊利诺伊州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员彼得·菲茨杰拉德决定在一个任期后退休。民主党和共和党的初选于3月举行，共有15名候选人参加，争夺空出的席位，竞选总支出超过6000万美元，创下纪录。州参议员巴拉克·奥巴马赢得民主党初选，杰克·瑞安赢得共和党初选。三个月后，芝加哥论坛报说服加利福尼亚州法院公开瑞安的子女监护记录；四天后，瑞安宣布退出竞选。

en.t: United States Senate election in Alaska, 2004
en.s: The 2004 United States Senate election in Alaska took place on November 2, 2004 alongside other elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives, various state and local elections, and the presidential election of that year. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Lisa Murkowski of Anchorage, sought election to her first full term after being appointed to serve out the rest of her father's unexpired term when he resigned in December 2002 to become Governor of Alaska. Her main challenger was Democratic former Governor Tony Knowles, her father's predecessor as governor.

zh.t: 2004年美国阿拉斯加州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2004年美国阿拉斯加州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行，同时还举行了其他州的联邦参议员选举、联邦众议院选举、各州和地方选举以及总统选举。共和党籍现任参议员丽莎·穆尔科斯基来自安克雷奇，此前她在父亲于2002年12月辞职出任阿拉斯加州州长后获任命，接替父亲未满的任期；这次她寻求首次完整任期。主要对手是民主党人、前州长托尼·诺尔斯，他曾在穆尔科斯基父亲之前担任州长。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections, 2004
en.s: Elections to the United States House of Representatives for the 109th Congress were held on November 2, 2004. The House of Representatives has 435 seats. It coincided with the reelection of President George W. Bush. In the 108th Congress, Republicans held 227 seats, Democrats held 205, with two Republican vacancies and one independent. As a result of this election, the 109th Congress began composed of 232 Republicans, 201 Democrats, one independent (who caucuses with the Democrats), and one vacancy (Democratic Representative Bob Matsui won reelection, but died on January 1, 2005, just three days before the beginning of the 109th Congress.).

zh.s: 第109届美国国会联邦众议院选举于2004年11月2日举行。众议院共有435个席位。选举与乔治·W·布什总统连任同时举行。在第108届国会中，共和党有227席，民主党有205席，另有两个共和党席位空缺和一名独立议员。选举后，第109届国会由232名共和党人、201名民主党人、一名与民主党团共同行动的独立议员组成，另有一个席位空缺。民主党众议员鲍勃·松井连任，但于2005年1月1日去世，距离第109届国会开会仅三天。

Voters chose 5 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Nevada was won by incumbent President George W. Bush by a 2.6% margin of victory. Prior to the election, news organizations who made predictions were split on who would win the state, with half saying it leaned Bush, or a red state and the others who implied it as a swing state.

zh.s: 2004年美国内华达州总统选举于11月2日举行，当时全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了总统选举。选民选出5名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。现任总统乔治·W·布什以2.6个百分点的优势赢得内华达州。选前作出预测的新闻机构对该州结果看法不一；一半认为布什占优或该州倾向共和党，另一半则认为这是一个摇摆州。

en.t: United States presidential election in Montana, 2004
en.s: The 2004 United States presidential election in Montana took place on November 2, 2004 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2004 United States presidential election. Voters chose 3 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Montana was won by incumbent President George W. Bush by a 20.5% margin of victory. zh.s: 2004年美国蒙大拿州总统选举于11月2日举行，当时全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了总统选举。选民选出3名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。现任总统乔治·W·布什以20.5个百分点的优势赢得蒙大拿州。选举前，12家新闻机构都认为布什会赢得该州，或将其视为共和党稳胜州。蒙大拿州通常在州级选举中倾向民主党，当时有两名民主党籍参议员马克斯·鲍卡斯和乔恩·泰斯特，以及一位颇受欢迎的州长布赖恩·施韦策。

en.t: United States presidential election in Maryland, 2004

en.s: The 2004 Indiana gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 2004, to elect the Governor of Indiana. Incumbent Democratic Governor Joe Kernan was defeated by Republican Mitch Daniels. Daniels' victory was the first time the Republican Party had held the governor's office for 16 years and gave the party control of all the important statewide offices. It was also the first time an incumbent governor had been defeated since the Constitution of Indiana was amended in 1972 to permit governors to serve two consecutive terms.

en.t: United States Senate election in California, 2004
en.s: The 2004 United States Senate election in California took place on November 2, 2004 alongside other elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Barbara Boxer ran for re-election and defeated Republican former Secretary of State Bill Jones. Boxer's 6.96 million votes set the all-time record for the most votes cast for one candidate in one state in one election, although it was surpassed by Senator Dianne Feinstein's 7.75 million votes in 2012.

en.s: The 2004 San Diego City Council election occurred on November 2, 2004. The primary election was held on March 2, 2004. Four of the eight seats of the San Diego City Council were contested. This election used the boundaries created by the 2000 Redistricting Committee for the odd-numbered districts. All four incumbent council members ran for reelection in their respective districts. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan, although most candidates do identify a party preference. A two-round system was used for the election, starting with a primary in March followed by a runoff in November between the top-two candidates if no candidate received a majority of the votes in the first round.

en.t: United States presidential election in Vermont, 2004
en.s: The 2004 United States presidential election in Vermont took place on November 2, 2004 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2004 United States presidential election. Voters chose 3 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Vermont is the home state of United States presidential candidate and anti-war advocate Howard Dean, its former governor. Kerry received 58.94% of the vote to Bush's 38.80%, a Democratic victory margin of 20.14%.

en.s: The 2004 Missouri gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 2004 for the post of Governor of Missouri. The Republican nominee, Missouri Secretary of State Matt Blunt, defeated Democratic State Auditor Claire McCaskill. This gave the Republican Party control of both the governorship and the Missouri General Assembly for the first time in 80 years. McCaskill had earlier defeated incumbent Governor Bob Holden in the Democratic primary. This was the first time a sitting Governor of Missouri had been defeated in a primary and the first time any United States governor had lost in a primary since 1994.

en.t: United States Senate election in Iowa, 2004
en.s: The 2004 United States Senate election in Iowa was held on November 2, 2004. Incumbent Republican United States Senator Chuck Grassley ran for re-election to a fifth term in the United States Senate. Grassley and former State Senator Arthur A. Small won the Republican and Democratic primaries, respectively, unopposed, and faced each other in the general election. Though this election coincided with the highly competitive presidential election, Grassley was in little danger of losing his seat and defeated Small handily.

en.s: The 2004 California State Assembly elections were held November 2, 2004. California's State Assembly in its entirety comes up for election in even numbered years. Each seat has a two-year term and members are limited to three 2-year terms (six years). All 80 biennially elected seats in the Assembly were up for election this year. It was expected that the Democrats would retain control of the Assembly, which they did. While some seats were close races, no opposing party challenges to incumbents were successful on either side and thus, there were no changes to the party balance.

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in North Dakota, 2004
en.s: The 2004 U.S. House of Representatives election for the state of North Dakota's At-large congressional district was held November 2, 2004. The incumbent, Democratic-NPL Congressman Earl Pomeroy was re-elected to his seventh term, defeating Republican candidate Duane Sand. Only Pomeroy filed as a Dem-NPLer, and the endorsed Republican candidate was Duane Sand, who had previously faced Democrat Kent Conrad in 2000 for North Dakota's Senate seat (see election). Pomeroy and Sand won the primary elections for their respective parties. Although Sand ran an aggressive campaign, it was not as aggressive as that of Rick Clayburgh who had faced the congressman in the previous election.

en.s: The United States presidential election of 2004 was the 55th quadrennial presidential election. It was held on Tuesday, November 2, 2004. Republican Party candidate and incumbent President George W. Bush defeated Democratic Party candidate John Kerry, Senator from Massachusetts and eventual U.S. Secretary of State. Bush and incumbent Vice President Dick Cheney were renominated by their party with no difficulty. Howard Dean, former Governor of Vermont, was initially the frontrunner for the Democratic Party's nomination, but Kerry won nearly all of the primaries and caucuses. Kerry chose Senator John Edwards of North Carolina, who had himself sought that party's 2004 presidential nomination, to be his running mate.

en.s: The 2004 United States presidential election in Florida took place on November 2, 2004 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 2004 United States presidential election. Voters chose 27 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Florida was won by incumbent President George W. Bush by a 5.0% margin of victory. Prior to the election, most news organizations considered this a swing state. Once again Florida was under the national spotlight because of the facts that it had a high number of electoral votes (27) and the memory of the controversy surrounding the 2000 Florida vote still fresh in the minds of voters.

en.s: Pennsylvania's Auditor General election was held November 2, 2004. Necessary primary elections were held on April 27, 2004, with both major party candidates running unopposed. Democrat Jack Wagner, a State Senator from Pittsburgh was elected Auditor General; he had previously been the endorsed Democratic candidate for Lieutenant Governor in 2002, but was upset by Catherine Baker Knoll. zh.t: 小鲍勃·凯西当选宾夕法尼亚州财长
zh.s: 2004年11月2日，美国宾夕法尼亚州举行州财长选举，民主党人小鲍勃·凯西击败共和党候选人珍·克雷格·佩珀，当选州财长。凯西当时担任州审计长，但因任期限制不能再次连任，于是竞选另一个职位——州财长。
zh.n: 宾夕法尼亚州财长选举举行于2004年11月2日，同日还举行了州审计长选举。

zh.s: 2004年美国科罗拉多州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行，与其他州的联邦参议员选举、联邦众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时进行。共和党籍现任参议员本·奈特霍斯·坎贝尔决定退休，没有竞选第三个任期。民主党候选人肯·萨拉查赢得空缺席位。

en.s: The Alaska Congressional election of 2004 was held on Tuesday, November 2, 2004. The term of the state's sole Representative to the United States House of Representatives expired on January 3, 2005. The winning candidate would serve a two-year term from January 3, 2005, to January 3, 2007.

zh.s: 2004年美国阿拉斯加州国会选举于11月2日（星期二）举行。该州唯一一名联邦众议员的任期于2005年1月3日届满。胜选者将任职两年，任期从2005年1月3日至2007年1月3日。

en.s: The 2004 congressional elections in Indiana were elections for Indiana's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred along with congressional elections nationwide on November 2, 2004. Republicans held a majority of Indiana's delegation, 6-3, before the elections. The only incumbent to lose re-election was Democrat Baron Hill, losing to Republican Mike Sodrel in the 9th district.

zh.s: 2004年美国印第安纳州联邦众议院选举于11月2日举行，与全美各地的国会选举同时进行。选举前，共和党在印第安纳州代表团中以6比3占多数。唯一未能连任的现任议员是民主党人巴伦·希尔；他在第九选区败给共和党人迈克·索德雷尔。
