en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Maryland, 2004
en.s: The Maryland Congressional elections of 2004 were held on Tuesday, November 2, 2004. The terms of all eight Representatives to the United States House of Representatives will expire on January 3, 2005, and therefore all were put up for contest. The winning candidates will serve a two-year term from January 3, 2005, to January 3, 2007.

zh.t: 2004年美国马里兰州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2004年马里兰州联邦众议院选举于11月2日（星期二）举行。该州8名联邦众议员的任期都将在2005年1月3日届满，因此全部席位都进行改选。胜选者将任职两年，任期从2005年1月3日至2007年1月3日。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 2004
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 2004 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 2, 2004. The districts after the 2000 census were gerrymandered to protect incumbents of both parties, so there was no change in the party balance, 33 Democrats and 20 Republicans.

zh.t: 2004年美国加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2004年美国加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举是选举该州联邦众议员的一部分，于11月2日举行。根据2000年人口普查划分的选区经过重新划分，以保护两党的现任议员，因此两党席位没有变化，民主党仍有33席，共和党20席。

en.t: United States Senate election in Utah, 2004
en.s: The 2004 United States Senate election in Utah was held on November 2, 2004. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Bob Bennett won re-election to a third term.

zh.s: 2004年美国犹他州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员鲍勃·贝内特成功连任，开启第三个任期。

en.s: California's state elections were held November 2, 2004. Necessary primary elections were held on March 2. Up for election were all the seats of the State Assembly, 20 seats of the State Senate, and sixteen ballot measures.

zh.s: 2004年美国路易斯安那州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员约翰·布里奥决定退休。共和党联邦众议员戴维·维特在无第二轮投票的开放初选中以51%的选票胜出。

en.t: United States Senate election in South Carolina, 2004
en.s: The 2004 United States Senate election in South Carolina was held on November 2, 2004. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Fritz Hollings decided to retire. Jim DeMint, a Republican Representative won the open seat.

zh.s: 2004年南卡罗来纳州联邦参议员选举于2004年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员弗里茨·霍林斯决定退休。共和党联邦众议员吉姆·德明特赢得空缺席位。

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming, 2004
en.s: The 2004 United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming were held on November 2, 2004 to determine who will represent the state of Wyoming in the United States House of Representatives. Wyoming has one, at large district in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census, due to its low population. Representatives are elected for two-year terms.

zh.t: 2004年怀俄明州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2004年怀俄明州联邦众议院选举于11月2日举行，选出该州的联邦众议员。根据2000年美国人口普查结果，由于人口较少，怀俄明州在众议院只有一个全州单一选区。众议员任期为两年。

en.s: The 2004 United States House of Representatives election in Vermont was held on Tuesday, November 2, 2004 to elect the U.S. Representative from the state's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with the elections of other federal and state offices, including a quadrennial presidential election and an election to the U.S. Senate.

zh.t: 2004年佛蒙特州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2004年佛蒙特州联邦众议院选举于2004年11月2日星期二举行，选出该州全州单一选区的联邦众议员。此次选举与其他联邦和州级公职选举同时举行，包括每四年一次的总统选举和联邦参议员选举。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in New Hampshire, 2004
en.s: The 2004 congressional elections in New Hampshire were held on November 2, 2004 to determine who will represent the state of New Hampshire in the United States House of Representatives. It coincided with the state's senatorial and gubernatorial elections. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; those elected served in the 109th Congress from January 2005 until January 2007.

zh.t: 2004年新罕布什尔州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2004年新罕布什尔州联邦众议院选举于2004年11月2日举行，选出代表该州进入联邦众议院的议员。选举与该州的联邦参议员和州长选举同时进行。众议员任期为两年，当选者于2005年1月至2007年1月在第109届国会任职。

en.s: General elections were held in Palau on 2 November 2004, alongside several referendums. The presidential election was won comfortably by the incumbent, Tommy Remengesau, who took almost two-thirds of the vote, whilst all House of Delegates and Senate seats were won by non-partisan independents.

zh.s: 帕劳于2004年11月2日举行大选，同时举行多项公投。现任总统汤米·雷蒙格索以明显优势胜出，得票接近三分之二；众议院和参议院的席位均由无党派独立人士赢得。

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in the District of Columbia, 2004
en.s: The 2004 congressional election for the Delegate from the District of Columbia was held on November 2, 2004. The winner of the race was incumbent Eleanor Holmes Norton (D). zh.t: 2004年哥伦比亚特区联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 哥伦比亚特区联邦众议院代表选举于2004年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任代表埃莉诺·霍姆斯·诺顿胜出。哥伦比亚特区的无投票权联邦众议院代表任期为两年。此次选举与2004年总统选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2004 Minnesota House of Representatives election was held in the U.S. state of Minnesota on November 2, 2004, to elect members to the House of Representatives of the 84th Minnesota Legislature. The Republican Party of Minnesota won a majority of seats, remaining the majority party, followed by the Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party (DFL).

zh.s: 2004年明尼苏达州众议院选举于2004年11月2日举行，选出第84届明尼苏达州立法机构的众议员。初选于2004年9月14日举行。明尼苏达州共和党赢得多数席位并继续保持多数党地位，民主党—农民—劳工党位居其后。

zh.s: 2004年北达科他州联邦参议员选举于2004年11月2日举行，与其他州的联邦参议员选举、联邦众议院选举及多项州和地方选举同时进行。民主党—无党派联盟籍现任参议员拜伦·多根成功连任第三个任期。

en.s: The 2004 United States Senate election in South Dakota was held on November 2, 2004. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Tom Daschle ran for re-election a fourth term, but lost to Republican John Thune.

zh.s: 2004年南达科他州联邦参议员选举于2004年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员汤姆·达施勒竞选连任第四个任期，但败给共和党候选人约翰·图恩。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Washington, 2004
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in Washington were held on November 2, 2004. Washington has nine members in the House of Representatives, as apportioned during the 2000 Census, and all nine seats were up for re-election. There were two open seats in the 5th and 8th districts when Republicans George Nethercutt and Jennifer Dunn, respectively, retired. No seats changed party this year.

zh.s: 华盛顿州联邦众议院选举于2004年11月2日举行。根据2000年人口普查结果，华盛顿州在众议院有九个席位，全部需要改选。第五和第八选区出现两个空缺席位，原因是共和党人乔治·内瑟卡特和詹妮弗·邓恩分别退休。今年没有席位发生党派变更。

en.s: The Utah gubernatorial election in 2004 took place November 2, 2004. Huntsman won the election, carrying 25 of the 29 counties, winning 57.7% of the overall vote.

en.t: United States Senate election in Pennsylvania, 2004
en.s: The 2004 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania was held on November 2, 2004. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Arlen Specter won re-election to a fifth term.

zh.t: 2004年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2004年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议员选举于2004年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任参议员阿伦·斯佩克特成功连任第五个任期。

en.t: United States Senate election in Ohio, 2004
en.s: The 2004 United States Senate election in Ohio took place on November 2, 2004. It was concurrent with elections to the United States House of Representatives and the presidential election. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator George Voinovich won re-election to a second term.

zh.t: 2004年俄亥俄州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2004年俄亥俄州联邦参议员选举于2004年11月2日举行，与联邦众议院选举和总统选举同时进行。共和党籍现任参议员乔治·沃伊诺维奇成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 2004 Miami-Dade County mayoral election took place on November 2, 2004, following a primary election on August 31, 2004. Incumbent Mayor Alex Penelas was term-limited and could not run for a third consecutive term, instead opting to unsuccessfully run for Senate. Nine candidates ran to succeed Penelas. Carlos Álvarez, the Director of the Miami-Dade Police Department, placed first in the primary, winning 28 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 2004年迈阿密-戴德县县长选举于2004年11月2日举行，初选于同年8月31日举行。受任期限制，现任县长亚历克斯·佩内拉斯不能连续第三次竞选该职位，转而竞选联邦参议员但未成功。共有九名候选人竞选接替佩内拉斯。迈阿密-戴德县警察局局长卡洛斯·阿尔瓦雷斯在初选中排名第一，获得28%的选票。

en.s: The 2004 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 2004, coinciding with the U.S. presidential election. Incumbent Governor Ruth Ann Minner faced a serious challenge from retired Superior Court Judge Bill Lee but managed a five-point victory on election day. As of 2026, this is the last time Kent County voted Republican in a gubernatorial election, and the last time the Republican gubernatorial nominee won a majority of Delaware's counties.

zh.s: 2004年特拉华州州长选举于11月2日举行，与美国总统选举同时进行。现任州长露丝·安·明纳面对退役高等法院法官比尔·李的有力挑战，但在选举日仍以5个百分点的优势获胜。截至2026年，这是肯特县最后一次在州长选举中支持共和党，也是共和党州长候选人最后一次赢得特拉华州多数县。

en.s: The 2004 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 2, 2004, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent attorney general Jay Nixon defeated Republican nominee Chris Byrd, Libertarian nominee David R. Browning and Constitution nominee David Fry.

zh.s: 2004年密苏里州总检察长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州总检察长。民主党候选人、现任总检察长杰伊·尼克松击败共和党候选人克里斯·伯德、自由意志党候选人大卫·R·布朗宁和宪法党候选人大卫·弗莱。

en.t: 2004 West Virginia Supreme Court of Appeals election
en.s: The 2004 West Virginia Supreme Court of Appeals election took place on November 2, 2004, to elect a justice of the Supreme Court of Appeals of West Virginia for the next 12 years. Originally elected in 1998, incumbent Democratic Justice Warren McGraw had previously sought Justice George M. Scott's open seat which was up for election in 2000, and was a twelve year term which would expire in 2012.

zh.t: 2004年西弗吉尼亚州最高上诉法院选举
zh.s: 2004年西弗吉尼亚州最高上诉法院选举于11月2日举行，选出一名任期12年的法官。民主党籍现任法官沃伦·麦格劳于1998年首次当选；他曾在2000年竞选乔治·M·斯科特的空缺席位。该席位任期12年，将于2012年届满。

en.t: 2004 United States presidential election in the District of Columbia
en.s: The 2004 United States presidential election in the District of Columbia took place on November 2, 2004, as part of the 2004 United States presidential election. Voters chose three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Prior to the election, Washington DC was considered to be a jurisdiction Kerry would win or safely blue.

zh.t: 2004年美国哥伦比亚特区总统选举
zh.s: 2004年美国哥伦比亚特区总统选举于11月2日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出3名选举人，组成选举人团投票选总统和副总统。选举前，华盛顿哥伦比亚特区被认为会支持民主党候选人约翰·克里，或是稳固的民主党票仓。

en.s: The 2004 Will County Executive election was held on November 2, 2004. Incumbent Republican County Executive Joseph Mikan ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged by State Senator Larry Walsh, the Democratic nominee. Despite Republican President George W. Bush's win in the county in the presidential election, Walsh narrowly defeated Mikan, 51–49 percent, to win the election.

zh.s: 2004年威尔县县行政长官选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍现任县行政长官约瑟夫·米肯竞选连任第二个任期，对手是民主党提名人、州参议员拉里·沃尔什。尽管共和党籍总统乔治·W·布什赢得该县总统选举，沃尔什仍以51%对49%的微弱优势击败米肯，当选县行政长官。

en.s: The 2004 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 2, 2004, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Missouri Senate Sarah Steelman defeated Democratic nominee Mark Powell, Libertarian nominee Lisa J. Emerson and Constitution nominee Chris Fluharty.

zh.t: 2004年密苏里州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 2004年密苏里州州财政部长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州州财政部长。共和党候选人、密苏里州参议员莎拉·斯蒂尔曼击败民主党候选人马克·鲍威尔、自由意志党候选人丽莎·J·埃默森和宪法党候选人克里斯·弗卢哈蒂。

en.s: Elections to the 185th Massachusetts Senate were held on November 2, 2004. The Democrats picked up one former Republican seat. The 185th Massachusetts General Court began in January 2005, and consisted of 34 Democrats and 6 Republican State Senators. The 2004 Massachusetts House election was held on the same date as the Senate election, as well as Federal and Congressional elections. Massachusetts Senators serve two-year terms.

zh.s: 第185届马萨诸塞州参议院选举于2004年11月2日举行。民主党从共和党手中赢得一个席位。第185届马萨诸塞州议会于2005年1月开会，由34名民主党州参议员和6名共和党州参议员组成。2004年马萨诸塞州众议院选举与参议院选举、联邦和国会选举在同一天举行。马萨诸塞州参议员任期两年。

en.t: 2004 United States House of Representatives elections in Wisconsin
en.s: Elections for Wisconsin's 8 seats in the United States House of Representatives were held on November 2, 2004. All of the incumbents won reelection except for Jerry Kleczka, who chose to retire.

zh.t: 2004年美国威斯康星州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2004年美国联邦众议院威斯康星州8个席位的选举于11月2日举行。除杰里·克莱奇卡决定退休外，所有现任议员都成功连任。

en.s: The 2004 New Hampshire gubernatorial election occurred on November 2, 2004, concurrent with that year's presidential election. Democrat John Lynch, a multimillionaire businessman from Hopkinton, narrowly defeated incumbent Republican governor Craig Benson of Rye, winning a two-year term. Benson was the first New Hampshire governor in 80 years to lose reelection after one term. Lynch was sworn in on January 6, 2005.

zh.s: 2004年新罕布什尔州州长选举于11月2日举行，与当年总统选举同时进行。来自霍普金顿的民主党商人约翰·林奇以微弱优势击败共和党籍现任州长、来自赖伊的克雷格·本森，赢得两年任期。本森成为80年来首位只任职一届便未能连任的新罕布什尔州州长。林奇于2005年1月6日宣誓就职。

en.t: 2004 United States House of Representatives elections in New Mexico
en.s: The 2004 United States House of Representatives elections in New Mexico were held on November 2, 2004, to determine who will represent the state of New Mexico in the United States House of Representatives. New Mexico has three seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms.

zh.t: 2004年美国新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2004年美国新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举于11月2日举行，选出代表该州进入联邦众议院的议员。根据2000年美国人口普查，新墨西哥州在众议院有3个席位。众议员任期两年。

en.s: The 2004 Connecticut State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 2004 United States Elections. All 36 seats of the Connecticut State Senate were up for re-election. Senators serve two-year terms and are up for re-election every election cycle. The August 10th primary elections decided candidates that appeared on the ballot for the General election. The General Election took place on November 2, 2004.

zh.s: 2004年康涅狄格州参议院选举是2004年美国定期选举的一部分。州参议院36个席位全部改选，州参议员任期两年，每次选举周期都要竞选连任。8月10日举行的初选决定了大选候选人。大选于2004年11月2日举行。

en.t: 2004 United States House of Representatives elections in Nebraska
en.s: The 2004 United States House of Representatives elections in Nebraska were held on November 2, 2004 to determine who will represent the state of Nebraska in the United States House of Representatives. Nebraska has three seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms.

zh.t: 2004年内布拉斯加州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2004年内布拉斯加州联邦众议院选举于2004年11月2日举行，以选出代表该州的联邦众议员。内布拉斯加州共有3个联邦众议院席位，按2000年美国人口普查结果分配。联邦众议员任期为两年。

en.t: 2004 San Juan, Puerto Rico, mayoral election
en.s: San Juan, Puerto Rico, held an election for mayor on November 2, 2004. It was held as part of the 2004 Puerto Rican general election. It saw the re-election incumbent mayor Jorge Santini, a member of the New Progressive Party. Santini ran unchallenged.

zh.t: 2004年波多黎各圣胡安市长选举
zh.s: 波多黎各圣胡安市长选举于2004年11月2日举行，是2004年波多黎各大选的一部分。新进步党籍现任市长豪尔赫·桑蒂尼成功连任，且无人挑战。

en.t: 2004 United States House of Representatives elections in Connecticut
en.s: The 2004 United States House of Representatives elections in Connecticut were held on November 2, 2004, to elect the five members of the U.S. House, one from each of the state's congressional districts, to represent Connecticut in the 109th Congress. The elections coincided with the Presidential election and a U.S. Senate election, as well as with Congressional elections in other states. No seats changed partisan control.

zh.t: 2004年康涅狄格州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2004年康涅狄格州联邦众议院选举于2004年11月2日举行，选出代表该州五个国会选区的联邦众议员，进入第109届国会。选举与总统选举、联邦参议员选举以及其他州的联邦众议院选举同时进行。各席位的党派归属均未改变。

en.s: General elections were held in Guam on November 2, 2004, in order to elect all 15 members of the legislature, the federal delegate, mayors of 14 cities, vice mayors of three cities, the public auditor, the Consolidated Commission on Utilities, two judges of the Superior Court, running for retention and the Guam Public Education Policy Board.

zh.s: 关岛大选于2004年11月2日举行，选出立法机关全部15名议员、联邦代表、14个市的市长、3个市的副市长、公共审计长、公用事业联合委员会成员、两名接受留任投票的高等法院法官，以及关岛公共教育政策委员会成员。

en.s: An election was held on November 2, 2004, to elect all 41 members to Delaware's House of Representatives. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including for U.S. President, U.S. House of Representatives, Governor, Lieutenant Governor, and state senate. The primary election was held on September 11, 2004.

zh.s: 2004年11月2日举行选举，选出特拉华州众议院全部41名议员。选举与美国总统、联邦众议员、州长、副州长和州参议院等职位的选举同时进行。初选于2004年9月11日举行。

loc: 美国华盛顿哥伦比亚特区

en.t: 2004 United States Shadow Representative election in the District of Columbia
en.s: On November 2, 2004, the District of Columbia held a U.S. House of Representatives election for its shadow representative. Unlike its non-voting delegate, the shadow representative is only recognized by the district and is not officially sworn or seated. This race was a rematch of 2002 when the same two candidates appeared on the ballot. Like in 2002, incumbent Shadow Representative Ray Browne was reelected.

zh.t: 2004年哥伦比亚特区影子联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 2004年11月2日，哥伦比亚特区举行影子联邦众议员选举。影子众议员不同于没有投票权的国会代表，只获哥伦比亚特区承认，不会正式宣誓就职或入席。这场选举是2002年两名候选人再次对决。与2002年一样，现任影子众议员雷·布朗成功连任。

en.t: 2004 United States House of Representatives elections in Florida
en.s: The 2004 United States House of Representatives Elections in Florida were held on November 2, 2004, to determine who would represent the state of Florida in the United States House of Representatives. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; those elected served in the 109th Congress from January 3, 2005, to January 3, 2007. The election coincided with the 2004 U.S. presidential election as well as an election to the United States Senate.

zh.t: 2004年佛罗里达州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2004年佛罗里达州联邦众议院选举于2004年11月2日举行，选出代表该州的联邦众议员。联邦众议员任期两年，当选者在2005年1月3日至2007年1月3日期间担任第109届国会议员。该选举与2004年美国总统选举和联邦参议员选举同时进行。

en.t: 2004 United States House of Representatives elections in Tennessee
en.s: The 2004 congressional elections in Tennessee was held on November 2, 2004, to determine who will represent the state of Tennessee in the United States House of Representatives. Following the 2004 elections, no seats changed hands, leaving the Tennessee delegation at a 5-4 Democratic majority. Tennessee was one of four states in which the party that won the state's popular vote did not win a majority of seats in 2004, the other states being Colorado, Connecticut, and New Mexico.

zh.t: 2004年田纳西州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2004年田纳西州联邦众议院选举于2004年11月2日举行，选出代表该州的联邦众议员。选举后没有席位易手，田纳西州的联邦众议员仍为民主党5人、共和党4人。2004年有4个州出现了某政党赢得全州普选票、却未在联邦众议院赢得多数席位的情况；除田纳西州外，其余是科罗拉多州、康涅狄格州和新墨西哥州。

en.t: 2004 United States House of Representatives elections in New Jersey
en.s: The 2004 United States House of Representatives elections in New Jersey were held on November 2, 2004, to determine who would represent the people of New Jersey in the United States House of Representatives. This election coincided with national elections for U.S. President, and the U.S. House and U.S. Senate. There was no concurrent election for Senator or Governor in the state.

zh.t: 2004年新泽西州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2004年新泽西州联邦众议院选举于2004年11月2日举行，选出代表该州的联邦众议员。该选举与美国总统、联邦众议院和联邦参议院的全国性选举同时进行。新泽西州当年没有举行联邦参议员或州长选举。

en.t: 2004 United States House of Representatives elections in Oregon
en.s: The 2004 United States House of Representatives elections in Oregon were held on November 2, 2004, to select Oregon's representatives to the United States House of Representatives. All five seats were up for election in 2004, as they are every two years. All five incumbents were re-elected, four of them by large margins; only the 5th district was somewhat competitive.

zh.t: 2004年俄勒冈州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2004年俄勒冈州联邦众议院选举于2004年11月2日举行，选出该州的联邦众议员。5个席位全部改选，任期为两年。5名现任众议员均成功连任，其中4人以较大优势获胜；只有第五选区的竞争较为激烈。

en.s: The Indiana general election was held on November 2, 2004. Primary elections took place on May 4, 2004.

zh.s: 印第安纳州大选于2004年11月2日举行。初选于2004年5月4日举行。

en.s: On November 2, 2004, an election was held in Portland, Oregon, to elect the mayor. Tom Potter was elected, defeating Jim Francesconi. Incumbent mayor Vera Katz did not seek a fourth term. Portland uses a nonpartisan system for local elections, in which all voters are eligible to participate. All candidates are listed on the ballot without any political-party affiliation.

zh.t: 2004年俄勒冈州波特兰市长选举
zh.s: 2004年11月2日，俄勒冈州波特兰市举行市长选举。汤姆·波特胜出，击败吉姆·弗朗西斯科尼。现任市长维拉·卡茨没有竞选第四个任期。波特兰市的地方选举不设党派，所有选民都可以参加投票；候选人姓名在选票上不标注党派。

en.s: The 2004 Delaware Senate election was held on November 2, 2004, to elect 10 of the 21 members to Delaware's Senate. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including for U.S. President, U.S. House of Representatives, Governor, Lieutenant Governor, and state house. The primary election was held on September 11, 2004.

zh.s: 2004年特拉华州参议院选举于2004年11月2日举行，改选州参议院21个席位中的10席。该选举与美国总统、联邦众议院、州长、副州长和州众议院等职位的选举同时进行。初选于2004年9月11日举行。

en.t: 2004 United States House of Representatives elections in Minnesota
en.s: The 2004 congressional elections in Minnesota were held on November 2, 2004, to determine who would represent the state of Minnesota in the United States House of Representatives. Minnesota had eight seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; those elected served in the 109th Congress from January 3, 2005, until January 3, 2007.

zh.t: 2004年明尼苏达州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2004年明尼苏达州联邦众议院选举于2004年11月2日举行，以选出代表该州的联邦众议员。根据2000年美国人口普查，明尼苏达州在联邦众议院有8个席位。联邦众议员任期两年；当选者在2005年1月3日至2007年1月3日期间担任第109届国会议员。

en.s: The Illinois general election was held in the U.S. state of Illinois on November 2, 2004. Primaries were held March 16, 2004.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州大选于2004年11月2日举行。初选于2004年3月16日举行。

en.s: The 2004 Arizona Senate election was held on November 2, 2004. Voters elected members of the Arizona Senate in all 30 of the state's legislative districts to serve a two-year term. Primary elections were held on September 7, 2004. Prior to the elections, the Republicans held a majority of 17 seats over the Democrats' 13 seats.

zh.s: 2004年亚利桑那州参议院选举于2004年11月2日举行。全州30个立法选区的选民均选出州参议员，任期两年。初选于2004年9月7日举行。选举前，共和党在州参议院占多数，拥有17席，民主党有13席。

en.s: The 2004 Kentucky Senate election was held on November 2, 2004. The Republican and Democratic primary elections were held on May 18. Half of the senate (all odd-numbered seats) were up for election. Republicans maintained their majority in the chamber without gaining or losing any seats. A numbered map of the senate districts at the time can be viewed here.

zh.s: 2004年肯塔基州参议院选举于11月2日举行。共和党和民主党初选于5月18日举行。参议院一半席位（全部奇数编号席位）进行改选。共和党保住参议院多数席位，席位数没有增减。文中附有当时的参议院选区编号地图。

en.s: Elections to state legislatures were held on November 2, 2004, alongside other elections. Elections were held for 85 legislative chambers, with all states but Louisiana, Mississippi, New Jersey, Alabama, Maryland, and Virginia holding elections in at least one house. Michigan and Minnesota held elections for their lower, but not upper houses. Six chambers in three territories and the District of Columbia were up as well.

zh.s: 美国州议会选举于2004年11月2日举行，与其他选举同时进行。共有85个州议会机构举行选举。除路易斯安那州、密西西比州、新泽西州、阿拉巴马州、马里兰州和弗吉尼亚州外，其他各州至少有一个议会院举行选举。密歇根州和明尼苏达州只选举下议院，不选举上议院。美国三个属地和哥伦比亚特区的6个议会机构也进行改选。

en.s: The 2004 Elections for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives were held on November 2, 2004, with all districts being contested. Necessary primary elections were held on April 27, 2004. Necessary primary elections were held on May 21, 2002. The term of office for those elected in 2004 ran from January 4, 2005 through November 2006.

zh.t: 2004年宾夕法尼亚州众议院选举
zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州众议院选举于2004年11月2日举行，所有选区均进行改选。必要的初选于2004年4月27日举行。另一次必要的初选于2002年5月21日举行。2004年当选者的任期为2005年1月4日至2006年11月。

en.s: The 2004 North Carolina Attorney General election was held on November 2, 2004, along with the gubernatorial election, as well as the Presidential election. Incumbent Democratic State Attorney General Roy Cooper won re-election, while incumbent Republican President George W. Bush won the state.

zh.t: 2004年北卡罗来纳州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2004年北卡罗来纳州总检察长选举于11月2日举行，与州长选举和总统选举同时进行。民主党籍现任州总检察长罗伊·库珀成功连任；与此同时，共和党籍现任总统乔治·W·布什赢得北卡罗来纳州。

en.s: The 2004 Arizona House of Representatives election took place on Tuesday, November 2, 2004, with the primary election held on Tuesday, September 7, 2004. Arizona voters elected all 60 members of the Arizona House of Representatives in multi-member districts to serve two-year terms. The election coincided with United States national elections and Arizona state elections, including for U.S. president, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and Arizona Senate.

zh.s: 2004年亚利桑那州众议院选举于11月2日（星期二）举行，初选于2004年9月7日（星期二）举行。选民从多席位选区中选出亚利桑那州众议院全部60名议员，任期两年。此次选举与美国全国选举和亚利桑那州选举同时举行，包括美国总统、联邦参议员、联邦众议员和亚利桑那州参议院选举。

en.t: 2004 North Carolina House of Representatives election
en.s: An election was held on November 2, 2004 to elect all 120 members to North Carolina's House of Representatives. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including the Presidency, U.S Senate, Governorship, U.S. House of Representatives, Council of State, and state senate. The primary election was held on July 20, 2004 with a run-off occurring on August 17, 2004.

zh.t: 2004年北卡罗来纳州众议院选举
zh.s: 北卡罗来纳州于2004年11月2日举行选举，改选州众议院全部120个席位。此次选举与总统、联邦参议员、州长、联邦众议员、州行政委员会和州参议院等公职选举同时举行。初选于2004年7月20日举行，第二轮初选于8月17日举行。

en.s: The 2004 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 2, 2004, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Democratic nominee Robin Carnahan defeated Republican nominee and incumbent speaker of the Missouri House of Representatives Catherine Hanaway, Libertarian nominee Christopher Davis and Constitution nominee Donna L. Ivanovich.

zh.s: 2004年密苏里州州务卿选举于11月2日举行，选出该州州务卿。民主党候选人罗宾·卡纳汉击败共和党候选人、密苏里州众议院现任议长凯瑟琳·汉纳韦、自由意志党候选人克里斯托弗·戴维斯和宪法党候选人唐娜·L·伊万诺维奇。

en.s: An election was held on November 2, 2004, to elect all 100 members to Montana's House of Representatives. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including U.S. President, U.S. House of Representatives, Governor and State Senate. The primary election was held on June 8, 2004. A net loss of three seats by the Republicans resulted in the House being tied at 50 seats each.

zh.s: 蒙大拿州于2004年11月2日举行选举，改选州众议院全部100个席位。此次选举与美国总统、联邦众议院、州长和州参议院等公职选举同时举行。初选于2004年6月8日举行。共和党净失去3席后，众议院两党席位数持平，各有50席。

en.s: The 2004 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was an election for the lieutenant governor of Missouri, held on November 2, 2004. Republican Peter Kinder won the election narrowly, becoming the first Republican to hold the office since Edward Henry Winter in 1933. As of 2025, this remains the last time that the lieutenant governorship of Missouri changed partisan control.

zh.s: 2004年密苏里州副州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党人彼得·金德以微弱优势获胜，成为自1933年爱德华·亨利·温特以来首位担任该职的共和党人。截至2025年，这是密苏里州副州长职位最近一次更换政党控制权。

en.s: The 2004 Oregon Secretary of State election was held on November 2, 2004, to elect the Oregon Secretary of State. Democratic incumbent Bill Bradbury won re-election, defeating Republican state representative Betsy Close.

zh.s: 2004年俄勒冈州州务卿选举于11月2日举行，选出该州州务卿。民主党籍现任州务卿比尔·布拉德伯里击败共和党州众议员贝齐·克洛斯，成功连任。

en.s: The 2004 West Virginia Senate election took place on Tuesday, November 2, 2004, to elect members to the 77th and 78th Legislatures; held concurrently with the presidential, U.S. House, and gubernatorial elections. State senate seats in West Virginia are staggered, with senators serving 4-year terms. 17 of the 34 state senate seats were up for election. While Republican candidate for George W.

zh.t: 2004年西弗吉尼亚州参议院选举
zh.s: 2004年西弗吉尼亚州参议院选举于11月2日（星期二）举行，选出该州第77届和第78届州议会成员；选举与总统、联邦众议院和州长选举同期进行。该州参议员任期为4年，席位分批改选，34个席位中有17席本次改选。

en.t: 2004 United States House of Representatives elections in Illinois
en.s: The 2004 congressional elections in Illinois were held November 2, 2004 to determine who would represent the State of Illinois in the United States House of Representatives. Illinois had nineteen seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; those elected would serve in the 109th Congress from January 3, 2005, to January 3, 2007.

zh.t: 2004年美国伊利诺伊州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2004年美国伊利诺伊州联邦众议院选举于11月2日举行，选出代表伊利诺伊州进入联邦众议院的议员。根据2000年美国人口普查，伊利诺伊州在众议院有19个席位。众议员任期两年，当选者将在第109届国会任职，任期从2005年1月3日至2007年1月3日。

en.s: The 2004 North Carolina Senate elections were held on November 2, 2004, to elect members to all fifty seats in the North Carolina Senate. The election coincided with the elections for other offices including the Presidency, U.S. Senate, Governorship, U.S. House of Representatives, Council of State, and state house. The primary election was held on July 20, 2004, with a primary run-off occurring on August 17, 2004.

zh.t: 2004年北卡罗来纳州参议院选举
zh.s: 2004年北卡罗来纳州参议院选举于11月2日举行，改选州参议院全部50个席位。此次选举与总统、联邦参议员、州长、联邦众议员、州行政委员会和州众议院等公职选举同时举行。初选于2004年7月20日举行，第二轮初选于8月17日举行。

en.t: 2004 United States House of Representatives elections in Alabama
en.s: The 2004 United States House of Representatives elections in Alabama were held on November 2, 2004, to determine the representation of the state of Alabama in the United States House of Representatives. the winning candidates will serve a two-year term from January 3, 2005, to January 3, 2007. The primary elections were held on Tuesday, June 6, 2006.

zh.t: 2004年美国众议院选举（阿拉巴马州）
zh.s: 阿拉巴马州于2004年11月2日举行美国众议院选举，选出该州在美国众议院的代表。胜选候选人的任期为两年，即2005年1月3日至2007年1月3日。初选于2006年6月6日星期二举行。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Vermont on November 2, 2004. All of Vermont's executive officers were up for election as well as Vermont's at-large seat in the U.S. House and Class 3 U.S. Senate seat. The 2004 presidential election was also held at the same time.

zh.s: 佛蒙特州于2004年11月2日举行大选。该州所有行政部门公职、联邦众议院不分区席位和第三类联邦参议员席位都进行改选。总统选举也在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2004 Delaware lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 2004, coinciding with the Delaware gubernatorial election. Democratic nominee and incumbent Lieutenant Governor of Delaware John Carney was reelected lieutenant governor over Republican nominee James P. Ursomarso in a landslide.

zh.s: 2004年特拉华州副州长选举于11月2日举行，与特拉华州州长选举同时进行。民主党候选人、现任副州长约翰·卡尼以压倒性优势击败共和党候选人詹姆斯·P·乌尔索马索，成功连任。

en.s: The 2004 Kentucky House of Representatives elections were held on November 2, 2004, as part of the biennial United States elections. All 100 of Kentucky's state representatives were up for reelection. In Kentucky, members of the House of Representatives serve two-year terms. Accordingly, they are up for reelection in both presidential and midterm election years. Democrats held onto their majority in the House, which had been in democratic control since the 1921 elections.

zh.s: 2004年肯塔基州众议院选举于11月2日举行，是每两年举行一次的美国选举的一部分。肯塔基州众议院全部100个席位都进行改选。州众议员任期两年，因此在总统选举年和中期选举年都会改选。民主党保住众议院多数；自1921年选举以来，该院一直由民主党控制。

en.t: 2004 United States House of Representatives elections in Mississippi
en.s: The 2004 United States House of Representatives elections in Mississippi were held on Tuesday, November 2, 2004 and elected the four U.S. representatives from the state of Mississippi. The elections coincided with the elections of other federal and state offices, including a quadrennial presidential election.

zh.t: 2004年美国密西西比州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2004年美国密西西比州联邦众议院选举于11月2日（星期二）举行，选出该州4名联邦众议员。此次选举与其他联邦和州级公职选举同时进行，包括每四年举行一次的总统选举。

en.s: The 2004 Wyoming Senate election was held on November 2, 2004, to elect members to the Wyoming Senate for its 58th session as part of the 2004 United States elections. Partisan primaries were held on August 17. All even-numbered seats were up for election as well as an unexpired term for District 1. Republicans picked up three seats in the legislative chamber.

zh.s: 2004年怀俄明州参议院选举是2004年美国选举的一部分，于2004年11月2日举行，选出第58届州参议院议员。党内初选于8月17日举行。所有偶数编号选区的席位以及第一选区的一个未满任期席位都进行改选。共和党在州参议院增加了3个席位。

en.s: The 2004 South Carolina Senate election was held on Tuesday, November 2, 2004. The primary elections were held on June 8, and the runoff elections were held on June 22. With each Senator's four-year term expired, all forty-six seats were up for election. Republicans retained their majority gained in the 2002 South Carolina Senate elections, marking the first prolonged period of Republican rule of the chamber since the Reconstruction Era, and the "maturity" of South Carolina's "long-predicated [political realignment]" away from Democratic control.

zh.t: 2004年南卡罗来纳州参议院选举
zh.s: 2004年南卡罗来纳州参议院选举于2004年11月2日星期二举行。初选于6月8日举行，第二轮初选于6月22日举行。由于所有参议员的四年任期均在当年届满，46个席位全部改选。共和党保住了在2002年南卡罗来纳州参议院选举中取得的多数。这标志着重建时期以来，共和党首次长期控制州参议院，也显示该州长期以来逐步摆脱民主党控制的政治重组已进入成熟阶段。

en.s: The 2004 United States Senate elections were held on November 2, 2004, with all Class 3 Senate seats being contested. They coincided with the re-election of George W. Bush as president and the United States House elections, as well as many state and local elections. Senators who were elected in 1998, known as Senate Class 3, were seeking re-election or retiring in 2004.

zh.s: 2004年美国联邦参议院选举于2004年11月2日举行，所有第三类参议员席位都进行改选。选举与乔治·W·布什连任总统、联邦众议院选举以及许多州和地方选举同时举行。1998年当选的第三类参议员当年竞选连任或退休。

en.s: The 2004 Salt Lake County mayoral election was held to elect the Mayor of Salt Lake County, Utah on November 2, 2004, alongside the presidential, House of Representatives, Senate and gubernatorial elections. This marked the second election to the office since the post was created in 2000. In 2000, Nancy Workman was elected as the first county mayor.

zh.t: 2004年犹他州盐湖县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2004年犹他州盐湖县行政长官选举于2004年11月2日举行，与总统、联邦众议院、联邦参议院和州长选举同时进行。这是2000年设立盐湖县行政长官职位后的第二次选举。2000年，南希·沃克曼当选首任县行政长官。

en.t: 2004 United States House of Representatives elections in New York
en.s: The 2004 United States House of Representatives elections in New York took place on November 2, 2004. One seat changed parties; in the 27th district Democrat Brian Higgins was elected to replace Republican Jack Quinn.

zh.s: 2004年纽约州联邦众议院选举于2004年11月2日举行。一个席位更换党派：在第27选区，民主党人布莱恩·希金斯当选，接替共和党人杰克·奎因。

en.t: 2004 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 2004 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 2, 2004. Voters chose 15 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Georgia was won by incumbent President George W. Bush by a 16.60% margin of victory. Prior to the election, all 12 news organizations considered this a state Bush would win, or otherwise a red state.

zh.t: 2004年美国总统选举佐治亚州结果
zh.s: 2004年美国总统选举佐治亚州投票于2004年11月2日举行。选民选出15名总统选举人，由他们投票选举总统和副总统。现任总统乔治·W·布什赢得佐治亚州，领先16.60个百分点。选举前，所有12家新闻机构都认为布什会赢得该州，或将其视为共和党稳固的州。

en.s: The 2004 Summit County, Ohio Executive election took place on November 2, 2004. Incumbent Democratic County Executive James McCarthy ran for re-election to a second term. No challengers filed to run against him, and he won the Democratic primary and general election unopposed. However, McCarthy would not end up serving out his full term as County Executive. He resigned on June 30, 2007, and was succeeded by Russ Pry.

zh.t: 2004年俄亥俄州萨米特县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2004年俄亥俄州萨米特县行政长官选举于2004年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任行政长官詹姆斯·麦卡锡竞选连任第二个任期。没有对手参选，他先在民主党初选中胜出，随后在大选中无人竞争而当选。不过，麦卡锡未能任满，于2007年6月30日辞职，由拉斯·普赖接任。

en.t: 2004 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 2004 United States Senate election in New York took place on November 2, 2004, along with elections to the United States Senate in other states, as well as the presidential election, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections. Incumbent Senator Chuck Schumer won re-election to a second term with 71.2% of the vote, at the time the highest margin of victory for any statewide candidate in New York's history, and winning every county except Hamilton.

zh.s: 2004年纽约州联邦参议员选举于2004年11月2日举行，与其他州的联邦参议员选举、总统和联邦众议院选举以及各项州和地方选举同时进行。现任参议员查克·舒默以71.2%的得票率成功连任第二个任期。当时，这是纽约州全州选举中领先幅度最大的一次；舒默赢得了除汉密尔顿县以外的所有县。

en.t: 2004 United States House of Representatives elections in Georgia
en.s: The 2004 House elections in Georgia occurred on November 2, 2004, to elect the members of the state of Georgia's delegation to the United States House of Representatives. Georgia has thirteen seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States census. These elections were held concurrently with the United States presidential election of 2004, United States Senate elections of 2004 (including one in Georgia), the United States House elections in other states, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2004年佐治亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2004年佐治亚州联邦众议院选举于2004年11月2日举行，选出代表该州进入联邦众议院的议员。根据2000年美国人口普查，佐治亚州在联邦众议院有13个席位。此次选举与2004年美国总统选举、2004年联邦参议员选举（包括佐治亚州的一个席位）、其他州的联邦众议院选举以及多项州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2004 Oakland County Executive election was held on November 2, 2004. Incumbent County Executive L. Brooks Patterson ran for re-election. He won the Republican primary by a wide margin, and faced Green Party nominee Art Myatt, an engineer, in the general election. Patterson defeated Myatt in a landslide, winning 81 percent of the vote.

zh.t: 2004年密歇根州奥克兰县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2004年密歇根州奥克兰县行政长官选举于2004年11月2日举行。现任行政长官L·布鲁克斯·帕特森竞选连任。他以较大优势赢得共和党初选，并在大选中面对绿党提名人、工程师阿特·迈亚特。帕特森以81%的得票率大胜。

en.t: 2004 St. Louis County Executive special election
en.s: The 2004 St. Louis County Executive special election took place on November 2, 2004. County Executive Buzz Westfall, who was elected to his fourth term in 2002, died on October 27, 2003, following an illness. County Councilman Charlie Dooley, who briefly served as Acting County Executive as Westfall's condition worsened, was elected by the Council to serve until a special election could be held.

zh.t: 2004年密苏里州圣路易斯县行政长官特别选举
zh.s: 2004年密苏里州圣路易斯县行政长官特别选举于2004年11月2日举行。行政长官巴兹·韦斯特福尔于2003年10月27日病逝；此前他在2002年成功连任第四个任期。县议会议员查理·杜利曾在韦斯特福尔病情恶化时短暂代理行政长官，之后由县议会选出，暂时担任这一职位，直至举行特别选举。

en.s: The 2004 San Diego mayoral election was held on Tuesday, November 2, 2004 to elect the mayor of San Diego. Incumbent mayor Dick Murphy stood for reelection for a second term. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan, though some candidates do receive funding and support from various political parties. The non-partisan primary was held Tuesday, June 3, 2004.

zh.s: 2004年圣迭戈市长选举于2004年11月2日星期二举行。现任市长迪克·墨菲竞选连任第二个任期。加利福尼亚州的市政选举正式不设党派，但有些候选人会得到各党派的资金和支持。无党派初选于2004年6月3日星期二举行。

en.s: The 2004 Washington State Senate election was held on November 2, 2004, in which about half of the state's 49 legislative districts choose a state senator for a four-year term to the Washington State Senate. The other half of state senators are chosen in the next biennial election, so that about half of the senators, along with all the members of the Washington State House of Representatives, are elected every two years.

zh.s: 2004年11月2日举行华盛顿州参议院选举，改选49个立法选区中约一半的州参议员，任期四年。另一半参议员在下一次两年一度的选举中产生。因此，州参议员约有一半席位会与华盛顿州众议院全部席位每两年一同改选。

en.s: The 2004 Baton Rouge mayoral election was held on September 18 and November 2, 2004, to elect the mayor-president of Baton Rouge, Louisiana. It saw Democrat Kip Holden unseat Incumbent Republican Mayor Bobby Ray Simpson.

zh.t: 2004年路易斯安那州巴吞鲁日市长选举
zh.s: 路易斯安那州巴吞鲁日市长选举于2004年9月18日和11月2日举行，选出市长兼行政长官。民主党人基普·霍尔顿击败共和党籍现任市长鲍比·雷·辛普森。

en.t: 2004 San Francisco Board of Supervisors election
en.s: The 2004 San Francisco Board of Supervisors elections occurred on November 2, 2004. Seven of the eleven seats were contested in this election. Six incumbents and one open seat were up for election. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan, though most candidates in San Francisco do receive funding and support from various political parties. This is the first Board of Supervisors election in San Francisco to implement ranked-choice voting.

zh.s: 2004年旧金山市监事会选举于2004年11月2日举行。市监事会11个席位中有7席改选，其中包括6名现任成员的席位和一个空缺席位。加利福尼亚州市政选举正式不设党派，但旧金山大多数候选人确实会得到各党派的资金和支持。这是旧金山市监事会首次采用排序选择投票制的选举。

en.s: The 2004 Pierce County Executive election took place on November 2, 2004. The election took place following the invalidation of Washington's blanket primary and used separate primaries for the first time. Incumbent Democratic County Executive John Ladenburg ran for re-election to a second term. He was unopposed in the Democratic primary and faced casino manager Greg Bakamis, the Republican nominee, in the general election.

zh.t: 2004年华盛顿州皮尔斯县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2004年华盛顿州皮尔斯县行政长官选举于2004年11月2日举行。华盛顿州综合初选被判无效后，该选举首次改用分别举行的党派初选。民主党籍现任行政长官约翰·拉登伯格竞选连任第二个任期。他在民主党初选中没有对手，大选对手是共和党提名人、赌场经理格雷格·巴卡米斯。

en.s: The 2004 New Castle County Executive election was held on November 2, 2004. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Thomas P. Gordon was term-limited and unable to seek a third consecutive term. County Council President Chris Coons won the Democratic primary by a wide margin and faced New Castle City Council President Chris Castagno, the Republican nominee, in the general election.

zh.s: 2004年新堡县县行政长官选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任县行政长官托马斯·P·戈登受任期限制，不能竞选连续第三个任期。县议会主席克里斯·库恩斯在民主党初选中以较大优势获胜，将在大选中对阵共和党候选人、新堡市议会主席克里斯·卡斯塔尼奥。

en.t: 2004 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 2004 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 2, 2004. Incumbent Democrat U.S. Senator Patty Murray won re-election to a third term, defeating Republican U.S. Representative George Nethercutt. She became only the fourth Washington senator to win 3 consecutive terms, just after fellow Democrats Warren G. Magnuson and Scoop Jackson.

zh.t: 2004年美国华盛顿州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2004年美国华盛顿州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员帕蒂·默里击败共和党联邦众议员乔治·内瑟卡特，赢得第三个任期。她成为华盛顿州第四位连续三次当选的联邦参议员，仅次于民主党人沃伦·G·马格努森和亨利·“斯库普”·杰克逊。

en.s: The 2004 Washington gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 2004. The race gained national attention for its legal twists and extremely close finish, among the closest political races in United States election history. Republican Dino Rossi was declared the winner of the initial count and again of the automated recount, but after a second recount done by hand, Democrat Christine Gregoire took the lead by a margin of 129 votes.

zh.s: 2004年华盛顿州州长选举于11月2日举行。此次选举因法律争议和极其接近的结果而受到全国关注，是美国选举史上差距最小的选举之一。共和党人迪诺·罗西在首次计票和自动重新计票后都被宣布胜选；但第二次人工重新计票后，民主党人克里斯汀·格雷瓜尔以129票的优势领先。

en.t: 2004 DeKalb County, Georgia Chief Executive Officer election
en.s: The 2004 DeKalb County, Georgia Chief Executive Officer election took place on November 2, 2004. Incumbent CEO Vernon Jones ran for re-election to a second term. Jones, who experienced controversy in office and faced a grand jury inquiry into county finances and his security detail, was challenged by six opponents in the Democratic primary. However, Jones won renomination with 53 percent of the vote, avoiding the need for a runoff election.

zh.t: 2004年佐治亚州迪卡尔布县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2004年佐治亚州迪卡尔布县行政长官选举于11月2日举行。现任行政长官弗农·琼斯竞选连任第二个任期。琼斯在任期间卷入争议，并因县财政和安保团队问题接受大陪审团调查；民主党初选中有6名对手向他发起挑战。不过，琼斯以53%的选票赢得提名，无需参加第二轮选举。

en.t: 2004 United States Senate election in Georgia
en.s: The 2004 United States Senate election in Georgia took place on November 2, 2004, alongside other elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. This election was the fifth consecutive even-number year in which a senate election was held in Georgia after elections in 1996, 1998, 2000, and 2002.

zh.t: 2004年美国佐治亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2004年美国佐治亚州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行，与其他州的联邦参议员、联邦众议员以及各州和地方选举同时举行。这是佐治亚州连续第五个偶数年举行联邦参议员选举，此前分别于1996年、1998年、2000年和2002年举行。

en.t: Salt Lake County elects four council members
en.s: On November 2, 2004, voters in Salt Lake County, Utah, elected four members of their nine-seat county council. The seats on the ballot were one elected countywide and three elected by district. Democrats gained the countywide seat, bringing their total to four council seats, while Republicans retained five. The vote was part of Utah's 2004 general election.
en.n: The Salt Lake County Council election took place November 2, 2004.

zh.t: 美国盐湖县选出四名县议会议员
zh.s: 2004年11月2日，美国犹他州盐湖县改选九名县议会议员中的四人，其中一个席位由全县选民投票产生，另外三个按选区选出。民主党赢得全县选举的席位，议会席位增至四席；共和党保有五席。这次投票属于犹他州2004年大选。
zh.n: 盐湖县议会这次改选举行于2004年11月2日。

en.s: The Cook County, Illinois, general election was held on November 2, 2004. Primaries were held March 16, 2004. Elections were held for Clerk of the Circuit Court, Recorder of Deeds, State's Attorney, Board of Review district 3, three seats on the Water Reclamation District Board, and judgeships on the Circuit Court of Cook County.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州库克县于2004年11月2日举行大选。初选于2004年3月16日举行。本次选举改选巡回法院书记官、契据登记官、州检察官、审查委员会第3区、都市水资源管理区董事会3个席位，以及库克县巡回法院的法官职位。

en.s: The 2004 Texas House of Representatives elections took place as part of the biennial United States elections. Texas voters elected state representatives in all 150 State House of Representatives districts. The winners of this election served in the 79th Texas Legislature. State representatives serve for two-year terms. Republicans maintained control of the House, losing one seat to the Democrats.

zh.s: 2004年得克萨斯州众议院选举是当年每两年举行一次的美国选举的一部分。得克萨斯州选民选出州众议院全部150个选区的议员。胜选者将在得克萨斯州第79届议会任职。州众议员任期两年。共和党保住众议院控制权，但失去1席给民主党。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2003–2004 Baltimore mayoral election saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Martin O'Malley. In 1999, Baltimore citizens voted to move mayoral elections to take place in presidential election years, effective with the 2004 elections. However, primary dates in Maryland can only be set by the General Assembly, which refused to move the primary to 2004.

zh.s: 2003—2004年巴尔的摩市长选举中，现任市长马丁·奥马利成功连任。1999年，巴尔的摩市民投票决定把市长选举改到总统选举年举行，并从2004年开始实施。但马里兰州的初选日期只能由州议会确定，州议会拒绝将初选日期改到2004年。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2004 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 2004 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in half of the state senate's districts—the 25 even-numbered state senate districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate, with half of the seats up for election each cycle. The primary election on June 8, 2004, determined which candidates appeared on the November 2, 2004 general election ballot.

zh.s: 2004年艾奥瓦州参议院选举是当年每两年举行一次的美国选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民选出州参议院一半选区的议员，即全部25个偶数编号选区的议员。州参议员任期四年，每轮选举改选约一半席位。2004年6月8日的初选决定了哪些候选人进入11月2日的大选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2004 New Mexico Senate election took place as part of the biennial United States elections. New Mexico voters elected state senators in all 42 of the state senate's districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the New Mexico Senate. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including for U.S. President, U.S House, and state house.

zh.s: 2004年新墨西哥州参议院选举是当年每两年举行一次的美国选举的一部分。新墨西哥州选民在该州全部42个州参议院选区选出参议员。州参议员任期四年。此次选举与总统、联邦众议院和州众议院等公职选举同时举行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: Washington has 9 Executive seats, all elected at large. In 2004, all 9 positions were up for reelection.

zh.s: 华盛顿州有9个全州不分区的行政职位。2004年，这9个职位都进行改选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2004 Texas Senate elections took place as part of the biennial United States elections. Texas voters elected state senators in 15 State Senate districts. All of the seats up for this election were for two-year terms, with senators up for re-election in the 2008 elections. The winners of this election served in the 79th Texas Legislature.

zh.s: 2004年得克萨斯州参议院选举是当年每两年举行一次的美国选举的一部分。得克萨斯州选民在15个州参议院选区选出参议员。所有当选者的任期都是两年，他们将在2008年再次竞选连任。胜选者将在得克萨斯州第79届议会任职。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.t: 2004 United States presidential straw poll in Guam
en.s: The 2004 United States presidential straw poll in Guam took place on November 2, 2004, Guam is a territory and not a state. Thus, it is ineligible to elect members of the Electoral College, instead, the territory conducts a non-binding presidential straw poll during the general election. It does not cast direct electoral votes for president and vice president. Incumbent Republican president George W.

zh.s: 2004年美国关岛总统意向投票于11月2日举行。关岛是美国领土而非州，因此不能选举总统选举人；该领地会在大选期间举行不具约束力的总统意向投票，也不会直接投票选举总统和副总统。当时的共和党籍现任总统是乔治·W·布什。

en.s: El Castillo del Terror (2006) was the second annual El Castillo del Terror professional wrestling event produced by the International Wrestling Revolution Group. It took place on November 2, 2006, at Arena Naucalpan in Naucalpan, State of Mexico. The show featured the eponymous main event match; a nine-man Steel Cage Match where the last twp men in the cage were forced to wrestle each other and the loser would be forced to unmask under Luchas de Apuestas, or "Bet rules". For the 2006 event Ave Fénix, Bacteria, Fabián el Gitano, Fantasma de la Ópera, El Felino, El Hijo del Diablo, Macho II, Nitro and Xibalva all wagered their masks on the outcome of the match.

zh.s: 2006年“恐怖城堡”赛事是墨西哥国际摔角革命集团（IWRG）举办的第二届年度职业摔角赛事，于2006年11月2日在墨西哥州瑙卡尔潘的瑙卡尔潘竞技场举行。主赛是同名九人钢笼赛，最后留在笼中的两人必须继续比赛，败者按“赌注规则”（Luchas de Apuestas）被迫摘下面具。参赛者阿维·菲尼克斯、细菌、法比安·埃尔·吉塔诺、歌剧幽灵、埃尔·费利诺、魔鬼之子、马乔二世、尼特罗和希巴尔瓦都押上了自己的面具。

en.s: The 2008 Brazilian Grand Prix (formally the XXXVII Grande Prêmio do Brasil) was a Formula One motor race held on 2 November 2008 at the Autódromo José Carlos Pace, Interlagos, in São Paulo, Brazil. It was the 18th and final race of the 2008 Formula One season. The 71-lap race was won by Ferrari driver Felipe Massa after starting from pole position. Fernando Alonso finished second in a Renault, and Kimi Räikkönen third in a Ferrari. Massa started the race alongside Toyota driver Jarno Trulli. Massa's teammate Räikkönen began from third next to McLaren driver Lewis Hamilton.

zh.s: 2008年巴西大奖赛（正式名称：第37届巴西大奖赛）是一级方程式赛车比赛，于2008年11月2日在巴西圣保罗的何塞·卡洛斯·帕塞赛道（英特拉格斯）举行。这是2008年一级方程式赛季的第18场，也是最后一场比赛。法拉利车手费利佩·马萨从杆位发车并赢得比赛。雷诺车手费尔南多·阿隆索获得第二名，法拉利车手基米·莱科宁获得第三名。马萨发车时旁边是丰田车手雅诺·特鲁利；莱科宁从第三位发车，旁边是迈凯伦车手刘易斯·汉密尔顿。

en.s: Battle of Los Angeles (2008) was the fourth Battle of Los Angeles professional wrestling tournament produced by Pro Wrestling Guerrilla (PWG). The event took place on November 1 and November 2, 2008 in Burbank, California. The tournament concluded with a final match in which Low Ki defeated the PWG World Champion Chris Hero.

zh.s: 2008年洛杉矶之战是职业摔角游击队（PWG）举办的第四届洛杉矶之战职业摔角锦标赛。赛事于2008年11月1日至2日在加利福尼亚州伯班克举行。决赛中，洛·基击败PWG世界冠军克里斯·英雄。

en.t: United States Senate election in Indiana, 2010
en.s: The 2010 United States Senate election in Indiana took place on November 2, 2010, alongside 33 other elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections to fill Indiana's class III United States Senate seat. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Evan Bayh decided in February 2010 to retire instead of seeking a third term shortly after former U.S. Senator Dan Coats announced his candidacy for Bayh's contested seat. No Democratic candidate submitted enough signatures by the deadline to run, leading Democratic officials to choose U.S.

zh.t: 2010年美国印第安纳州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2010年美国印第安纳州联邦参议员选举于2010年11月2日举行，与其他33场美国联邦参议员选举、联邦众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同期进行，以选出印第安纳州第三组参议员。民主党籍现任联邦参议员埃文·贝于2010年2月决定退休，不再寻求第三个任期；此前不久，前联邦参议员丹·科茨宣布竞选贝的席位。由于没有民主党候选人在截止前提交足够签名，印第安纳州民主党最终选定联邦众议员布拉德·埃尔斯沃思为该党候选人。

en.s: The 2010 Maine gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 2010. Incumbent Democratic Governor John Baldacci was term-limited and unable to seek re-election. Primary elections took place on June 8, 2010. The candidates who appeared on the November ballot were (in alphabetical order by last name): Eliot Cutler (Independent), Paul LePage (Republican), Libby Mitchell (Democrat), Shawn Moody (Independent), and Kevin Scott (Independent). With 94% of precincts reporting on the day after the election, the Bangor Daily News declared LePage the winner, carrying 38.1% of the votes. Cutler was in second place with 36.7% of the votes (less than 7,500 votes behind LePage), while Mitchell was a distant third with 19%.

zh.s: 2010年缅因州州长选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州长约翰·巴尔达奇受任期限制，无法寻求连任。初选于2010年6月8日举行。11月大选选票上的候选人按姓氏字母顺序为：独立候选人伊莱奥特·卡特勒、共和党人保罗·勒佩奇、民主党人利比·米切尔、独立候选人肖恩·穆迪和独立候选人凯文·斯科特。选举次日，94%的选区完成计票，《班戈每日新闻》宣布勒佩奇获胜，得票率为38.1%。卡特勒以36.7%居第二，落后勒佩奇不到7500票；米切尔以19%远居第三。

en.t: United States Senate election in Connecticut, 2010
en.s: The 2010 United States Senate election in Connecticut was a midterm election which took place on November 2, 2010 to decide a Class III Senator from the State of Connecticut to join the 112th United States Congress. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Christopher Dodd suffered from dropping approval ratings in the past few years due to major controversies, leading him to announce in January 2010 that he would retire, instead of seeking a sixth term. As Dodd was a Democrat, Richard Blumenthal, incumbent State Attorney General, announced on the same day that he would run for Dodd’s seat.

zh.t: 2010年美国康涅狄格州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2010年美国康涅狄格州联邦参议员选举是一次中期选举，于2010年11月2日举行，选出该州第三类联邦参议员，进入第112届美国国会。民主党籍现任参议员克里斯托弗·多德因过去几年的争议事件导致支持率下降，于2010年1月宣布退休，不再寻求第六个任期。多德是民主党人，当天在任的州总检察长理查德·布卢门撒尔便宣布参选，争夺多德空出的席位。

en.s: The 2010 Ohio gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 2010. Incumbent Democratic Governor of Ohio Ted Strickland ran for re-election to a second term as Governor and was opposed by former United States Congressman John Kasich; both Strickland and Kasich won their respective primaries uncontested. The race between the two major candidates was prolonged and brutal, with both candidates employing various campaign surrogates to bolster their campaigns. Ultimately, Kasich narrowly defeated Governor Strickland in one of Ohio's closest gubernatorial elections.

zh.s: 2010年俄亥俄州州长选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州长泰德·斯特里克兰寻求连任第二个任期，对手是前联邦众议员约翰·卡西奇。斯特里克兰和卡西奇都在无人竞争的情况下赢得各自政党的初选。两位主要候选人之间的竞选持续时间长，竞争激烈；双方都请来多名代理人助选。最终，卡西奇以微弱优势击败斯特里克兰，这是俄亥俄州竞争最激烈的州长选举之一。

en.s: The 2010 Tennessee gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 2010. Democratic Governor Phil Bredesen was term-limited and unable to seek re-election. Knoxville mayor Bill Haslam, the Republican Party nominee, defeated Democratic Party nominee Mike McWherter. Non-partisan organizations The Cook Political Report, CQ Politics, and The New York Times rated the gubernatorial election as leaning Republican, while The Rothenberg Political Report rated it as "Republican favored," RealClearPolitics and Sabato's Crystal Ball as "Likely Republican", and Rasmussen Reports as "Solid Republican."

zh.s: 2010年田纳西州州长选举于11月2日举行。民主党州长菲尔·布雷德森受任期限制，无法寻求连任。共和党候选人、诺克斯维尔市长比尔·哈斯拉姆击败了民主党候选人迈克·麦克韦特。无党派机构《库克政治报告》、CQ Politics和《纽约时报》认为共和党候选人占优；《罗滕伯格政治报告》认为共和党胜算较大，RealClearPolitics和Sabato's Crystal Ball认为共和党很可能获胜，Rasmussen Reports则认为共和党稳胜。

en.s: The Oklahoma gubernatorial election of 2010 was held on November 2, 2010 to elect the Governor of Oklahoma. Due to term limits placed on him by the Oklahoma Constitution, incumbent Democratic Governor Brad Henry could not seek re-election. The race had been hotly contested by both political parties, with several well-known Oklahomans announcing their candidacy up to two years before the election. The non-partisan Cook Political Report and CQ Politics rate the gubernatorial election as "likely Republican" and "leaning Republican", respectively.On November 2, 2010 Republican candidate Mary Fallin was elected, defeating Democratic candidate Jari Askins.

zh.s: 2010年俄克拉何马州州长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州州长。根据俄克拉何马州宪法规定的任期限制，民主党籍现任州长布拉德·亨利无法寻求连任。两党激烈争夺州长职位，一些知名的俄克拉何马州居民早在选举前两年就宣布参选。无党派机构《库克政治报告》和CQ Politics分别将选举评为“共和党很可能获胜”和“共和党占优”。11月2日，共和党候选人玛丽·法林当选州长，击败民主党候选人贾里·阿斯金斯。

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming, 2010
en.s: The 2010 House election in Wyoming was held on November 2, 2010 and determined who would represent the state of Wyoming in the United States House of Representatives. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; the elected served in the 112th Congress from January 4, 2011 until January 3, 2013. The election coincided with the 2010 midterm elections. Wyoming has one seat in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census. Its 2008-2010 congressional delegation consisted of one Republican.

zh.t: 2010年美国怀俄明州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2010年怀俄明州联邦众议院选举于11月2日举行，选出该州在美国联邦众议院的代表，任期两年。当选者在第112届国会任职，任期为2011年1月4日至2013年1月3日。此次选举与2010年中期选举同时举行。根据2000年美国人口普查，怀俄明州在众议院有1个席位。2008至2010年，该州在国会的代表团由一名共和党人组成。

en.s: The 2010 Minnesota House of Representatives election was held in the U.S. state of Minnesota on November 2, 2010, to elect members to the House of Representatives of the 87th Minnesota Legislature. A primary election was held in several districts on August 10, 2010. The Republican Party of Minnesota won a majority of seats, defeating the Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party (DFL), which had a majority since defeating the Republicans in the 2006 election. The new Legislature convened on January 4, 2011.

zh.s: 2010年明尼苏达州众议院选举于2010年11月2日举行，选出明尼苏达州第87届议会众议院议员。部分选区于2010年8月10日举行初选。明尼苏达州共和党赢得多数席位，击败自2006年击败共和党后一直占多数席位的民主党—农民—劳工党（DFL）。新一届州议会于2011年1月4日召开。

en.s: The 2010 Texas gubernatorial election was held on Tuesday, November 2, 2010, to elect the Governor of Texas. Incumbent Republican Governor Rick Perry ran successfully for election to a third consecutive term. He won the Republican primary against U.S. Senator Kay Bailey Hutchison. The former Mayor of Houston, Bill White, won the Democratic nomination. Kathie Glass, a lawyer from Houston and previous candidate for Texas Attorney General, won the Libertarian nomination. Deb Shafto was the nominee of the Texas Green Party. Andy Barron, an orthodontist from Lubbock, was a declared write-in candidate. The Lieutenant Governor of Texas is elected on a separate ticket.

zh.s: 2010年得克萨斯州州长选举于2010年11月2日星期二举行，选出该州州长。共和党籍现任州长里克·佩里成功连任，开始连续第三个州长任期。他在共和党初选中击败了美国参议员凯·贝利·哈奇森。休斯敦前市长比尔·怀特赢得民主党提名；休斯敦律师、曾竞选得州总检察长的凯西·格拉斯赢得自由党提名；得州绿党提名德布·沙夫托。来自拉伯克的牙齿矫正医生安迪·巴伦登记为写入选票的候选人。得州副州长由单独选举产生。

en.s: The 2010 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 2010. Democratic Governor Bill Richardson was term limited and unable to seek re-election. On June 1, 2010, the Republicans nominated Susana Martínez, the district attorney for Doña Ana County, New Mexico, and the Democrats nominated Lieutenant Governor Diane Denish. While it was initially thought that Richardson would resign early to become Secretary of Commerce in the Obama administration, Richardson withdrew from the position due to allegations of corruption that were later cleared and he remained Governor until the conclusion of his term.

zh.s: 2010年新墨西哥州州长选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍州长比尔·理查森受任期限制，无法寻求连任。6月1日，共和党提名多尼亚安娜县地方检察官苏珊娜·马丁内斯，民主党提名副州长黛安·丹尼什。此前一度有人认为理查森会提前辞职，加入奥巴马政府担任商务部长；但他因被指腐败而放弃这一职位。相关指控后来被澄清，他继续担任州长直至任期结束。

en.s: The Michigan gubernatorial election of 2010 was held on November 2, 2010. Incumbent Democratic Governor Jennifer Granholm was prohibited by the state's Constitution from seeking a third term. This resulted in a large pool of candidates which was whittled down, when the May 11 filing deadline passed, to two Democrats and five Republicans. Both the Cook Political Report and the non-partisan Rothenberg Political Report rated the election as leaning Republican. The Republican primary race was highly competitive; both local and national polling reported Congressman Peter Hoekstra, state Attorney General Mike Cox, and businessman Rick Snyder as being front-runners for the Republican Party nomination.

zh.s: 2010年密歇根州州长选举于11月2日举行。州宪法禁止民主党籍现任州长詹妮弗·格兰霍姆寻求第三个任期，因此有大批候选人参选。5月11日登记截止后，候选人缩减为两名民主党人和五名共和党人。《库克政治报告》和无党派的《罗滕伯格政治报告》都认为共和党候选人占优。共和党初选竞争激烈；地方和全国民调都显示联邦众议员彼得·胡克斯特拉、州总检察长迈克·考克斯和商人里克·斯奈德是共和党提名的领跑者。

en.s: The 2010 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 2010. Incumbent Governor Mark Parkinson, who assumed office when previous Governor Kathleen Sebelius was sworn in as the United States Secretary of Health and Human Services on April 28, 2009, declined to seek election. United States Senator Sam Brownback, who unsuccessfully ran for president in 2008, emerged as the Republican nominee, facing off against Democratic State Senator Tom Holland, who was unopposed for his party's nomination. Owing to the large amount of popularity that he had accumulated during his tenure in the United States Senate, Brownback defeated Holland in a landslide to become the 46th Governor of Kansas.

zh.s: 2010年堪萨斯州州长选举于11月2日举行。州长马克·帕金森在前任州长凯瑟琳·塞贝利厄斯于2009年4月28日宣誓就任美国卫生与公众服务部长后接任州长，但他决定不参选。曾于2008年竞选总统的美国参议员萨姆·布朗巴克赢得共和党提名，对手是无人竞争获得民主党提名的州参议员汤姆·霍兰德。布朗巴克在参议院任职期间积累了很高的人气，因此以压倒性优势击败霍兰德，当选第46任堪萨斯州州长。

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in North Dakota, 2010
en.s: The 2010 House election in North Dakota took place on November 2, 2010 to elect the state's At-large Representative to the United States House of Representatives. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; the person elected will serve in the 112th Congress from January 3, 2011 until January 3, 2013. North Dakota has one seat in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census. The election was held concurrently with the United States Senate elections of 2010 (including one in North Dakota), the United States House elections in other states and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2010年美国北达科他州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2010年美国北达科他州联邦众议院选举于11月2日举行，选出该州的单一国会选区代表。众议员任期两年，当选者将在第112届国会任职，任期为2011年1月3日至2013年1月3日。根据2000年美国人口普查，北达科他州在众议院有1个席位。此次选举与2010年联邦参议员选举（包括北达科他州的一场参议员选举）、其他州的联邦众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: United States Senate special election in Delaware, 2010
en.s: The 2010 United States Senate special election in Delaware took place on November 2, 2010 concurrently with elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. It was a special election to fill Delaware's Class II Senate seat, then held by Ted Kaufman, an appointee. The seat had been previously held by long-time Senator Joe Biden, who vacated it when he became Vice President of the United States in 2009. The state primary election was September 14, 2010. U.S.

zh.t: 2010年美国特拉华州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 2010年美国特拉华州联邦参议员特别选举于2010年11月2日举行，与其他州的联邦参议员选举、联邦众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同期进行。此次特别选举是为了填补特拉华州第二组参议员席位；乔·拜登于2009年就任美国副总统后辞去参议员职务，此前该席位由受任参议员特德·考夫曼担任。特拉华州初选于2010年9月14日举行。前州长、联邦众议员迈克·卡斯尔原被视为共和党提名的热门人选，但在备受全国关注的初选中败给克里斯蒂娜·奥唐奈。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Massachusetts, 2010
en.s: The 2010 congressional elections in Massachusetts was held on November 2, 2010, to determine who would represent the state of Massachusetts in the United States House of Representatives. Massachusetts has ten seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; those elected will serve in the 112th Congress from January 3, 2011 until January 3, 2013. All current representatives are member of the Democratic Party and none of the ten faced major party opposition in 2008.

zh.t: 2010年美国马萨诸塞州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2010年马萨诸塞州联邦众议院选举于11月2日举行，选出代表该州进入美国联邦众议院的议员。根据2000年美国人口普查，马萨诸塞州在众议院有10个席位。众议员任期两年，当选者将在第112届国会任职，任期为2011年1月3日至2013年1月3日。现任的10名众议员都是民主党人，2008年没有人遇到主要政党对手。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Mississippi, 2010
en.s: Elections were held on November 2, 2010 to determine Mississippi's four members of the United States House of Representatives. Representatives were elected for two-year terms to serve in the 112th United States Congress from January 3, 2011 until January 3, 2013. Primary elections were held on June 1, 2010, and primary runoff elections on June 22. Of the four elections, the 1st district was rated as competitive by Sabato's Crystal Ball, and the 1st and 4th districts were rated as competitive by The Cook Political Report, CQ Politics and The Rothenberg Political Report.

zh.t: 2010年美国密西西比州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2010年11月2日举行选举，改选密西西比州的4名联邦众议员。议员任期两年，在第112届美国国会任职，时间为2011年1月3日至2013年1月3日。初选于2010年6月1日举行，第二轮初选于6月22日举行。在该州4场选举中，萨巴托的Crystal Ball将第一国会选区列为竞争选区；《库克政治报告》、CQ Politics和《罗滕伯格政治报告》则将第一和第四选区列为竞争选区。

en.s: The Iowa gubernatorial election of 2010 was held on Tuesday, November 2, 2010 to elect the Governor and Lieutenant Governor, who will serve a four-year term to begin on January 14, 2011. In Iowa the Governor and Lieutenant Governor are elected on the same ballot. The two major party candidates were first-term incumbent governor Chet Culver, a Democrat, who ran for re-election with first-term incumbent lieutenant governor Patty Judge, and former four-term governor Terry Branstad, who won a three-way primary for the Republican nomination and ran with State Senator Kim Reynolds. The Branstad/Reynolds ticket defeated the Culver/Judge ticket in the general election.

zh.s: 2010年艾奥瓦州州长选举于2010年11月2日星期二举行，选出州长和副州长，任期四年，从2011年1月14日开始。艾奥瓦州的州长和副州长由选民在同一张选票上选出。两大政党的候选人分别是寻求连任的民主党籍首届州长切特·卡尔弗及其竞选搭档、首届副州长帕蒂·贾奇，以及曾四次担任州长的特里·布兰斯塔德和州参议员金·雷诺兹。布兰斯塔德在三人参加的共和党初选中胜出。布兰斯塔德—雷诺兹组合在大选中击败了卡尔弗—贾奇组合。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Iowa, 2010
en.s: The 2010 House elections in Iowa occurred on November 2, 2010 and elected the members of the State of Iowa's delegation to the United States House of Representatives. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; those elected served in the 112th Congress from January 3, 2011 until January 3, 2013. Iowa has five seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census. These elections were held concurrently with the United States Senate elections of 2010 (including one in Iowa), the United States House elections in other states, and various state and local elections. All five of Iowa's incumbent representatives were re-elected.

zh.t: 2010年美国艾奥瓦州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2010年美国艾奥瓦州联邦众议院选举于11月2日举行，选出该州的联邦众议员，任期两年。当选者在第112届国会任职，时间为2011年1月3日至2013年1月3日。根据2000年美国人口普查，艾奥瓦州在众议院有5个席位。此次选举与2010年联邦参议员选举（包括艾奥瓦州的一场参议员选举）、其他州的联邦众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。艾奥瓦州全部5名现任众议员都成功连任。

en.s: The 2010 Illinois gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 2010. Incumbent Governor Pat Quinn, a Democrat, sought and was elected to a full term. Quinn was elected as the Democratic nominee, the Illinois Green Party nominee was attorney and 2006 nominee Rich Whitney, the Republican nominee was State Senator Bill Brady, the Libertarian Party nominee was Lex Green, and Scott Lee Cohen ran as an independent. Governor Quinn won election to a full term in a very close race, beating Senator Brady by only about 32,000 votes, despite Brady winning in 98 of 102 Illinois counties.

zh.s: 2010年伊利诺伊州州长选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任州长帕特·奎因寻求任满一个完整任期，并成功当选。奎因作为民主党候选人参选；伊利诺伊州绿党提名律师、2006年候选人里奇·惠特尼；共和党提名州参议员比尔·布雷迪；自由党提名莱克斯·格林；斯科特·李·科恩以独立候选人身份参选。奎因在一场差距很小的选举中赢得完整任期，只比布雷迪多约32,000票，尽管布雷迪赢得了伊利诺伊州102个县中的98个。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Oklahoma, 2010
en.s: The 2010 congressional elections in Oklahoma were held on November 2, 2010, to determine who would represent the state of Oklahoma in the United States House of Representatives. Oklahoma has five seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census. This election was the final one held in which Congressional districts apportioned according to the 2000 U.S. Census data. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; those elected serve in the 112th Congress from January 3, 2011 until January 3, 2013.

zh.t: 2010年美国俄克拉何马州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2010年俄克拉何马州联邦众议院选举于11月2日举行，选出代表该州进入美国联邦众议院的议员。根据2000年美国人口普查，俄克拉何马州在众议院有5个席位。这是最后一次使用依据2000年美国人口普查数据划分的国会选区举行的选举。众议员任期两年，当选者将在第112届国会任职，时间为2011年1月3日至2013年1月3日。

en.s: The 2010 Alaska gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 2010. Former Governor Sarah Palin did not run, having resigned in July 2009. Incumbent Governor Sean Parnell, who as lieutenant governor succeeded Palin following her resignation, announced that he would seek a full term. Following the primary election on Tuesday, August 24, 2010, the Democratic ticket consists of Ethan Berkowitz and Diane E. Benson running against Republican Parnell and his running mate, Mead Treadwell. In the general election Parnell/Treadwell defeated Berkowitz/Benson by a wide margin. Parnell received over 59% of the vote, which is the highest percentage for any Alaska gubernatorial candidate in history.

zh.s: 2010年阿拉斯加州州长选举于11月2日举行。前州长莎拉·佩林没有参选；她于2009年7月辞职。现任州长肖恩·帕内尔在佩林辞职后由副州长继任，并宣布寻求完整任期。8月24日星期二举行初选后，民主党候选人组合为伊桑·伯科维茨和黛安·E·本森，共和党候选人组合为帕内尔和米德·特里德韦尔。大选中，帕内尔—特里德韦尔组合以较大优势击败伯科维茨—本森组合。帕内尔获得超过59%的选票，是阿拉斯加州州长候选人有史以来的最高得票率。

en.s: The Oregon gubernatorial election of 2010 was held on Tuesday, November 2, 2010 to elect the Governor of Oregon, who will serve a four-year term to begin on January 10, 2011. The incumbent governor, Democrat Ted Kulongoski, was ineligible to run due to term limits barring him from being elected to more than two consecutive terms. The Democratic candidate John Kitzhaber, who had previously served two terms as governor from 1995 to 2003, was elected to a third term, earning a narrow victory over Republican candidate Chris Dudley and two minor party candidates.

zh.s: 2010年俄勒冈州州长选举于2010年11月2日星期二举行，选出州长，任期四年，从2011年1月10日开始。民主党籍现任州长泰德·库隆戈斯基受任期限制，不能连续当选超过两届，因此无法参选。民主党候选人约翰·基茨哈伯曾于1995至2003年担任两届州长，这次当选并开始第三个任期。他以微弱优势击败共和党候选人克里斯·达德利和两名小党候选人。

en.s: The 2010 Florida gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 2010 to determine the Governor for the State of Florida. Republican-turned-Independent incumbent Governor Charlie Crist chose not to run for a second term. He instead ran (unsuccessfully) for the Senate seat vacated by Mel Martínez. This resulted in an open race for Governor of Florida in which Republican Rick Scott narrowly defeated Democrat Alex Sink. Despite mixed to unfavorable ratings, Rick Scott benefited greatly from the midterm GOP wave, in which Republicans made significant gains across the country. Scott was one of six Republican gubernatorial pick-ups nationwide (counting Crist now as an Independent).

zh.s: 2010年佛罗里达州州长选举于11月2日举行。转为独立人士的共和党籍现任州长查理·克里斯特决定不寻求第二个任期，转而竞选梅尔·马丁内斯空出的联邦参议员席位，但未能当选。州长选举因此没有在任者参选，共和党人里克·斯科特以微弱优势击败民主党人亚历克斯·辛克。尽管斯科特的评价褒贬不一，他仍受益于中期选举中的共和党浪潮；共和党在全国取得显著进展。全国共有6个州长职位从民主党转为共和党；将克里斯特计为独立人士时，斯科特是其中之一。

en.s: The 2010 California Attorney General election was held on November 2, 2010 to choose the Attorney General of California. The primary election was held on June 8, 2010. Incumbent Attorney General Jerry Brown, a Democrat was elected Governor of California. The two major candidates were Los Angeles County District Attorney Steve Cooley of the Republican Party and San Francisco County District Attorney Kamala Harris representing the Democratic Party. On November 24, 2010, Cooley conceded to Harris, giving the Democrats a sweep of statewide executive offices. On November 30, Harris declared victory.

zh.t: 2010年加利福尼亚州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2010年加利福尼亚州总检察长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州总检察长。初选于2010年6月8日举行。民主党籍现任总检察长杰里·布朗当选加利福尼亚州州长。两名主要候选人是共和党人、洛杉矶县地方检察官史蒂夫·库利和民主党人、旧金山县地方检察官卡玛拉·哈里斯。11月24日，库利承认败选，民主党因此赢得全部州级行政职位。11月30日，哈里斯宣布胜选。

en.t: United States Senate election in North Carolina, 2010
en.s: The 2010 United States Senate election in North Carolina was held on November 2, 2010. The filing deadline for the primaries was February 26; the primaries were held on May 4, with a Democratic primary runoff held on June 22. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Richard Burr won re-election to a second term. Burr is the first incumbent to win re-election for this seat since Sam Ervin's last re-election in 1968. Burr's 54.8% also represented the highest vote share a North Carolina Republican has received since the state began directly electing its Senators.

zh.t: 2010年美国北卡罗来纳州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2010年美国北卡罗来纳州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行。初选登记截止日期为2月26日，初选于5月4日举行，民主党初选第二轮于6月22日举行。共和党籍现任参议员理查德·伯尔成功连任第二个任期。自萨姆·欧文于1968年最后一次连任以来，伯尔是首位在该席位上成功连任的现任参议员。他获得54.8%的选票，也是北卡罗来纳州开始直接选举参议员以来，共和党候选人的最高得票率。

en.s: The 2010 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on Tuesday, November 2, 2010 to elect the Governor of Colorado, who would serve a four-year term that began in January 2011. John Hickenlooper won the race with over 50% of the vote. Incumbent Democratic Governor Bill Ritter announced that he would not run for re-election in 2010. Dan Maes claimed the Republican nomination in the primary with 50.6% of the vote and a 1.3% margin over rival Scott McInnis. In claiming victory, Maes called on Constitution Party candidate and former Republican Congressman Tom Tancredo to "stop your campaign tonight."

zh.s: 2010年科罗拉多州州长选举于2010年11月2日星期二举行，选出任期四年的州长，新任期于2011年1月开始。约翰·希肯卢珀获得超过50%的选票，赢得选举。民主党籍现任州长比尔·里特宣布不寻求2010年连任。丹·梅斯在共和党初选中获得50.6%的选票，以1.3个百分点的优势击败对手斯科特·麦金尼斯，赢得共和党提名。梅斯宣布胜选时，呼吁宪法党候选人、前共和党联邦众议员汤姆·坦克雷多“今晚就停止竞选”。

en.t: United States Senate election in Alaska, 2010
en.s: The 2010 United States Senate election in Alaska took place on November 2, 2010, alongside 33 other U.S. Senate elections in other states, as well as elections in all states for Representatives to the U.S. House, and various state and local offices. The November general election in Alaska was preceded by primary elections which were held on August 24, 2010. Scott McAdams, the Mayor of Sitka, became the Democratic Party nominee for U.S. Senate after winning the largest number of votes of any Democrat in the open primary (any registered Alaska voter can vote this ballot, regardless of party registration).

zh.t: 2010年美国阿拉斯加州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2010年美国阿拉斯加州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行，同时还举行了其他州的33场联邦参议员选举、各州联邦众议员选举以及各州和地方选举。阿拉斯加州大选前，于2010年8月24日举行了初选。锡特卡市长斯科特·麦克亚当斯在开放式初选中获得所有民主党候选人中最多的选票，因此成为民主党联邦参议员候选人。阿拉斯加州所有登记选民都可以参加这场初选，无论其登记的党派是什么。

en.s: The Hawaii gubernatorial election of 2010 was held on November 2, 2010 to determine the next Governor and Lieutenant Governor of Hawaii. The winning candidates will serve a four-year term from 2010 to 2014. Incumbent Republican Governor Linda Lingle was term-limited in 2010 and not eligible to run for re-election. Former congressman Neil Abercrombie was declared the winner, defeating lieutenant governor Duke Aiona. Abercrombie was sworn in as the state's seventh (and its fifth Democratic) Governor on December 6, 2010. The winners of the 2010 lieutenant governor primary election became the running mates of the 2010 gubernatorial nominees.

zh.s: 2010年夏威夷州州长选举于11月2日举行，选出州长和副州长，任期四年，为2010至2014年。共和党籍现任州长琳达·林格尔受任期限制，不能在2010年寻求连任。前联邦众议员尼尔·阿伯克龙比宣布胜选，击败副州长杜克·艾奥纳。阿伯克龙比于2010年12月6日宣誓就任夏威夷州第七任州长，也是该州第五位民主党籍州长。2010年副州长初选的胜者成为各州长候选人的竞选搭档。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Rhode Island, 2010
en.s: The 2010 congressional elections in Rhode Island were held on November 2, 2010, and determined who would represent Rhode Island in the United States House of Representatives. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; the elected served in the 112th Congress from January 3, 2011 until January 3, 2013. Rhode Island has two seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census. Its 2009-2010 congressional delegation consisted of two Democrats, and following the election, it stayed with two Democrats.

zh.t: 2010年美国罗得岛州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2010年罗得岛州联邦众议院选举于11月2日举行，选出代表该州进入美国联邦众议院的议员。众议员任期两年，当选者在第112届国会任职，时间为2011年1月3日至2013年1月3日。根据2000年美国人口普查，罗得岛州在众议院有2个席位。2009至2010年，该州在国会的代表团由两名民主党人组成；选举后仍由两名民主党人组成。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Missouri, 2010
en.s: Elections were held on November 2, 2010, to determine Missouri's nine members of the United States House of Representatives. Representatives were elected for two-year terms to serve in the 112th Congress from January 3, 2011 until January 3, 2013. Primary elections were held on August 3, 2010. Of the nine elections, the races in the 3rd and 4th districts were rated as competitive by The Cook Political Report, CQ Politics, The Rothenberg Political Report and Sabato's Crystal Ball. Seven of Missouri's nine incumbents were re-elected, while one (Ike Skelton of the 4th district) unsuccessfully sought re-election and one (Roy Blunt of the 7th district) did not seek re-election.

zh.t: 2010年美国密苏里州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2010年11月2日举行选举，改选密苏里州的9名联邦众议员。议员任期两年，在第112届国会任职，时间为2011年1月3日至2013年1月3日。初选于2010年8月3日举行。9场选举中，《库克政治报告》、CQ Politics、《罗滕伯格政治报告》和Sabato's Crystal Ball将第三和第四国会选区列为竞争选区。密苏里州9名现任众议员中有7人连任；第四选区的艾克·斯凯尔顿竞选连任失败，第七选区的罗伊·布朗特没有寻求连任。

en.t: United States Senate election in Colorado, 2010
en.s: The 2010 United States Senate election in Colorado took place on November 2, 2010, alongside other elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. In December 2008, President-Elect Barack Obama selected incumbent U.S. Senator Ken Salazar to become Secretary of the Interior. After Salazar resigned from his seat, Democratic Governor Bill Ritter appointed Denver Public Schools Superintendent Michael Bennet to fill the seat, who won re-election to his first full term.

zh.t: 2010年美国科罗拉多州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2010年美国科罗拉多州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行，同时还举行了其他州的联邦参议员选举、联邦众议院选举以及各州和地方选举。2008年12月，当选总统巴拉克·奥巴马提名现任参议员肯·萨拉查出任内政部长。萨拉查辞去参议员职务后，民主党籍州长比尔·里特任命丹佛公立学校总监迈克尔·贝内特填补空缺。贝内特这次当选，赢得首个完整参议员任期。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Wisconsin, 2010
en.s: The 2010 congressional elections in Wisconsin were held on November 2, 2010 to determine who will represent the state of Wisconsin in the United States House of Representatives. It coincided with the state's senatorial and gubernatorial elections. Representatives were elected for two-year terms; those elected will serve in the 112th Congress from January 2011 until January 2013. Wisconsin has eight seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census. The seats are currently held by five Democrats and three Republicans in the 111th Congress.

zh.t: 2010年美国威斯康星州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2010年威斯康星州联邦众议院选举于11月2日举行，选出该州在美国联邦众议院的代表。选举与威斯康星州联邦参议员和州长选举同时举行。众议员任期两年，当选者在第112届国会任职，时间为2011年1月至2013年1月。根据2000年美国人口普查，威斯康星州在众议院有8个席位。在第111届国会中，这些席位由5名民主党人和3名共和党人占据。

zh.t: 2010年伊利诺伊州第17国会选区联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 2010年伊利诺伊州第17国会选区联邦众议员选举于11月2日举行，决定谁将代表该选区进入第112届美国国会。该选区位于伊利诺伊州西部及中部部分地区。民主党籍现任众议员菲尔·黑尔自2006年起担任该职，并寻求连任。共和党候选人是鲍比·希林，绿党候选人是罗杰·K·戴维斯。

en.t: United States Senate election in Pennsylvania, 2010
en.s: The 2010 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania took place on November 2, 2010, during the 2010 midterm elections. Incumbent Republican-turned-Democrat U.S. Senator Arlen Specter ran for reelection to a sixth term, but lost in the Democratic primary to Joe Sestak. Republican nominee Pat Toomey then won the seat. Toomey had previously run for United States Senate in 2004, challenging Specter for the Republican nomination, but was narrowly defeated in the primary. Specter went on to be reelected to his fifth term, defeating the Democratic nominee, Congressman Joe Hoeffel. Toomey announced on April 15, 2009, that he would again seek the Republican nomination for U.S.

zh.t: 2010年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州于2010年11月2日举行联邦参议员选举，是2010年中期选举的一部分。时任共和党转民主党籍参议员阿伦·斯佩克特竞选第六届任期，但在民主党初选中败给乔·塞斯塔克。共和党候选人帕特·图米随后赢得席位。图米此前曾于2004年挑战斯佩克特，争取共和党提名，但在初选中以微弱差距落败。斯佩克特后来连任第五届，击败民主党候选人、众议员乔·赫弗尔。图米于2009年4月15日宣布再次争取共和党提名参选联邦参议员……

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Washington, 2010
en.s: Elections were held on November 2, 2010, to determine Washington's nine members of the United States House of Representatives. Representatives were elected for two-year terms to serve in the 112th Congress from January 3, 2011 until January 3, 2013. Nonpartisan blanket primary elections were held on August 17, 2010. en.s: The 2010 Pennsylvania gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 2010, to elect the Governor and Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania, concurrently with elections to the United States Senate in Pennsylvania and other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic Governor Ed Rendell was term limited and thus ineligible to seek re-election in 2010. en.t: California Superintendent of Public Instruction election, 2010
en.s: The 2010 California Superintendent of Public Instruction election occurred on November 2, 2010. Incumbent Jack O'Connell was term-limited and unable to run for re-election to a third term. In the nonpartisan primary election on June 8, 2010, no candidate received a majority of the votes. The top two finishers, Larry Aceves, who came first with 19% of the vote, and State Assemblyman Tom Torlakson, who came second with 18.5% of the vote, advanced to the general election. In the general election on November 2, 2010, Torlakson defeated Aceves.
