en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Connecticut, 2010
en.s: The 2010 United States House of Representatives elections in Connecticut took place on Tuesday, November 2, 2010 to elect the five Congressional representatives from the state, one from each of the state's five Congressional districts. The elections coincided with the elections of other federal and state offices, including governor, U.S. Senate, and state legislature races. Primary elections were necessary to select Republican candidates in all districts except the Third, while no Democratic candidates faced primary challenges.

en.s: The 2010 Wyoming gubernatorial election was held on Tuesday, November 2, 2010 to elect the Governor of Wyoming, who will serve a four-year term to begin in January 2011. Party primaries were held on August 17. While it was initially thought that term limits would prevent incumbent Democratic Governor Dave Freudenthal from running for re-election, the constitutionality of the term limit law has been questioned, leaving the possibility that if Freudenthal had successfully challenged the law, he might have been able to run for a third term. On March 4, 2010, Freudenthal announced he would not run for a third term.

en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in Oregon, 2010 were held on November 2, 2010, to determine who would represent the state of Oregon in the United States House of Representatives. en.s: The 2010 Vermont gubernatorial general election took place on November 2, 2010. en.s: The 2010 United States House of Representatives election in South Dakota took place on Tuesday, November 2, 2010. en.s: Elections were held on November 2, 2010 to determine Louisiana's seven members of the United States House of Representatives. en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in New Mexico, 2010
en.s: The 2010 congressional elections in New Mexico were held on November 2, 2010 and determined New Mexico's representation in the United States House of Representatives. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; the winners of the election served in the 111th Congress, which began on January 4, 2009 ended on January 3, 2011. New Mexico has three seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census. zh.t: 2010年美国新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Florida, 2010
en.s: The 2010 congressional elections in Florida were held on November 2, 2010 to determine who will represent the state of Florida in the United States House of Representatives. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; those elected will serve in the 112th Congress from January 2011 until January 2013. Florida has twenty-five seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census, and it likely to remain at that number until there is a possible addition of two more congressional seats in 2012. A large majority of the incumbents sought re-election on November 2, and only the 12th district and the 17th district are open races.

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Maine, 2010
en.s: Elections were held on November 2, 2010 to determine Maine's two members of the United States House of Representatives. en.t: United States Senate election in Florida, 2010
en.s: The 2010 United States Senate election in Florida took place on November 2, 2010 concurrently with other elections to the United States Senate in other states, as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. en.s: The 2010 Nevada gubernatorial election was held on Tuesday, November 2, 2010, to elect the Governor of Nevada, who would serve a four-year term to begin on January 3, 2011. en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in New York, 2010
en.s: The 2010 congressional elections in New York were held on November 2, 2010 to determine representation in the state of New York in the United States House of Representatives. New York has 29 seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census. en.s: The Rhode Island gubernatorial election of 2010 was held on November 2, 2010. It was preceded by the primary election on September 14, 2010. Voters chose the Governor of the United States Virgin Islands, the non-voting delegate to the U.S. House of Representatives and all fifteen seats in the Legislature of the Virgin Islands. The election coincided with the 2010 United States general election.

zh.s: 美属维尔京群岛大选于2010年11月2日举行。选民选出美属维尔京群岛总督、美国联邦众议院无投票权代表，以及维尔京群岛议会全部15个席位。此次选举与2010年美国大选同时举行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2010 Alabama gubernatorial election took place on November 2, 2010. Republican Governor Bob Riley was term limited and unable to seek re-election. The party primaries were held on June 1, 2010, with a Republican runoff on July 13. In the general election, Republican Robert J. Bentley defeated Democrat Ron Sparks.

zh.s: 2010年阿拉巴马州州长选举于11月2日举行。共和党籍州长鲍勃·赖利因任期限制不能竞选连任。两党初选于2010年6月1日举行，共和党第二轮初选于7月13日举行。大选中，共和党人罗伯特·J·本特利击败民主党人罗恩·斯帕克斯。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in the District of Columbia, 2010
en.s: The 2010 congressional election for the Delegate from the District of Columbia was held on November 2, 2010. The winner of the race is to serve in the 112th Congress from January 3, 2011, until January 3, 2013. The non-voting delegate to the United States House of Representatives from the District of Columbia is elected for two-year terms.

zh.t: 2010年美国哥伦比亚特区联邦众议院代表选举
zh.s: 2010年哥伦比亚特区联邦众议院代表选举于11月2日举行。胜选者将在第112届国会任职，任期从2011年1月3日至2013年1月3日。哥伦比亚特区选出的联邦众议院代表没有投票权，任期两年。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Maryland Comptroller election of 2010, was held on November 2, 2010. Incumbent Democratic Comptroller Peter Franchot ran for a second term and faced off against former Amtrak CFO William H. Campbell in the general election, whom he defeated in a landslide.

zh.s: 2010年马里兰州州审计长选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任审计长彼得·弗兰乔特竞选第二个任期，在大选中击败前美国铁路公司首席财务官威廉·H·坎贝尔，且胜出优势很大。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2010 Florida Attorney General election took place on November 2, 2010, to elect the Attorney General of Florida. The election was won by Republican Pam Bondi who took office in January 2011.

zh.t: 2010年佛罗里达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2010年佛罗里达州总检察长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州总检察长。共和党人帕姆·邦迪胜选，并于2011年1月就任。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Maryland county executive elections of 2010 were held on November 2, 2010. Anne Arundel County, Baltimore County, Harford County, Howard County, Montgomery County, Prince George's County, and Wicomico County elected county executives. This race coincided with the election for Maryland county offices elections, 2010.

zh.t: 2010年马里兰州县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2010年马里兰州县行政长官选举于11月2日举行。安妮阿伦德尔县、巴尔的摩县、哈福德县、霍华德县、蒙哥马利县、乔治王子县和威科米科县都选出了县行政长官。此次选举与2010年马里兰州县级公职选举同时举行。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina, 2010
en.s: The 2010 South Carolina House of Representatives elections were held on Tuesday, November 2, 2010. The primary elections were held on June 8.The composition of the state delegation before the election was four Republicans and two Democrats. After the general election, the composition of the state delegation entering the 112th Congress was five Republicans and just one Democrat. All seats were rated safe for their incumbent parties except for district 5.

zh.t: 2010年美国南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2010年美国南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举于11月2日（星期二）举行。初选于6月8日举行。选举前，该州代表团由4名共和党人和2名民主党人组成。大选后，进入第112届国会的代表团将由5名共和党人和1名民主党人组成。除第5选区外，所有席位都被评为现任所属政党稳占的席位。

en.t: United States Senate election in Utah, 2010
en.s: The 2010 United States Senate election in Utah took place on November 2, 2010 along with other midterm elections throughout the United States. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Bob Bennett was seeking re-election to a fourth term, but was eliminated in the GOP state convention. Republican Mike Lee, who won the Republican primary, won the open seat.

zh.t: 2010年美国犹他州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2010年美国犹他州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行，与美国其他中期选举同时进行。共和党籍现任参议员鲍勃·贝内特竞选第四个任期，但在共和党州代表大会上出局。赢得共和党初选的迈克·李随后赢得该空缺席位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Elections were held in Minnesota on Tuesday, November 2, 2010. Primary elections took place on August 10, 2010.

zh.s: 明尼苏达州于2010年11月2日（星期二）举行选举。初选于2010年8月10日举行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: Bill Lockyer wins reelection as California state treasurer
en.s: On November 2, 2010, California voters reelected Democrat Bill Lockyer as state treasurer. Lockyer defeated Republican Mimi Walters in the statewide race. The treasurer election was one of several separate California contests held that day, alongside elections for governor, secretary of state and other offices.
en.n: California's state treasurer election was held on November 2, 2010; the June 8 primary was a separate vote.

zh.t: 比尔·洛克耶连任加利福尼亚州财长
zh.s: 2010年11月2日，美国加利福尼亚州举行州财长选举。民主党籍现任州财长比尔·洛克耶击败共和党候选人米米·沃尔特斯，成功连任。当天加州还举行了州长、州务卿等其他职位的选举。
zh.n: 加州州财长普选举行于2010年11月2日；此前的党内初选在6月8日举行。

en.t: United States Senate special election in West Virginia, 2010
en.s: The 2010 United States Senate special election in West Virginia was held on November 2, 2010. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Robert C. Byrd died in office on June 28, 2010. Democratic Governor Joe Manchin appointed Carte Goodwin to temporarily fill the vacancy. Goodwin pledged to not run for election to the seat in exchange for the appointment.

zh.t: 2010年西弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 2010年西弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员特别选举于2010年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任参议员罗伯特·C·伯德于2010年6月28日在任内去世。民主党籍州长乔·曼钦任命卡特·古德温暂时接任空缺席位。古德温承诺不参加该席位的选举，以换取这项任命。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2010 Connecticut House of Representatives election was held on Tuesday, November 2, 2010 to elect members to the Connecticut House of Representatives, one from each of the state's 151 General Assembly districts. The date of this the election corresponded with other elections in the state, including ones for governor, U.S. Senate, and the Connecticut State Senate. Representatives elected will serve a two-year term, beginning in January 2011.

zh.s: 2010年康涅狄格州众议院选举于2010年11月2日星期二举行，每个州众议院选区各选出一名议员，共151人。投票日期也举行了该州其他选举，包括州长、联邦参议员和州参议员选举。当选议员任期两年，于2011年1月就职。

en.t: United States Senate election in South Dakota, 2010
en.s: The 2010 United States Senate election in South Dakota was held on November 2, 2010 along other elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator John Thune won re-election to a second term unopposed.

zh.t: 2010年南达科他州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2010年南达科他州联邦参议员选举于2010年11月2日举行，与其他州的联邦参议员选举、联邦众议院选举及多项州和地方选举同时进行。共和党籍现任参议员约翰·图恩没有对手，成功连任第二个任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Texas, 2010
en.s: The 2010 US congressional elections in Texas were held on November 2, 2010 to determine who will represent the state of Texas in the United States House of Representatives. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; those elected will serve in the 112th Congress from January 2011 until January 2013. With 27% of the voting age public turning out, the Republican Party won 23 seats and the Democratic Party won 9 seats.

zh.t: 2010年得克萨斯州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2010年得克萨斯州联邦众议院选举于2010年11月2日举行，选出代表该州进入联邦众议院的议员。众议员任期为两年，当选者于2011年1月至2013年1月在第112届国会任职。适龄选民投票率为27%；共和党赢得23席，民主党赢得9席。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Elections were held in Indiana on Tuesday, November 2, 2010. Primary elections were held on May 4, 2010.

zh.s: 印第安纳州于2010年11月2日星期二举行选举。初选于2010年5月4日举行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Maryland, 2010
en.s: The 2010 congressional elections in Maryland were held on November 2, 2010, to determine who will represent the state of Maryland in the United States House of Representatives. Maryland has eight seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; those elected served in the 112th Congress from January 3, 2011 until January 3, 2013.

zh.t: 2010年马里兰州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2010年马里兰州联邦众议院选举于2010年11月2日举行，选出代表该州进入联邦众议院的议员。根据2000年美国人口普查结果，马里兰州有八个众议院席位。众议员任期为两年，当选者于2011年1月3日至2013年1月3日在第112届国会任职。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2010 Orange County, Florida, mayoral election took place on November 2, 2010. Incumbent Republican mayor Richard Crotty was unable to seek re-election due to term limits, and four candidates ran to replace him. A nonpartisan primary election was held on August 24, 2010, but because no candidate won a majority of the vote, former county commissioner Teresa Jacobs, a Republican, advanced to a runoff election against fellow county commissioner Bill Segal, a Democrat.

zh.t: 2010年佛罗里达州奥兰治县县长选举
zh.s: 2010年佛罗里达州奥兰治县县长选举于2010年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任县长理查德·克罗蒂受任期限制，不能竞选连任，共有四名候选人竞选接替他。无党派初选于2010年8月24日举行，但无人获得过半选票，因此前县委员、共和党人特蕾莎·雅各布斯进入第二轮，对阵同为县委员的民主党人比尔·西格尔。

en.s: The 2010 Wisconsin Fall General Election was held in the U.S. state of Wisconsin on November 2, 2010. All of Wisconsin's executive and administrative officers were up for election as well as one of Wisconsin's U.S. Senate seats, Wisconsin's eight seats in the United States House of Representatives, seventeen seats in the Wisconsin State Senate, and all 99 seats in the Wisconsin State Assembly.

zh.s: 威斯康星州于2010年11月2日举行秋季大选。该州所有行政和行政管理官员职位、一个联邦参议员席位、八个联邦众议员席位、17个州参议员席位，以及威斯康星州议会全部99个席位都参加了选举。

en.s: The 2010 Oregon State Treasurer special election was held on November 2, 2010, to elect the Oregon State Treasurer. This election determined who would fill the remaining two years of the term of Ben Westlund, who died in office from lung cancer earlier in the year. Incumbent Democratic State Treasurer Ted Wheeler, who was appointed by Governor Ted Kulongoski to serve until this special election could be held, ran for election to the office.

zh.t: 2010年俄勒冈州州财政部长特别选举
zh.s: 2010年俄勒冈州州财政部长特别选举于2010年11月2日举行，选出州财政部长，完成本·韦斯特伦未满的两年任期。韦斯特伦当年因肺癌在任内去世。民主党籍现任州财政部长特德·惠勒由州长特德·库隆戈斯基任命，暂时接任该职，直至举行特别选举；他随后参选。

en.s: Elections were held in Missouri on Tuesday, November 2, 2010. Primary elections were held on August 3, 2010.

zh.s: 密苏里州大选于2010年11月2日星期二举行。初选于2010年8月3日举行。

en.s: The 2010 elections for the Illinois Senate was conducted on Tuesday, November 2, 2010. The 2010 primary election was conducted on Tuesday, February 2, 2010. State Senators elected this year sat for two year terms, all of which expired at the beginning of the next General Assembly.

zh.s: 2010年伊利诺伊州参议院选举于2010年11月2日星期二举行。2010年初选于2月2日星期二举行。当年当选的州参议员任期为两年，任期均在下一届州议会开始时届满。

en.t: 2010 Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts election
en.s: The 2010 Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts election took place on November 2, 2010, to elect the comptroller of public accounts of Texas. Incumbent Republican comptroller Susan Combs successfully ran for re-election against Libertarian Mary Ruwart and Green Party candidate Edward Lindsay, both of whom saw abnormally high levels of support for a third party because the state Democratic Party did not field a candidate.

zh.t: 2010年得克萨斯州公共账户审计长选举
zh.s: 2010年得克萨斯州公共账户审计长选举于2010年11月2日举行，选出该州公共账户审计长。共和党籍现任审计长苏珊·康布斯击败自由党候选人玛丽·鲁沃特和绿党候选人爱德华·林赛，成功连任。由于该州民主党没有提名候选人，两名第三党候选人都获得了异常高的支持率。

en.t: 2010 United States Senate elections in Illinois
en.s: The 2010 United States Senate elections in Illinois took place on November 2, 2010. There were two ballot items for the same seat: a general election, to fill the Class 3 seat beginning with the 112th United States Congress beginning on January 3, 2011, and a special election, to fill that seat for the final weeks of the 111th Congress.

zh.t: 2010年伊利诺伊州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2010年伊利诺伊州联邦参议员选举于2010年11月2日举行。同一个席位有两项投票：一项是选出第112届国会议员的常规选举，任期从2011年1月3日开始；另一项是特别选举，为第111届国会剩余的最后几周选出该席位的参议员。

en.t: 2010 United States House of Representatives elections in Hawaii
en.s: The 2010 congressional elections in Hawaii was held on November 2, 2010, to determine who was to represent the state of Hawaii in the United States House of Representatives for the 112th Congress from January 2011, until their terms of office expire in January 2013. Hawaii has two seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms.

zh.t: 2010年夏威夷州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2010年夏威夷州联邦众议院选举于2010年11月2日举行，选出代表夏威夷州参加第112届国会的联邦众议员。其任期从2011年1月开始，到2013年1月届满。根据2000年美国人口普查，夏威夷州在联邦众议院有两个席位。联邦众议员任期两年。

en.s: An election was held on November 2, 2010, to elect all 41 members to Delaware's House of Representatives. The election coincided with the elections for other offices, including for U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, and state senate. The primary election was held on September 14, 2010.

zh.s: 2010年11月2日举行选举，选出特拉华州众议院全部41名议员。选举与美国联邦参议员、联邦众议员和州参议员等职位的选举同时进行。初选于2010年9月14日举行。

en.s: The 2010 Indiana State Treasurer election was held in on Tuesday, November 2, 2010, as part of the 2010 Indiana elections, held during the 2010 midterms. Incumbent Republican Treasurer Richard Mourdock won reelection. His Democratic opponent was Navy veteran Pete Buttigieg.

zh.t: 2010年印第安纳州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 2010年印第安纳州州财政部长选举于2010年11月2日星期二举行，是当年印第安纳州中期选举的一部分。共和党籍现任州财政部长理查德·莫道克成功连任。民主党对手是海军退伍军人皮特·布蒂吉格。

en.s: The 2010 Delaware Senate election was held on November 2, 2010, to elect 11 of the 21 members to Delaware's Senate. The election coincided with the elections for other offices, including the U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, and state house. The primary election was held on September 13, 2010.

zh.s: 2010年特拉华州参议院选举于2010年11月2日举行，改选21个席位中的11席。选举与美国联邦参议员、联邦众议员和州众议院等职位的选举同时进行。初选于2010年9月13日举行。

en.s: General elections were held in Guam on November 2, 2010. Voters in Guam chose their Governor, their non-voting delegate to the United States House of Representatives, Attorney General, as well as all fifteen members of the territorial legislature. The election coincided with the 2010 United States elections.

zh.s: 关岛大选于2010年11月2日举行。选民选出关岛总督、无投票权的联邦众议院代表、总检察长以及属地立法机关全部15名议员。此次选举与2010年美国选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2010 Wisconsin State Assembly elections were held on Tuesday, November 2, 2010. All 99 seats in the Wisconsin State Assembly were up for election. Before the election, 49 Assembly seats were held by Democrats, 45 seats were held by Republicans, 2 were held by independents, and 3 seats were vacant. The primary election was held on September 14, 2010.

zh.s: 2010年威斯康星州众议院选举于2010年11月2日星期二举行。州众议院99个席位全部改选。选举前，民主党占49席，共和党占45席，独立人士占2席，另有3席空缺。初选于2010年9月14日举行。

en.s: The 2010 Idaho Secretary of State election was held on November 2, 2010, to elect the Secretary of State of Idaho. Incumbent Republican Secretary of State Ben Ysursa won re-election to a third term.

zh.s: 2010年爱达荷州州务卿选举于2010年11月2日举行，选出该州州务卿。共和党籍现任州务卿本·伊苏尔萨成功连任第三个任期。

en.s: The 2010 Alabama Senate election was held on November 2, 2010. Voters in all 35 districts of the Alabama State Senate voted for their representatives. Other elections were also held on November 2. Republicans gained 9 seats, taking control of the chamber, while the Democrats lost 10 seats. This was the first time since 1873 that the Republican Party held a majority of seats in the Alabama Senate.

zh.s: 2010年阿拉巴马州参议院选举于2010年11月2日举行。该州35个选区的选民均选出州参议员。共和党增加了9个席位，取得参议院控制权；民主党失去10个席位。这是自1873年以来共和党首次在阿拉巴马州参议院占多数。

en.s: The 2010 Maryland House of Delegates election was held on November 2, 2010, electing all 141 members of the chamber. This coincided with the election of all 47 of Maryland's state senators, along with other statewide offices.

zh.s: 2010年马里兰州众议院选举于11月2日举行，改选州众议院全部141个席位。此次选举与马里兰州参议院全部47个席位以及其他全州公职选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2010 Wyoming Senate election was held on November 2, 2010, to elect members to the Wyoming Senate for its 61st session as part of the 2010 United States elections. Partisan primaries were held on August 17. Republicans gained three seats in the Senate in a cycle that was characterized as a "red wave".

zh.s: 2010年怀俄明州参议院选举于11月2日举行，选出第61届怀俄明州参议院议员，是2010年美国选举的一部分。两党初选于8月17日举行。共和党在这轮被称为“红色浪潮”的选举中增加了3个参议院席位。

en.s: The 2010 Missouri State Auditor election took place on November 2, 2010. Republican Ambassador Tom Schweich defeated incumbent Democratic State Auditor Susan Montee. It was only the third time in the last four decades that a sitting auditor in Missouri was unseated. Schweich's victory made him one of only two Republicans elected to Missouri's executive branch.

zh.s: 2010年密苏里州州审计长选举于11月2日举行。共和党大使汤姆·施魏希击败民主党籍现任州审计长苏珊·蒙蒂。这是过去40年里密苏里州在任州审计长第三次败选。施魏希获胜后，共和党人在密苏里州行政部门中只有两人当选，他是其中之一。

en.s: The 2010 elections for the Missouri House of Representatives were held on November 2, 2010, with all districts being contested. Necessary primary elections were held on August 3, 2010. The Republicans increased their majority in the chamber by 17 seats.

zh.s: 密苏里州众议院选举于2010年11月2日举行，所有选区都进行改选。初选于2010年8月3日举行。共和党在众议院增加了17席，扩大多数优势。

en.s: The 2010 Connecticut State Treasurer election took place on November 2, 2010, to elect the Connecticut State Treasurer. Incumbent Democratic State Treasurer Denise L. Nappier won re-election to a fourth term, defeating Republican mayor of Newington Jeff Wright.

zh.t: 2010年康涅狄格州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 2010年康涅狄格州州财政部长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州州财政部长。民主党籍现任州财政部长丹尼斯·L·纳皮尔击败共和党候选人、新宁顿市市长杰夫·赖特，成功连任第四个任期。

en.s: An election was held on November 2, 2010 to elect all 100 members to Montana's House of Representatives. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives and State Senate. The primary election was held on June 8, 2010. A loss of 18 seats by the Democrats resulted in the Republicans winning 68 seats compared to 32 seats for the Democrats.

zh.s: 蒙大拿州于2010年11月2日举行选举，改选州众议院全部100个席位。此次选举与联邦参议员、联邦众议员和州参议员等公职选举同时举行。初选于2010年6月8日举行。民主党失去18席后，共和党赢得68席，民主党获得32席。

en.s: The 2010 Maryland Senate election were held on November 2, 2010, to elect senators in all 47 districts of the Maryland Senate. Members were elected in single-member constituencies to four-year terms. These elections were held concurrently with various federal and state elections, including for Governor of Maryland.

zh.s: 2010年马里兰州参议院选举于11月2日举行，改选全部47个州参议院选区。参议员由单一选区选出，任期四年。此次选举与多项联邦和州级选举同时举行，包括马里兰州州长选举。

en.s: The Massachusetts general election, 2010 was held on November 2, 2010 throughout Massachusetts. Primary elections took place on September 14, 2010.

zh.s: 马萨诸塞州于2010年11月2日举行大选。初选于2010年9月14日举行。

en.s: The 2010 Wisconsin Senate elections were held on Tuesday, November 2, 2010. Seventeen of the 33 seats in the Wisconsin State Senate were up for election—the odd-numbered districts. Before the election, 18 Senate seats were held by Democrats and 15 seats were held by Republicans. 10 Democratic seats and 7 Republican seats were up in this election. The primary election took place on September 14, 2010.

zh.s: 2010年威斯康星州参议院选举于11月2日（星期二）举行。威斯康星州参议院33个席位中有17席进行改选，涉及所有奇数编号选区。选举前，民主党有18席，共和党有15席；本次选举改选10个民主党席位和7个共和党席位。初选于2010年9月14日举行。

en.s: Elections were held in California on November 2, 2010. On a year marked by a strong Republican wave nationwide, the State of California elected Democrats to the state's top offices of Governor, Lieutenant Governor, State Controller, State Treasurer, Superintendent of Public Education, Insurance Commissioner and United States Senator.

zh.s: 加利福尼亚州于2010年11月2日举行选举。尽管当年全国出现了强烈的共和党浪潮，加利福尼亚州各项主要公职都由民主党人当选，包括州长、副州长、州审计长、州财政部长、公立教育总监、保险专员和联邦参议员。

en.s: The 2010 Kentucky Senate election was held on November 2, 2010. The Republican and Democratic primary elections were held on May 18. Half of the senate (all even-numbered seats) were up for election. Republicans increased their majority in the chamber, gaining two seats. A numbered map of the senate districts at the time can be viewed here.

zh.s: 2010年肯塔基州参议院选举于11月2日举行。共和党和民主党初选于5月18日举行。参议院一半席位（全部偶数编号席位）进行改选。共和党增加两席，扩大了在参议院的多数优势。文中附有当时的参议院选区编号地图。

en.s: The 2010 Oklahoma elections were held on November 2, 2010. The primary election was held on July 27. The runoff primary election was held August 24. The Republican Party swept every statewide election and expanded its majorities in both state legislative chambers. An extremely socially conservative state, Oklahoma has not voted Democratic in a presidential election since 1964 but remained reliably Democratic at the state level well into the 2000s.

zh.s: 俄克拉何马州于2010年11月2日举行选举。初选于7月27日举行，第二轮初选于8月24日举行。共和党赢得全部州级选举，并扩大了其在州议会两院的多数优势。俄克拉何马州社会观念极为保守，自1964年以来就没有在总统选举中支持民主党；但直到2000年代，该州州级政治仍稳定由民主党主导。

en.s: The 2010 Missouri Senate elections were held on November 2, 2010. Voters in the 17 even-numbered districts of the Missouri Senate voted for their representatives. Other elections were also held on November 2. The Missouri Republican Party gained three seats and maintained control of the Missouri Senate.

zh.s: 2010年密苏里州参议院选举于11月2日举行。选民在密苏里州参议院17个偶数编号选区选出代表。当天还举行了其他选举。密苏里州共和党增加3个席位，继续控制州参议院。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of North Dakota on Tuesday, November 2, 2010, with primary elections being held on June 8, 2010.

zh.s: 北达科他州于2010年11月2日（星期二）举行大选。初选于2010年6月8日举行。

en.s: The 2010 Arizona Senate election was held on November 2, 2010. Voters elected members of the Arizona Senate in all 30 of the state's legislative districts to serve a two-year term. Primary elections were held on August 24, 2010. Prior to the elections, the Republicans held a majority of 18 seats over the Democrats' 12 seats.

zh.s: 2010年亚利桑那州参议院选举于11月2日举行。选民选出该州全部30个州参议院选区的议员，任期两年。初选于2010年8月24日举行。选举前，共和党有18席，占多数；民主党有12席。

en.s: The 2010 West Virginia Senate election took place on Tuesday, November 2, 2010, to elect members to the 80th and 81st Legislatures; held concurrently with the U.S. House and U.S. Senate elections. State senate seats in West Virginia are staggered, with senators serving 4-year terms. 18 of the 34 state senate seats were up for election. 17 were regularly scheduled, with an additional special election in SD 10 after the death of Donald Caruth on May 1, 2010.

zh.t: 2010年西弗吉尼亚州参议院选举
zh.s: 2010年西弗吉尼亚州参议院选举于11月2日（星期二）举行，选出第80届和第81届州议会议员，与联邦众议院和参议院选举同时进行。西弗吉尼亚州参议院席位分批改选，参议员任期四年。本次选举涉及34个席位中的18席，其中17席按常规改选；第10选区还举行特别选举，原因是唐纳德·卡鲁斯于2010年5月1日去世。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of New Mexico on November 2, 2010. All of New Mexico's executive officers were up for election as well all of New Mexico's three seats in the United States House of Representatives. Primary elections were held on June 1, 2010.

zh.s: 新墨西哥州于2010年11月2日举行大选。该州所有行政部门公职和联邦众议院的3个席位都进行改选。初选于2010年6月1日举行。

en.t: 2010 United States House of Representatives election in Northern Mariana Islands
en.s: The 2010 Congressional election in the Northern Mariana Islands occurred on November 2, 2010 and elected the territory's Delegate to the United States House of Representatives. Representatives and non-voting Delegates are elected for two-year terms; the elected will serve in the 112th Congress from January 3, 2011 until January 3, 2013.

zh.t: 2010年美国北马里亚纳群岛联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2010年北马里亚纳群岛国会选举于11月2日举行，选出该领地的美国联邦众议院代表。联邦众议员和无投票权代表的任期均为两年，当选者将在第112届国会任职，任期从2011年1月3日至2013年1月3日。

en.s: The 2010 Connecticut attorney general election was held on Tuesday, November 2, 2010, to elect the 24th attorney general of the state of Connecticut. Five-term incumbent attorney general Richard Blumenthal declined to seek re-election in 2010, instead opting to run for Connecticut's open U.S. Senate seat held by the retiring Christopher Dodd. Blumenthal's decision not to seek a sixth term set-up the first open race for attorney general in the state since Blumenthal's election in 1990.

zh.t: 2010年康涅狄格州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2010年康涅狄格州总检察长选举于2010年11月2日星期二举行，选出该州第24任总检察长。任职五届的现任总检察长理查德·布卢门撒尔决定不竞选连任，而是竞选即将空缺的联邦参议员席位；现任参议员克里斯托弗·多德将退休。布卢门撒尔决定不竞选第六个任期后，康涅狄格州出现了自1990年他首次当选以来首场没有现任者参选的总检察长选举。

en.s: General elections were held in American Samoa on November 2, 2010. The deadline to register as a candidate for the election was September 1, 2010. Voters in American Samoa chose the 20 elected members of the American Samoa House of Representatives. Voters also cast their ballots for the federal Delegate to the United States House of Representatives in Washington, D.C., and proposed revisions to the American Samoan Constitution.

zh.s: 美属萨摩亚大选于2010年11月2日举行。候选人登记截止日期为2010年9月1日。选民选出美属萨摩亚众议院20名民选议员，同时选出一名驻华盛顿哥伦比亚特区的联邦众议院代表，并就美属萨摩亚宪法修订提案投票。

en.s: An election was held on November 2, 2010, to determine who would represent Virginia's 11th congressional district in the United States House of Representatives during the 112th Congress. The seat that was contested is located in Northern Virginia, and includes most of Fairfax County, all of the city of Fairfax, and part of eastern Prince William County. Democrat Gerry Connolly first won the seat in 2008.

zh.t: 2010年弗吉尼亚州第11国会选区联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 2010年11月2日举行选举，选出代表弗吉尼亚州第11国会选区进入第112届国会的联邦众议员。该选区位于北弗吉尼亚，包括费尔法克斯县的大部分地区、整个费尔法克斯市以及威廉王子县东部的一部分。民主党人杰里·康诺利于2008年首次当选该席位。

en.t: 2010 North Carolina House of Representatives election
en.s: An election was held on November 2, 2010 to elect all 120 members to North Carolina's House of Representatives. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including U.S. House of Representatives, and state senate. The primary election was held on May 4, 2010 with a primary run-off held on June 22, 2010.

zh.t: 2010年北卡罗来纳州众议院选举
zh.s: 2010年北卡罗来纳州众议院选举于2010年11月2日举行，改选州众议院全部120名议员。该选举与联邦众议院和州参议院等职位的选举同时进行。初选于2010年5月4日举行，第二轮初选于6月22日举行。

en.s: General elections were held in Oregon on November 2, 2010. Primary elections took place on May 18, 2010.

zh.s: 俄勒冈州大选于2010年11月2日举行。初选于2010年5月18日举行。

en.t: 2010 Connecticut Secretary of the State election
en.s: The 2010 Connecticut Secretary of the State election took place on November 2, 2010, to elect the Secretary of the State of Connecticut. Incumbent Democrat Susan Bysiewicz did not seek re-election to a 4th term, instead opting to run for Governor of Connecticut. Democratic nominee and Majority Leader of the Connecticut House of Representatives Denise Merrill defeated Republican nominee Jerry Farrell Jr.

zh.s: 2010年康涅狄格州州务卿选举于2010年11月2日举行，选出该州州务卿。民主党籍现任州务卿苏珊·拜西维奇决定不竞选第四个任期，而是竞选州长。民主党提名人、康涅狄格州众议院多数党领袖丹妮丝·梅里尔击败共和党提名人杰里·法雷尔二世。

en.s: On November 2, 2010, Washington, D.C., held an election for its mayor. The primary elections occurred on September 14. Vincent Gray won the general election by a wide margin, although many voters wrote in incumbent Mayor Adrian Fenty, whom Gray defeated in the primary.

zh.t: 2010年华盛顿哥伦比亚特区市长选举
zh.s: 华盛顿哥伦比亚特区于2010年11月2日举行市长选举。初选于9月14日举行。文森特·格雷在大选中以较大优势获胜；不过，不少选民仍以手写方式投票支持现任市长阿德里安·芬蒂，格雷此前曾在初选中击败芬蒂。

en.s: The 2010 Arizona House of Representatives election took place on Tuesday, November 2, 2010, with the primary election held on Tuesday, August 24, 2010. Arizona voters elected all 60 members of the Arizona House of Representatives in multi-member districts to serve two-year terms. The election coincided with United States national elections and Arizona state elections, including U.S. Senate, U.S. House, Arizona Governor, and Arizona Senate.

zh.s: 2010年亚利桑那州众议院选举于2010年11月2日星期二举行，初选于同年8月24日星期二举行。亚利桑那州选民选出州众议院全部60名议员；议员从多人选区选出，任期两年。此次选举与美国全国选举和亚利桑那州其他选举同时举行，包括联邦参议员、联邦众议员、州长和州参议员选举。

en.s: The 2010 Alabama House of Representatives elections were held on November 2, 2010. Voters in all 105 districts of the Alabama House of Representatives voted for their representatives. Other elections were also held on November 2. After the election, four Democrats switched parties and became Republicans, thereby bringing the Republican majority to 66-39.

zh.s: 2010年阿拉巴马州众议院选举于2010年11月2日举行。该州众议院105个选区的选民均投票选出代表。选举后，4名民主党人转投共和党，使共和党多数扩大到66席对39席。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Idaho on November 2, 2010. All of Idaho's executive offices were up for election, as well as a United States Senate seat and Idaho's two seats in the United States House of Representatives. Primary elections were held on May 25, 2010.

zh.s: 爱达荷州大选于2010年11月2日举行。该州所有行政职位都进行改选，此外还改选一个联邦参议员席位和两个联邦众议员席位。初选于2010年5月25日举行。

en.s: The 2010 Elections for the Illinois House of Representatives was conducted on Tuesday, November 2, 2010. The 2010 primary election was conducted on Tuesday, February 2, 2010. State Representatives are elected for two-year terms, with the entire House of Representatives up for a vote every two years.

zh.s: 2010年伊利诺伊州众议院选举于2010年11月2日星期二举行。初选于2010年2月2日星期二举行。州众议员任期两年，因此州众议院全部席位每两年都要改选。

en.s: The 2010 Ohio Attorney General election was held on November 2, 2010, concurrently with other statewide offices including a Class 1 Senate election as well as the Governor election. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Richard Cordray was first elected in a 2008 special election, and ran for a full 4-year term, losing to Republican challenger and former 2-term U.S. senator Mike DeWine.

zh.s: 2010年俄亥俄州总检察长选举于2010年11月2日举行，与州内其他全州职位选举同时进行，包括联邦参议院第一类席位和州长选举。民主党籍现任总检察长理查德·科德雷于2008年特别选举中首次当选，随后竞选完整的四年任期，但败给共和党对手、曾任两届联邦参议员的迈克·德温。

en.s: An election was held on November 2, 2010, to elect the Attorney General of Texas. Incumbent Republican Attorney General Greg Abbott successfully ran for re-election and defeated Democratic attorney Barbara Ann Radnofsky with 64.06% of the vote to his final term as attorney general.

zh.t: 2010年得克萨斯州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2010年11月2日举行选举，选出得克萨斯州总检察长。共和党籍现任总检察长格雷格·阿博特成功连任，击败民主党律师芭芭拉·安·拉德诺夫斯基，得票率为64.06%。这是阿博特担任总检察长的最后一个任期。

en.s: An election was held on November 2, 2010, to elect all 50 members to North Carolina's Senate. The election coincided with the elections for other offices, U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, and state house. The primary election was held on May 4, 2010, with a run-off on June 22, 2010. This was the first time since 1896 that Republicans won the most seats in the Senate.

zh.t: 2010年北卡罗来纳州参议院选举
zh.s: 2010年北卡罗来纳州参议院选举于2010年11月2日举行，改选州参议院全部50名议员。选举与联邦参议员、联邦众议员和州众议院等职位的选举同时进行。初选于2010年5月4日举行，第二轮初选于6月22日举行。这是自1896年以来共和党首次在州参议院赢得最多席位。

en.s: The 2010 United States state legislative elections were held on November 2, 2010, halfway through President Barack Obama's first term in office. Elections were held for 88 legislative chambers, with all states but Louisiana, Mississippi, New Jersey, and Virginia holding elections in at least one house. Kansas and New Mexico held elections for their lower, but not upper houses.

zh.s: 2010年美国州议会选举于11月2日举行，时间在巴拉克·奥巴马总统首个任期的中期。共有88个州议会院进行选举。除路易斯安那州、密西西比州、新泽西州和弗吉尼亚州外，其他州至少有一个议院举行选举。堪萨斯州和新墨西哥州只改选下议院，没有改选上议院。

en.s: Elections were held in West Virginia on November 2, 2010. Primary elections took place on May 11, 2010.

zh.s: 西弗吉尼亚州选举于2010年11月2日举行。初选于2010年5月11日举行。

loc: 美国华盛顿哥伦比亚特区

en.t: 2010 United States Shadow Representative election in the District of Columbia
en.s: On November 2, 2010, the District of Columbia held a U.S. House of Representatives election for its shadow representative. Unlike its non-voting delegate, the shadow representative is only recognized by the district and is not officially sworn or seated. Incumbent Shadow Representative Mike Panetta won election to a third term.

zh.t: 2010年哥伦比亚特区影子联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 2010年11月2日，哥伦比亚特区举行影子联邦众议员选举。影子众议员不同于无投票权的国会代表，只获哥伦比亚特区承认，不会正式宣誓就职或入席。现任影子众议员迈克·帕内塔当选第三个任期。

en.s: The 2010 elections for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives were held on November 2, 2010, with all districts being contested. Necessary primary elections were held on May 18, 2010. The term of office for those elected in 2010 will run from January 4, 2011, until November 30, 2012. State Representatives are elected for two-year terms, with the entire House of Representatives up for election every two years.

zh.t: 2010年宾夕法尼亚州众议院选举
zh.s: 2010年宾夕法尼亚州众议院选举于2010年11月2日举行，所有选区都进行改选。初选于2010年5月18日举行。2010年当选的议员任期从2011年1月4日开始，到2012年11月30日结束。州众议员任期两年，因此众议院所有席位每两年都要改选。

en.s: The 2010 mayoral election in Louisville Metro took place on November 2, 2010, alongside other federal, state and local elections. Incumbent Mayor Jerry Abramson was re-elected with 67% of the vote in 2006, after being elected to his first term with 74% of the vote in 2002. He announced his intention not to run for a third consecutive term, and instead run for lieutenant governor of Kentucky in 2011, with Governor Steve Beshear as his running mate.

zh.s: 路易斯维尔都会区市长选举于2010年11月2日举行，与其他联邦、州和地方选举同时进行。现任市长杰里·艾布拉姆森在2002年首次当选，得票率为74%；2006年他以67%的得票率连任。他宣布不竞选连续第三个任期，而是计划在2011年竞选肯塔基州副州长，州长史蒂夫·贝希尔将与他搭档参选。

en.s: The 2010 St. Louis County Executive election took place on November 2, 2010. Incumbent County Executive Charlie Dooley ran for re-election to a second full term. He won the Democratic primary by a closer margin than expected, and faced attorney Bill Corrigan, the Republican nominee, in the general election. Corrigan attacked Dooley over high county property tax rates, while Dooley emphasized his experience in managing the county through the economic crisis.

zh.t: 2010年圣路易斯县县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2010年圣路易斯县县行政长官选举于11月2日举行。现任县行政长官查理·杜利竞选第二个完整任期。他在民主党初选中获胜，但优势小于预期；大选中，他的对手是共和党候选人、律师比尔·科里根。科里根批评杜利任内县财产税过高，杜利则强调自己在经济危机期间管理该县的经验。

en.s: The Washington State Senate elections were held on November 2, 2010, in which about half of the state's 49 legislative districts choose a state senator for a four-year term to the Washington State Senate.

zh.s: 华盛顿州参议院选举于2010年11月2日举行。该州49个州参议院选区中约有一半选出州参议员，任期四年。

en.t: 2010 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 2010 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 2, 2010, alongside other elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic Senator Patty Murray won re-election to a fourth term by a margin of 52.4% to 47.6% over Republican Dino Rossi, who had run for governor in 2004 and 2008.

zh.t: 2010年美国华盛顿州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2010年美国华盛顿州联邦参议员选举于11月2日举行，与其他州的联邦参议员、联邦众议员以及各州和地方选举同时进行。民主党籍现任参议员帕蒂·默里以52.4%对47.6%的得票率击败共和党人迪诺·罗西，成功连任第四个任期。罗西曾在2004年和2008年竞选州长。

en.s: The 2010 New York State Senate elections were held on November 2, 2010, to elect representatives from all 62 State Senate districts in the U.S. state of New York. Primary elections were held on September 14, 2010. Republicans retook the Senate majority, winning 32 seats to the Democrats' 30 on Election Day. One Republican Senate incumbent, Senator Frank Padavan of Queens, was defeated, while four Democratic incumbents (Sens.

zh.s: 2010年纽约州参议院选举于11月2日举行，改选该州全部62个参议院选区的代表。初选于2010年9月14日举行。共和党在选举日重新取得参议院多数席位，以32席对民主党的30席。皇后区共和党籍现任参议员弗兰克·帕达万落选；此外，4名民主党籍现任参议员也……

en.s: The 2010 Cuyahoga County Council election was held on November 2, 2010 to elect all 11 members of the newly formed County Council of Cuyahoga County, Ohio. This was the first held under the newly ratified Charter of Cuyahoga County, which replaced Cuyahoga's 200 year old Board of County Commissioners with an executive and legislature. Democrats won control of the body with 8 seats to the 3 won by Republicans.

zh.t: 2010年俄亥俄州凯霍加县议会选举
zh.s: 2010年俄亥俄州凯霍加县议会选举于11月2日举行，选出新成立的县议会全部11名成员。这是凯霍加县批准新宪章后的首次选举；新宪章以行政长官和立法机构取代了有200年历史的县委员委员会。民主党赢得8席，共和党赢得3席，民主党因此控制议会。

en.s: The 2010 United States Senate elections were held on November 2, 2010, from among the United States Senate's 100 seats. A special election was held on January 19, 2010, for a midterm vacancy in Massachusetts. 34 of the November elections were for 6-year terms to the Senate's Class 3, while other 3 were special elections to finish incomplete terms.

zh.s: 2010年美国联邦参议院选举于11月2日举行，改选联邦参议院100个席位中的部分席位。2010年1月19日，马萨诸塞州还举行了一场特别选举，以填补中期空缺。11月选举中有34场是选出参议院第三类议员的六年任期，另有3场特别选举用于完成未满任期。

en.s: The 2010 Georgia House of Representatives elections occurred on November 2, 2010, to elect the members to the Georgia House of Representatives. All 180 seats in the state House were up for two-year terms. The winners of this election cycle served in the 151st Georgia General Assembly. It was the last election to the House before the 2010 redistricting cycle based on the 2010 United States census.

zh.s: 2010年佐治亚州众议院选举于11月2日举行，选出该州众议员。州众议院全部180个席位都进行改选，任期两年。胜选者将在佐治亚州第151届议会任职。这是根据2010年美国人口普查重新划分选区前的最后一次众议院选举。

en.s: The 2010 Lexington, Kentucky mayoral election was held on November 2, 2010. The primary election was held on May 18, with the top two candidates advancing to the general election. Incumbent mayor Jim Newberry, who was elected in 2006, was defeated for reelection by councilman Jim Gray. Mayoral elections in Lexington are nonpartisan; both Newberry and Gray were members of the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 2010年肯塔基州列克星敦市市长选举
zh.s: 2010年肯塔基州列克星敦市市长选举于11月2日举行。初选于5月18日举行，得票最高的两名候选人进入大选。2006年当选的现任市长吉姆·纽伯里败给市议员吉姆·格雷。列克星敦市长选举以无党派方式举行，但纽伯里和格雷都属于民主党。

en.s: The 2010 New York gubernatorial election was held on Tuesday, November 2, 2010. Incumbent Democratic governor David Paterson, who was elected as lieutenant governor in 2006 as the running mate of Eliot Spitzer, and became governor in 2008 following Spitzer's resignation, initially ran for a full term but withdrew in February 2010. Democratic New York Attorney General Andrew Cuomo defeated Republican Carl Paladino to become the next governor of New York.

zh.s: 2010年纽约州州长选举于11月2日（星期二）举行。民主党籍现任州长戴维·帕特森于2006年作为艾略特·斯皮策的副州长竞选搭档当选，并在斯皮策辞职后于2008年接任州长。他起初竞选完整任期，但于2010年2月退选。纽约州总检察长、民主党人安德鲁·科莫击败共和党人卡尔·帕拉迪诺，当选州长。

en.s: The 2010 Georgia State Senate elections occurred on November 2, 2010, to elect the members to the Georgia State Senate. All fifty-six seats in the state Senate and all 180 seats in the state House were up for two year terms. The winners of this election cycle served in the 151st Georgia General Assembly. Democrat Tim Golden became a Republican shortly after the election, which gave Republicans a 36–20 majority.

zh.s: 2010年佐治亚州参议院选举于11月2日举行，选出州参议员。州参议院全部56个席位和州众议院全部180个席位都进行改选，任期两年。胜选者将在佐治亚州第151届议会任职。民主党人蒂姆·戈尔登在选举后不久转投共和党，共和党因此以36席对20席占多数。

en.t: 2010 Cook County Board of Commissioners election
en.s: The 2010 Cook County Board of Commissioners election was held on November 2, 2010. It was preceded by a primary election held on February 5, 2010. It coincided with other 2010 Cook County, Illinois, elections (including the election for president of the Cook County Board of Commissioners). It saw all seventeen seats of the Cook County Board of Commissioners up for election to four-year terms.

zh.t: 2010年伊利诺伊州库克县委员委员会选举
zh.s: 2010年伊利诺伊州库克县委员委员会选举于11月2日举行。初选于2010年2月5日举行。此次选举与其他2010年库克县选举同时进行，包括库克县委员委员会主席选举。委员委员会全部17个席位都进行改选，任期四年。

en.s: The Cook County, Illinois, general election was held on November 2, 2010. Primaries were held February 2, 2010. Elections were held for Assessor, Clerk, Sheriff, Treasurer, President of the Cook County Board of Commissioners, all 17 seats of the Cook County Board of Commissioners, Cook County Board of Review district 1, three seats on the Water Reclamation District Board, and judgeships on the Circuit Court of Cook County.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州库克县大选于2010年11月2日举行。初选于2010年2月2日举行。选举改选了县评估官、县书记官、警长、财政官、库克县委员会主席、县委员会全部17个席位、库克县复核委员会第一选区席位、区域水务管理委员会3个席位，以及库克县巡回法院的法官职位。

en.s: The 2010 Jefferson County, Missouri Executive election took place on November 2, 2010. The 2010 election was the first election for the position after voters approved the County Charter in the 2008 election, which temporarily converted the County Commission into a Board of Executives until the County Executive and a full, seven-member County Council could be elected.

zh.t: 2010年密苏里州杰斐逊县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2010年密苏里州杰斐逊县行政长官选举于2010年11月2日举行。这是选民在2008年选举中批准县宪章后，该职位首次举行选举。县宪章曾暂时将县委员会改为行政委员会，直至选出县行政长官和由7名成员组成的县议会。

en.t: 2010 United States Senate special election in New York
en.s: The 2010 United States Senate special election in New York took place on November 2, 2010, concurrently with other elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Governor David Paterson had appointed Kirsten Gillibrand to serve as United States Senator from New York until the 2010 special election, replacing former senator Hillary Clinton, who resigned to serve as Secretary of State in the Barack Obama administration.

zh.t: 2010年纽约州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 2010年纽约州联邦参议员特别选举于2010年11月2日举行，与其他州的联邦参议员、联邦众议院以及多项州和地方选举同时进行。州长戴维·帕特森曾任命柯尔斯滕·吉利布兰德担任纽约州联邦参议员，直至2010年特别选举。她接替了辞职后加入巴拉克·奥巴马政府、担任国务卿的前参议员希拉里·克林顿。

en.t: 2010 United States House of Representatives elections in Georgia
en.s: Elections were held on November 2, 2010, to determine Georgia's 13 members of the United States House of Representatives. Representatives were elected for two-year terms to serve in the 112th United States Congress from January 3, 2011, until January 3, 2013. Primary elections were held on July 20, 2010, and primary runoff elections were held on August 10, 2010.

zh.t: 2010年佐治亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2010年11月2日举行选举，选出佐治亚州13名联邦众议员，任期为两年，进入第112届国会，任期从2011年1月3日至2013年1月3日。初选于2010年7月20日举行，第二轮初选于8月10日举行。

en.s: The 2010 Oakland mayoral election was held on November 2, 2010, to elect the mayor of Oakland, California, electing Jean Quan to be their mayor. In early August 2010 (prior to the first election using "instant-runoff" voting), incumbent mayor Ron Dellums announced that he would not be seeking reelection to a second term.

zh.s: 2010年奥克兰市长选举于2010年11月2日举行，选出加利福尼亚州奥克兰市市长，简·关当选。2010年8月初，现任市长罗恩·戴勒姆斯宣布不竞选连任第二个任期；该市此前尚未使用即时决选制举行选举。

en.s: The 2010 New York State Assembly elections were held on Tuesday, November 2, 2010, with the primary election on September 14, 2010. Voters in the 150 districts of the New York State Assembly elected their representatives. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including for governor, U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, and state senate.

zh.s: 2010年纽约州众议院选举于2010年11月2日星期二举行，初选于2010年9月14日举行。纽约州150个选区的选民选出各自的众议员。选举与州长、联邦参议员、联邦众议员和州参议员等职位的选举同时进行。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Georgia on November 2, 2010. All of Georgia's executive officers were up for election as well as a United States Senate seat, all of Georgia's thirteen seats in the United States House of Representatives and all seats in both houses of the Georgia General Assembly. Primary elections were held on July 20, 2010.

zh.s: 佐治亚州大选于2010年11月2日举行。该州所有行政职位、一个联邦参议员席位、联邦众议院全部13个席位，以及佐治亚州议会两院的所有席位都进行改选。初选于2010年7月20日举行。

en.s: Two elections in New York's 29th district were held on November 2, 2010. The candidates vied to replace Eric Massa, who resigned the seat on March 8, 2010, as a result of health issues and allegations of sexual harassment.

zh.s: 纽约州第29国会选区于2010年11月2日举行两场选举，选出代表该选区的联邦众议员。选举是为接替埃里克·马萨而举行；他于2010年3月8日因健康问题和性骚扰指控辞去席位。

en.t: 2010 United States Senate election in Georgia
en.s: The 2010 United States Senate election in Georgia took place on November 2, 2010. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Johnny Isakson won re-election to a second term.

zh.t: 2010年佐治亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2010年佐治亚州联邦参议员选举于2010年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任联邦参议员约翰尼·艾萨克森成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 2, 2010, in 37 states (with a special election in Utah) and two territories. These elections coincided with the elections for the United States Senate and the United States House of Representatives as well as other state and local elections. As in most midterm elections, the party controlling the White House lost ground.

zh.s: 2010年11月2日，美国37个州和两个属地举行州长选举，犹他州另举行一场特别选举。选举与联邦参议院、联邦众议院以及其他州和地方选举同时进行。与多数中期选举一样，执政党在国会和州长职位上有所失利。

en.s: The 2010 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 2010. Incumbent Republican governor Sonny Perdue was term-limited and unable to seek re-election. Primary elections for the Republican and Democratic parties took place on July 20. Democrats nominated former governor Roy Barnes, and Republicans nominated Representative Nathan Deal following a runoff on August 10. The Libertarian Party also had ballot access and nominated John Monds.

zh.s: 2010年佐治亚州州长选举于2010年11月2日举行。共和党籍现任州长桑尼·珀杜因任期限制，不能竞选连任。共和党和民主党初选都于7月20日举行。民主党提名了前州长罗伊·巴恩斯；共和党提名了联邦众议员内森·迪尔，后者在8月10日的第二轮初选中胜出。自由党也取得了参选资格，并提名约翰·蒙兹。

en.s: The 2010 Macomb County Executive election was held on November 2, 2010. The 2010 election was the first election for the position after voters approved the Macomb County Charter in a 2009 election. Sheriff Mark Hackel won the Democratic nomination unopposed and faced Republican nominee Randell Shafer, a retired U.S. Army officer, and former St. Clair Shores City Councilwoman Erin Stahl, the Libertarian nominee, in the general election.

zh.t: 2010年密歇根州马科姆县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2010年密歇根州马科姆县行政长官选举于2010年11月2日举行。这是选民在2009年选举中批准马科姆县宪章后，该职位首次举行选举。警长马克·哈克尔在民主党初选中无人竞争，随后在大选中面对共和党提名人、美国陆军退役军官兰德尔·谢弗，以及自由党提名人、圣克莱尔海岸市前市议员艾琳·斯塔尔。

en.s: The 2010 Anaheim mayoral election was held on November 2, 2010, to elect the mayor of Anaheim, California. It saw the election of Tom Tait. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan.

zh.t: 2010年加利福尼亚州阿纳海姆市长选举
zh.s: 2010年加利福尼亚州阿纳海姆市长选举于2010年11月2日举行，汤姆·泰特当选。加利福尼亚州的市政选举正式不设党派。

en.t: 2010 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 2010 United States Senate election in New York took place on November 2, 2010, along with elections to the United States Senate in other states, as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democrat U.S. Senator Chuck Schumer won re-election to a third term. Schumer won every county except for Wyoming, Tioga, and Hamilton counties.

zh.s: 2010年纽约州联邦参议员选举于2010年11月2日举行，与其他州的联邦参议员和联邦众议员选举以及各项州和地方选举同时进行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员查克·舒默成功连任第三个任期。他赢得了除怀俄明县、蒂奥加县和汉密尔顿县以外的所有县。

en.s: The 2010 Cuyahoga County Executive election took place on November 2, 2010, to elect the County Executive of Cuyahoga County, Ohio. This was the first held under the newly ratified Charter of Cuyahoga County, which replaced Cuyahoga's 200 year old Board of County Commissioners with an executive and legislature, establishing the office of County Executive. The Democrats nominated the mayor of Lakewood Ed FitzGerald, while the Republicans nominated former Ohio State Representative Matt Dolan.

zh.t: 2010年俄亥俄州库亚霍加县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2010年俄亥俄州库亚霍加县行政长官选举于2010年11月2日举行，选出该县行政长官。这是库亚霍加县新宪章获批后的首次选举。该宪章以行政长官和立法机关取代了已有200年历史的县委员会，并设立县行政长官职位。民主党提名了莱克伍德市市长埃德·菲茨杰拉德；共和党提名了俄亥俄州前众议员马特·多兰。

en.s: The New York Attorney General election of 2010 took place on November 2, 2010 to elect the Attorney General of New York. Democratic nominee Eric Schneiderman defeated Republican nominee Dan Donovan. Previous Democratic Attorney General Andrew Cuomo vacated the office following his run for governor.

zh.s: 2010年纽约州总检察长选举于2010年11月2日举行。民主党提名人埃里克·施奈德曼击败共和党提名人丹·多诺万。前民主党籍总检察长安德鲁·科莫在竞选州长后离开了该职位。

en.s: The 2010 Wayne County Executive election was held on November 2, 2010. Incumbent County Executive Robert A. Ficano ran for re-election to his third term. He faced no opposition in the Democratic primary and faced Mario Nesr Fundarski, a businessman and the Republican nominee, in the general election. Ficano defeated Fundarski in a landslide, winning 75 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 2010年韦恩县县行政长官选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任行政长官罗伯特·A·菲卡诺竞选第三个任期。他在无人竞争的情况下赢得民主党初选，大选对手是商人、共和党候选人马里奥·内斯尔·芬达斯基。菲卡诺以压倒性优势获胜，得票率为75%。

en.s: The 2010 Jackson Executive election took place on November 2, 2010. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Mike Sanders contemplated running for Mayor of Kansas City in 2011, but ultimately decided to run for re-election to a second term. He was unopposed in the Democratic primary, and faced former County Legislator Robert Stringfield, the Republican nominee, and retiree Junior Tolbert, the Reform Party nominee, in the general election.

zh.t: 2010年杰克逊县县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2010年杰克逊县县行政长官选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任行政长官迈克·桑德斯曾考虑在2011年竞选堪萨斯城市长，但最终决定竞选连任第二个任期。他在民主党初选中无人竞争，大选对手是共和党候选人、前县议员罗伯特·斯特林菲尔德和改革党候选人、退休人士朱尼尔·托尔伯特。

en.t: 2010 San Francisco Board of Supervisors election
en.s: The 2010 San Francisco Board of Supervisors elections were held on November 2, 2010. Five of the eleven seats of the San Francisco Board of Supervisors were contested in this election. Four incumbents were termed out of office, while one ran for reelection. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan, though most candidates in San Francisco do receive funding and support from various political parties.

zh.s: 2010年旧金山市监事会选举于11月2日举行，改选监事会11个席位中的5席。4名现任监事因任期限制不能参选，另有1人竞选连任。加利福尼亚州的市政选举正式以无党派方式举行，但旧金山多数候选人都会获得各政党的资金和支持。

en.s: The 2010 Georgia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 2010, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Georgia. Republican nominee and incumbent lieutenant governor Casey Cagle defeated Democratic nominee Carol Porter and Libertarian nominee Dan Barber.

zh.s: 2010年佐治亚州副州长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州副州长。共和党候选人、现任副州长凯西·凯格尔击败民主党候选人卡罗尔·波特和自由意志党候选人丹·巴伯。

en.s: The 2010 St. Charles County Executive election took place on November 2, 2010. Incumbent County Executive Steve Ehlmann ran for re-election to a second term. He defeated retired autoworker Charles Davis in the Republican primary, receiving 78 percent of the vote. In the general election, he faced no opposition and won his second term uncontested.

zh.t: 2010年圣查尔斯县县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2010年圣查尔斯县县行政长官选举于11月2日举行。现任县行政长官史蒂夫·埃尔曼竞选连任第二个任期。他在共和党初选中击败退休汽车工人查尔斯·戴维斯，获得78%的选票。大选中他没有对手，未经竞争便赢得第二个任期。

en.s: The Navajo Nation presidential election of 2010 was held on Tuesday, November 2, 2010. Ben Shelly won the election. The general election was held between New Mexico State Senator Lynda Lovejoy and outgoing Navajo Nation Vice President Ben Shelly. The primary election was held on August 3, 2010. Lynda Lovejoy won a plurality of the vote, becoming the first woman to do so.

zh.s: 2010年纳瓦霍族总统选举于11月2日（星期二）举行。选举在新墨西哥州参议员琳达·洛夫乔伊和即将卸任的纳瓦霍族副总统本·谢利之间进行，谢利获胜。初选于2010年8月3日举行。洛夫乔伊在初选中获得相对多数，成为首位做到这一点的女性。

en.s: The 2010 elections for the Oregon Legislative Assembly determined the composition of both houses for the 76th Oregon Legislative Assembly. The Republican and Democratic primary elections were on May 18, 2010, and the general election was held on November 2, 2010. Sixteen of the Oregon State Senate's thirty seats were up for election, as were all 60 seats of the Oregon House of Representatives.

zh.s: 2010年俄勒冈州立法机关选举决定第76届俄勒冈州议会两院的席位分配。共和党和民主党初选于2010年5月18日举行，大选于11月2日举行。俄勒冈州参议院30个席位中有16席改选，州众议院全部60个席位也都改选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2010 Michigan Senate elections were held on November 2 of that year, with partisan primaries to determine each party's nominees on August 3. The election was the last contested under constituency boundaries drawn as a result of the 2000 U.S. census, and members served in the 96th and 97th Legislatures.

zh.s: 2010年密歇根州参议院选举于当年11月2日举行，各党于8月3日举行党派初选，确定候选人。此次选举是最后一次使用根据2000年美国人口普查划定的选区。当选议员分别在第96届和第97届密歇根州议会任职。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The New York comptroller election of 2010 involved the first election campaign of Democrat Thomas DiNapoli to the Office of State Comptroller. DiNapoli was appointed as Comptroller by a joint session of the New York State Legislature on February 7, 2007. In the general election on November 2, 2010, DiNapoli defeated Republican nominee Harry Wilson to be elected to his first full term in office.

zh.s: 2010年纽约州州审计长选举是民主党人托马斯·迪纳波利首次竞选该职位。迪纳波利于2007年2月7日由纽约州议会联席会议任命为州审计长。2010年11月2日举行的大选中，他击败共和党提名人哈里·威尔逊，当选完整任期。

en.t: 2010 New Mexico House of Representatives election
en.s: The 2010 New Mexico House of Representatives election took place as part of the biennial United States elections. New Mexico voters elected state representatives in all 70 of the state house's districts. State representatives serve two-year terms in the New Mexico House of Representatives. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including for Governor, U.S. House, and Attorney General.

zh.s: 2010年新墨西哥州众议院选举是当年美国定期选举的一部分。新墨西哥州选民在州众议院全部70个选区选出议员，任期两年。该选举与州长、联邦众议员和总检察长等职位的选举同时举行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: In the elections to the Massachusetts State Senate in 2010, the Democrats continued their dominance, winning 36 seats against 4 seats for the Republicans.

zh.s: 2010年马萨诸塞州参议院选举中，民主党继续保持优势，赢得36席，共和党获得4席。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2010 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 2010 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in half of the state senate's districts—the 25 odd-numbered state senate districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate, with half of the seats up for election each cycle. The primary election on June 8, 2010, determined which candidates appeared on the November 2, 2010 general election ballot.

zh.s: 2010年艾奥瓦州参议院选举是2010年美国定期选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民选出参议院50个选区中一半的议员，即25个奇数编号选区的议员。州参议员任期四年，每个选举周期改选一半席位。2010年6月8日举行的初选确定了进入11月2日大选的候选人。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.t: Texas elects all 150 members of its state House of Representatives
en.s: On November 2, 2010, Texans voted for all 150 seats in the Texas House of Representatives. Republicans won a majority of House seats in the election.
en.n: All 150 Texas House seats were contested on November 2, 2010.

zh.t: 美国得克萨斯州改选全部150个州众议院席位
zh.s: 2010年11月2日，美国得克萨斯州举行州众议院选举，全部150个席位都由选民投票改选。共和党在这次选举后取得州众议院多数席位。
zh.n: 得克萨斯州众议院全部150个席位都在2010年11月2日改选。

en.s: Municipal elections were held in San Diego in 2010 for city council and propositions. The primary election was held on June 8, 2010, and the general election was held on November 2, 2010. Four of the eight seats of the San Diego City Council were contested. This was the last election to use eight council districts. Two incumbents ran for reelection in their council district.

zh.s: 2010年圣迭戈举行了市议会选举和公投提案表决。初选于2010年6月8日举行，大选于11月2日举行。圣迭戈市议会8个席位中有4席改选。这是该市最后一次使用8个市议会选区举行选举。两名现任议员在各自选区竞选连任。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: Virginia's 8th congressional district election, 2010 was an election held to determine who would represent Virginia's 8th congressional district in the United States House of Representatives during the 112th Congress. The seat contested is located in Northern Virginia, and includes part of Fairfax County, the city of Alexandria, and all of Arlington County. Since 1990, the 8th district had been represented by 10-term Democratic incumbent Jim Moran.

zh.t: 2010年弗吉尼亚州第8国会选区联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 2010年举行弗吉尼亚州第8国会选区联邦众议员选举，选出代表该选区进入第112届国会的议员。该选区位于北弗吉尼亚，包括费尔法克斯县的一部分、亚历山德里亚市和整个阿灵顿县。自1990年以来，该选区一直由已任10届的民主党籍现任众议员吉姆·莫兰代表。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2010 Indian Super Cup was the 9th Indian Super Cup, an annual football match contested by the winners of the previous season's I-League and Federation Cup competitions. The match was between Dempo and East Bengal with Dempo winning 3-1. The match was played in Gurgaon, In 2010. The Man of the Match was Bryan Cohen of Dempo.

zh.s: 2010年印度超级杯是第9届印度超级杯。这项年度足球赛由上一赛季印度足球联赛和联邦杯的冠军球队对阵。本届由邓波队对阵东孟加拉队，邓波队以3比1获胜。比赛于2010年在古尔冈举行，邓波队的布莱恩·科恩当选最佳球员。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2010 Shreveport mayoral election resulted in the re-election of incumbent Democrat Cedric Glover who defeated Republican Bryan Wooley in the runoff to win a second term in office. The nonpartisan blanket primary was held on October 2, 2010, and as no candidate obtained the required majority, the general election followed on November 2, 2010.
en.n: This entry records the runoff, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 2010年路易斯安那州什里夫波特市长选举
zh.s: 2010年路易斯安那州什里夫波特市长选举中，民主党籍现任市长塞德里克·格洛弗在第二轮选举中击败共和党人布赖恩·伍利，成功连任第二个任期。无党派综合初选于2010年10月2日举行。由于没有候选人达到规定的多数，11月2日举行了大选。
zh.n: 此条记录对应原文资料框列出的第二轮选举日期。

en.s: The 2012–2014 Quneitra Governorate clashes began in early November 2012, when the Syrian Army began engaging with rebels in several towns and villages of the Quneitra Governorate. The clashes quickly intensified and extended into the United Nations-monitored demilitarized zone along the ceasefire line with the Israeli-controlled Golan Heights, which Israel considers as a sensitive security area.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 库奈特拉省冲突始于2012年11月上旬。当时，叙利亚军队开始在库奈特拉省多个城镇和村庄与反政府武装交战。冲突迅速升级，并蔓延至联合国监测的非军事区；该区域沿停火线延伸，与以色列控制的戈兰高地相邻。以色列将戈兰高地视为敏感安全区。
zh.n: 本条目采用来源信息框标注的开始日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: 2013 J.League Cup final was the 21st final of the J.League Cup competition. The final was played at National Stadium in Tokyo on November 2, 2013. Kashiwa Reysol won the championship.

zh.s: 2013年J联赛杯决赛是J联赛杯的第21届决赛。比赛于2013年11月2日在东京国立竞技场举行。柏太阳神赢得冠军。

en.s: The 2013 AFC Cup final was the final of the 2013 AFC Cup, the 10th edition of the AFC Cup, a football competition organized by the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) for clubs from "developing countries" in Asia. The final was contested as a single match between two Kuwaiti teams, Al-Qadsia and Al-Kuwait. The match was hosted by Al-Qadsia at the Al-Sadaqua Walsalam Stadium in Kuwait City on 2 November 2013.

zh.s: 2013年亚足联杯决赛是亚足联杯的第10届决赛。亚足联为亚洲“发展中国家”的俱乐部组织这项足球赛事。决赛由两支科威特球队卡迪西亚和科威特体育会进行单场较量。比赛于2013年11月2日在科威特城的萨达卡与萨拉姆体育场举行，由卡迪西亚主办。

en.s: El Castillo del Terror (2014) was a professional wrestling event, the tenth annual El Castillo del Terror event produced by the International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG). IWRG has held an Castillo del Terror branded show since 2005, usually late in the year, making this year's event the tenth overall event in the series. The event took place on November 2, 2014, at Arena Naucalpan in Naucalpan, State of Mexico. The main event was the eponymous Castillo del Terror (Spanish for "Castle of Terror") Steel cage match where the last person eliminated was forced to unmasked per the match stipulation.

zh.s: 2014年“恐怖城堡”赛事是国际摔角革命集团（IWRG）举办的第十届年度职业摔角赛事。IWRG自2005年以来每年都会举办“恐怖城堡”主题赛事，通常安排在年末，因此2014年赛事是该系列的第十届。赛事于2014年11月2日在墨西哥州瑙卡尔潘的瑙卡尔潘竞技场举行。主赛是同名钢笼赛，按比赛规则，最后被淘汰的人被强制摘下面具。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2014 FAI Cup final was the final match of the 2014 FAI Cup, the national association football cup of the Republic of Ireland. The match took place on 2 November 2014 at the Aviva Stadium in Dublin, and was contested between Derry City and St Patrick's Athletic, with St. Pat's being the winners by two goals to nil.

zh.s: 2014年爱尔兰足协杯决赛是该年度爱尔兰共和国国内足球杯赛的决赛。比赛于2014年11月2日在都柏林的英杰华体育场举行，由德里城对阵圣帕特里克竞技。圣帕特里克竞技以2比0获胜。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Romania in 2014. They were the seventh presidential elections held in post-1989 Romania. In the first round of the elections on 2 November, the top two of the fourteen candidates qualified in a run-off on 16 November.
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 罗马尼亚于2014年举行总统选举，这是1989年后该国举行的第七次总统选举。首轮投票于11月2日举行，14名候选人中得票最高的两人进入11月16日的第二轮投票。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的首轮投票日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2014–2015 India–Pakistan border skirmishes were a series of armed clashes and exchanges of gunfire that first began between the India's Border Security Force and the Pakistan Rangers: the border patrolling forces of both nations, responsible for patrolling the India-Pakistan border), but quickly escalated in to exchange along the Line of Control (LoC) in the disputed Kashmir region between Indian Army and Pakistan Army.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2014—2015年印巴边境冲突是一系列武装冲突和交火，最初发生在印度边境安全部队与巴基斯坦游骑兵部队之间；两者分别负责巡逻印巴边境。冲突很快升级，沿争议地区克什米尔的实际控制线蔓延，印度和巴基斯坦军队在此交火。
zh.n: 本条目采用来源信息框标注的结束日期。
