en.s: The Apertura 2016 Copa MX final was the final of the Apertura 2016 Copa MX, the ninth edition of the Copa MX under its current format and 76th overall organized by the Mexican Football Federation, the governing body of association football in Mexico. The final was contested in a single leg format between Liga MX clubs Querétaro and Guadalajara.

zh.t: 2016年墨西哥杯（Copa MX）秋季赛决赛
zh.s: 2016年墨西哥杯（Copa MX）秋季赛决赛，是现行赛制下第9届墨西哥杯的决赛，也是墨西哥足球联合会主办的第76届赛事决赛。本场采用单场决胜制，由墨超俱乐部克雷塔罗和瓜达拉哈拉交锋。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: El Castillo del Terror (2017) (Spanish for "The Tower of Terror") was a major professional wrestling event, the eleventh annual El Castillo del Terror event, produced by the International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG) that took place on November 2, 2017. IWRG has held their Castillo del Terror show since 2005, usually late in the year.

zh.s: 2017年“恐怖城堡”赛事是国际摔角革命集团（IWRG）举办的第11届年度职业摔角赛事。“恐怖城堡”一词在西班牙语中意为“恐怖塔”。IWRG自2005年以来每年都会举办这项赛事，通常安排在年末。2017年赛事于11月2日举行。

en.s: The CMLL Día de Muertos (2018) (Spanish for "Day of the Dead") is a professional wrestling pay-per-view event, scripted and produced by the Mexican Lucha Libre promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL). The show took place on November 2, 2018, in CMLL's main venue, Arena México, in Mexico City, Mexico and celebrated the Mexican Day of the Dead celebration.

zh.t: 2018年墨西哥摔角理事会亡灵节赛事
zh.s: 2018年墨西哥摔角理事会亡灵节赛事是一场职业摔角付费观看赛事，由墨西哥摔角推广机构墨西哥摔角理事会（CMLL）策划并制作。“Día de Muertos”在西班牙语中意为“亡灵节”。赛事于2018年11月2日在墨西哥城的墨西哥竞技场（CMLL主场馆）举行，庆祝墨西哥亡灵节。

en.s: The 2018 Crown Jewel was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by the American company WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw and SmackDown. It was the inaugural Crown Jewel and took place on Friday, November 2, 2018, at the King Saud University Stadium in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The main card aired live at 7:00 p.m.

zh.s: 2018年皇冠珠宝大赛是职业摔角付费观看和网络直播赛事，由美国公司WWE制作，参赛选手来自其主力品牌Raw和SmackDown。这是首届皇冠珠宝大赛，于2018年11月2日（星期五）在沙特阿拉伯利雅得的沙特国王大学体育场举行。主赛于晚上7时现场直播。

en.s: UFC 244: Masvidal vs. Diaz was a mixed martial arts pay-per-view event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on November 2, 2019, at Madison Square Garden in New York City, New York, United States. It was the UFC's 500th live event.

zh.s: UFC 244：马斯维达尔对阵迪亚兹是一场综合格斗付费观看赛事，由终极格斗冠军赛（UFC）主办，于2019年11月2日在美国纽约州纽约市麦迪逊广场花园举行。这是UFC第500场现场赛事。

en.s: Saturday Night SuperFight was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the Major League Wrestling (MLW) promotion, which took place at the Cicero Stadium in Cicero, Illinois on November 2, 2019. It was MLW's first pay-per-view event and the second event under the Superfight chronology. The event aired live on traditional PPV outlets and FITE TV.

zh.s: 周六夜超级格斗是美国职业摔角联盟（MLW）制作的一场付费观看赛事，于2019年11月2日在伊利诺伊州锡塞罗市的锡塞罗体育场举行。这是MLW首场付费观看赛事，也是“超级格斗”系列的第二场赛事。赛事通过传统付费频道和FITE TV现场直播。

en.s: The 2019 Thai FA Cup final was the final match of the 2019 Thai FA Cup, the 26th season of a Thailand's football tournament organised by Football Association of Thailand. It was played at the Leo Stadium in Pathum Thani, Thailand on 2 November 2019, between Ratchaburi Mitr Phol a big team from the Western part and Port a big team from the capital of Thailand.

zh.s: 2019年泰国足协杯决赛是泰国足协主办的第26届足球杯赛决赛。比赛于2019年11月2日在泰国巴吞他尼府的Leo体育场举行，由来自西部的强队叻丕府米特波尔队对阵来自泰国首都的强队港口队。

en.s: The 2019 Muscogee (Creek) general elections took place on November 2, 2019, to elect the Principal Chief, Second Chief, and half of the 16 National Council seats of the Muscogee Nation. The primary election was held on September 21 and in races where no one candidate won a majority of the votes, the top candidates moved on to the November general election.

zh.s: 马斯科吉族于2019年11月2日举行大选，选出首席酋长、副首席酋长和马斯科吉族议会16个席位中的一半。初选于9月21日举行；如果没有候选人获得过半选票，得票最高的候选人进入11月大选。

en.s: The 2019 Malaysia Cup final was a football match which were played on 2 November 2019, to determine the champion of the 2019 Malaysia Cup. It was the final of the 93rd edition of the Malaysia Cup, competition organised by the Football Association of Malaysia. The match was played at the Bukit Jalil National Stadium in Kuala Lumpur between Kedah and Johor Darul Ta'zim.

zh.s: 2019年马来西亚杯决赛于2019年11月2日举行，决出当年马来西亚杯冠军。这是由马来西亚足球协会主办的第93届赛事。比赛在吉隆坡武吉加里尔国家体育场举行，由吉打队对阵柔佛达鲁塔克欣队。

en.s: The 2019 LEN Super Cup was the 38th edition of the annual trophy organised by LEN and contested by the reigning champions of the two European competitions for men's water polo clubs. The match was played between European champions Ferencváros (winners of the 2018–19 LEN Champions League) and CN Marseille (winners of the 2018–19 LEN Euro Cup) at the Piscine Pierre Garsau in Marseille, France, on 2 November 2019.

zh.s: 2019年LEN超级杯是LEN举办的第38届年度奖杯赛事，由欧洲男子水球俱乐部两项赛事的卫冕冠军参赛。比赛于2019年11月2日在法国马赛的皮埃尔·加尔索游泳馆举行，对阵双方是欧洲冠军费伦茨瓦罗斯（2018—19赛季LEN冠军联赛冠军）和马赛水球俱乐部（2018—19赛季LEN欧洲杯冠军）。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: On 2 November 2020, a series of shootings took place in Vienna, Austria a few hours before the city was scheduled to enter a lockdown as a result of the COVID-19 pandemic. A lone gunman started shooting in the busy city centre, killing four civilians and injuring 23 others, seven critically, including a police officer. The attacker was killed by police and was later identified as an ISIL sympathizer.

zh.s: 2020年11月2日，奥地利维也纳发生一系列枪击事件。当晚数小时后，该市原计划因新冠疫情进入封锁。枪手在市中心繁忙地段开枪，造成4名平民死亡、23人受伤，其中7人伤势严重，伤者包括一名警察。警方将袭击者击毙，之后确认他同情伊斯兰国。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: An election for the mayor of New York City was held on November 2, 2021. Incumbent mayor Bill de Blasio was term-limited and ineligible to run for re-election. Democratic Brooklyn Borough president and former police officer Eric Adams won the election in a landslide, defeating Republican candidate Curtis Sliwa. Adams became the city's second Black mayor. Primary elections took place on June 22, 2021.

zh.s: 纽约市市长选举于2021年11月2日举行。现任市长比尔·白思豪受任期限制，不能竞选连任。民主党籍布鲁克林区区长、前警察埃里克·亚当斯以压倒性优势胜出，击败共和党候选人柯蒂斯·斯利瓦。亚当斯成为纽约市第二位黑人市长。初选于2021年6月22日举行。

en.s: The 2021 Dearborn mayoral election took place on November 2, 2021, following a primary election on August 3, 2021. Incumbent Mayor John B. O'Reilly Jr. declined to seek re-election, creating an open seat for the first time in thirty-six years. A crowded field emerged to succeed O'Reilly, and in the primary, State Representative Abdullah Hammoud placed first, receiving 42 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 2021年迪尔伯恩市长选举于11月2日举行，初选于2021年8月3日举行。现任市长约翰·B·奥赖利二世决定不竞选连任，这是36年来首次出现空缺席位。多名候选人参选接替奥赖利；初选中，州众议员阿卜杜拉·哈穆德排名第一，获得42%的选票。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 2, 2021, in two states, New Jersey and Virginia, and a recall election was held in California on September 14. These elections form part of the 2021 United States elections. The last gubernatorial elections for New Jersey and Virginia were in 2017, and the last regular gubernatorial election for California was in 2018.

zh.s: 2021年11月2日，新泽西州和弗吉尼亚州举行州长选举；加利福尼亚州则于9月14日举行州长罢免选举。这些选举是2021年美国选举的一部分。新泽西州和弗吉尼亚州上一次举行州长选举是在2017年；加利福尼亚州上一次举行常规州长选举是在2018年。

en.s: The 2021 Manhattan District Attorney election was held on November 2, 2021, to elect the Manhattan District Attorney. The incumbent, Cyrus Vance Jr., had announced in March 2021 that he would not seek a fourth term. The Democratic primary election was held on June 22, 2021. Despite the introduction of ranked-choice voting for other elected positions in New York City, this race used plurality voting, as it is a state position, rather than a city position.

zh.s: 2021年曼哈顿地区检察官选举于11月2日举行，选出曼哈顿地区检察官。现任检察官赛勒斯·万斯二世于2021年3月宣布不竞选第四个任期。民主党初选于2021年6月22日举行。纽约市其他民选职位开始采用排序选择投票，但地区检察官属于州级职位而非市级职位，因此本次选举采用相对多数制。

en.t: 2021 New York City borough president elections
en.s: The 2021 New York City borough president elections were held on November 2, 2021. Four of the five incumbent borough presidents were unable to run for reelection due to term limits. Only the Queens borough president was eligible to seek re-election after winning a special election in 2020 (and won re-election).

zh.t: 2021年纽约市各行政区区长选举
zh.s: 纽约市各行政区区长选举于2021年11月2日举行。由于任期限制，5名现任区长中有4人不能竞选连任。只有皇后区区长可以寻求连任；他在2020年特别选举中当选后，这次成功连任。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of New Jersey on November 2, 2021. Primary elections were held on June 8. All elected offices at the state level are on the ballot in this election cycle, including Governor and Lieutenant Governor for four-year terms, all 80 seats in the New Jersey General Assembly for two-year terms, and all 40 seats in the State Senate for four-year terms.

zh.s: 新泽西州于2021年11月2日举行大选。初选于6月8日举行。该选举周期涉及所有州级民选职位，包括任期四年的州长和副州长、新泽西州众议院全部80个席位（任期两年），以及州参议院全部40个席位（任期四年）。

en.s: The Jersey City mayoral election of 2021 was held on November 2, 2021. Democrat Steve Fulop was re-elected to a third term with 67% of the vote.

zh.s: 2021年泽西市市长选举于11月2日举行。民主党人史蒂夫·富洛普以67%的选票获胜，连任第三个任期。

en.s: The 2021 New Jersey State Senate election was held on November 2, 2021. New Jersey voters elected state senators in all of the state's legislative districts for a two-year term to the New Jersey Senate. Republicans flipped the 3rd and 8th districts, and Democrats flipped the 16th. This was the first election since 1991 where Republicans posted a net gain of state Senate seats.

zh.s: 2021年新泽西州参议院选举于11月2日举行。新泽西州选民在全部州参议院选区选出州参议员，任期两年。共和党赢得第3和第8选区，民主党赢得第16选区。这是自1991年以来，共和党首次净增州参议院席位。

en.s: The 2021 New Jersey gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 2021, to elect the governor of New Jersey. Incumbent Governor Phil Murphy was first elected in 2017 with 56% of the vote and won re-election to a second term. Murphy and his running mate, Lt. Gov. Sheila Oliver, defeated the Republican ticket of Jack Ciattarelli and Diane Allen, 51.2% to 48%.

zh.s: 2021年新泽西州州长选举于11月2日举行，选出该州州长。现任州长菲尔·墨菲于2017年首次当选，得票率为56%；这次他与副州长竞选搭档希拉·奥利弗成功连任第二个任期，以51.2%对48%的得票率击败共和党候选人组合杰克·恰塔雷利和戴安·艾伦。

en.s: The 2021 Miami mayoral election took place on November 2, 2021. Incumbent Mayor Francis Suarez ran for re-election to a second term. He faced four little-known opponents, and was a clear favorite to win re-election, significantly outraising and outspending his opponents during the campaign. The Miami Herald reluctantly endorsed him for re-election, criticizing him for his role in the firing of Police Chief Art Acevedo and suggesting that City Commissioner Joe Carollo, a former Mayor, was "functioning as the de facto mayor."

zh.s: 2021年迈阿密市长选举于11月2日举行。现任市长弗朗西斯·苏亚雷斯竞选第二个任期。他面对4名知名度不高的对手，是连任的明显热门；竞选期间，他在筹款和竞选支出上都远超对手。《迈阿密先驱报》勉强支持他连任，同时批评他参与解雇警察局长阿特·阿塞维多，并指出前市长、市专员乔·卡罗洛“实际上在行使市长职权”。

en.s: The 2021 Texas constitutional amendment election took place on November 2, 2021. Texas voters statewide voted on eight proposed amendments to the Texas Constitution. All eight propositions were passed.

zh.t: 2021年得克萨斯州宪法修正案选举
zh.s: 2021年得克萨斯州宪法修正案选举于11月2日举行。得克萨斯州全州选民就8项拟议的州宪法修正案投票，8项提案全部通过。

en.s: The 2021 Boston mayoral election was held on November 2, 2021, to elect the mayor of Boston, Massachusetts. Incumbent mayor Marty Walsh was eligible to seek a third term. However, he resigned as mayor on March 22, 2021, after being confirmed as secretary of labor in the Cabinet of Joe Biden.

zh.s: 2021年11月2日举行波士顿市长选举。时任市长马蒂·沃尔什有资格竞选第三个任期，但他于2021年3月22日辞去市长职务，此前他已获任命进入乔·拜登内阁，出任劳工部长。

en.s: The 2021 Cincinnati mayoral election took place on November 2, 2021, to elect the mayor of Cincinnati, Ohio. The election was officially nonpartisan, with the top two candidates from the primary election on May 4, 2021 advancing to the general election, regardless of party. Incumbent Democratic mayor John Cranley, first elected in 2013, was term-limited and could not seek a third consecutive term.

zh.s: 2021年辛辛那提市长选举于11月2日举行，选出俄亥俄州辛辛那提市市长。此次选举正式以无党派方式举行，5月4日初选中得票最高的两名候选人进入大选，不分党派。民主党籍现任市长约翰·克兰利于2013年首次当选，因任期限制不能竞选连续第三个任期。

en.s: Two special elections for the Michigan Senate were held in the U.S. state of Michigan on November 2, 2021, in addition to various other local elections and ballot measures.

zh.s: 密歇根州于2021年11月2日举行两场州参议院特别选举，此外还举行了其他地方选举并对多项提案进行投票。

en.s: The 2021 New Jersey General Assembly election was held on November 2, 2021. New Jersey voters elected two assembly members in all of the state's legislative districts for a two-year term to the New Jersey General Assembly. All 80 seats of the New Jersey General Assembly were up for election. Democrats held a 52–28 majority in the lower house prior to the election.

zh.s: 2021年新泽西州众议院选举于11月2日举行。新泽西州选民在全部州议会选区选出众议员，每个选区选出2名议员，任期两年。州众议院全部80个席位都进行改选。选举前，民主党在下议院以52席对28席占多数。

en.s: A mayoral election was held on November 2, 2021, to elect the mayor of the U.S. city of Minneapolis. Incumbent DFL mayor Jacob Frey won reelection to a second term, becoming the first Minneapolis mayor to win a second term since R. T. Rybak in 2005. Minneapolis mayoral elections use instant-runoff voting, also known as ranked-choice voting. All candidates appear on the same ballot and there is no primary election of candidates.

zh.s: 美国明尼阿波利斯市于2021年11月2日举行市长选举。民主党—农民—劳工党（DFL）籍现任市长雅各布·弗雷获胜，连任第二个任期，成为自R·T·赖巴克于2005年连任以来，首位连任的明尼阿波利斯市长。该市市长选举采用即时决选投票，也称排序选择投票。所有候选人都出现在同一张选票上，不举行候选人初选。

en.s: The 2021 Virginia House of Delegates election for the 162nd Virginia General Assembly were held on November 2, 2021, to coincide with biennial elections in the U.S. state of Virginia. All 100 Delegates are elected to two-year terms in single-member constituencies. Primary elections took place on June 8. This election coincided with the 2021 Virginia Gubernatorial election, the Lieutenant Gubernatorial election, and lastly, the Attorney General election, all of which were won by Republicans.

zh.s: 2021年弗吉尼亚州众议院选举于2021年11月2日举行，选出第162届弗吉尼亚州议会的众议员，并与该州每两年举行一次的选举同时进行。众议院100个席位全部改选，议员由单一选区选出，任期两年。初选于6月8日举行。州长、副州长和总检察长选举也在同一天举行，三场选举均由共和党人获胜。

en.s: The city of Saint Paul, Minnesota held an election on November 2, 2021, to elect the mayor. It was held with ranked-choice voting, and there was no primary election. Few candidates filed to challenge incumbent mayor Melvin Carter III, and he easily won a second term with over 60% of first-preference votes.

zh.s: 明尼苏达州圣保罗市于2021年11月2日举行市长选举。选举采用排序选择投票制，没有初选。只有少数候选人挑战现任市长梅尔文·卡特三世，他轻松赢得第二个任期，第一轮得票率超过60%。

en.s: The 2021 Virginia elections were held on Tuesday, November 2, 2021. Republicans swept all three statewide races and won back control of the House of Delegates in an upset. Primary elections were held on June 8, 2021.

zh.s: 2021年弗吉尼亚州选举于2021年11月2日星期二举行。共和党赢得全部3个全州职位，并意外重新控制州众议院。初选于2021年6月8日举行。

en.t: 2021 New York City Public Advocate election
en.s: The 2021 New York City Public Advocate election was held on November 2, 2021. The incumbent, Jumaane Williams, was re-elected. Williams defeated Dr. Devi Nampiaparampil, a physician running on the Republican party line in the general election.

zh.s: 2021年纽约市公共倡导人选举于2021年11月2日举行。现任公共倡导人朱马尼·威廉姆斯成功连任。他击败了共和党提名人、医生德维·南皮亚帕拉姆皮尔。

en.s: The 2021 Cedar Rapids mayoral election was held on November 2, 2021, with a subsequent runoff election held on November 30, 2021. The first round of the election futured three major candidates. Candidate Tiffany O'Donnell strongly led the first round, with candidate Amara Andrews finishing in second place. Incumbent mayor Brad Hart failed to advance to the runoff, narrowly finishing behind Andrews.

zh.s: 2021年锡达拉皮兹市长选举于2021年11月2日举行，之后于11月30日举行第二轮选举。第一轮有3名主要候选人参选，蒂芙尼·奥唐奈明显领先，阿马拉·安德鲁斯位居第二。现任市长布拉德·哈特未能进入第二轮，得票略少于安德鲁斯。

en.s: A general election was held in Minneapolis on November 2, 2021. Minneapolis's mayor was up for election as well as all the seats on the City Council, the two elected seats on the Board of Estimate and Taxation, and all the seats on the Park and Recreation Board. Voters were able to rank up to three candidates for each office in order of preference.

zh.s: 明尼阿波利斯于2021年11月2日举行大选，选出市长、市议会全部议员、税务估值委员会的两名民选成员，以及公园与娱乐委员会的全部成员。选民可以按偏好顺序为每个职位最多排列3名候选人。

en.s: The 2021 mayoral election in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania was held on November 2, 2021. Two-term incumbent mayor Eric Papenfuse, a member of the Democratic Party, ran for a third term, but lost the re-nomination to City Council President Wanda Williams. On September 15, 2021, Papenfuse formally announced that he would run a write-in campaign in the November general election. Williams won the general election against Papenfuse by more than a 2–1 margin.

zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州哈里斯堡于2021年11月2日举行市长选举。民主党籍、已任两届的现任市长埃里克·帕彭富斯竞选第三个任期，但在党内提名中败给了市议会主席旺达·威廉姆斯。2021年9月15日，帕彭富斯正式宣布将在11月大选中以手写名字的方式参选。威廉姆斯最终以超过两倍的票数击败帕彭富斯。

en.s: The 2021 Lansing mayoral election was held on November 2, 2021, following a primary election on August 3, 2021. Incumbent Mayor Andy Schor ran for re-election to a second term. Schor originally faced a challenge from former Mayor Virgil Bernero, but following allegations of sexual harassment against Bernero, he dropped out of the race. Instead, Schor was challenged by two members of the City Council: Kathie Dunbar and Patricia Spitzley.

zh.s: 2021年兰辛市长选举于2021年11月2日举行，初选于2021年8月3日举行。现任市长安迪·肖尔竞选连任第二个任期。他原本将面对前市长维吉尔·贝尔纳罗的挑战，但贝尔纳罗被指控性骚扰后退出竞选。随后，市议会两名成员凯西·邓巴和帕特里夏·斯皮茨利成为肖尔的对手。

en.s: The 2021 United States state legislative elections were held on November 2, 2021. Three legislative chambers in two states, New Jersey and Virginia, held regularly scheduled elections. These off-year elections coincided with other state and local elections, including gubernatorial elections in both states. As a result of the elections, New Jersey retained its Democratic trifecta, while a divided government was established in Virginia, as Republicans won back the lower house of the Virginia legislature, which they lost two years earlier.

zh.s: 2021年美国州议会选举于2021年11月2日举行。新泽西州和弗吉尼亚州共有3个州议会院举行定期选举。这些非大选年选举与两州的州长选举等州和地方选举同时举行。选举后，新泽西州继续由民主党全面执政；弗吉尼亚州则形成分立政府，共和党重新控制了两年前失去的州众议院。

en.s: An election were held in Minneapolis on November 2, 2021, to elect representatives for all 13 wards of the Minneapolis City Council. These elections occurred alongside the mayoral race and several other municipal offices, including Park Board and Board of Estimate and Taxation positions. The council elections were conducted using a ranked-choice voting system, which allows voters to rank candidates by preference on their ballots.

zh.t: 2021年明尼阿波利斯市议会选举
zh.s: 明尼阿波利斯于2021年11月2日举行选举，选出代表市议会13个选区的议员。选举与市长选举及公园委员会、税务估值委员会等多个市政职位的选举同时进行。市议会选举采用排序选择投票制，选民可以按偏好顺序排列候选人。

en.s: The 2021 Virginia gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 2021, to elect the governor of Virginia. Republican businessman Glenn Youngkin defeated Democratic former governor Terry McAuliffe. Youngkin succeeded Democratic incumbent Ralph Northam who was term-limited and ineligible to seek a second consecutive term. The Democratic Party held its primary elections on June 8, 2021. McAuliffe won the primary with 62% of the vote.

zh.s: 2021年弗吉尼亚州州长选举于2021年11月2日举行。共和党商人格伦·扬金击败民主党前州长特里·麦考利夫。扬金接替民主党籍现任州长拉尔夫·诺瑟姆；诺瑟姆因任期限制，不能竞选连续第二个任期。民主党初选于2021年6月8日举行，麦考利夫以62%的得票率胜出。

en.s: Elections were held in Texas on November 2, 2021, including a special election to congress, multiple special elections to the Texas House of Representatives, eight legislatively referred ballot measures on the November 2 ballot, and many regularly scheduled local elections.

zh.s: 得克萨斯州选举于2021年11月2日举行，包括一场联邦众议院特别选举、多场得克萨斯州众议院特别选举、列入11月2日选票的8项立法机关转交公投议案，以及多项按计划举行的地方选举。

en.s: The 2021 Virginia Attorney General election was held on November 2, 2021, to elect the attorney general of Virginia. Republican state delegate Jason Miyares defeated Democratic incumbent Mark Herring. Herring conceded defeat at 5:02 PM EST the following day, November 3. Miyares became the first Cuban-American and Hispanic to be elected to statewide office in Virginia. Miyares was sworn into office on January 15, 2022.

zh.t: 2021年弗吉尼亚州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2021年弗吉尼亚州总检察长选举于2021年11月2日举行。共和党州众议员杰森·米亚雷斯击败民主党籍现任总检察长马克·赫林。赫林于次日即11月3日下午5时02分承认败选。米亚雷斯成为弗吉尼亚州首位当选全州职位的古巴裔和西班牙裔人士，并于2022年1月15日宣誓就职。

en.s: The 2021 Virginia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 2, 2021, to elect the lieutenant governor of Virginia. Republican former state delegate Winsome Earle-Sears defeated Democratic state delegate Hala Ayala. Earle-Sears succeeded Democratic incumbent Justin Fairfax who ran for the Democratic gubernatorial nomination. Ayala won the Democratic primary held on June 8, 2021, with 38% of the vote.

zh.s: 2021年弗吉尼亚州副州长选举于2021年11月2日举行。共和党前州众议员温瑟姆·厄尔—西尔斯击败民主党州众议员哈拉·阿亚拉，当选副州长。她接替民主党籍现任副州长贾斯汀·费尔法克斯；费尔法克斯竞选民主党州长提名。阿亚拉在2021年6月8日举行的民主党初选中胜出，得票率为38%。

loc: 美国宾夕法尼亚州阿伦敦

en.s: The 2021 mayoral election in Allentown, Pennsylvania was held on November 2, 2021. The primary election was held on May 18, 2021.

zh.t: 2021年宾夕法尼亚州阿伦敦市长选举
zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州阿伦敦市长选举于2021年11月2日举行。初选于2021年5月18日举行。

en.s: The 2021 New York City Council elections were held on November 2, 2021. The primary elections were held on June 22, 2021. There were several special elections for seats vacated in 2020 and early 2021; these special elections were the first to use ranked-choice voting in city council elections after it was approved by a ballot question in 2019 and the second to use ranked-choice voting since New York City repealed PR-STV in 1945.

zh.s: 2021年纽约市议会选举于2021年11月2日举行。初选于2021年6月22日举行。2020年和2021年初，有多个席位举行了特别选举。这些是纽约市议会选举在2019年公投通过采用排序选择投票制后，首次采用该投票制的特别选举；也是纽约市在1945年废除单记可让渡投票制后，第二次采用排序选择投票制。

en.s: The 2021 Cleveland mayoral election took place on November 2, 2021, to elect the mayor of Cleveland, Ohio. The election was officially nonpartisan, with the top two candidates from the September 14 primary election advancing to the general election, regardless of party. Incumbent Democratic Mayor Frank G. Jackson was eligible to run for reelection to a fifth term, but instead chose to retire.

zh.s: 2021年俄亥俄州克利夫兰市市长选举于11月2日举行。此次选举正式以无党派方式举行，9月14日初选中得票最高的两名候选人进入大选，不分党派。民主党籍现任市长弗兰克·G·杰克逊有资格竞选第五个任期，但决定退休。

en.s: The 2021 Albuquerque mayoral election was held on November 2, 2021, to elect the mayor of Albuquerque, New Mexico. The election was nonpartisan; candidates' party affiliations did not appear on the ballot. Incumbent mayor Tim Keller won re-election to a second term by earning a majority of the vote in the primary election, negating the need for a runoff.

zh.s: 2021年新墨西哥州阿尔伯克基市市长选举于11月2日举行。选举以无党派方式进行，选票上不显示候选人的党派。现任市长蒂姆·凯勒在初选中获得过半选票，成功连任第二个任期，因此无需举行第二轮选举。

en.s: The 2021 Durham, North Carolina mayoral election was held on November 2, 2021, to elect the next mayor of Durham, North Carolina. Mayor Steve Schewel was elected with 59.5% of the vote in 2017, and was reelected with 83.4% in 2019. On May 27, 2021, he announced that he would not seek a third term. Seven candidates filed to run in this election to succeed Schewel as mayor.

zh.t: 2021年北卡罗来纳州达勒姆市长选举
zh.s: 2021年北卡罗来纳州达勒姆市市长选举于11月2日举行。市长史蒂夫·舍韦尔在2017年获得59.5%的选票当选，2019年以83.4%的选票连任。2021年5月27日，他宣布不竞选第三个任期。共有7名候选人登记参选，竞逐接替舍韦尔担任市长。

en.s: The 2021 Stamford mayoral election was held on November 2, 2021. Incumbent Democratic mayor David Martin sought re-election to a third term in office, but lost renomination to state representative Caroline Simmons. Simmons, who was also endorsed by the Independent Party, faced unaffiliated candidate Bobby Valentine. Initial results indicated Simmons had a slight lead over Valentine. Absentee ballots swung heavily in Simmons' favor resulting in a 5-points lead over Valentine.

zh.s: 2021年斯坦福市市长选举于11月2日举行。民主党籍现任市长戴维·马丁竞选第三个任期，但在党内提名竞争中败给州众议员卡罗琳·西蒙斯。西蒙斯也获独立党支持，她在大选中对阵无党派候选人鲍比·瓦伦丁。初步计票显示西蒙斯略微领先；缺席选票的结果则大幅倾向西蒙斯，使她最终领先瓦伦丁5个百分点。

en.s: The 2021 Boston City Council election was held on November 2, 2021. All thirteen councillors from the nine districts and four councillors at-large were up for election. Elections in Boston are officially nonpartisan. Councillors Andrea Campbell, Annissa Essaibi George, Kim Janey, and Michelle Wu ran in the mayoral election, while Matt O'Malley did not seek re-election. Councillors Ricardo Arroyo, Frank Baker, Kenzie Bok, Liz Breadon, Lydia Edwards, Michael F.

zh.s: 2021年波士顿市议会选举于11月2日举行。9个选区的13名议员及4名市议会普选议员全部改选。波士顿选举在官方上不设党派。市议员安德烈娅·坎贝尔、安妮莎·埃萨伊比·乔治、金·珍妮和米歇尔·吴竞选市长，马特·奥马利则未寻求连任。

en.s: The 2021 King County Executive election took place on November 2, 2021, following a primary election on August 3, 2021. Incumbent County Executive Dow Constantine ran for re-election to a fourth term. He was challenged by four opponents, the most well-known of whom was State Senator Joe Nguyen. In the nonpartisan primary, Constantine placed first with 52 percent of the vote and advanced to the general election against Nguyen, who won 33 percent.

zh.s: 2021年金县县行政长官选举于11月2日举行，初选于2021年8月3日举行。民主党籍现任行政长官道·康斯坦丁竞选第四个任期，对手有4人，其中最知名的是州参议员乔·阮。无党派初选中，康斯坦丁以52%的选票排名第一，进入大选；阮获得33%的选票，也进入大选。

en.s: The 2021 Kansas City, Kansas mayoral election was held on November 2, 2021, for the office of Mayor/CEO of the United Government of Wyandotte County and Kansas City, Kansas. The election was officially nonpartisan, with a primary being held on August 3, 2021. Incumbent David Alvey and Tyrone Garner took the top two spots in the primary election and were on ballot in the general election.

zh.t: 2021年堪萨斯州堪萨斯城市市长选举
zh.s: 2021年堪萨斯州堪萨斯城市市长选举于11月2日举行，选出怀恩多特县与堪萨斯城联合政府的市长兼首席执行官。此次选举以无党派方式举行，初选于2021年8月3日进行。现任市长戴维·阿尔维和泰隆·加纳在初选中排名前两位，进入大选。

en.s: The 2021 Westchester County Executive election was held on November 2, 2021. The election was between incumbent county executive George Latimer and former advisor to former county executive Rob Astorino Christine Sculti. The elections were held on the same day as elections for Westchester County Board of Legislators. Latimer defeated Sculti by a comfortable margin.

zh.t: 2021年韦斯特彻斯特县县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2021年韦斯特彻斯特县县行政长官选举于11月2日举行。候选人是现任县行政长官乔治·拉蒂默和前县行政长官罗伯·阿斯托里诺的前顾问克里斯汀·斯库尔蒂。选举与韦斯特彻斯特县立法机构选举在同一天举行。拉蒂默以较大优势击败斯库尔蒂。

en.s: The 2021 Annapolis mayoral election was held on November 2, 2021, to elect the mayor of Annapolis, Maryland. Incumbent Democratic mayor Gavin Buckley was re-elected to a second term.

zh.t: 2021年马里兰州安纳波利斯市长选举
zh.s: 2021年马里兰州安纳波利斯市长选举于2021年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任市长加文·巴克利成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 2021 Lehigh County Executive election was held on November 2, 2021. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Phillips Armstrong ran for re-election to a second term. He won the Democratic primary unopposed and faced the Republican nominee, former County Controller Glenn Eckhart, in the general election. Armstrong defeated Eckhart by a narrow margin, winning re-election with 52 percent of the vote.

zh.t: 2021年宾夕法尼亚州利哈伊县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2021年宾夕法尼亚州利哈伊县行政长官选举于2021年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任行政长官菲利普斯·阿姆斯特朗竞选连任第二个任期。他在民主党初选中没有对手，大选对手是共和党提名人、前县审计长格伦·埃克哈特。阿姆斯特朗以52%的得票率小胜埃克哈特，成功连任。

en.s: The 2021 Erie County Executive election was held on November 2, 2021. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Kathy Dahlkemper declined to run for re-election to a third term. Tyler Titus, the President of the Erie City School District, and the first openly transgender person elected to office in Pennsylvania, narrowly won the Democratic primary to succeed Dahlkemper.

zh.t: 2021年宾夕法尼亚州伊利县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2021年宾夕法尼亚州伊利县行政长官选举于2021年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任行政长官凯茜·达尔肯珀决定不竞选第三个任期。伊利市学区主席泰勒·泰特斯在民主党初选中险胜，成为接替达尔肯珀的提名人；他是宾夕法尼亚州首位公开身份的跨性别当选官员。

en.s: The 2021 Rochester mayoral election was held on November 2, 2021. Incumbent Democratic mayor Lovely Warren ran for reelection to a third term in office but was defeated in the Democratic primary by city councilman Malik Evans.

zh.t: 2021年纽约州罗切斯特市长选举
zh.s: 2021年纽约州罗切斯特市长选举于2021年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任市长洛夫利·沃伦竞选连任第三个任期，但在民主党初选中败给了市议员马利克·埃文斯。

en.s: The 2021 Atlantic City mayoral election was held on November 2, 2021, to elect the Mayor of Atlantic City, New Jersey. Primary elections were held on June 7. Incumbent Democrat Marty Small Sr., who was running for a full term after being elected to the mayor position by City Council following Frank Gilliam's resignation, won re-election to his first full term against Republican opponent Tom Forkin and several other opponents running third-party.

zh.t: 2021年新泽西州大西洋城市长选举
zh.s: 2021年新泽西州大西洋城市长选举于2021年11月2日举行，初选于6月7日举行。民主党籍现任市长马蒂·斯莫尔二世在市议会于弗兰克·吉列姆辞职后选他出任市长，因此此次是他竞选首个完整任期。他成功连任，击败共和党对手汤姆·福金和其他第三党候选人。

en.s: The 2021 Pittsburgh mayoral election took place on November 2, 2021. The primary election was held on May 18, 2021. The Democratic nominee, State Representative Ed Gainey, defeated the Republican nominee, retired police officer Tony Moreno. Incumbent Democratic Mayor Bill Peduto ran for re-election to a third term in office, but lost renomination to state representative Ed Gainey. Four Democrats and no Republicans filed to appear on their respective primary ballots.

zh.t: 2021年宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡市长选举
zh.s: 2021年宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡市长选举于2021年11月2日举行。初选于2021年5月18日举行。民主党提名人、州众议员埃德·盖尼击败共和党提名人、退休警员托尼·莫雷诺。民主党籍现任市长比尔·佩杜托竞选第三个任期，但在党内提名中败给了州众议员盖尼。共有4名民主党人和0名共和党人登记参加各自的初选。

en.s: The 2021 Cleveland City Council election was held on November 2, 2021. The primary elections were held on September 14, 2021. All 17 seats on Cleveland City Council were up for election for four-year terms. Elections in Cleveland are officially nonpartisan, with the top two candidates from the primary election advancing to the general election, regardless of party.

zh.t: 2021年俄亥俄州克利夫兰市议会选举
zh.s: 2021年俄亥俄州克利夫兰市议会选举于2021年11月2日举行。初选于2021年9月14日举行。市议会17个席位全部改选，议员任期四年。克利夫兰选举正式不设党派；初选中得票最高的两名候选人进入大选，不受党派限制。

en.s: The 2021 Seattle city attorney election was held on November 2, 2021. Incumbent City Attorney Pete Holmes sought reelection to a fourth term in office, but came third place in the officially nonpartisan August 3 primary election and failed to advance to the general election, with both Nicole Thomas-Kennedy and Ann Davison finishing ahead of Holmes in the primary. Davison defeated Thomas-Kennedy in the general election.

zh.t: 2021年华盛顿州西雅图市检察官选举
zh.s: 2021年西雅图市检察官选举于2021年11月2日举行。现任市检察官皮特·霍姆斯竞选第四个任期，但在8月3日举行的无党派初选中排名第三，未能进入大选。妮可·托马斯—肯尼迪和安·戴维森的初选得票都高于霍姆斯。戴维森在大选中击败托马斯—肯尼迪。

en.s: The 2021 Atlanta mayoral election occurred on November 2, 2021, with a runoff between the top two candidates taking place on November 30. Incumbent mayor Keisha Lance Bottoms did not seek reelection. City council member Andre Dickens defeated council president Felicia Moore in the runoff by a margin of more than 20%. Candidates eliminated in the general election included former mayor Kasim Reed and attorney Sharon Gay.

zh.t: 2021年佐治亚州亚特兰大市长选举
zh.s: 2021年佐治亚州亚特兰大市长选举于2021年11月2日举行，得票最高的两名候选人随后于11月30日参加第二轮选举。现任市长凯莎·兰斯·博顿斯没有竞选连任。市议员安德烈·狄更斯在第二轮中以超过20个百分点的优势击败市议会主席费莉西亚·摩尔。大选中落败的候选人包括前市长卡西姆·里德和律师莎伦·盖伊。

en.s: The 2021 Nassau County, New York Executive election was held on November 2, 2021. The election was between incumbent county executive Laura Curran and former advisor to former county executive Bruce Blakeman. The elections were held on the same day as elections for county legislature. Blakeman defeated Curran by a close margin of 2,146 votes.

zh.t: 2021年纽约州拿骚县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2021年纽约州拿骚县行政长官选举于2021年11月2日举行。对阵双方是现任行政长官劳拉·柯伦和前任行政长官的前顾问布鲁斯·布莱克曼。该选举与县议会选举同日举行。布莱克曼以2,146票的微弱优势击败柯伦。

en.s: The 2021 Detroit mayoral election occurred on November 2, 2021. The Mayor of Detroit is elected on a non-partisan basis, where the candidates are not listed by political party. A non-partisan primary election was held on August 3, 2021. The top two finishers (incumbent mayor Mike Duggan and former deputy mayor Anthony Adams) advanced to the general election on November 2, 2021.

zh.t: 2021年密歇根州底特律市长选举
zh.s: 2021年密歇根州底特律市长选举于2021年11月2日举行。底特律市长选举不设党派，选票上不标注候选人的党派。无党派初选于2021年8月3日举行，得票最高的两人——现任市长迈克·杜根和前副市长安东尼·亚当斯——进入11月2日的大选。

en.s: The 2021 Seattle City Council election were held on November 2, 2021. Two seats of the nine-member Seattle City Council were up for election.

zh.t: 2021年华盛顿州西雅图市议会选举
zh.s: 2021年西雅图市议会选举于2021年11月2日举行。西雅图市议会9个席位中有2席改选。

en.s: The 2021 Northampton County Executive election was held on November 2, 2021. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Lamont McClure ran for re-election to a second term. He won the Democratic primary unopposed and faced Republican activist Steve Lynch in the general election. During the campaign, Lynch spread conspiracy theories about the results of the 2020 presidential election and suggested that he would not accept the results of the County Executive election.

zh.t: 2021年宾夕法尼亚州北安普顿县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2021年宾夕法尼亚州北安普顿县行政长官选举于2021年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任行政长官拉蒙特·麦克卢尔竞选连任第二个任期。他在民主党初选中没有对手，大选对手是共和党活动人士史蒂夫·林奇。竞选期间，林奇传播有关2020年总统选举结果的阴谋论，并表示可能不接受县行政长官选举结果。

en.s: The 2021 Buffalo mayoral election was held on November 2, 2021. Democratic incumbent Byron Brown won re-election to a fifth term, defeating Democratic nominee India Walton through a write-in campaign. Brown's victory marked the first time since 1985 that Buffalo did not elect the Democratic nominee for mayor. Four-time incumbent Democratic Mayor Byron Brown lost the June Democratic primary to India Walton, a political activist and nurse.

zh.s: 2021年纽约州布法罗市长选举于2021年11月2日举行。民主党籍现任市长拜伦·布朗成功连任第五个任期。他通过手写名字的方式参选，击败了民主党提名人因迪娅·沃尔顿。自1985年以来，这是布法罗首次没有选出民主党提名人担任市长。已任四届的布朗在6月的民主党初选中败给了政治活动人士兼护士沃尔顿。

en.s: The 2021 Nassau County Legislature Election was held on November 2, 2021, to elect the 19 legislators in Nassau County, New York, one from each of the county's legislative districts. The elections coincided with the county executive and district attorney elections well as other elections to various cities, towns, and villages. The Republican Party gained one seat, increasing their majority from 11–8 to 12–7.

zh.s: 2021年纽约州拿骚县议会选举于2021年11月2日举行，选出该县19名议员，每个立法选区各选出一人。选举与县行政长官和地区检察官选举以及多个市镇的选举同时举行。共和党增加了1个席位，将多数优势从11席对8席扩大到12席对7席。

en.t: 2021 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: There were six special elections to the United States House of Representatives in 2021 during the 117th United States Congress. All of the elections were won by the party previously holding the seat. Therefore, there were no net changes in party.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 2021年美国联邦众议院特别选举
zh.s: 2021年，第117届国会期间共举行了6场美国联邦众议院特别选举。所有席位均由原先占有该席位的政党保住，因此两党席位没有净变化。
zh.n: 本条目采用来源信息框标注的结束日期。

en.s: The 2021 St. Petersburg, Florida, mayoral election was held on August 24, 2021, with a runoff on November 2 because no candidate received more than 50% of the vote in the first round. It elected the mayor of St. Petersburg, Florida. Incumbent Democratic mayor Rick Kriseman was term-limited and could not seek a third term in office. Municipal elections in St. Petersburg are officially nonpartisan.
en.n: This entry records the listed event date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 2021年佛罗里达州圣彼得堡市长选举
zh.s: 2021年佛罗里达州圣彼得堡市长选举于2021年8月24日举行；由于首轮无人得票超过50%，11月2日举行了第二轮投票。选举产生了圣彼得堡市长。民主党籍现任市长里克·克里斯曼已达任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期。该市的市政选举名义上不分党派。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列出的事件日期。

en.t: 2022 President of the Senate of the Czech Republic election
en.s: Election of the President of the Senate of the Czech Republic was held on 2 November 2022 after 2022 Senate election. The incumbent president ran unopposed and was elected for another term.

zh.s: 捷克参议院议长选举于2022年11月2日举行，在2022年参议院选举后进行。现任议长没有对手，成功连任。

en.s: The Ethiopia–Tigray peace agreement, also called the Pretoria Agreement or the Cessation of Hostilities Agreement (CoHA), is a peace treaty between the government of Ethiopia and the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) that was signed 2 November 2022, wherein both parties agreed to a "permanent cessation of hostilities" to end the Tigray war. The agreement was made effective the next day on 3 November, marking the second anniversary of the war.

zh.t: 埃塞俄比亚—提格雷和平协议
zh.s: 埃塞俄比亚—提格雷和平协议又称《比勒陀利亚协议》或《停止敌对行动协议》（CoHA），是埃塞俄比亚政府与提格雷人民解放阵线（TPLF）签署的和平条约。协议于2022年11月2日签署，双方同意“永久停止敌对行动”，以结束提格雷战争。协议于次日（11月3日）生效，正值战争爆发两周年。

en.s: The 2022 Iranian Super Cup was the 8th Iranian Super Cup, an annual football match played between the winners of the previous season's Persian Gulf Pro League, Esteghlal, and the previous season's Hazfi Cup, Nassaji. It was played on 2 November 2022 at the Shahid Bahonar Stadium, Kerman. Esteghlal Tehran defeated Nassaji 1–0 to win their first title.

zh.s: 2022年伊朗超级杯是第8届伊朗超级杯，这项年度足球赛由上赛季波斯湾职业联赛冠军德黑兰独立队对阵上赛季哈兹菲杯冠军马赞德兰纺织队。比赛于2022年11月2日在克尔曼的沙希德·巴霍纳尔体育场举行。德黑兰独立队以1比0击败马赞德兰纺织队，首次夺冠。

en.s: The 35th Tokyo International Film Festival was a film festival that took place from 24 October to 2 November 2022. American writer-director Julie Taymor served as jury president. With The Beasts winning the Tokyo Grand Prix, the festival's top prize, Rodrigo Sorogoyen became the second Spanish director to achieve the prize, after Alejandro Amenábar in 1998.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第35届东京国际电影节于2022年10月24日至11月2日举行。美国编剧兼导演朱莉·泰莫担任评审团主席。《野兽》（The Beasts）获得电影节最高奖东京大奖后，罗德里戈·索罗戈延成为第二位获此奖的西班牙导演，前一位是1998年的亚历杭德罗·阿梅纳瓦尔。

en.t: Israeli military announces encirclement of Gaza City
en.s: On November 2, 2023, the Israeli military said its troops had completed the encirclement of Gaza City in the Gaza Strip. Its forces had been conducting ground operations in northern Gaza while fighting Palestinian armed groups during the Gaza war. The encirclement marked a new phase in the campaign around the city; fighting there had begun before November 2.
en.n: On November 2 the Israeli military announced the city's encirclement; ground fighting had begun earlier.

zh.t: 以色列军方宣布完成对加沙城的包围
zh.s: 2023年11月2日，以色列军方表示，其部队已完成对加沙地带加沙城的包围。此前，以军已在加沙地带北部展开地面行动，并与巴勒斯坦武装组织交战。包围加沙城标志着当地战事进入新阶段；城内及周边的战斗在11月2日以前已经开始。
zh.n: 以色列军方于11月2日宣布包围加沙城；当地地面战斗此前已经开始。

en.s: On November 2, 2023, the Armenian government announced that it had foiled an attempted coup dubbed "Northern Leaflet drop" and the "National Salvation Uprising" by a group of anti-Government activists.

zh.t: 2023年11月亚美尼亚政变未遂指控
zh.s: 2023年11月2日，亚美尼亚政府宣布挫败了一起政变企图。政府称，这次行动由一群反政府活动人士发起，并称其为“北方传单投放行动”和“民族拯救起义”。

en.s: The 2024 Crown Jewel was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by the American company WWE. It was the sixth Crown Jewel and took place on November 2, 2024, at the Mohammed Abdo Arena in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia as part of Riyadh Season, held primarily for wrestlers from the promotion's Raw and SmackDown brand divisions, with one match involving wrestlers from WWE's developmental brand NXT.

zh.s: 2024年皇冠珠宝大赛是职业摔角付费观看和网络直播赛事，由美国公司WWE制作。这是第六届皇冠珠宝大赛，于2024年11月2日在沙特阿拉伯利雅得的穆罕默德·阿卜杜体育馆举行，属于利雅得季活动的一部分。参赛选手主要来自WWE的Raw和SmackDown品牌，还有一场比赛由WWE发展品牌NXT的选手参加。

en.t: November 2024 Green Party (Czech Republic) leadership election
en.s: The Green Party (Greens) leadership election of 2024 was held on 2 November 2024. Both Gabriela Svárovská and Matěj Pomahač ran unopposed and thus were elected.

zh.s: 捷克绿党于2024年11月2日举行领导层选举。加布里埃拉·斯瓦罗夫斯卡和马泰·波马哈奇都没有对手，因此当选。

en.t: UFC Fight Night: Moreno vs. Albazi
en.s: UFC Fight Night: Moreno vs. Albazi (also known as UFC Fight Night 246 and UFC on ESPN+ 104) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on November 2, 2024, at Rogers Place in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada.

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜：莫雷诺对阵阿尔巴齐
zh.s: UFC格斗之夜：莫雷诺对阵阿尔巴齐又称UFC格斗之夜246和UFC ESPN+ 104，是终极格斗冠军赛主办的综合格斗赛事，于2024年11月2日在加拿大艾伯塔省埃德蒙顿的罗杰斯体育馆举行。

en.s: Municipal elections were held in the city of Montreal, Quebec, Canada, on November 2, 2025, as part of the 2025 Quebec municipal elections. The incumbent Projet Montréal–led council sought re-election to a third consecutive term under new leader Luc Rabouin; the party was defeated by Ensemble Montréal, led by former federal Liberal MP Soraya Martinez Ferrada. They won a majority on city council, and Martinez Ferrada defeated Luc Rabouin in the mayoral election.

zh.s: 加拿大魁北克省蒙特利尔市于2025年11月2日举行市级选举，是2025年魁北克市级选举的一部分。由现任市议会多数党蒙特利尔计划党主导的市议会寻求连任第三个连续任期，该党由新任党魁吕克·拉布安领导；但该党败给由前联邦自由党议员索拉娅·马丁内斯·费拉达领导的蒙特利尔联合党。蒙特利尔联合党赢得市议会多数，马丁内斯·费拉达也在市长选举中击败拉布安。

en.s: The 2025 municipal elections in Quebec were held on November 2, 2025. Under the Act respecting elections and referendums in municipalities, municipal general elections in all municipalities in the Canadian province of Quebec must be held every four years on the first Sunday of November. Voters in the province of Quebec elected mayors, councillors, and all other elected officials in all of the province's municipalities.

zh.s: 魁北克省市级选举于2025年11月2日举行。根据《市政选举和公投法》，加拿大魁北克省所有市镇每四年必须在11月的第一个星期日举行市级大选。魁北克省各地选民选出市长、市议员和其他民选公职人员。
